article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza A Naik di September, Dinkes Medan Perkuat Kesiapsiagaan Puskesmas dan Rumah Sakit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A cases rise in September, Medan Health Office strengthens preparedness of community health centers and hospitals
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases rose in Medan City, Indonesia, with 15 Influenza A and 3 Influenza B reported from January through September 2026, and September activity increasing. Acting Head of the Medan City Health Office, Dr. Surya Syahputra Pulungan, M.Kes, attributes rapid spread to the highly contagious Influenza A virus and stresses heightened preparedness. Following an order from Mayor Rico Tri Putra Bayu Waas, Dinkes Medan issued a preparedness letter to all Puskesmas (community health centers) and hospitals to strengthen response and surveillance. Focus on high-risk groups—the elderly, those with comorbidities, and travelers. Community measures include PHBS, handwashing, coughing/sneezing etiquette, and masking for those with symptoms. Citizens are urged to seek early evaluation at Puskesmas for fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, malaise, or myalgia; screening protocols include fever >38°C with cough and symptoms ≤10 days, plus similar hospital screening for inpatients.

triage.headline_ja: 9月にインフルエンザA型症例が増加、メダン保健局が保健センターと病院の準備態勢を強化
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節性インフルエンザ（A型15件、B型3件）の報告であり、重症例や異常な流行の兆候はなく、行政が通常の予防啓発対応を行っているのみで、国際的拡大リスクも低い。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの通常範囲内の増加であり、市当局がルーティンの予防措置を講じている段階。対象国リストにIndonesiaは含まれるが、イベント自体の重大性が低いためverified_locationsには計上しない基準に該当せず、念のため空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Қытай ғалымдары кене арқылы жұғып, белгісіз ауру тудыратын жаңа вирусты анықтады
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chinese scientists identify a new virus transmitted by ticks that causes an unknown disease.
article.articleSummary: Asian longhorned tick nairovirus (ALTNV) is a newly identified tick-borne pathogen (Nairoviridae) linked to an unknown febrile illness in endemic areas of China. Beijing researchers analyzed 3,163 tick-bite patients and found ALTNV infection in 10.4% of cases; among DBV (Dabi virus)-negative patients, ALTNV accounted for 15.1% of illnesses. ALTNV's key symptoms include fatigue (84%), gastrointestinal disturbances (80%), thrombocytopenia (38%), and elevated transaminases (36%); all monoinfected patients recovered. Co-infection with DBV occurred in 38 individuals, who showed 61% respiratory symptoms, 84% renal impairment, and an 18.4% mortality rate. Surveillance of 47,428 ticks across 15 Chinese provinces detected ALTNV RNA in 1.3% of ticks, most frequently in Haemaphysalis longicornis ticks (about 1.8%). The study, published in the New England Journal of Medicine, highlights a potentially emerging tick-borne threat in China.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の科学者、マダニ媒介で未知の疾患を引き起こす新型ウイルスを同定
triage.triage_reason: 中国で新規マダニ媒介ウイルス（ALTNV）がNEJMで報告され、共感染時に高い致死率が確認されたが、現時点では急性アウトブレイクの報告ではなく研究報告であり、国際的拡大の証拠もないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 本報告は学術論文（NEJM掲載）に基づく新規病原体の発見であり、現時点でのアウトブレイク発生を示すものではない。共感染例で18.4%の致死率が報告されているため、今後の症例報告や公衆衛生当局の対応を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Covid, Broccolo: "Ripresa attesa, il virus ormai è endemico
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19, Broccolo: "Expected recovery, the virus is now endemic."
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 is now endemic, with SARS-CoV-2 potentially causing one or two waves per year, not following strict influenza-like seasonality, according to Francesco Broccolo, clinical microbiologist at the University of Salento. Among the circulating variants are NB181 and XFG, both descended from the JN-1 lineage. Spike-protein mutations may help these strains evade antibodies and trigger new infections in previously exposed people, but there is no evidence of increased clinical severity; they spread more easily rather than being more dangerous. Rising case numbers are driven by school and workplace return, more time indoors, and waning immunity over months. In China, late July–early August positivity rose above 20% without imposing major hospital strain. Protection should focus on the vulnerable: test symptomatic individuals, limit contact with the vulnerable, ensure good ventilation, and sustain genomic surveillance and laboratory diagnostics beyond emergencies as an early warning system.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19、ブロッコロ氏「流行の再燃は予想される、ウイルスはもはや風土病化した」
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は既にエンデミック化しているとの専門家見解であり、重症度増加の証拠もなく、異常性・緊急性に乏しいため見送り。
triage.notes: 記事はイタリアの専門家によるCOVID-19のエンデミック化に関する解説記事。中国の症例増加について言及があるが、イベント発生国として主題化されておらず、イタリアも対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Doctors Without Borders Worker Contracts Ebola in Congo, Evacuated to Netherlands
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues with confirmed infections and deaths since it began. A Doctors Without Borders (MSF) worker contracted Ebola while helping fight the DRC's largest-ever outbreak and was evacuated to the Netherlands for treatment. The outbreak remains difficult to contain despite an expanding response and ongoing control efforts. The report emphasizes the scale of the outbreak in the DRC and the ongoing international response, including medical evacuation of an infected worker for care.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団の職員がコンゴでエボラに感染、オランダへ搬送
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模とされるエボラ流行が継続中であり、国際医療従事者の感染・国際搬送という越境事案が発生していることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: オランダは感染者の搬送先であり、発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCでの『過去最大規模』の流行継続と国際医療従事者の感染搬送は国際的拡大・管理能力の懸念を示す重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: 지오영, ﻿가축전염병 대비 동물의약품 공급망 점검
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: GeoYoung inspects the veterinary medicines supply chain in preparation for livestock infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: GeoYoung to bolster storage and delivery of veterinary medicines as South Korea enters the 'Special Livestock Disease Countermeasures Period' through February next year. Korea currently faces nationwide outbreaks of foot-and-mouth disease, African swine fever, lumpy skin disease, and bovine tuberculosis, alongside avian influenza and reports of new SAT1 strain foot-and-mouth disease in neighboring China and Mongolia, prompting heightened biosecurity. GeoYoung will pre-emptively inspect cold-chain facilities, inventory, and emergency delivery systems to ensure rapid response if outbreaks occur. Chair Cho Seon-hye stated that the effectiveness of livestock disease control hinges on prompt on-site supply capabilities and pledged seamless distribution so medicines reach where needed without gaps. The initiative emphasizes supply-chain resilience to support veterinary authorities during the extended outbreak-preparedness window.

triage.headline_ja: 지오영、가축전염병 대비 동물의약품 공급망 점검（GeoYoung、家畜伝染病に備え動物用医薬品の供給網を点検）
triage.triage_reason: 韓国で口蹄疫・アフリカ豚熱・ランピースキン病・牛結核など複数の家畜伝染病が全国的に発生し、政府が「特別家畜伝染病対策期間」を宣言。さらに中国・モンゴルで新型SAT1株口蹄疫の報告があり越境拡大の懸念があるため、IHR・WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は韓国（対象国リスト外）の動物用医薬品企業による供給網点検であり、人への直接感染報告はないが、複数の家畜伝染病が同時多発し、中国・モンゴルで新型SAT1株口蹄疫の発生が報告されている点を考慮しPICKUPとした。鳥インフルエンザ（ヒト感染の可能性含む疾患タグ）も含まれるため人獣共通感染症としての注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 지오영, 겨울철 가축전염병 대비 동물의약품 공급망 점검 - 매일일보
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: GEOYOUNG conducts inspection of the veterinary medicines supply chain in preparation for winter livestock infectious diseases - Maeil Ilbo
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-02, GEOYOUNG announced strengthened storage and distribution of animal medicines during the Livestock Infectious Disease Special Quarantine Period (Oct–Feb) to fortify winter control. Incheon and Deokpyeong centers will audit cold-chain facilities, stock status, and emergency delivery to enable rapid response to outbreaks. Fall–winter peaks raise risks of Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD), Classical Swine Fever (CSF), Lumpy Skin Disease, and Bovine Tuberculosis, with rising avian influenza threats from wild birds and SAT1 FMD reports in China and Mongolia. GEOYOUNG handles 373 veterinary medicines; 9.3 million units were processed January–September. Deokpyeong Center (4,620 m2) maintains 2–8°C refrigeration and ≤-20°C ultra-cold storage. Vaccines require strict temperature control; many are refrigerated or freeze-dried; liquid vaccines must be mixed before use. Major vaccines include FMD, CSF, PRRS, bovine mastitis; companion vaccines include DHPPi, canine coronavirus, Kennel Cough, canine influenza, Rabies, FeLV. Chairman Jang Hye emphasizes timely field supply.

triage.headline_ja: ジオヨン、冬季家畜伝染病に備え動物用医薬品供給網を点検 - 毎日日報
triage.triage_reason: 韓国の動物用医薬品企業による季節的な供給体制点検に関する予防的・業務的記事であり、具体的な新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。対象国における感染症発生事例も確認されない。
triage.notes: 記事は韓国企業GEOYOUNGの冬季家畜伝染病対策としての医薬品供給網点検に関する内容。中国・モンゴルでのSAT1型FMD報告に言及があるが、これは背景情報であり記事の主題ではなく、また両国とも評価対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とした。中国(1814991)は発生地域として付与されているが、記事の主題国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Doctors Without Borders Worker Contracts Ebola in Congo, Evacuated to Netherlands | Today News
article.articleSummary: MSF worker contracted Bundibugyo virus disease (Ebola) during the Democratic Republic of Congo’s largest-ever outbreak and is being evacuated to the Netherlands for treatment under strict protocols, with Congolese and Dutch authorities coordinating. Separately, a Montreal hospital isolated a patient with Ebola-like symptoms while investigation proceeds; no public risk identified. Since the outbreak began in May, Congo has 8,224 confirmed infections and 3,982 deaths. About 254 health workers have been infected and 50 have died. On Sept. 29, 53 new cases and 28 deaths were reported, including 22 community deaths. The response remains challenging: roughly 80% of new infections occur among people not on contact lists; Africa CDC estimates responders reach only about 23% of expected contacts, with more than 30,000 identified contacts under monitoring. Authorities say the outbreak cannot yet be confidently deemed under control.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団の職員がコンゴでエボラに感染、オランダへ搬送
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行が継続しており、致死率・感染者数・医療従事者感染ともに深刻で、国際的な患者搬送や監視体制の限界も報告されているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: モントリオールの疑い症例は調査中で公衆衛生リスクは確認されていないため、主要発生国としてはDRCのみを採用。オランダは患者搬送先であり発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Artsen zonder Grenzen-medewerker besmet met ebola tijdens recorduitbraak in Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MSF worker infected with Ebola during a record outbreak in Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, Médecins Sans Frontières reports one confirmed Bundibugyo virus disease case in an MSF worker aiding Congo’s response to the world’s largest recorded Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The patient is evacuated to the Netherlands for specialized care under strict protocols. Since the outbreak began in May, the DRC has recorded about 8,224 infections and 3,982 deaths. On 29 September, authorities reported 53 new cases and 28 deaths, 22 of them community-acquired. Around 254 health workers have been infected, 50 have died. Persistent gaps in contact tracing show nearly 80% of new infections occur among unregistered contacts; Congo reported 79% of registered contacts followed up on 29 September, while Africa CDC estimates responders reach only about 23%. Separately, a Montreal hospital isolated a patient with Ebola-compatible symptoms, with no identified public risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国での記録的なエボラ流行中、国境なき医師団のスタッフがエボラに感染
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大規模のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（感染者8,224人、死者3,982人）が継続中で、医療従事者への感染拡大や国際搬送事例（オランダ、カナダ）も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: オランダおよびカナダ（モントリオール）での症例は輸入・疑い例であり、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。主たる発生地はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: 国庆假期健康防护指南：科学佩戴口罩，警惕蚊媒和肠道传染病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National Day Holiday Health Protection Guide: Proper Mask-Wearing, Be Vigilant Against Mosquito-Borne and Enteric Infectious Diseases
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-02, COVID-19 remains at low transmission and influenza at moderate-to-low levels during the National Day holiday in China. With increased travel, mask-wearing in transit hubs and indoor venues is advised to reduce respiratory infection risk. Dengue fever and chikungunya fever persist in southern provinces, with scattered and localized clusters; residents should eliminate standing water, overturn containers, clean outdoor debris, and install screens or nets to curb mosquitoes and protect outdoor exposure. Holiday gatherings raise risks of norovirus and enteric infections such as hand-foot-and-mouth disease; emphasize food and water hygiene, wash hands before meals, and keep raw and cooked foods separate. For outbound travel, monitor destination infectious disease risks and report overseas travel history when seeking medical care upon return. With inter-regional movement, influenza risk rises; early influenza vaccination is recommended, ahead of the flu season that begins after October.

triage.headline_ja: 国慶節連休健康防護ガイド：マスクの適切な着用、蚊媒介感染症と腸管感染症への警戒
triage.triage_reason: 国慶節休暇に向けた一般的な公衆衛生啓発記事であり、COVID-19・インフルエンザは低〜中程度、デング熱・チクングニア熱も散発的局地的発生にとどまり、新規異常事態は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は季節性の公衆衛生啓発・注意喚起であり、特定の異常な集団発生や新規事象の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Exotic Pet Trade Poses Rising Zoonotic Disease Risks in India
article.articleSummary: India's exotic pet trade elevates zoonotic spillover risk as close contact with imported wild animals creates repeated opportunities for pathogens to jump to humans. In Mumbai, avian and exotic wildlife veterinarian Dr. Rina Dev treats imported animals and warns psittacosis (avian chlamydiosis) is a common risk for bird handlers. Traders can carry salmonellosis from reptiles and tuberculosis from primates, with tuberculosis increasingly detected among primates. Nonhuman primates can transmit Ebola and HIV to people, underscoring cross-species danger. Global analyses show traded mammals are 1.5 times more likely to share pathogens with humans than nontraded species, with roughly one additional shared pathogen per decade of trade. A 2026 Humane World for Animals report notes 75% of emerging infectious diseases are zoonotic and estimates about 850,000 unknown viruses in birds and mammals that could infect people. Risks rise in pet cafes, petting zoos, and public events; first responders often lack PPE, and illegal trafficking bypasses quarantine. A One Health approach is urged, but investment remains limited.

triage.headline_ja: インドでエキゾチックペット取引が人獣共通感染症リスクを増大させている
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、エキゾチックペット取引に伴う人獣共通感染症リスクに関する一般的な解説・啓発記事であるため、トリアージ対象の実発生事例に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定のアウトブレイク事例ではなく、エキゾチックペット取引全般に関するリスク啓発・レビュー記事。具体的な症例数・発生日・感染者数等の記載なし。継続的なエクスポージャー（取引継続）という観点でWPRO基準1つ該当するが、社会的関心・緊急性は低いためDISMISS。

article.articleHeadline: 지오영 "가축전염병 특별방역기간 맞춰 동물의약품 관리 강화"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: GEOYOUNG: Strengthen the management of veterinary medicines in line with the special quarantine period for livestock infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: During Korea’s special quarantine period for livestock infectious diseases, GEOYOUNG will strengthen storage and distribution of animal medicines from October 2026 through February 2027. The plan targets cold-chain integrity, inventory control, and emergency delivery to ensure rapid on-site supply. Incheon and Deokpyeong centers handle 373 veterinary medicines for swine, poultry, cattle, and pets; Jan–Sep 2026 volumes reached about 9.3 million units. The Deokpyeong Center spans 4,620 m2 with cold-chain facilities for 2–8°C and -20°C, storing vaccines and other temperature-sensitive products. Vaccines require varied storage—refrigerated, room temperature, or ultra-low with liquid nitrogen—including foot-and-mouth disease, rabies, PRRS, and canine/feline vaccines. Domestic breakthroughs include foot-and-mouth disease, African swine fever, and lumpy skin disease; international concerns involve wild bird–associated highly pathogenic avian influenza and SAT1-foot-and-mouth in neighboring China and Mongolia, heightening winter biosecurity needs. Chairperson Cho Seon-hye of GEOYOUNG underscored seamless supply to frontline responders.

triage.headline_ja: 지오영「家畜伝染病特別防疫期間に合わせ動物用医薬品の管理強化」
triage.triage_reason: これは韓国の動物用医薬品流通企業による物流・在庫管理体制の広報記事であり、具体的な新規感染症発生や公衆衛生上の異常事態を報告するものではない。対象国（対象国リスト）における実際の発生事例としては確認できず、社会的関心や緊急対応の必要性も認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は韓国国内の動物用医薬品サプライチェーン管理の企業広報であり、対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）における疾病発生事例ではない。韓国自体も対象国リストに含まれておらず、中国・モンゴルへの言及も背景情報に留まり新規発生報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: "أطباء بلا حدود": من المرجح أن تكون إصابات الإيبولا في الكونغو أعلى من المُسجلة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders: Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are likely higher than those recorded
article.articleSummary: As of October 2, 2026, Doctors Without Borders (MSF) says Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are likely higher than officially recorded due to surveillance gaps and security constraints hindering containment. The outbreak has surpassed 8,000 confirmed cases and around 4,000 deaths, making it the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in the DRC to date. An MSF staffer involved in the response has been infected with the Bundibugyo strain and evacuated to the Netherlands under strict medical protocols. Healthcare workers remain among the most at risk. The United Nations warns that rising violence in eastern DRC is impeding response efforts after a fire destroyed a major transit hub for suspected cases at the Kigonzi IDP camp in Ituri province. The outbreak, declared in May, is the second-largest globally after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数は公式記録より多い可能性
triage.triage_reason: DRCで8,000例超・死者約4,000人に達する過去最大級のエボラ流行であり、治安悪化や監視体制の不備により国際的拡大・管理困難のリスクが高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: オランダへのスタッフ避難は医療搬送であり、オランダ国内での感染拡大事例ではないためverified_locationsから除外。既にDRC史上最大規模の流行であり、国連も治安悪化による対応阻害を警告しており、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Mẹ nhiễm viêm gan B, 90% trẻ sơ sinh có thể thành bệnh nhân mạn tính
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mother infected with Hepatitis B, 90% of newborns may become chronically infected.
article.articleSummary: In Hung Yen, a 32-year-old pregnant woman at 34 weeks with chronic hepatitis B (HBV) presented with fatigue, progressive jaundice, and dark urine; she was admitted to Bach Mai Hospital and found to have advanced HBV with coagulopathy (prothrombin activity ~57%). Her husband also has HBV. This case illustrates the high risk of mother-to-child transmission (MTCT) during late pregnancy, and the potential for newborns infected at birth to develop chronic infection in 85–90% of cases. Poor maternal monitoring may mask disease progression. WHO and CDC note that chronic HBV risk is strongly age-dependent, being much higher for perinatal transmission. Preventive strategy recommended includes antenatal HBV screening, viral load assessment, antiviral therapy when indicated, and newborn prophylaxis with hepatitis B vaccine plus hepatitis B immune globulin (HBIG) per guidelines. Globally, about 240 million live with chronic HBV, causing roughly 1.1 million deaths.

triage.headline_ja: B型肝炎に感染した母親、新生児の90%が慢性患者になる可能性
triage.triage_reason: 個別症例report及び疾患啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の突発的事象や異常な流行ではないため、アウトブレイクシグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事はベトナムの病院における母子感染（垂直感染）に関する個別症例と一般的な疾患啓発情報であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。B型肝炎は既知の慢性感染症であり、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Deadly Brain Infection From Soil Bacteria Exposed by Tamil Nadu Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Neuromelioidosis, a rare brain/spinal cord infection caused by Burkholderia pseudomallei, is highlighted by a southern India focus. Global melioidosis estimates reach about 165,000 cases and 89,000 deaths annually; neurological involvement is typically 2–5% but regional data from southern India show higher proportions. In 2022–2023, a northern Tamil Nadu outbreak documented 22 probable cases across four districts with eight deaths, linked to contaminated saline used in a dental-care setting, revealing healthcare-associated transmission. Whole-genome sequencing identified sequence type ST1553; the bimA Bm allele appeared in three clonal isolates (two clinical, one from saline), with core-SNP phylogeny supporting a common source. Burkholderia pseudomallei displays diverse lineages; bimA Bm is associated with neurotropism but is not a standalone predictor. A standardized core-genome MLST scheme (4,221 targets) underpins international molecular surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州のアウトブレイクで明らかになった土壌細菌による致死性脳感染症
triage.triage_reason: 2022-2023年に発生した過去のメリオイドーシスのアウトブレイクに関するゲノム解析研究の紹介記事であり、現在進行中の新規公衆衛生イベントではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2022-2023年に発生した汚染生理食塩水による院内感染（22例、死亡8例）の全ゲノム解析研究を紹介する科学ニュースであり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクではない。将来的な医療関連感染対策の参考として注視価値はあるが、即時のシグナルトリアージ対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 387.250 Kasus Influenza A Ditemukan di Banten hingga Oktober
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 387,250 Influenza A cases found in Banten through October.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A in Banten Province, Indonesia; about 387,250 cases by Oct 1, 2026, per the Banten Health Office. Detection enhancements in health facilities drive higher counts. The Ministry of Health lists Jakarta, West Java, and Banten as top regions by cases and positivity rate, though cumulative provincial figures are not published in the national report. In Banten, cases are spread across districts with no dominant area. Influenza A is not a new disease and is commonly found in communities, but transmission can be rapid. Most cases recover with appropriate care; public health guidance emphasizes hygiene, hydration, rest, masking when sick or in crowds, and cough etiquette. Vulnerable groups—young children, elderly, pregnant women, and those with comorbidities—require extra attention.

triage.headline_ja: バンテン州で10月までにインフルエンザA型387,250件確認
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの通常の流行として説明されており、IHR基準の該当は乏しいが、症例数が多く検査体制強化の影響もあるため動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はインフルエンザA型の季節性流行であり、新規性や重篤性の明確な記載はない。検出強化による報告数増加が主因とされる。重症度・死亡例に関する情報は不明。

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ebola : le bilan réel de l'épidémie probablement plus lourd que les chiffres officiels, selon MSF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: the real toll of the outbreak is probably higher than the official figures, according to MSF.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo; MSF warns the true toll is higher than official figures. Since the outbreak declared in May, more than 8,000 confirmed cases and about 4,000 deaths have been reported, making it the largest Ebola epidemic in the DRC to date. One MSF responder tested positive for Bundibugyo ebolavirus and was evacuated to the Netherlands under strict medical protocols. Healthcare workers remain among the most exposed, with protection measures not eliminating risk. The United Nations notes that escalating violence in eastern DRC is hindering the response: a major transit center for suspected patients in the Kigonze camp, Ituri province, burned, displacing around 19,000 people. Access to health zones is restricted; lab sample transport is delayed; transfers to treatment centers are disrupted. The outbreak is the largest in the DRC and the second-largest globally after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: DRC/エボラ出血熱：MSFによると、流行の実際の被害は公式統計よりも深刻な可能性が高い
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ出血熱がDRC史上最大規模（8000例超、死者約4000人）に達し、国際的な症例輸出（オランダへの医療従事者避難）や紛争による対応阻害も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: オランダは症例の国際移送先（医療避難）であり発生国ではないため除外。アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文中に言及がないため除外。イツリ州はDRC国内のADM1レベルの情報としてDRCに統合。

article.articleHeadline: Вирусолог перечислила первые симптомы гонконгского гриппа
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Virologist listed the first symptoms of the Hong Kong flu.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong flu begins with a sharp, wave-like rise in fever, accompanied by body aches and weakness, according to virologist Elena Malinnikova, Doctor of Medical Sciences and infectious disease specialist. She also notes muscle pain and headache as early signs. A characteristic feature is the fever's oscillating course, alternating between spikes and temporary declines. The following day, cough, sore throat, and runny nose appear. To reduce the risk of complications and severe illness, Malinnikova recommends influenza vaccination. The report cites Olga Shuppo, who previously stated that autumn increases in viral diseases are typical for the interseason period. Information was provided by RIA Novosti.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス学者が香港インフルエンザの初期症状を列挙
triage.triage_reason: 「香港インフルエンザ」という名称の季節性インフルエンザ株に関する一般的な症状解説記事であり、具体的な発生状況や公衆衛生上の異常事態の報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアの医学専門家が季節性インフルエンザ（通称：香港インフルエンザ）の一般的な症状とワクチン接種を解説したもので、香港や中国における具体的な発生事例やアウトブレイクの報告は含まれていない。Bluedotが付与した発生地域（Hong Kong, China）は記事の主題と一致しないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 10月疾病风险预报来了，湖南重点防控这些疾病_经济.民生_湖南频道
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: October Disease Risk Forecast Released; Hunan Prioritizes Prevention and Control of These Diseases.
article.articleSummary: Hunan Province, China, released its October disease risk forecast, with a prevention index at level III (medium). Six priority areas are highlighted. Mosquito-borne diseases (Dengue fever and Chikungunya) carry a moderate risk as mosquitoes remain active; watch for fever, orbital pain, rash, and conjunctival injection, and control mosquitoes at home and outdoors. Dog bites pose a rabies risk; ensure pet vaccination, keep dogs leashed, and seek immediate care if bitten. Acute respiratory infections rise with temperature swings; symptoms include fever, sore throat, cough, and fatigue; recommendations include ventilation, masking in crowded places, hand hygiene, and vaccination for vulnerable groups. Wild mushroom poisoning is common in autumn; avoid picking or eating wild mushrooms, and preserve samples if poisoning occurs. Toxic plant/animal-origin foodborne illnesses and microbiological foodborne diseases are also flagged; avoid unknown wild edibles, practice safe food handling, and seek care for symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 10月の疾病リスク予報発表、湖南省が重点的に予防・管理すべき疾病
triage.triage_reason: 定例の季節性疾病リスク予報であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による季節性疾病予防の定期広報であり、具体的な症例数やアウトブレイクの報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Doctors Without Borders worker contracts Ebola in Congo
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus disease (Ebola) in DRC: A Doctors Without Borders worker lab-confirmed Bundibugyo virus disease while fighting Congo's largest outbreak and was evacuated to the Netherlands for treatment under strict medical protocols. Separately, a Montreal hospital isolated a patient with Ebola-like symptoms on Oct 1; the case is under investigation with no identified public risk. The DRC outbreak has 8,224 confirmed infections and 3,982 deaths since May, according to the National Institute of Public Health (Sept 30 data). Some 254 health workers have been infected and 50 have died. On Sept 29, 53 new cases and 28 deaths were reported, including 22 community deaths. Containment remains challenging: nearly 80% of new infections occur among people not on contact lists, while responders reach about 23% of expected contacts; more than 30,000 identified contacts were monitored. As of Oct 1, the outbreak is not under control.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団の職員がコンゴでエボラウイルスに感染
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）流行が継続中で、死者数・感染者数が甚大かつ国際的な感染者移送（オランダ）や疑い例（カナダ）も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: オランダへの医療従事者搬送、カナダ（モントリオール）での疑い例は発生国ではなく、対象国リストにも含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCの流行は制御下になく、国際的懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Врач Малинникова: Повышение температуры является симптомом гонконгского гриппа
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dr. Malinnikova: Fever is a symptom of the Hong Kong flu.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong influenza (Hong Kong flu) begins with abrupt fever, muscle pains, general weakness, and aches; fever fluctuates and may rise again after a dip, with headache. By day two, cough, sore throat, and runny nose develop, creating a respiratory picture that helps identify this strain. To reduce risk of severe illness and complications, vaccination is advised, with updated vaccines already arriving in Russia. Medical experts urge as-early-as-possible vaccination to ensure immunity before seasonal case rises. High-risk groups are a priority, given their greater risk of severe outcomes. Timely immunization remains a key defense. The article notes academian Onishchenko warned of a potential new pandemic strain by 2029; influenza viruses mutate, potentially increasing virulence and immune evasion, while health systems can prepare in advance. This material is informational; consult a specialist for medical advice.

triage.headline_ja: マリンニコワ医師：発熱は香港インフルエンザの症状
triage.triage_reason: 特定の地域でのアウトブレイクを報じる記事ではなく、ロシアにおける季節性インフルエンザ（通称『香港インフルエンザ』）の症状解説とワクチン接種啓発を目的とした一般医療情報記事であるため。
triage.notes: 『香港インフルエンザ』はH3N2亜型インフルエンザの通称であり地名由来の病名。記事内容はロシアにおける季節性インフルエンザ予防接種の啓発であり、香港・中国・ロシアでの実際の流行拡大を報じるものではないため、対象国の発生地域には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A Belum Ditemukan di Ciamis, Dinkes Beberkan Bedanya dengan Flu Biasa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A Not Yet Detected in Ciamis, Health Department Explains How It Differs from the Seasonal Flu
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, Dinas Kesehatan Kabupaten Ciamis in West Java reports no detected Influenza A cases. Surveillance across hospitals and community health centers (puskesmas) found no patients with Influenza A, despite public concern. Seasonal influenza remains more common, with 1,379 cases recorded in Ciamis. Officials urge residents not to panic and to maintain preventive measures, including PHBS (Healthy Clean Living Habits), masking, and managing stress, since both influenza A and seasonal flu are viral and transmissible. Influenza A symptoms can resemble the flu but may be more severe, including fever over 38°C, joint and muscle pains, and a worse cough. The report underscores ongoing monitoring of respiratory illnesses in Ciamis and emphasizes public reassurance alongside vigilance and preventive hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAはチアミスではまだ検出されず、保健局が季節性インフルエンザとの違いを説明
triage.triage_reason: 記事はインフルエンザA型が未検出であることを伝える内容であり、季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行報告に過ぎず、異常性や深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念は確認されない。
triage.notes: 記事はインフルエンザA型が未検出であることを確認する内容で、季節性インフルエンザの通常範囲内の報告。公衆の懸念に対する安心情報提供が主旨。

article.articleHeadline: 겨울철 가축전염병 막는다...경남, 특별방역체계 가동
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Winter livestock infectious diseases to be prevented... South Gyeongsang Province activates a special quarantine system.
article.articleSummary: South Gyeongsang Province (Gyeongsangnam-do) launches a five-month special quarantine period from Oct 1, 2026 to Feb 28, 2027 to bolster prevention of high-pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) and foot-and-mouth disease (FMD). A 24/7 emergency response is activated with measures to block transmission via wild birds and livestock vehicles, and tightened management of large-scale layer farms and high-risk FMD farms. Surveillance is intensified at eight wild-bird sites and 14 vehicle-control points across 10 sites. Farms must pre-report restocking 7 days prior; broilers/ducks face 14-day restocking bans, with production restrictions for high-risk duck farms. Large-layer operations (>100,000 birds) receive weekly self-inspections (27 farms), and >200,000 birds farms pilot unmanned security posts. External staff and vehicles must pre-register in KAHIS. Nationally, 13 FMD cases occurred this year in Incheon, Gyeonggi, and Gyeongsangbuk-do; Gyeongsangnam-do has had no FMD since 2014. SAT1-type FMD detected in China/Mongolia; preparations for new strains. Movement of cattle/pig manure outside the province is restricted during the period.

triage.headline_ja: 冬季家畜伝染病を防ぐ...慶尚南道、特別防疫体制を稼働
triage.triage_reason: 韓国慶尚南道が季節的な予防的防疫体制を発動した内容であり、新規の異常な感染拡大事例ではないが、国内でのFMD発生（13件）やHPAI警戒、中国・モンゴルでの新規株検出への言及があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は主に韓国（対象国外）の家畜防疫対策に関する内容。中国・モンゴルでのSAT1型FMD検出への言及があるが、これは背景情報として言及されたのみで中国が主題ではない。対象国リストに韓国・モンゴルは含まれないため除外。中国は新規株検出の文脈で言及されているため参考として記載するが、記事の主題ではない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Онищенко назвал опасные болезни, которыми можно заразиться в Таиланде
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Onishchenko named dangerous diseases that can be contracted in Thailand.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis is highlighted as a serious infectious threat in Thailand amid heavy rains and floods, according to epidemiologist Gennady Onishchenko. He notes that in Thailand the risk extends beyond leptospirosis to other infections, including hepatitis and gastrointestinal diseases. In Bangkok, a disaster regime was declared after record rainfall and associated flooding, with leptospirosis cases reported in these conditions. Russians in Thailand reported symptoms such as aches, high fever, and migraines, and some tested positive for COVID-19. Separately, a Russian woman returning from Thailand contracted melioidosis and was hospitalized in severe condition. Onishchenko also enumerated four deadly diseases anticipated over the next five years. The article underscores Thailand's ongoing outbreak context and the need for vigilance among travelers, with leptospirosis, melioidosis, and COVID-19 highlighted as notable concerns.

triage.headline_ja: オニシチェンコ氏、タイで感染し得る危険な病気を指摘
triage.triage_reason: タイでの洪水に伴うレプトスピラ症等の感染リスクが指摘されているが、症例数や公衆衛生当局の公式発表など具体的データが乏しく、続報を注視する段階である。
triage.notes: ロシア人専門家の見解に基づく記事で、タイの公式統計や当局発表は言及されていない。洪水による環境要因が継続している点は懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: 전북도, AI·구제역·ASF 겨울철 방역망 강화 총력
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jeollabuk-do mobilizes a full-scale effort to strengthen its winter quarantine network against avian influenza, foot-and-mouth disease, and African swine fever
article.articleSummary: Jeollabuk-do launches a five-month winter special quarantine (October 2026–February 2027) to strengthen defenses against avian influenza (AI), foot-and-mouth disease (FMD; SAT1), and African swine fever (ASF). A 24/7 emergency system with 14 municipalities and the Animal Hygiene Laboratory targets transmission from migratory birds to livestock vehicles, entrants, and manure or feed. AI control uses a three-tier barrier to block wild-bird incursions and farm-to-farm spread. Poultry: 716 chicken farms (about 4.3 million birds) and 144 duck farms (about 2.5 million ducks) as of September; AI outbreaks last winter occurred on nine farms (Gimje, Iksan, Namwon, Gochang, Jangsu). Disinfection hubs expand to 25 by Oct 15 and 30 by Nov 1; three-step vehicle sanitation. FMD SAT1 risk from China/Mongolia with emergency vaccine stock and targeted vaccination; ASF caused two farms in Jeollabuk-do among 24 nationwide, with intensified pig-farm testing, wild boar surveillance, and environmental tests at slaughterhouses and facilities; movement of manure restricted within nine regions; 61 duck farms under seasonal restrictions (Nov 1–Feb 28).

triage.headline_ja: 全羅北道、AI・口蹄疫・ASF冬季防疫網強化に総力
triage.triage_reason: 韓国・全羅北道の家畜疾病（AI・FMD・ASF）に対する行政の季節的防疫強化策を伝える内容で、新規の重大アウトブレイクや人への感染拡大は報告されていないため、継続監視対象とする。
triage.notes: 本イベントは韓国（対象国リスト外）での家畜疾病防疫強化策であり、対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。中国・モンゴルからのFMDリスクに言及があるが、発生は韓国内のみでありChinaは主題国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 4 Warga Gunungkidul Positif Antraks Usai Nekat Makan Bangkai Kambing
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four Gunungkidul residents test positive for anthrax after eating a goat carcass.
article.articleSummary: Four Gunungkidul residents in Dadapayu, Semanu, have tested positive for anthrax after slaughtering and consuming a goat that died suddenly in September 2026. The district health office (Dinkes) reported seven suspected cases; PCR confirmed four. A further 47 individuals with direct exposure to the goat or its products are at risk and are under watch, with antibiotic prophylaxis and health monitoring for 60 days (two incubation periods). The confirmed patients are receiving treatment and gradually improving. Authorities educated residents on the dangers of slaughtering, processing, or eating animals that are ill or have died suddenly and urged rapid reporting of livestock deaths. The Agriculture and Food Office (DPP Gunungkidul) conducted soil testing at the slaughter site, with results positive for anthrax; site disinfection with formalin and livestock vaccination were undertaken. A local brandu tradition persisted, with some meat already cooked.

triage.headline_ja: グヌンキドゥル住民4人、死んだヤギを食べた後に炭疽菌陽性と判明
triage.triage_reason: ヒトの炭疽菌感染が確認されているが、動物由来で地域限定・既知の繰り返し発生パターンであり、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大のリスクは低い。曝露者の経過観察が続いているため注視が必要。
triage.notes: 炭疽菌はインドネシアのこの地域で過去にも発生歴があり既知の人獣共通感染症。死亡例やヒト-ヒト感染の報告はなく、47名の曝露者は抗生物質予防投与と60日間の健康監視下にある。地元保健・農業当局が消毒・ワクチン接種等で対応中。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases more than double in Chennai in September
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Chennai surged in September with 1,290 infections, up from 605 in August, and 72 new cases detected on Wednesday, amid Tamil Nadu’s seasonal rise in vector-borne diseases ahead of the northeast monsoon. The state reported over 18,000 dengue cases and nine deaths up to September 30. Chennai was among districts with high incidence. Health authorities intensified fever surveillance at 5,818 facilities, deploying 26,303 health workers for surveillance and rapid response; more than 2.23 lakh dengue tests were conducted in the first nine months. The Greater Chennai Corporation dispatched 3,690 domestic breeding checkers across 15 zones to identify and eliminate mosquito breeding sites, while intensifying source-reduction, cleaning, and fogging in higher-incidence areas.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイでデング熱症例が9月に倍増
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱増加であり、インド・タミルナドゥ州で既に対策体制が機能しているため緊急のRRAは不要だが、症例数増加傾向は継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱は例年モンスーン前後に流行する季節性疾患であり、州・市当局が既に大規模なサーベイランスと媒介蚊対策を実施している。死亡9例・感染18,000例超は深刻ではあるが、例年の季節変動の範囲内と考えられ、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: حالة اشتُبِه في أنها إصابة بفيروس إيبولا يتبيّن أنها إنذار كاذب
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A case suspected of Ebola virus infection turns out to be a false alarm.
article.articleSummary: On Oct 2, 2026, a Montreal hospital briefly activated isolation procedures after a woman presenting with symptoms suggestive of Ebola was evaluated at the Centre hospitalier universitaire de Montréal (CHUM). Healthcare teams immediately implemented Ebola infection-control protocols, ensuring safety while monitoring for potential exposure. By around 8:00 p.m., CHUM spokespersons said laboratory tests returned negative for Ebola, allowing the emergency measures to be lifted. Hospital officials could not confirm whether the patient had recently traveled to the Ebola-affected region in the Democratic Republic of Congo, noting they had not reviewed her travel history. The episode occurred amid an ongoing, deadly Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where thousands have died in recent months. No public risk was identified.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染が疑われた症例は誤報であったことが判明
triage.triage_reason: モントリオールで疑われたエボラ疑似症例は検査で陰性と確認され、公衆衛生上のリスクは認められなかった。DRCでの流行自体は継続中だが、本記事はカナダでの誤報事例に関するものでピックアップ対象ではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はカナダ・モントリオールでの誤報事例であり、DRCでのエボラ流行自体を報じたものではないためDRCはverified_locationsに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Pune tops Maha's influenza cases as state sees sharp spike
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1 influenza) in Maharashtra reports 2,320 cases and eight deaths from January 1 to September 21, 2026; Pune Municipal Corporation leads with 709 cases, followed by Mumbai 626, Nashik 275, Nagpur 226, and Pimpri-Chinchwad 113; Pune rural has zero. Overall, 390 patients are hospitalized and 1,922 are in home isolation; no ventilator use. Testing through September 29, 2026 stood at 1,135,328 this year, far lower than 2025’s 3,009,459 and 2024’s 2,415,082. Common symptoms: high fever, severe body ache, dry cough, runny nose, sore throat. Early antivirals like oseltamivir are advised; most cases recover in OPD, though older individuals with diabetes or cardiac disease may require hospitalization for pneumonia or ARDS. Free vaccination for high-risk groups (pregnant women in 2nd/3rd trimesters, diabetics, hypertensives, healthcare workers) has been ongoing since 2024, with ongoing surveillance and medicine stock management.

triage.headline_ja: マハラシュトラ州でインフルエンザ急増、プネーが州内最多の症例数に
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1インフルエンザの例年報告であり異常性・国際的拡大リスクは低いが、入院・死亡例が継続して発生しており経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 季節性H1N1インフルエンザ（毎年発生）の地域サーベイランス報告。ワクチン接種・抗ウイルス薬提供等の対策体制が既に確立されており、外部支援の必要性は低い。死亡8例/症例2320件は季節性流行として想定範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: Россиянам перечислили симптомы гонконгского гриппа
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Symptoms of the Hong Kong flu listed for Russians.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, Russian virologist Elena Malinnikova warned about the Hong Kong flu, noting its characteristic wave-like fever. She enumerated key symptoms: a rapid rise in temperature, weakness, muscle pains, headache, and body aches. Malinnikova stressed that the fever tends to fluctuate in waves. She urged early influenza vaccination to allow time for immunity to develop. Earlier, therapist Chernyshova advised vaccination for people with asthma and other high-risk groups. The Hong Kong flu is especially dangerous not for the illness itself but for possible complications, which may include pneumonia, bronchitis, and myocarditis. The article cites RIA Novosti and targets Russians seeking guidance on prevention and vaccination timing during ongoing concerns about influenza season.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア人向けに香港風邪の症状が列挙される
triage.triage_reason: 「香港かぜ」はH3N2亜型の通称であり、記事はロシアの医師による季節性インフルエンザワクチン接種の啓発記事であって、香港や中国での実際の流行・異常事態を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 「香港インフルエンザ（Hong Kong flu）」はH3N2型インフルエンザの通称であり、地理的な香港・中国での発生を意味しない。記事はロシア国内向けの季節性インフルエンザ予防啓発であり、対象国リストに該当する実際の発生国は確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: Вирусолог назвала первые признаки гонконгского гриппа
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A virologist identified the early signs of the Hong Kong flu.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, virologist Elena Malinnikova, MD, infectious-disease specialist and virologist, describes early signs of Hong Kong flu: abrupt fever with sharp rises followed by falls, along with marked weakness, headache, and muscle pains. The fever pattern is wave-like, with temperature fluctuating over time. Within the next day, cough, sore throat, and runny nose typically develop. To reduce the risk of complications and severe illness, she recommends influenza vaccination. The article emphasizes recognizing Hong Kong flu through this distinctive fever pattern and common respiratory symptoms and promotes vaccination as a preventive measure. She also notes the clinical pattern as a potential early indicator for timely diagnosis and preventive action.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス学者が香港インフルエンザの初期症状を解説
triage.triage_reason: 特定地域でのアウトブレイクを報じるものではなく、ウイルス学者による香港インフルエンザ（季節性インフルエンザの一種）の一般的な症状解説記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や発生情報は含まれない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の国・地域での発症例や流行状況を報じたものではなく、ロシアのメディアが専門家の一般的な症状解説を伝える内容。発生地域として香港・中国が付与されているが、記事本文に実際の発生事実は記載されていないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Nekat Makan Bangkai Kambing, 4 Warga Gunungkidul Positif Antraks
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four Gunungkidul residents test positive for anthrax after eating a goat carcass.
article.articleSummary: Four residents of Dadapayu, Semanu, Gunungkidul Regency, Indonesia tested positive for anthrax after consuming a goat carcass. The cluster began in early September 2026, when one patient sought care at a primary health center with anthrax-like symptoms. An epidemiological investigation identified seven suspected cases with direct contact to a lethargic, suddenly dead goat. PCR testing confirmed anthrax in four of the seven. Contact tracing extended the exposure assessment to 47 people considered at risk due to contact with the goat or products from the animal that died unexpectedly. The investigation highlights transmission risk from contaminated animal meat and products. Laboratories confirmed cases via PCR; authorities are monitoring exposed individuals and implementing public health measures to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: 山羊の死骸を食べたグヌンキドゥル住民4人が炭疽陽性
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの地域的な炭疽菌クラスター（確定4例、曝露47人）だが、ヒト-ヒト感染なく、同国内では時折発生する既知の人獣共通感染症であり社会的関心も限定的なため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 炭疽は死んだ家畜の摂食・接触による感染経路で、インドネシアの一部地域では散発的に発生する既知の疾病。47人が曝露評価対象となっており動向の継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Chennai Latest News Today on October 2nd, 2026: Free Bus Scheme Expands, Metro Ridership Soars & Dengue Cases Rise
article.articleSummary: Chennai reports a dengue surge with cases crossing 1,775 in total, including 1,290 cases in September 2026, prompting intensified mosquito-control measures. Tamil Nadu expands the Vetri Payanam free bus scheme for women to 12,692 buses, benefiting about 84.32 lakh women across the state. Chennai Metro Rail Limited records September ridership over 1 crore, the third consecutive eight-figure month. Perambur Barracks Road road cave-in exposes infrastructure strain, while Chennai Metro Phase 2 underground tunneling at Kilpauk Medical College Station achieves a breakthrough of about 685 meters with the TBM Kaveri. The government plans a MRTS takeover from Southern Railway within three months. Chennai’s reservoirs sit at 38% capacity, signaling urgent water scarcity. Other developments include Paranur Toll Plaza going barrier-free from Oct 1, and measures like ration-card rule changes, 1,000 new rain gauges, voter-enrollment drives, and a waste-segregation campaign.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイ最新ニュース2026年10月2日：無料バス制度拡大、メトロ利用者数急増、デング熱症例増加
triage.triage_reason: チェンナイでのデング熱症例増加が報告されているが、季節性流行の範囲内とみられ、重症度や死亡者数等の詳細情報が不足しているため、経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はインド・チェンナイで毎年季節的に流行する既知の感染症であり、今回の報告も地域ニュースの一部として扱われている。症例数の増加（9月だけで1,290例）は注視すべきだが、重症度・死亡者数等の詳細が不明なためフルRRAには至らない。

article.articleHeadline: Tasa de mortalidad de ébola en RD del Congo es probablemente mayor de lo reportado, inseguridad obstaculiza atención, dice MSF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola mortality rate in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is likely higher than reported; insecurity hampers care, says MSF.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains the largest and deadliest in the country’s history. As of October 1, 2026, MSF reports over 8,000 confirmed cases and about 4,000 deaths, with real figures likely higher due to monitoring gaps and case detection challenges, exacerbated by worsening insecurity that hampers care. A Bundibugyo ebolavirus infection among an MSF staff member led to evacuation to the Netherlands under strict protocols. Health workers are among the most at-risk. The UN warns escalating violence in eastern DRC further obstructs response efforts, including the destruction by fire of a key transit center for suspected patients at the Kigonze displacement camp in Ituri province. The outbreak, declared in May 2026, ranks as the second-largest Ebola outbreak globally after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱による死亡率は報告より高い可能性、治安悪化が医療対応を妨げるとMSFが指摘
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行が継続し、死者数・感染者数とも甚大で、治安悪化により対応が困難化、国際的な懸念（MSFスタッフのオランダ避難）も生じているためフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: オランダはMSFスタッフの医療搬送先であり発生地域ではないため除外。既知の大規模エボラ流行であり、治安悪化が対応能力に深刻な影響を与えている点が特筆される。

article.articleHeadline: Palawan confirms ASF case, strengthen containment measures
article.articleSummary: Palawan Province confirms its first African Swine Fever (ASF) case in Barangay Concepcion, Agutaya, with Bureau of Animal Industry lab confirming ASF in 40 Concepcion samples. Quarantine checkpoints are in place across Agutaya to restrict movement of people, animals, and materials. A three-day depopulation operation (Sept 28–30) targeted remaining hogs to break transmission. DA-MIMAROPA provides disinfectants, rapid test kits, depopulation guidance, indemnification procedures, movement controls, biosecurity, and disease surveillance support. Active surveillance, field investigations, and sample collection are ongoing to detect hidden cases in Agutaya. The province is recording hog-raiser losses and arranging aid. Information campaigns urge raisers to limit pig movements, disinfect gear, report sudden illness or death, and avoid transporting or slaughtering suspected pigs or meat without veterinary guidance. ASF does not infect humans; spread occurs via contaminated pork, equipment, vehicles, footwear, and other materials; cooperation with quarantine personnel is essential.

triage.headline_ja: パラワン州がASF（アフリカ豚熱）症例を確認、封じ込め対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: ASFはヒトに感染しない動物疾病であり、記事内容は国内（フィリピン・パラワン州）の家畜防疫対応にとどまる。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大・渡航貿易制限のリスクについての具体的言及はない。
triage.notes: ASF（アフリカ豚熱）は豚のみに感染する動物疾病でヒトへの感染性はないため、CEPRの公衆衛生シグナルとしての優先度は低い。地域の家畜産業・経済影響の観点では地方当局が監視中。

article.articleHeadline: Симптомы гонконгского гриппа
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Symptoms of Hong Kong flu.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong flu begins with high fever, body aches, weakness, and muscle pains, as described by Dr. Elena Malinnikova, MD, infectious disease physician and virologist. The next day, cough, sore throat, and nasal congestion develop. The illness can feature a wave-like fever, rising and falling over time. To prevent complications and a more severe course, vaccination against influenza is advised. In Russia, current influenza vaccines are available, and doctors urge getting vaccinated as early as possible to allow immunity to develop. Fever is a defensive mechanism, and its absence does not necessarily indicate a weak immune response; studies show many adults with viral respiratory infections experience no fever.

triage.headline_ja: 香港かぜの症状について
triage.triage_reason: 一般的なインフルエンザ（いわゆる香港かぜ）の症状説明とワクチン推奨に関する医療解説記事であり、具体的な発生状況や公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す情報がないため。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアの一般向け健康情報コンテンツであり、季節性インフルエンザ（通称「香港かぜ」）の症状解説とワクチン接種の啓発が主題。中国・ロシアでの具体的な発生拡大や異常事態は報告されていない。発生地域に香港・中国が含まれるが、記事主題は疾患名に由来する一般名称の解説であり、実際の発生国としての記載はないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: 17 bị cáo lĩnh án vụ thịt lợn nhiễm dịch tả châu Phi tại Công ty Đồ hộp Hạ Long
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 17 defendants were sentenced in the case of pork meat infected with African swine fever at Ha Long Canned Foods Company.
article.articleSummary: Seventeen defendants in Haiphong were sentenced in a case involving African swine fever (ASF)-infected pork used by Ha Long Canned Foods Company. On Sept 30, 2026, the Hai Phong City People’s Court convicted 15 defendants of food safety violations tied to importing and processing ASF-infected pork from supplier Bui Duc Trong. Former company CEO Truong Sy Toan received 19 years; Trong 18 years; other defendants faced 3 to 16 years. In separate bribery-related charges, Le Nhat Huy received 18 months and Tran Thi Huong four years. The court found that Toan, deputy quality-control head Pham Thi Thuy Lan, lead quality inspector Bui Thi Thoan, and incoming-material handler Lai Thi Thanh Huong bypassed testing, allowing over 197 metric tons of ASF-infected pork from May 2025 through Sept 8, 2025 to be used in production. The total value of violative meat was about 17.4 billion VND, with over 9.7 billion VND destroyed.

triage.headline_ja: ハロン缶詰会社のアフリカ豚熱感染豚肉事件で17人の被告に判決
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2025年に発生したASF感染豚肉の食品安全違反に対する刑事裁判の判決報道であり、新規の感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。ASFはヒトに感染しないため公衆衛生への直接影響もない。
triage.notes: 記事は2025年に発生したASF感染豚肉の違法流通事件に対する司法判決（2026年9月30日）の報道であり、過去の事案に対する法的措置が主題。新規の動物疫病発生や公衆衛生リスクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: संचारी रोगों से बचाव को गांव में किया जागरूक
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Raising awareness in the village about protection against infectious diseases
article.articleSummary: On October 2, 2026, during the Communicable Disease Control Campaign in Badaun district, District Malaria Officer Amit Kumar Tiwari visited Jagat Pipri village in Islamnagar block to assess health and sanitation measures. Anti-larval spray was applied to destroy mosquito larvae in the village. Tiwari briefed residents and children on protection against dengue, malaria, and other vector-borne diseases, detailing steps such as eliminating water stagnation around homes, keeping surroundings clean, and using mosquito precautions. He emphasized that early awareness and good sanitation can substantially reduce transmission. The visit highlights ongoing local efforts to mitigate vector-borne disease risk through environmental management and public education in rural Uttar Pradesh.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症予防に関する村での啓発活動
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防啓発活動の報告であり、異常な流行や深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は日常的な防疫・衛生啓発活動の報告であり、具体的な症例数やアウトブレイク情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO báo động số tử vong vì bệnh tả
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of the death toll from cholera.
article.articleSummary: Cholera mortality alarm: WHO reports 2025: 451,499 cholera cases and 7,870 deaths across 47 countries, the highest annual cholera deaths reported to WHO since 1999; true burden likely higher due to under-reporting. About 90% of cases and deaths are in seven countries: Angola, Bangladesh, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Nigeria, South Sudan, Sudan, and Yemen. Africa region experienced a 34% increase in cases and 58% increase in deaths versus 2024. More than 20% of cholera deaths occur outside healthcare facilities, signaling limited timely care. Global supply of oral cholera vaccine rose from about 30 million doses in 2022 to nearly 80 million in 2025. In addition, 2025 saw 21,526 suspected meningitis cases with 971 deaths in 24 African countries; and plague reports show 3,847 suspected cases and 423 deaths 2019–2025 across 10 countries. Core measures: access to clean water, sanitation, vaccination, surveillance, and timely treatment.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコレラによる死者数増加を警告
triage.triage_reason: WHOがコレラによる年間死者数が1999年以降で最多と警告しており、複数国にまたがる深刻な公衆衛生上の異常事態としてIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOの世界的なコレラ・髄膜炎・ペストに関する年次報告であり、主な被害国はアンゴラ、バングラデシュ、DRC、ナイジェリア、南スーダン、スーダン、イエメンの7カ国（全体の約90%）。対象国リストの中ではDRCのみが該当する。他の対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン等）への直接言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: BSE case prompts the Philippines to ban UK beef
article.articleSummary: Philippines bans beef imports from the United Kingdom after detection of Bovine Spongiform Encephalopathy (BSE) in a cow in Scotland. The measure follows a report submitted to the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) by Dr. Christine Middlemiss, chief veterinary officer at the UK Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs (DEFRA). BSE, commonly known as mad cow disease, prompted the ban to mitigate potential risk from UK beef exports. The article notes only a single Scottish case and provides no further details on laboratory confirmation or additional infections. The decision reflects precautionary action in response to the BSE finding and illustrates ongoing international animal health reporting to WOAH as countries adjust import policies. Publication date: 2026-10-02.

triage.headline_ja: 英国でのBSE症例を受け、フィリピンが英国産牛肉の輸入を禁止
triage.triage_reason: 英スコットランドでの単発的なBSE症例に対するフィリピンの予防的な輸入禁止措置であり、ヒトへの感染拡大や公衆衛生上の重大なリスクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: BSE発生地はスコットランド（英国）であり対象国リストに含まれない。フィリピンは輸入禁止措置を取った側であり、感染症の発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: RSUD Jombang Siaga Influenza A di Tengah Cuaca Ekstrem, Masyarakat Diimbau Kenali Gejalanya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jombang Regional General Hospital on Alert for Influenza A Amid Extreme Weather, Public Urged to Recognize Its Symptoms
article.articleSummary: RSUD Jombang in Indonesia is vigilant for Influenza A amid an extreme weather shift from hot to rainy, with respiratory infections on the rise. The hospital is prepared to treat patients as influenza activity increases, a pattern noted earlier in 2026. Symptoms to watch include high fever, cough, sore throat, and headache, with greater risk to children, the elderly, and people with diabetes, heart disease, or kidney disease. Health Ministry data show rising influenza activity in August–September 2026; in week 38, 148 of 265 sentinel specimens tested positive for influenza, with Influenza A (H1N1pdm09) as the dominant strain. The ministry is also monitoring Influenza A (H3N2) subclade K, informally called 'superflu' in public discourse; this label is not an official WHO/CDC designation. Surveillance and testing inform ongoing public health responses.

triage.headline_ja: ジョンバン県立総合病院、異常気象の中インフルエンザAに警戒態勢、症状の自覚を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1pdm09優勢）の通常のサーベイランス報告だが、新型H3N2 subclade K（俗称'superflu'）のモニタリング継続中であり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア国内の季節性インフルエンザサーベイランス報告であり、H3N2 subclade K（'superflu'）は非公式な俗称であり公式のWHO/CDC指定ではない点に留意。重症度や国際的拡大に関する具体的データは不明。

article.articleHeadline: संचारी रोगों पर वार, एक माह चलेगा महाअभियान
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Month-Long Mega Campaign to Combat Communicable Diseases
article.articleSummary: Unnao district, Uttar Pradesh, India, launched a month-long special campaign to control communicable diseases, including dengue, malaria, and brain fever (encephalitis). District Magistrate Ghanshyam Meena flagged off the rally from Uma Shankar Dixit District Hospital, marking the campaign's third phase; officials, staff, and the public were urged to pledge to prevent communicable diseases. Chief Medical Officer Dr. Ajay Kumar Sharma said the Special Communicable Disease Control Campaign will run through October 31, while the Dastak door-to-door campaign will run October 12–31. The program focuses on preventing waterlogging, improving sanitation, waste disposal, and ensuring safe drinking water. The article does not report any case or death counts. This multi-pronged initiative aims to reduce vector-borne and waterborne disease risks during the campaign period.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症対策キャンペーン開始、一か月にわたる大規模運動
triage.triage_reason: これは季節性の媒介生物・水系感染症予防のための定例行政キャンペーンの告知であり、症例数や死亡数の報告がなく、異常性や深刻な公衆衛生インパクトを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はウッタル・プラデーシュ州ウンナーオ県における行政主導の予防キャンペーン（デング熱・マラリア・脳炎対策）の開始を伝えるもので、具体的な症例数・死亡数の報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Pandemias como el covid, un riesgo a debate en un encuentro en la UDC: "El peligro es real
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pandemics like COVID-19, a risk to be debated at a UDC meeting: "The danger is real."
article.articleSummary: At the University of A Coruña, the CITIC hosts a two-day EU ZOE Consortium meeting on zoonotic emergence through degraded and restored forest ecosystems (ZOE). Felix Drexler of Charité, Berlin, warns the danger is real, citing COVID-19 and hantavirus as warnings and noting zoonoses are rising due to human disturbance and livestock intensification. The project studies 'disturbance grades' and how habitat disruption—such as hotels in wild areas or large livestock facilities housing tens of thousands of animals—can upset pathogens in wildlife hosts like bats and rodents, enabling spillover. COVID-19 was highly transmissible but not very lethal; Ebola in Congo is a worse zoonosis. ZOE aims to prevent future pandemics and aid vaccine development, informing policy to protect ecosystems and avert outbreaks. Teams in Guatemala and Mexico contribute, with UDC's Adina Dumitru leading analyses of human impact on ecosystems.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19のようなパンデミック、UDCでの会合で議論されるリスク：「危険は現実のものだ」
triage.triage_reason: これは学術会議・研究プロジェクト(ZOE)に関する報道であり、特定の感染症アウトブレイクの発生を報じるものではないため、トリアージ対象のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は人獣共通感染症の発生メカニズムに関する学術研究会議の内容で、コンゴのエボラやCOVID-19は過去の例として言及されているに過ぎず、新規発生事例ではない。DRCも例示的言及のみでverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Still Air, Falling Temperatures: Weather Patterns Drive Influenza Surges in
article.articleSummary: Influenza in Nanchang, Jiangxi Province, China, shows climate-linked surges. In 120,308 laboratory-confirmed cases from Jan 2023–Mar 2026, activity peaks in winter–spring under a monsoon climate. The 2025 incidence reached 837.36 per 100,000 with the peak in Week 49. Children aged 0–19 accounted for 76% of cases, with students the largest occupational group; Xihu and Honggutan districts bore the heaviest burden. About 89.64% of cases were diagnosed within two days of symptom onset, but delays were more common among those 60+ and among farmers. Weather variables were linked to incidence: average temperature was the most important predictor with a U-shaped relationship, followed by wind speed, cloud cover, and precipitation. Random Forest identified these as key drivers; DLNM modeled lagged effects. The study suggests wind speed may offer an early warning signal; vaccination ahead of winter–spring surges and targeted diagnostics for elderly and rural populations are advised.

triage.headline_ja: 静穏な大気と気温低下:気象パターンが中国の都市でインフルエンザ流行を促進
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに関する気候要因の疫学研究であり、異常な公衆衛生イベントではなく通常の季節性流行パターンの分析報告である。
triage.notes: 本記事は南昌市における季節性インフルエンザと気象要因の関連を分析した学術研究の紹介であり、異常発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。対象国の病原体発生地域としての言及はあるが、研究報告のため地域検証対象外として扱う。

article.articleHeadline: Pasien RSUD Soekardjo Tasikmalaya Melonjak 3 Kali Lipat, Diduga Terpapar Infeksi Virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patients at Soekardjo Regional General Hospital in Tasikmalaya Tripled, Suspected to Have Been Exposed to a Viral Infection
article.articleSummary: As of September 2026, RSUD dr Soekardjo in Tasikmalaya, West Java, reported a surge of viral infections, recording about 182 cases for the month. The hospital could not confirm influenza A, noting they could not detect it despite the overall rise in viral infections. Bed capacity was strained: of 249 adult ward beds, only about 10 were vacant, with 11 patients on the ED waiting list. Administrators shifted bed assignments throughout the day to cope with a threefold increase in cases. Initially pediatric cases dominated in early September, but by the fourth week cases among adults surged and the pediatric numbers declined. Health officials emphasize rapid transmission via droplets and contact; while not lethal, the outbreak correlates with rising symptom burden. Efforts include increased care for referrals from clinics and other hospitals.

triage.headline_ja: タシクマラヤのソエカルジョ県立病院患者が3倍に急増、ウイルス感染の疑い
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア西ジャワ州の病院で呼吸器感染症患者が通常の3倍に急増し病床が逼迫しており、ヒト-ヒト感染（飛沫・接触）の可能性が示唆されているため、WPRO基準複数該当かつ地元メディアで報道されている。
triage.notes: 病原体はインフルエンザAと疑われたが病院側は検出できず未確定。致死性は低いとされるが病床逼迫と飛沫・接触感染拡大の可能性から経過注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Barantin Sulteng Salurkan 100 Dosis Vaksin Rabies untuk Hewan Peliharaan di Palu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Barantin Sulteng Distributes 100 Doses of Rabies Vaccine for Pets in Palu
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination drive for pets in Palu, Central Sulawesi, Indonesia. Barantin Sulteng (Balai Karantina Hewan, Ikan, dan Tumbuhan Sulawesi Tengah) distributed 100 doses of rabies vaccine, with about 20 doses used in the first phase. The initial vaccination took place at Lapangan Vatulemo during Palu City’s 48th anniversary on 27 September 2026. Remaining vaccinations are conducted at the Barantin Sulteng office to reduce stress for animals in crowded, hot conditions. Pets undergo a health check before vaccination to ensure fitness, and owners are advised to keep a health book recording vaccination history. The next dose must be administered at least three months after the previous one. Ahmad Mansuri Alfian, head of Barantin Sulteng, emphasized a staged approach to prevent rabies spread among pets in Palu and surrounding areas.

triage.headline_ja: Barantin中部スラウェシ、パルで狂犬病ワクチン100回分をペットに配布
triage.triage_reason: ペット向け狂犬病予防接種活動の通常の実施報告であり、ヒトの感染事例や異常な流行状況は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 動物向け予防的ワクチン接種活動の報道であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Vaksinasi Rabies Gratis di Palu, Barantin Sulteng Tekankan Risiko Penularan ke Manusia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Free Rabies Vaccination in Palu, Barantan Central Sulawesi, Emphasizes the Risk of Transmission to Humans.
article.articleSummary: Free rabies vaccination for pets in Palu, Central Sulawesi, Indonesia, is being expanded by Barantan Sulteng to curb rabies and support the national goal of a rabies-free Indonesia by 2030. About 100 doses are prepared, with around 20 administered at Lapangan Vatulemo on 27 September 2026, coinciding with Palu’s 48th anniversary. Vaccinations continue at the Barantan office to keep animals calm and reduce stress in busy, hot environments. Rabies, a zoonotic disease that can transmit to humans, is the focus of these efforts to prevent rising cases and protect public health. The initiative strengthens efforts to safeguard pets and advance Indonesia’s 2030 target for rabies elimination in Central Sulawesi.

triage.headline_ja: パルでの無料狂犬病ワクチン接種、中スラウェシ検疫庁が人への感染リスクを強調
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防接種キャンペーンに関する記事であり、異常な発生や急激な症例増加の報告はなく、既存の公衆衛生対策活動の一環である。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的なワクチン接種活動を報じるもので、狂犬病のアウトブレイクや症例急増についての言及はない。2030年までの狂犬病撲滅目標に向けた通常の取り組み。

article.articleHeadline: Barantin Sulteng Vaksinasi Rabies Gratis di Palu, Cegah Penyebaran Penyakit Zoonosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Barantin Sulteng Free Rabies Vaccination in Palu, Prevent the Spread of Zoonotic Diseases.
article.articleSummary: On 2 October 2026, Barantin Sulawesi Tengah (Animal, Fish, and Plant Quarantine Office) in Palu offered free rabies health checks and vaccination for pets, as part of the 149th Quarantine Day. The event at Barantin Sulteng, Jalan Garuda, Birobuli Utara, Palu Selatan, opened to pet owners from 09:00 WITA. Staff conducted pre-vaccination health assessments, including weight and body temperature, before administering rabies shots. Barantin Sulteng head Ahmad Mansuri Alfian said the drive aims to curb rabies cases in Central Sulawesi and support the national program for Indonesia to be rabies-free by 2030. He stressed rabies as a zoonotic disease that can transmit to humans, and vaccination of pets as essential to prevent transmission. A total of 100 rabies doses were prepared for the event, along with public education on animal health.

triage.headline_ja: バランティン・スルテン、パルで無料狂犬病ワクチン接種実施、人獣共通感染症の拡大を防止
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防的ワクチン接種キャンペーンであり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的な狂犬病ワクチン接種イベントの告知であり、具体的な症例増加やアウトブレイクの報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Moringa Shows Promise Against Bacteria Infections and Inflammation
article.articleSummary: 2026-10-02: A review of Moringa oleifera leaves and stems (134 references from PubMed/MEDLINE, Web of Science, Scopus, Google Scholar) reports antibacterial and anti-inflammatory potential. Lab studies show activity against Staphylococcus aureus, Escherichia coli, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Klebsiella pneumoniae, and Enterococcus faecalis, with leaf/stem MICs roughly 0.2–4 mg/mL. Mechanisms include bacterial membrane damage, enzyme interference, reduced adhesion, disrupted quorum sensing, and biofilm inhibition. Astragalin (IC50 ~0.22 mg/mL against E. coli) and compounds such as rutin, chlorogenic acid, and hyperoside contribute activity; astragalin also reduces adhesion and biofilm integrity. On the inflammatory side, Moringin (isothiocyanate) may activate the Nrf2/Keap1 pathway and inhibit NF-κB, while quercetin and kaempferol may lower cytokines and COX/LOX activity. In rats with infected diabetic ulcers, leaf extract reduced bacterial burden and proinflammatory TNF-α/IL-1β, increased anti-inflammatory IL-10, and sped up wound closure, though synergy is unproven. Human evidence is limited; no large randomized trials exist, underscoring the need for standardized preparations and robust clinical studies. Published in International Journal of Molecular Sciences; Thailand Medical News highlighted the findings.

triage.headline_ja: モリンガ（ワサビノキ）、細菌感染症と炎症に対する有望な効果を示す
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はモリンガ葉の抗菌・抗炎症作用に関する基礎研究レビューであり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生事象を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は実験室・動物実験に基づく植物由来成分の抗菌作用に関する学術レビューであり、タイ国内での実際の感染症発生事例ではない。Bluedotが付与した発生地域（Thailand）はメディア掲載国を示すのみで、疾病発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Вирусолог назвала первые симптомы гонконгского гриппа
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Virologist names the first symptoms of the Hong Kong flu.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong flu presents with abrupt high fever, body aches, weakness, and fatigue, followed by cough, sore throat, and runny nose; fever often fluctuates in waves. Virologist Elena Malinnikova told RIA Novosti that these are key symptoms of the Hong Kong flu. Vaccination is advised to avoid complications and severe illness, with current influenza vaccines available in Russia, especially for at-risk groups. Georgiy Vikulov, director of the Scientific Information Center for Prevention and Treatment of Viral Infections, said Hong Kong flu and swine flu are not considered highly dangerous, but vaccination at the start of the autumn-winter season is recommended to reduce disease burden.

triage.notes: 「香港かぜ」はH3N2型インフルエンザの通称であり、記事内容はロシア国内向けの季節性インフルエンザ注意喚起・ワクチン推奨記事。香港・中国・ロシアにおける実際の発生報告ではないため、対象国としての地域該当なし。
