article.articleHeadline: Гонконгский грипп начинается с резкого скачка температуры: врач назвала первые симптомы заболевания
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong flu begins with a sharp fever spike: a doctor described the first symptoms of the disease.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong flu refers to influenza A(H3N2), first identified in Hong Kong in 1968. The 2026 surge is described by abrupt fever spikes with severe weakness, headache, and myalgia, with fever taking a wave-like course that may subside and rise again. Respiratory symptoms (cough, sore throat, runny nose) can appear later and vary in severity among individuals. A new variant emerged this year, but experts say a pandemic is unlikely. High-risk groups include young children, people over 65, pregnant women, and those with chronic diseases or immunocompromised states. Vaccination remains the primary prevention, with current vaccines in Russia covering circulating A(H3N2) strains and updated annually per public health guidance. Additional measures include regular handwashing, ventilating indoor spaces, avoiding close contact with the ill, and seeking medical care if symptoms worsen or in high-risk individuals.

triage.headline_ja: 香港かぜは急激な発熱から始まる：医師が初期症状を解説
triage.triage_reason: 「香港かぜ」はH3N2型インフルエンザの通称であり、本記事はロシア国内向けの季節性インフルエンザに関する一般的な健康啓発記事。特定の国・地域における異常な発生や流行を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 「香港かぜ」は1968年に香港で最初に同定されたH3N2型インフルエンザの歴史的通称であり、記事は現在の香港や中国での発生を報じたものではない。ロシアの季節性インフルエンザワクチン接種に関する一般的な医療情報記事であり、特定の発生国は対象国リストに該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Demam Tinggi Mendadak pada Anak, Waspadai Influenza A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sudden High Fever in Children: Beware Influenza A
article.articleSummary: Influenza A in children in Tangerang City, Indonesia, is highlighted as a condition to monitor when a sudden high fever appears with cough and, in some cases, shortness of breath. Health official Dr. Dini Anggraeni warns that influenza A can start like a common flu but may worsen, especially in children. Parents should not panic but watch for rapid fever onset, cough, or breathing difficulty; seek prompt care if the child shows weakness, digestive disturbance, or a persistent cough with breathlessness. Initial influenza management is symptomatic with rest and good nutrition; if fever remains uncontrolled at home or at first-level health facilities, care should be escalated to referral hospitals. Public education efforts are ongoing via puskesmas networks, social media, and WhatsApp at the RT/RW level, ensuring health staff and referral facilities remain prepared. Published Oct 2, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 子供の急な高熱、インフルエンザAに注意
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAに関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりを示す情報が見られない。
triage.notes: タンゲラン市における小児の季節性インフルエンザAに関する啓発・注意喚起記事で、集団発生や異常な重症度の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Tradisi Brandu Kembali Menularkan Antraks kepada 4 Orang di Gunungkidul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brandu Tradition Again Transmits Anthrax to Four People in Gunungkidul
article.articleSummary: Anthrax has spread to four people in Gunungkidul Regency, Special Region of Yogyakarta, linked to the Brandu tradition of slaughtering sick or dying goats. The outbreak began in early September 2026 after livestock illnesses; seven people were suspected cases, all with direct contact to a goat that appeared weak and died suddenly. PCR confirmed four cases of anthrax. In total, 47 people were identified as at-risk due to exposure to the animals or their products. The four confirmed patients were treated and recovered; at-risk individuals received antibiotic prophylaxis and will be monitored for 60 days (two incubation periods). Health authorities conducted surveillance in Dadapayu, Semanu; samples of meat and soil were collected, and authorities sterilized slaughter sites with formalin and vaccinated livestock. Education campaigns emphasize reporting livestock deaths and avoiding slaughter/consumption of sick animals to prevent transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ブランドゥの伝統が再びグヌンキドゥルで4人に炭疽菌を感染させる
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・グヌンキドゥルで伝統的な病死家畜の解体慣習（ブランドゥ）に関連した炭疽感染事例だが、感染者4名は全員回復し、地元当局が既に検体採取・消毒・予防投薬・監視など対応を完了しており、人-人感染や国際的拡大のリスクも低い。
triage.notes: 炭疽は人獣共通感染症であり、動物由来の感染経路が継続する可能性はあるが、本件は既知の伝統的慣習に起因する散発事例であり、地域保健当局により迅速に制御されている。繰り返し発生している事象（見出しに'again'とあり）であるため異常性は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: संचारी रोगों से बचाव को पूरे महीने चलेगा जागरूकता अभियान
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A month-long awareness campaign to prevent communicable diseases.
article.articleSummary: Kushinagar, Uttar Pradesh hosts a month-long awareness campaign by the Agriculture Department addressing infectious diseases spread by rats and shrews. The campaign warns that flooded fields drive rodents toward homes, increasing risks of Scrub Typhus (Orientia tsutsugamushi) and Leptospirosis (Leptospira). Symptoms include high fever, headache, severe muscle pain, calf pain, and red eyes. To mitigate risk, authorities advocate rodent control with baits, using Zinc Phosphide 80% WP under expert guidance; Aluminum Phosphide is highly toxic and must follow safety standards and expert advice; Bromadiolone 0.005% bait should be used in prescribed amounts. Keep poisons away from children and non-targets. Preserve natural predators such as cats, snakes, owls, foxes, and hawks. Emphasize sanitation, cover and securely store food, and seek immediate medical care for fever, headache, or red eyes.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症予防のため1か月間の啓発キャンペーンを実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防啓発キャンペーンの告知であり、具体的な集団発生や症例数の急増等の報告がなく、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも明確に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は洪水後のネズミ媒介性疾患（つつが虫病・レプトスピラ症）予防の啓発活動を伝える内容で、実際の症例発生や流行の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Island Pharmaceuticals starts Galidesivir production for Ebola emergency-use program | Stockhead
article.articleSummary: Galidesivir production underway for Ebola emergency-use program in Uganda under the WHO MEURI framework. Island Pharmaceuticals (ASX: ILA) started GMP manufacturing of the drug’s active pharmaceutical ingredient on Oct 1, targeting a 5 kg batch by end-October for Uganda’s MEURI program amid the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). A second 5 kg batch is planned by late November to support a broader Ebola strategy and a planned Marburg study in non-human primates under FDA Animal Rule pathway. MEURI enables emergency access to unproven interventions with prospective data collection on efficacy, safety and virology, potentially adding human evidence to existing preclinical/clinical data. Uganda’s MEURI follows the Aug 27 end of its outbreak; however, Bundibugyo in the DRC has reported 8,137 cases and 3,926 deaths as of Sept 27 (CFR ~48%).

triage.headline_ja: アイランド・ファーマシューティカルズ、エボラ緊急使用プログラム向けガリデシビル生産を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCのブンディブギョ型エボラ流行は8,137症例・3,926死亡（致死率約48%）と極めて深刻で、WHOのMEURI枠組みによる緊急薬剤投与が進行中であり、国際的な医療支援を要する重大な公衆衛生事案であるため。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダでのMEURIプログラムによる薬剤生産が主題だが、ウガンダの流行は8月27日に終息済み。対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため除外。主題の深刻な流行はDRCのブンディブギョで継続中。

article.articleHeadline: 登革熱疫情拉警報　彰化縣政府中庭設快篩站
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever outbreak raises alarm as Changhua County Government sets up rapid screening stations in its courtyard.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak persists in Changhua City, Changhua County, Taiwan. Since July, imported dengue cases have surged about twofold, with totals approaching 20. In September, two consecutive locally transmitted dengue cases were confirmed in the Dongxingli neighborhood, signaling community spread. Viral sequencing identified dengue virus serotype 1, traced to a person who returned from Vietnam in August. In response, the county Health Bureau announced eight high-risk dirty sites—abandoned and unsanitary areas—and will fine landlords who refuse cleanup orders; authorities will use subrogation to mobilize environmental cleaners for compulsory clearance. Two rapid screening stations were established in the county government courtyard and on Dongmin Street, with the first wave of testing notifying more than 50 nearby households for blood tests. Residents frequenting these sites or living nearby are urged to intensify vector control and seek prompt medical care if symptoms arise to prevent further community spread.

triage.headline_ja: 登革熱疫情拉警報　彰化縣政府中庭設快篩站（デング熱の流行警戒、彰化県政府が中庭に迅速検査ステーションを設置）
triage.triage_reason: 台湾彰化県で輸入症例の増加に加え地域内感染が確認されたが、現時点では局地的な対応（検査・清掃）で管理可能とみられ、国際的拡大のリスクは限定的。
triage.notes: 発生地域に台湾とベトナムが含まれるが、台湾もベトナムも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。ベトナムは感染者の渡航歴として言及されているのみで、発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 4 Warga Semanu Gunungkidul Positif Antraks, 47 Orang Masuk Risiko Terpapar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 4 Semanu residents in Gunungkidul test positive for anthrax, 47 people at risk of exposure.
article.articleSummary: On 2 October 2026, four residents of Padukuhan Pelem, Kalurahan Dadapayu, Kapanewon Semanu in Gunungkidul Regency, Yogyakarta, Indonesia, tested positive for anthrax, with 47 more people identified as at risk due to contact with goats. Seven initial suspects emerged after exposure to goats that died suddenly; four were confirmed positive as cases, while treatments are underway and conditions are reported to be improving. Soil samples collected around the goat slaughter site tested positive for Bacillus anthracis. Dinkes Gunungkidul and DPP Gunungkidul are conducting investigations and providing antibiotic prophylaxis to the 47 at risk, with monitoring planned up to 60 days or two incubation periods. Public education campaigns warn against slaughtering or consuming meat from sick or dead animals, and compensation for livestock owners is offered to deter such practices. Seven goats died suddenly; three were slaughtered and meat distributed, with earlier reports of 54 people having eaten that meat.

triage.headline_ja: グヌンキドゥルのセマヌ地区住民4人が炭疽陽性、47人が曝露リスク
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの地域で発生した炭疽の集団事例で、動物由来かつヒト-ヒト感染のない地域流行病であり、地元保健当局が予防投薬・監視を実施中で管理下にある。国際的拡大リスクや渡航貿易制限の可能性は低い。
triage.notes: 炭疽はインドネシアの一部地域（グヌンキドゥルを含む）で散発的に発生する地方病的な動物由来感染症であり、本事例も感染源（病死したヤギ）が特定され、地元当局により封じ込め対応が進行中。重症例や死亡者の報告はなく、国際的な懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Rabies is possible to control
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies can be controlled.
article.articleSummary: Gokak, Belgaum district, Karnataka, India — On World Rabies Prevention Day, Dr. Mohan Kumte urged that timely vaccination of dogs can control rabies. Dog owners should regularly monitor their pets’ health and ensure vaccinations and boosters are administered on schedule. With dog-bite–related rabies cases on the rise, citizens were urged to exercise caution. In case of a dog bite, wash the wound with soap and running water and seek medical advice promptly. The remarks were delivered during a World Rabies Prevention Day programme held Monday at the veterinary hospital premises, with attendance by veterinary officers and staff. The program stressed the critical role of vaccination and adherence to post-exposure protocols.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病は制御可能
triage.triage_reason: 世界狂犬病予防デーの啓発イベントに関する一般的な報道であり、具体的な異常発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 犬咬傷による狂犬病症例増加との記載はあるが、具体的な症例数や死亡例の報告はなく、啓発イベントの報道が中心。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết ở Đà Nẵng tăng 2,4 lần, ngành y tế đang giám sát chặt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever in Da Nang has risen 2.4-fold; health authorities are closely monitoring.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Da Nang, Vietnam, has reached 4,251 cases in the first nine months of 2026, up 2.4-fold from the same period in 2025. Da Nang CDC reports 39 of 56 virus isolates tested were dengue-type D2 (about 70% positivity), a strain linked to severe illness and fatalities. Weather is favorable for Aedes mosquitoes, raising the risk of a wider outbreak if control measures falter. Authorities are boosting surveillance and reporting through the MOH online system (Circular 15/2026/TT-BYT) and deploying rapid-response teams in high-incidence areas. Vector-control campaigns include larval source reduction, insecticide spraying, and community education via social media, SMS, and Hotline 1022. Citizens are urged to spend 10–15 minutes daily to remove standing water and larvae; vaccination is available for those aged 4+, and fever should prompt prompt medical consultation.

triage.headline_ja: ダナンのデング熱が2.4倍に増加、保健当局が厳重監視中
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例の顕著な増加（2.4倍）と重症化しやすいD2型の高い検出率が見られるが、現時点では国際的拡大や渡航制限等の明確な懸念は無く、当局による既存の対策体制内で管理されているためWATCH判定とする。
triage.notes: 地域流行性のデング熱増加事例であり、ベトナム国内での既存のサーベイランス・媒介蚊対策で対応中。重症型D2株の高検出率は注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza A Naik, Kenali Gejala Awal yang Perlu Diwaspadai
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A cases rise; know the early symptoms to watch out for.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia reports 46% influenza positivity in week 36, up to Sept 19, 2026; of 185 specimens, 86 tested positive: 76 influenza A(H1N1)pdm09, 8 A(H3N2), and 2 influenza B(Victoria). Children aged 0–4 years account for 42% of cases, though overall activity remains low. Influenza A, which drives seasonal outbreaks and has pandemic potential, includes A(H1N1)pdm09 and A(H3N2); A(H5N1) is mainly an avian virus. Early symptoms are abrupt and include fever, myalgia, headache, fatigue, dry cough, sore throat, nasal congestion, and sometimes nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea (more common in children). CDC notes uncomplicated illness lasting 3–7 days; cough and malaise may persist beyond two weeks, especially in the elderly or those with chronic lung disease. Most recover within about a week without care (WHO), but urgent care is advised for signs such as shortness of breath, chest or abdominal pain, confusion, dehydration, seizures, or deterioration of chronic conditions.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA感染例が増加、注意すべき初期症状を知る
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1pdm09)の通常の検査陽性率報告であり、全体の活動は低水準で重症化や異常性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザのサーベイランス報告記事。H5N1への言及は一般的な背景説明であり、実際の症例報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Influenza A Menjelang Musim Hujan, Simak Gejalanya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be wary of Influenza A as the rainy season approaches; learn its symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Deputy Health Minister Dante Saksono Harbuwono says Influenza A is not dangerous and is usually self-limiting, with recovery without treatment. Officials are monitoring domestic cases, but there has been no significant rise nationally or globally. Influenza A, caused by influenza A virus, spreads via respiratory droplets and follows a seasonal pattern in Indonesia, typically increasing ahead of the rainy season and waning in February–March. The minister urged the public to respond proportionally and avoid sensationalized headlines. The remarks were made in Jakarta on October 2, 2026. No laboratory-confirmed outbreaks or case counts are reported in the article, and there is no indication of imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季を前にインフルエンザAに注意を、症状を確認しよう
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザAは季節性で深刻でないと当局が説明しており、症例数の顕著な増加もなく、IHR・WPRO基準いずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 当局は季節性インフルエンザであり危険ではないと明言し、国内外で有意な増加もないと述べている。注意喚起的な記事であり、具体的な症例数・アウトブレイクの報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: В АТОР оценили ситуацию с крысиной лихорадкой в Таиланде
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ATOR Assessed the Murine Typhus Situation in Thailand.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, the Association of Tour Operators of Russia (ATOR) states that Russian organized tourists in Thailand are not at risk from leptospirosis, since they stay in hotels and visit venues that meet sanitary standards. The Thai Ministry of Public Health had warned about the disease’s spread among residents of flooded homes and volunteers involved in flood response in Bangkok and other areas. The advisory targets locals and responders, not travelers. The report references an archival image from Nai Thon Beach, Phuket. In short, organized tourism for Russians in Thailand is not considered threatened by leptospirosis based on current precautions, though flood-affected communities should remain vigilant.

triage.headline_ja: ATOR、タイのレプトスピラ症（ねずみチフス）状況を評価
triage.triage_reason: タイの洪水被災地域住民・ボランティアでのレプトスピラ症拡大が報告されているが、組織旅行者への影響は低いとされ、詳細な規模や重症度情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア人観光客向けの安全性評価が主眼であり、洪水被災地住民・ボランティアにおけるレプトスピラ症流行の詳細（症例数、死亡者数など）は不明。タイ保健省の注意喚起内容の継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ritorno del Covid, Bassetti commenta l'aumento dei casi: "Ecco cosa sta succedendo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Return of COVID-19, Bassetti comments on the rise in cases: "Here's what's happening."
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 is rising again, with Santé publique France reporting a 76% increase in GP visits for COVID-19 during the week of 14–20 September (data updated 23 September). Matteo Bassetti, head of the Infectious Diseases Department at San Martino Hospital, attributes the resurgence to waning immunity from vaccination and prior infections, and notes reduced testing masking true case counts. He also observes that current presentations resemble influenza, with mild cold-like symptoms and headaches. The uptick has appeared in France, the United States, and China, and is now also emerging in Italy. While generally not severe for the broader population, the elderly and those with comorbidities over 80 should receive annual vaccination, as vaccines administered in 2021 offer little protection for this age group.

triage.headline_ja: コロナの再流行、バセッティ氏が症例増加についてコメント「これが現状だ」
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のCOVID-19増加に関する専門家コメントであり、重症度や異常性は示されておらず、既知の季節的変動の範囲内と考えられる。
triage.notes: 記事はフランス・米国・イタリアでの増加が主題であり、これらは対象国リストに含まれない。中国への言及はあるが詳細情報はなく、主題はイタリア国内の状況分析。重症度に関する言及なく、季節性インフルエンザ様の軽症例と記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A Bisa Menular Sebelum Gejala Muncul, Dinkes P2KB Jember Ungkap Cara Pencegahan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A Can Be Transmitted Before Symptoms Appear, Jember Health Office P2KB Reveals Prevention Measures
article.articleSummary: Jember, Indonesia—The Jember Health Office (Dinkes P2KB) warns that influenza A can spread easily, amid rising acute respiratory infections. Preventive measures emphasize personal hygiene and healthy living (PHBS): hand washing, mask-wearing in crowds, nutritious meals, adequate rest, and vaccination for high-risk groups. Influenza A transmits via droplets, especially in dense settings such as schools, pesantren, families, and workplaces. Infected individuals can shed the virus before symptoms and for 5–7 days after onset, with contagiousness starting 1–3 days prior. Symptoms include sudden high fever, dry cough, muscle aches, and severe fatigue, though these do not definitively indicate influenza A. As of 02 Oct 2026, no influenza A cases have been diagnosed in Jember, and rapid tests or PCR have not been performed to confirm cases.

triage.headline_ja: 発症前にも感染しうるインフルエンザA、ジェンバル保健局(P2KB)が予防策を発表
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザAに関する一般的な予防啓発記事であり、ジェンバルでは実際の感染例は確認されておらず、異常性や重篤性、国際的拡大リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザに関する啓発・予防情報であり、確定症例の報告はない。感染地域として挙げられたインドネシア(Jember)は対象国リストに含まれるが、実際の発生事例がないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Zambia : Chilanga Records 8 Cholera Cases
article.articleSummary: Eight cholera cases have been recorded in Chilanga District, with all eight treated and discharged. Acting Chilanga District Commissioner Maureen Chilende told media the cases originated in neighboring Chibombo District and sought care at facilities in Chilanga, including Tubalange Mini Hospital. A further suspected cholera case, admitted on Tuesday, September 30, is awaiting laboratory results. The Department of Health is conducting contact tracing to prevent further spread. Clinicians have been reoriented and are actively screening facilities for cholera, supported by Community Based Volunteers conducting community sensitisation on prevention, with outreach funded by the Zambia National Public Health Institute and the Red Cross Society in Game Area (Chilanga Ward) and Kazimva (Namalombwe Ward). No deaths have been reported in the district since the current cholera outbreak was announced by the MOH.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビア：チランガでコレラ8例を記録
triage.triage_reason: 既存のコレラアウトブレイクに関連する小規模症例（8例、全員回復・死亡なし）の継続報告であり、WPRO基準の一部に該当するが深刻度・国際的拡大の懸念は低く、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 既にMOHにより発表されている既存のコレラアウトブレイクの一環としての地区別報告。全例軽症で死亡なし、接触者追跡や啓発活動など国内の通常対応が行われている。

article.articleHeadline: ทำไมโรคฉี่หนูถึงต้องเฝ้าระวังหลังน้ำท่วม ? | Thai PBS NOW
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why does leptospirosis need to be monitored after floods? | Thai PBS NOW
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis (Weil disease) is a zoonotic bacterial infection in Thailand that spreads from animal urine into water and wet soil, driving outbreaks during floods and the rainy season. Transmission occurs via direct contact with urine from reservoir animals (rats, pigs, horses, dogs, cattle) or indirectly through contaminated floodwater. Incubation is 1–2 weeks. Mild cases present fever, headache, muscle aches and red eyes; severe disease includes jaundice, low blood pressure, kidney or lung involvement, and bleeding. Early antibiotics improve outcomes; risk groups include farmers, veterinarians, and flood-affected individuals. Prevention includes handwashing after handling animals, wearing boots in water, avoiding barefoot exposure, and rodent control. Other flood-related infections noted are conjunctivitis during the rainy season, melioidosis common in northeastern Thailand, and hand, foot and mouth disease in young children.

triage.headline_ja: 洪水後にレプトスピラ症（ワイル病）を警戒すべき理由とは？ | Thai PBS NOW
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後の季節性レプトスピラ症に関する一般的な啓発記事であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の重大な影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は啓発・予防情報が中心で、具体的な症例数や流行拡大の報告はない。口蹄疫についての言及はなく、疾患名リストのFoot And Mouth DiseaseはHFMD（手足口病）の誤分類と思われる。

article.articleHeadline: Korban Ebola di RD Kongo kemungkinan lebih tinggi dari laporan resmi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola victims in DR Congo likely exceed official reports.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo may exceed official counts, as MSF warns gaps in surveillance and case detection blunt the response. Since the outbreak began in May, more than 8,000 confirmed cases and around 4,000 deaths have been reported, making it the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak on record in DR Congo. MSF notes healthcare workers are among those at highest risk, and one MSF staff member involved in patient care tested positive for Bundibugyo virus and is being medically evacuated to the Netherlands under strict protocols. The UN warns escalating violence in eastern DR Congo is hampering containment, after a transit center for suspected patients was burned at the Kigonze refugee camp in Ituri province. The outbreak ranks as the second-largest globally after the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数、公式報告より多い可能性
triage.triage_reason: DRCで8,000人超の確定症例・約4,000人死亡という過去最大規模のエボラ流行が続いており、医療従事者感染や国際医療搬送、紛争による対応阻害も発生しているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: オランダはMSFスタッフの医療搬送先であり発生国ではないため除外。アンゴラへの言及はサマリー上なく除外。本件は2014-2016西アフリカ流行に次ぐ史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行であり、紛争による対応阻害やサーベイランスの不備が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Adventurer who nearly died from malaria braves jungle on inflatable
article.articleSummary: Published 2026-10-02: Adventurer Ash Dykes launches Project Six, a month-long Congo Basin expedition down the Sangha River, paddling 434 miles on an inflatable kayak with a small team. He will start Oct 3, entering Dzanga-Dzanga National Park, hoping to glimpse forest elephants and silverback gorillas while facing Nile crocodile risk. Dykes recalls malaria in Madagascar, where five days of illness preceded care. He also cites the 2010 crocodile attack on Hendrik Coetzee on the Lukuga River in the Congo; locals warned that war had pushed about 1,500 bodies into the river, feeding larger Nile crocodiles. If successful, he plans a London return before Halloween, then Mission Two in November in a freezing Northern Hemisphere location, possibly −15°C.

triage.headline_ja: マラリアで九死に一生を得た冒険家、クロコダイルが生息するジャングルをインフレータブルカヤックで挑む
triage.triage_reason: 個人の冒険譚であり、公衆衛生上の脅威やアウトブレイクに関する情報は含まれていない。マラリアへの言及は過去の個人的エピソードに過ぎない。
triage.notes: 記事は冒険家Ash Dykesのコンゴ川流域探検記であり、マラリアはマダガスカルでの過去の個人体験として言及されているのみ。対象国リストに含まれる具体的な感染症アウトブレイク情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Kawardha News: पशुओं पर मंडराया संक्रमण का खतरा, गांव-गांव पहुंची टीमें, 3 लाख से ज्यादा को लगे टीके | Animal Vaccination Campaign Over 3 Lakh Livestock Vaccinated
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kawardha News: Threat of infection looming over livestock, teams reached villages across the district, vaccinations administered to more than 300,000 animals.
article.articleSummary: As of October 2, 2026, Kawardha district has launched a large livestock vaccination drive to protect cattle, buffaloes, goats, sheep, and pigs from multiple infectious diseases. Since late May, veterinary teams have vaccinated over 242,800 animals, about 96% of the target. Cattle and buffalo vaccination addresses diseases including Ektangiya and Galghontu, plus Lumpy Skin Disease, with around 170,000 cattle vaccinated for the latter. The pig population (~2,600) saw 2,300 vaccinated. Small ruminants are being covered under a PPR (Peste des Petits Ruminants) campaign, with 108,023 animals registered for a Sept 20–Oct 20 drive. Earlier, about 17,200 young goats and sheep received ET-related vaccines ahead of the monsoon. Health checks accompany vaccination, including 270 animals examined at a Gaushala and deworming where needed. Officials urge timely vaccination and symptom reporting.

triage.headline_ja: カワルダ・ニュース：家畜に感染の脅威、各村にチーム到達、30万頭以上にワクチン接種
triage.triage_reason: 動物の感染症（PPR・ランピースキン病）に対する予防的ワクチン接種事業の進捗報告であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生リスクや異常な流行拡大は認められない。
triage.notes: 動物疾患（PPR、ランピースキン病等）に対する予防接種キャンペーンの実施状況報告であり、ヒト感染症のアウトブレイクではない。

article.articleHeadline: संगमनेरला गढूळ पाण्याचा विळखा! साथीच्या आजारांनी रुग्णालये भरली प्रशासनाच्या आकडेवारीवर सवाल
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Sangamner, a ring of muddy water! Hospitals filled with infectious diseases; questions raised about the administration's statistics.
article.articleSummary: Sangamner city confronts a mud-filled water crisis as taps deliver turbid drinking water, with sediments seen after storage. Despite dam releases from Bhandardara, Nilwande, and Adhala, clean water remains scarce. A drought year (rainfall about 50% of last year) worsens the situation, though certain floods temporarily filled reservoirs. Hospitals report rising cases of fever, cold, cough, body aches, abdominal and back pain, along with dengue, malaria, chikungunya, and jaundice. In September 2026, dengue testing covered 73 samples with 8 positives; chikungunya had 4 samples tested with none positive; malaria had 9,149 samples tested with none positive. A month recorded eight dengue cases. Government data versus private hospitals show substantial discrepancies in patient counts, prompting questions about surveillance. Routine fumigation is reportedly not being conducted, compounding public health risk amid ongoing outbreaks and water contamination concerns.

triage.headline_ja: サングムネールで濁った水の渦!季節性疾患で病院が満床、行政の統計に疑問の声
triage.triage_reason: インド・マハーラーシュトラ州サングムネールで水質汚染に伴うデング熱・マラリア・チクングニア等の季節性感染症が報告されているが、症例数は少なく重症度も不明瞭なため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・マハーラーシュトラ州サングムネール市における飲料水の濁り・汚染問題と、それに伴う季節性感染症（デング熱、マラリア、チクングニア等）の増加、行政統計と民間病院データの乖離について報じている。パキスタンの地域情報はBluedotの発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事サマリーでは言及されていないため除外した。症例数（デング熱8例、マラリア陽性0例）は限定的で、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大性は現時点で不明。

article.articleHeadline: 中國駐剛果使館急發撤離令！伊波拉奪4000命又逢民兵政府軍衝突
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Chinese embassy in the Congo issues an urgent evacuation order! Ebola claims 4,000 lives as clashes between militias and government forces erupt.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is spreading in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 8,116 confirmed cases and 3,924 deaths across seven provinces (Ituri; North Kivu; South Kivu; Haut-Uele; Bas-Uele; Tshopo; South Ubangi) as of 28 September 2026. The Chinese embassy in Kinshasa issued an urgent evacuation alert on 1 October 2026, urging Chinese nationals and businesses to withdraw or relocate to safety and to avoid outbreak zones. Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu and Haut-Uele are declared extremely high risk; Lualaba, Haut-Katanga, Bas-Uele, Tanganyika, Maniema, Kasai-Central, Sankuru, Lomami, and Upper Lomami are high risk. Security deteriorates as government forces clash with M23, CODECO, CRP and other militias in North and South Kivu and Ituri. On 28 September, M23 drones struck militant positions in Masisi, killing 8 civilians and injuring 6; on 29 September, an attack in Masisi left 3 dead and 3 injured.

triage.headline_ja: 中国駐コンゴ大使館が緊急退避命令！エボラ出血熱で4000人死亡、さらに民兵と政府軍の衝突も発生
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で8,116症例・3,924人死亡という大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行が継続しており、中国大使館による緊急退避勧告や治安悪化（武装勢力との衝突）も重なり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の両方で複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 7州（Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, Tshopo, South Ubangi）にわたる大規模流行。致死率は約48%と高い。M23・CODECO等の武装勢力との軍事衝突により医療アクセス・対応能力がさらに悪化している点にも注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo registra novos casos de sarampo e atinge 40 notificações em 2026 -- Política Distrital agora é PDNews, notícias sobre Política e Saúde do DF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo records new measles cases and reaches 40 notifications in 2026 -- District Politics is now PDNews, news about Politics and Health in the Federal District.
article.articleSummary: Measles in São Paulo State, Brazil, reaches 40 infections in 2026, with the city of São Paulo accounting for 36 cases (90% of positives). New diagnoses on Oct 1 involve two men (ages 18 and 21) and a 1-year-old infant, linked to transmission chains active since June. Surveillance by the Center for Epidemiological Vigilance notes capital hosts the majority of cases; São Bernardo do Campo (2), Guarulhos (1), and Santo André (1) report additional detections. Of the 40 infected this year, 30 have no vaccination history or doses overdue. Authorities emphasize vaccination to prevent new foci and maintain isolation. Transmission appears to be declining in Guarulhos and São Bernardo do Campo. The measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccine remains the main defense: first dose at 12 months, booster at 15 months; 15 months–29 years require two doses; 30–59 years at least one; health workers two doses. Dose zero is offered for 6–11 month infants with suspected exposure in locales.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、麻疹の新規症例を記録し2026年の通知数は40件に到達
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の継続的な伝播（6月以降）とワクチン未接種者が多いことから流行しやすさが懸念されるが、ブラジルは対象国であり小規模な局地的発生に留まるため、フルRRAに進むほどの深刻性は現時点で確認できない。
triage.notes: サンパウロ州内での局地的な麻疹流行で、ワクチン未接種者を中心に6月以降伝播が継続。一部地域（グアルーリョス、サンベルナルド・ド・カンポ）では減少傾向との記載あり。重症度・死亡例の記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo: Noch nicht unter Kontrolle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo: Not yet under control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo remains not under control. Africa-CDC reports more than 8,000 confirmed cases and 4,000 deaths since May, with likely undercounting due to surveillance gaps. Cases expanded from three health zones to 63. More than 7,000 people, mainly health workers and volunteers, have been vaccinated and 50,000 doses delivered; Ervebo targets the Zaire variant, while Bundibugyo variant currently circulates in the east with no specific vaccines or therapies. Three-week data hint at a decline, but epidemiologists caution against assuming the outbreak is controlled given security challenges and community resistance, including denial of the virus and opposition to burial measures; Nord-Kivu province reports 59% case fatality. Paper-based reporting hampers data flow; efforts to digitalize include Starlink licenses, tablets, and mobile devices. International aid approaches $3 billion pledged by the G20, Germany contributing $127 million; numerous countries have travel restrictions for Congo, which Africa-CDC argues reduces reporting and transparency is essential as the virus spreads via bodily fluids, not air.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行：まだ制御下にない
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部でのエボラ流行は8,000例超・死亡4,000人超、致死率59%、63保健区域に拡大し、医療体制の脆弱性や地域住民の抵抗により制御が困難。国際的な資金・渡航制限も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ドイツは資金拠出国として言及されているが、発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外。Africa-CDCおよびG20による国際支援の動きが顕著で、致死率の高さと地域的拡大が深刻なリスクを示している。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en la RDC: más de 8.000 casos y 81 % de letalidad
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: More than 8,000 cases and 81% fatality rate.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) declared May 15 has surpassed 8,000 confirmed infections and near 4,000 deaths as of Sept 26: 8,067 infections and 3,901 deaths (case fatality rate 48.4%). About 2,070 recoveries and 773 hospitalized or in isolation; contact tracing 74.7%. Active community transmission persists in Ituri, North Kivu, Haut-Uélé and Bas-Uélé. Investigations completed for 95.2% of suspected cases within 24 hours. IOM warns that population movements fuel spread; by Sept 21 the DRC reported over 7,700 cases and 3,700 deaths. The outbreak spans 63 health zones across seven provinces: Ituri, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, North Kivu, South Kivu and South Ubangi. IDP camps show an 81% fatality rate. Congo River corridor Kinshasa remains a focus. IOM, with WHO and Africa CDC, strengthens surveillance, case management, logistics, and community engagement; funding needs total $69m for DRC and $110m regionally, with $29.6m mobilized and ~$80.4m gap.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：感染者8,000人超、致死率81%
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で8,000人超の感染者、致死率約48%（一部地域では81%）という深刻なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続しており、複数州への拡大と国際支援の必要性（資金ギャップ約8,040万ドル）が確認されているため、フルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: IOM、WHO、Africa CDCが連携して対応中だが資金ギャップが大きく（必要総額約1.79億ドルのうち約2,960万ドルのみ調達）、国際支援の継続的必要性が高い。IDPキャンプでの致死率81%は特に深刻。

article.articleHeadline: В Шелехове Иркутской области пациентка умерла от "особо опасной инфекции". Это может быть чума - ЭХО
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Shelekhov, Irkutsk Oblast, a female patient died from a highly dangerous infection. This could be plague — Echo.
article.articleSummary: In Shelekhov District Hospital, Irkutsk Oblast, Russia, several hospital departments were quarantined due to a highly dangerous infection. A female patient, who had arrived from Thailand, died and was hospitalized with pneumonic plague; authorities have not officially confirmed the disease, though earlier reports linked quarantine to suspected plague. Governor Igor Kobzev convened an extraordinary regional sanitary-epidemiological commission, with participation from Russia’s Chief Sanitary Doctor Anna Popova. All identified contacts are under medical observation; as of now, they show no symptoms and laboratory tests are negative. The article notes the case involves an imported patient from Thailand, but the specific infection source and final diagnosis were not disclosed by officials. The situation centers on potential foreign-origin plague concerns and ongoing monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: イルクーツク州シェレホボで、女性患者が『特に危険な感染症』により死亡。ペストの可能性 — エコー通信
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペスト疑いで死亡例が発生し、病院の複数病棟が隔離、州知事主導の緊急衛生疫学委員会が招集されるなど公的対応が強まっており、診断未確定・渡航歴ありという点でIHR基準複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。患者はタイから帰国した渡航者とされるが、タイ国内での感染拡大や発生は報告されていないため Thailand は含めない。診断は未確定（当局未発表）であり、続報での確定診断・接触者の症状発現有無の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo official killed defending Ebola response buried
article.articleSummary: Eastern DRC's 17th and deadliest Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has recorded over 8,000 cases and nearly 4,000 deaths as of 2026-10-02. Transmission is ongoing across Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Sud Ubangi and Tshopo, with Ituri the hardest hit. There is no vaccine or approved specific treatment for Bundibugyo; researchers are testing candidates. Officials pursue a village-based response, but distrust persists, with some residents dismissing Ebola as a hoax. Rebel-held areas in eastern DRC further complicate control efforts, contributing to a difficult environment for responders. In a related violent incident, Marie-Celestin Karondwa, a Butembo politician in North Kivu, was beaten at his home after defending the government's Ebola response on radio; he died from injuries in hospital, motive unknown. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns of a 'catastrophic collision of disease and conflict' in the region.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴ:エボラ対応を擁護した当局者が殺害され埋葬される
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行で8000例・死者約4000人に達し、紛争地域での対応困難と地域社会の不信が拡大リスクを高めているため、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: ワクチン・特異的治療薬が未承認のブンディブギョ株による史上最悪規模の流行。紛争地域での対応、住民の不信、暴力事件（当局者殺害）が対応をさらに複雑化させている。WHO事務局長も『疾病と紛争の破滅的衝突』と警告。

article.articleHeadline: 吃壽司嘔吐腹瀉！瑞典360人集體中毒　韓知名海苔驗出諾羅
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Eating sushi, vomiting and diarrhea! Mass poisoning of 360 people in Sweden; Norovirus detected in a famous Korean seaweed snack.
article.articleSummary: Norovirus outbreak in Sweden linked to a Korean seaweed snack sickened about 360 people at two sushi restaurants in Laholm Municipality in April 2026, with vomiting and diarrhea as the main symptoms. Unopened sushi seaweed was tested, revealing norovirus with the same genotype as patients. The batch, produced by the Guangchuan Seaweed brand and imported from Korea, led to a nationwide recall of about 22,000 packs in May and immediate destruction of the affected stock. While the Swedish Food Agency noted the manufacturing date was roughly 10 months prior to the outbreak, attribution to the seaweed remains uncertain and other infection sources are possible. The Korean Ministry of Food and Drug Safety said the batch had been exported in July 2025, over a year before; the virus's infectiousness is considered unlikely, but monitoring continues. The episode raises European calls for stricter heavy metals and microbiological testing on seaweed products.

triage.headline_ja: 寿司を食べて嘔吐・下痢！スウェーデンで360人が集団食中毒、韓国の有名海苔からノロウイルス検出
triage.triage_reason: 発生国はスウェーデン、原因食品は韓国産海苔であり、対象国リストに該当する国での発生ではないため対象外とする。
triage.notes: 発生場所はスウェーデン（対象国外）、原因食品は韓国産海苔（対象国の韓国ではあるがリストに含まれず、かつ発生国でもない）。発生地域に中国が含まれているが記事内容に中国への言及はなく無関係と判断。対象国での発生事例ではないためDISMISS。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza A Naik, Dinkes Medan Siagakan Seluruh Puskesmas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A cases rise, Medan Health Office mobilizes all Puskesmas.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases rise in Medan, Indonesia, with 15 influenza A and 3 influenza B cases recorded from January to September 2026. The Medan City Health Office (Dinkes Medan) has elevated alert and mobilized all community health centers (Puskesmas) and hospitals, following directives from Mayor Rico Tri Putra Bayu Waas. Given influenza A’s easy human-to-human transmission, attention focuses on high-risk groups, including the elderly, those with comorbidities, and travelers returning from abroad. A readiness notice requires facilities to conduct screening: at Puskesmas for fever above 38 Celsius and cough lasting up to 10 days; at hospitals for fever above 38 Celsius or cough lasting up to 10 days and requiring inpatient care. Health education campaigns and PHBS reinforcement, leveraging local wisdom, are urged.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型の症例増加、メダン保健局が全プスケスマスに警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常範囲内の症例増加であり、地方保健当局による予防的対応と見られるが、継続的な動向確認が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年1月から9月までの累計18件（A型15件、B型3件）と報告数は少なく、季節性インフルエンザの範囲内と考えられる。市長指示による地方自治体レベルの予防的監視強化措置であり、重症例や死亡の報告はない。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: New COVID Wave in US and UK: लौट आया कोरोना वायरस ! ब्रिटेन और अमेरिका में बढ़े मरीज
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New COVID Wave in the US and the UK: The coronavirus has returned! Cases rising in Britain and America.
article.articleSummary: New COVID-19 wave is spreading in the United States and United Kingdom as Stratus (XFG), the so‑called American Covid strain first detected in January 2025, circulates in both countries. UK Health Security Agency data show weekly Covid hospital admissions rising from 0.81 to 1.20 per 100,000, with the share of positive tests increasing from 5.9% to 7%. In London, hospital admissions over seven days rose about 80%, and among those aged 85+ the rate increased from 7.08 to 12.43 per 100,000. Testing is not widespread, so the true scale may be higher. Symptoms resemble flu: sore throat, headache, runny nose, fatigue, with some patients reporting loss of taste and, in others, stomach/digestive issues. Dr. Rene Hoenderkamp notes recent patients with these symptoms, highlighting flu‑like illness linked to Stratus and potential winter co-circulation with other respiratory viruses.

triage.headline_ja: 米国と英国で新たなCOVIDの波：コロナウイルスが再来！英国・米国で患者数増加
triage.triage_reason: 米英で季節性とみられるCOVID-19（Stratus株）の増加が報告されているが、重症度・異常性の面で明確な懸念は示されておらず、対象国（インド）での実際の発生は確認できないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はインド向けメディアによる米英のCOVID動向報道であり、インド国内での発生事例は記載されていないためverified_locationsは空とした。米国・英国・ロンドンは対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Ebola RD Kongo Tembus 8.000, Kenali Virus Bundibugyo & Gejalanya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in DR Congo surpass 8,000; learn about Bundibugyo ebolavirus and its symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 8,000 cases. By 26 September 2026, the ministry reported 8,067 confirmed cases and 3,901 deaths across 63 health zones in seven of the country’s 26 provinces, with a case fatality rate above 48%. The outbreak, declared 15 May 2026, is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DR Congo and the deadliest to date. The disease is caused by Bundibugyo virus (BDBV), one of the Orthoebolavirus species; Ebola outbreaks have involved EBOV, SUDV, and BDBV. Bundibugyo was first identified in 2007 in Bundibugyo District, Uganda. Early symptoms are non-specific: fever, fatigue, myalgia, headache, sore throat; later vomiting, diarrhea, rash, renal and hepatic dysfunction, and possible bleeding. The incubation is 2–21 days (avg 8–10). Transmission is via contact with bodily fluids, especially once ill. WHO cites high mortality and health-system strain complicating rapid detection and patient care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の症例が8,000人を超える、ブンディブギョウイルスとその症状について
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最悪規模のエボラ流行（8,067症例、致死率48%超、7州63保健区に拡大）であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれるが、これはBundibugyoウイルスの発見地としての言及であり、現在の流行発生国はDRCのみ。ウガンダでの現行流行は記事中に言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Older Adults Delay Seeking Rabies Treatment After Animal Bites, Hangzhou
article.articleSummary: Rabies remains nearly 100% fatal after symptom onset but preventable with timely post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP). A Hangzhou, China study of 3,327 exposure-related clinic visits (October 2022–October 2025) at Tongde Hospital of Zhejiang Province examined why people delay care. Only 218 visits (6.6%) occurred on a calendar day after injury, using calendar-day delay as a conservative proxy. After adjustment, patients aged 65 and older had significantly higher odds of delayed presentation than those 15–44 years (aOR 2.28; 95% CI 1.31–3.96; p=0.003). Pre-hospital wound self-treatment was associated with higher odds of delay (aOR 2.72; 95% CI 2.00–3.69). The oldest group was less likely to report self-treatment, but this was not statistically significant (aOR 0.71; 95% CI 0.50–1.01; p=0.056). Findings were modeled separately; no individual linkage between delay and self-care. Implication: targeted outreach in Hangzhou to prompt prompt PEP after bites. WHO guidelines stress washing wounds for at least 15 minutes.

triage.headline_ja: 高齢者は動物に噛まれた後の狂犬病治療を遅らせる傾向、杭州の研究で判明
triage.triage_reason: これは狂犬病曝露後の受診遅延に関する行動疫学研究の紹介記事であり、新規アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は狂犬病の発生報告ではなく、杭州の病院における受診行動の研究報告であるため、感染症イベントとしてのトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: همزمانی کرونا و آنفلوآنزا در ایران؛ زنگ هشدار برای مراکز درمانی به صدا درآمد | اطلاع باما
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Coexistence of COVID-19 and influenza in Iran; the alarm bell for healthcare facilities has sounded | اطلاع باما
article.articleSummary: In Iran, simultaneous increases in COVID-19 and influenza have prompted heightened health surveillance. The Respiratory Disease Surveillance System reports a COVID-19 test positivity of 17.4%, up from 8.9% in the same period last year, indicating ongoing community transmission. Influenza activity is rising, with children accounting for about 36.5% of positive influenza cases, including substantial shares among those under 2, 2–5, and 6–15 years. Influenza B now predominates among detected influenza viruses, whereas influenza A was dominant in the previous season. The dual circulation could strain healthcare facilities, especially respiratory and pediatric wards. Some COVID-19 samples are undergoing genetic analysis, with sequences linked to Omicron and its sublineages. International context notes increased influenza activity in East Asia (China, South Korea). Peak timing remains uncertain; continued simultaneous surveillance is essential.

triage.headline_ja: イランにおけるコロナとインフルエンザの同時流行；医療機関に警鐘が鳴らされる
triage.triage_reason: イランにおける季節性インフルエンザとCOVID-19の同時流行であり、対象国（Bluedotの日本向けモニタリング対象国）には該当しない。中国・韓国への言及も国際的文脈の一部に過ぎず主題ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はイランの国内医療体制への影響を主題としており、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。中国・韓国のインフルエンザ活動増加は国際的な文脈として触れられているのみで、記事の主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolapatiënt uit Congo in strikte isolatie in LUMC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patient from Congo in strict isolation at LUMC.
article.articleSummary: An MSF staff member infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is in strict isolation at Leiden University Medical Center (LUMC) since Oct 1, 2026. The patient, identity not disclosed, was repatriated to the Netherlands by a French private aircraft for medical escort, landing at Schiphol around 19:45; ambulances with the Royal Netherlands Marechaussee transported him to LUMC. Dutch authorities say the hospital is prepared for intake, screening, and care and that visiting is possible; LUMC maintains a specialized isolation unit and conducts drills. MSF notes that while precautions are extensive, transmission risk cannot be completely ruled out. The Congo outbreak, declared May 15, involves the Bundibugyo variant; as of Sep 28, there were 8,067 confirmed cases and 3,901 deaths; no approved vaccine or treatment exists.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ出身のエボラ患者、ライデン大学医療センター（LUMC）にて厳重隔離
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が8,067症例・3,901死亡と深刻かつ異常な公衆衛生事象であり、患者の国際搬送という国際的拡大リスクも確認されたためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 患者はオランダ・ライデンに搬送され隔離治療中だが、感染源・流行地はDRCであるためオランダ・フランスは対象国リストに含まれず除外。致死率約48%と極めて高く、ワクチン・治療薬が未承認である点も重大な懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: New research: Climate, floods and waterborne disease in Myanmar | MIMU
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-02, an open-access study of Myanmar (2021–2025) links waterborne disease to climate data and water–health policy context. The analysis combines health records with climate variables and a policy review, finding that cholera and acute watery diarrhoea cases peak in the rainy season, with coastal and delta areas such as Rakhine and Ayeyarwady reporting the most cholera. Fatality rates are higher in conflict-affected areas with weak infrastructure. Flooding shows association with outbreaks, but temperature and rainfall alone do not explain the patterns. The authors conclude that access to clean water and sanitation matters more than climate events by themselves and urge better cross-sector coordination between water and health, stronger data sharing, expanded local WASH services, and climate-resilient planning. Published in Water Research X (open access).

triage.headline_ja: 新たな研究：ミャンマーにおける気候変動、洪水、水系感染症
triage.triage_reason: 2021〜2025年のデータに基づく学術研究の紹介記事であり、新規の感染症発生や急性のアウトブレイクを報告するものではないため、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は過去数年間のコレラ・水系感染症の疫学パターンに関する学術研究のまとめであり、現在進行中の新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。WASH整備や政策提言が主眼。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : Jean-Noël Barrot attendu à Bunia sur fond de crise sécuritaire et d'épidémie d'Ebola - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Jean-Noël Barrot expected in Bunia amid a security crisis and an Ebola outbreak - LePotentiel
article.articleSummary: French Foreign Affairs Minister Jean-Noël Barrot is due in the Democratic Republic of Congo on 2–3 October 2026, with a stop in Bunia, capital of Ituri province, amid a security crisis in the east and a resurgence of Ebola. Ituri is experiencing the DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak, with authorities and partners continuing surveillance, case management, and prevention in affected areas. Barrot will be the first European minister to visit Bunia since the outbreak began, aiming to witness the on-the-ground situation and reaffirm France’s support to Congolese authorities and their partners in the response. The trip also aims to strengthen Franco-Congolese ties as part of France's broader Africa Forward diplomacy. The visit follows other initiatives in Africa, including engagements in Togo, Central African Republic, and Kenya—where the Africa Forward summit was held. This underscores France’s commitment to humanitarian and health response in the DRC’s eastern region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:ジャン=ノエル・バロ仏外相、治安危機とエボラ流行の最中にブニアを訪問予定 - LePotentiel
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラ流行に関する報道であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的関心（仏外相訪問）が確認されるためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・イツリ州ブニアでの第17次エボラ流行とフランス外相の訪問を主題としており、トーゴ・中央アフリカ・ケニアはフランスの外交日程の一部として言及されているのみでエボラ発生国ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: ONU denuncia destruição de centro de tratamento no leste da RDCongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: UN condemns destruction of a treatment center in eastern DRC.
article.articleSummary: UN condemns destruction of an Ebola treatment center in Kigonze within the Ituri camp, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, after a fire at a displacement site hosting about 19,000 people. The Ebola facility was inside the Kigonze camp, which was abandoned after mass flight amid armed incursions, leaving thousands without direct medical care. UN response coordinator Julien Harneis warned that loss of such centers erodes invested resources and delays outbreak control. The camp housed roughly 1,000 direct contacts of Ebola patients, with only about 20% traced post-evacuation. Amid broader insecurity, two health workers were killed in Lubero (North Kivu), and Rhoe camp in Ituri saw attacks and mass displacements. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak, declared May 15, has 8,224 confirmed cases and 3,982 deaths; 2,212 recovered; 851 hospitalized or in isolation in Angola.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：国連がコンゴ民主共和国東部の治療センター破壊を非難
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（確定例8,224件、死亡3,982件）に加え、武装勢力による治療施設破壊と接触者追跡の失敗（追跡率約20%）により感染拡大リスクが高く、国際的な対応支援も必要とされているため。
triage.notes: 記事内でアンゴラにおける入院例への言及があるが、サマリーの主題はDRC東部（北キブ州・イトゥリ州）での治安悪化とエボラ対応の阻害であり、アンゴラは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: KDC'deki Ebola salgınında 8 bin 224 doğrulanmış vaka ve 3 bin 982 ölüm kaydedildi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Ebola outbreak in KDC, 8,224 confirmed cases and 3,982 deaths were recorded.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), the Ebola outbreak has 8,224 confirmed cases and 3,982 deaths, with 2,121 recoveries and a case fatality rate of 48.4%. Response efforts span seven provinces and 63 regions, focusing on patient care, transmission containment, and bolstering health-system capacity. The outbreak began near the Ebola River and was declared on 15 May after Ituri province reported 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths. The Bundibugyo Ebola variant identified in May currently has no approved treatment or vaccine. Historical context noted includes previous epidemics in Africa: 1976 outbreaks in Nzara (Sudan) and Yambuku (DRC), and the 2014–2017 West Africa epidemic (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) with about 30,000 infections and 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラ出血熱流行で8,224件の確定症例と3,982人の死亡が記録された
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱流行が8,224例・致死率48.4%と深刻な規模に達しており、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念とIHR基準の複数該当が認められるためフルリスク評価に進むべきである。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおける現在進行中のエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo変異株、未承認治療薬・ワクチン）に関するもの。スーダン（Yambuku/Nzara）、ギニア・リベリア・シエラレオネは1976年および2014-2017年の過去事例として言及されているのみで、現在の発生地ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Chia nhau nghỉ làm chăm con tái nhiễm tay chân miệng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Taking turns off from work to care for a child with recurrent hand-foot-mouth disease.
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City recorded 1,283 HFMD cases in Sep 14–20, up 47% from the prior four weeks; cases reached 35,121 by week 38. Tom, 18 months, had HFMD twice in one month: first Coxsackievirus A16, then Enterovirus 71 (EV71) a week later (grade 1). EV71 can cause neurological, cardiac, and respiratory complications; caregivers were advised to monitor at home and seek hospital care for persistent high fever, tremors, or poor intake. Tom’s third infection occurred on Oct 2 after returning to nursery; his parents split duties, taking unpaid leave and incurring reduced income. HFMD spreads via fecal-oral, droplets, and contaminated surfaces, with daycare as a high-risk setting. EV71 vaccine, approved by Health Ministry, began rollout at VNVC on Sep 25; about 300 centers have administered about 30,000 doses to children 2 months to under 6 years, 2–3 doses. The vaccine targets EV71 and does not protect against Coxsackievirus A16.

triage.headline_ja: 再発した手足口病の子どもの看病のために交代で休職
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市でEV71型を含む手足口病（HFMD）の症例が前週比47%増加し、重症化しうるEV71株の流行が続いている点、及び保健省によるEV71ワクチン導入という政府対応の動きがあり、継続的な監視とフルリスク評価が望まれる。
triage.notes: HFMDはベトナムで季節性に流行する疾患であり、今回はEV71株による重症化リスクと新規ワクチン導入が特徴的。深刻な国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はないため、IHR基準は非該当。続報（症例数推移、重症例・死亡例の有無）の確認が必要。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: 3 Gejala yang Kerap Muncul pada Anak Terinfeksi Influenza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three Symptoms Commonly Seen in Children Infected with Influenza.
article.articleSummary: Jakarta, Indonesia – A pediatric influenza briefing notes three core symptoms common in children: fever, body aches, and headache, often with diarrhea or loss of appetite. Other symptoms may include cough, runny or congested nose, and fatigue, though not all occur in every case. Influenza infection is confirmed by nasopharyngeal swab RT-PCR. Influenza is chiefly caused by type A (subtypes H1N1 and H3N2) and type B viruses, whereas the common cold is typically due to rhinovirus and is usually milder. The report emphasizes that influenza symptoms can worsen quickly, unlike colds which progress gradually and are generally milder. Prompt RT-PCR testing aids diagnosis. The article highlights pediatric cases in Jakarta, Indonesia, underscoring the rapid-onset severity of influenza relative to the common cold.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザに感染した子どもによく見られる3つの症状
triage.triage_reason: 一般的な小児インフルエンザの症状解説記事であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は季節性インフルエンザの一般的な症状と診断方法に関する啓発的な内容であり、特定のアウトブレイクや異常な感染拡大を報告するものではない。
