article.articleHeadline: Influenza Spike In Maharashtra, Pune Tops Cases: Why Flu Can Become Serious For Some
article.articleSummary: Influenza spike in Maharashtra driven by H1N1. From Jan 1 to Sep 21, 2026, the state recorded 2,320 H1N1 cases and eight deaths. Pune Municipal Corporation reported the highest district-level tally with 709 cases; Mumbai 626; Nashik 275; Nagpur 226; Pimpri-Chinchwad 113; Pune rural reported zero. Across the state, 390 patients were hospitalized and 1,922 were in home isolation; no patient was on a ventilator. The year-over-year comparison shows Maharashtra’s counts dipped vs 2024’s 2,351 but rose vs 2022’s 1,231; in 2025, 942 cases were documented. Symptoms include fever, dry cough, sore throat, body aches, fatigue, and chills. Influenza can become serious, especially in older adults and those with diabetes, heart or chronic lung disease. Early antiviral treatment is advised; antibiotics do not treat influenza. Maharashtra offers free vaccination for high-risk groups (pregnant women, diabetes or hypertension, healthcare workers).

triage.headline_ja: マハラシュトラ州でインフルエンザが急増、プネーが症例数トップ：なぜインフルエンザが重症化することがあるのか
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1インフルエンザの定例サーベイランス報告であり、死亡率・重症度は低く、前年（2024年）と比較しても件数は減少している。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の定期統計報告。入院390例・死亡8例・人工呼吸器使用者ゼロと重症度は限定的。2024年(2,351例)との比較で件数は減少しており、季節的な変動の範囲内と考えられる。州による無料ワクチン提供など通常の公衆衛生対応がなされている。

article.articleHeadline: Kesiapan Indonesia tangani Influenza - Infografik ANTARA News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Indonesia's Preparedness to Handle Influenza - ANTARA News Infographic
article.articleSummary: Influenza A and B cases in Indonesia in 2026 have triggered a swift response by the Ministry of Health (Kemenkes) as of 2 October 2026. The article, presented as an ANTARA News infographic, underscores Indonesia’s preparedness to handle influenza outbreaks. In response to rising cases, a range of control and prevention measures has been deployed to curb transmission and avert deterioration of public health. The piece highlights government initiatives aimed at boosting readiness, though it does not enumerate specific interventions or provide case counts. By focusing on national readiness and coordinated action, the report emphasizes ongoing efforts during the 2026 influenza activity to protect communities and strengthen public health defenses against influenza in Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ対応に向けたインドネシアの備え - ANTARAニュース インフォグラフィック
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの増加に対する政府の備えを紹介する内容で、具体的な症例数や重症度の情報がなく、異常性も明確でないため継続監視とする。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な症例数や重症度を示しておらず、通常の季節性インフルエンザ対策の広報的内容と考えられる。続報で詳細（症例数、重症度、異常なクラスター発生等）があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Heboh Influenza A, Praktisi Kesehatan Ingatkan Minum Obat Antivirus "Oveltamivir" Perlu Dikonsultasikan sama Dokter
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A Scare: Health Professionals Warn That Taking the Antiviral Medication "Oveltamivir" Should Be Discussed With a Doctor.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases in Jakarta, Indonesia, are rising amid extreme weather. The report explains influenza A and B drive seasonal epidemics, with transmission via droplets from infected individuals. An antiviral, Oseltamivir, is discussed but health professionals warn against self-prescribing. Dr. Muhamad Fajri Adda'i, a cardiologist, notes Oseltamivir can target influenza A and B and should be used only for patients with severe symptoms after medical evaluation. In severe cases it is best administered within the first 48 hours of illness. The doctor stresses that severity assessment must be made by a clinician (general practitioner, internist, or pulmonologist). Common influenza A symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, body aches, headaches, and extreme fatigue, sometimes with a dry cough. About 90% of flu infections recover on their own; no need for panic.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型流行騒動、医療従事者が抗ウイルス薬「オセルタミビル」服用は医師への相談が必要と警告
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAに関する一般的な注意喚起記事であり、異常性や重篤性、国際的拡大の兆候は示されていない。
triage.notes: ジャカルタで季節性インフルエンザA型症例が増加しているとの報道だが、通常の季節性流行の範囲内であり、約90%が自然回復するとされ、パニックの必要はないと記事内で明言されている。

article.articleHeadline: Thousands Flee Ebola-Hit Camp In DR Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, thousands fled the Kigonze displacement camp in Bunia, Ituri Province, DR Congo, after security forces entered the site searching for weapons, triggering gunfire and hindering Ebola containment. The camp, home to about 19,000 people, has been abandoned and access for humanitarian teams disrupted. The ongoing Ebola outbreak, declared in May and affecting eastern Congo with Ituri among the worst-affected, relies on surveillance, contact tracing, testing, and treatment at facilities such as a transit centre that was burned during the operation. About 1,000 people identified as Ebola contacts were living in Kigonze, but only roughly one-fifth had been traced, raising concerns about undetected transmission. Earlier reports noted over 30 deaths at the camp in a little more than a month, with some confirmed Ebola, underscoring the ongoing risk and the challenge of containing spread amid displacement.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴでエボラ発生キャンプから数千人が避難
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のエボラアウトブレイクにおいて、治安部隊の作戦によりコンタクトトレーシングが崩壊し、約19,000人が避難・分散したことで感染拡大リスクが急増しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 治安作戦によりキャンプが放棄され、約1,000人のエボラ接触者のうち約2割しか追跡できていない点が特に懸念される。既に5月に宣言された進行中のアウトブレイクの悪化事例として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll in DR Congo tops 4,000
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 2, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 4,000 deaths, with 4,018 fatalities among 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces. A total of 2,162 have recovered, yielding a case fatality rate of 48.4%. The update was released by Congolese health authorities, with Médecins Sans Frontières warning that the true toll is likely higher due to gaps in surveillance and case detection. This outbreak is the largest and deadliest ever recorded in the DRC and the second-largest Ebola outbreak globally, after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱による死者数が4,000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは史上最大規模で、致死率48.4%、死者4,000人超と深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRCのみが言及されており、Angolaでの発生は確認できないため除外した。MSFはサーベイランスの不備により実際の被害はさらに大きい可能性を指摘している。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'ndeki Ebola salgınında can kaybı 3 bin 982'ye yükseldi - Bursa Hakimiyet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll in the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rose to 3,982 - Bursa Hakimiyet.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-02, the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak has 8,224 confirmed cases and 3,982 deaths, with 2,121 recoveries and a case fatality rate of 48.4%, per the Ministry of Health. The epidemic spans seven provinces and 63 districts, with ongoing patient treatment, transmission containment, and capacity-building for health workers. Ebola is a viral hemorrhagic fever first identified in 1976 in Nzara, Sudan and Yambuku, DR Congo, with its name derived from the Ebola River near the initial village. In eastern DR Congo's Ituri Province, authorities reported 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths before the country declared the outbreak on May 15. The Bundibugyo Ebola variant implicated in this outbreak has no approved treatment or vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行による死者数が3,982人に増加 - Bursa Hakimiyet
triage.triage_reason: DRCで致死率48.4%の大規模エボラ流行が7州63地区に拡大しており、承認された治療法・ワクチンがないBundibugyo変異株による深刻な公衆衛生上の影響とヒト-ヒト感染拡大リスクが確認される。
triage.notes: 発生地域にBurundi、Sudanが含まれるが、記事はエボラの歴史的起源地（1976年の最初の発生地）として言及しているのみで、現在の流行はDRCに限定される。Muyinga Province(Burundi)、Nzara(Sudan)は現行流行地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak records more than 4,000 deaths as authorities struggle to contain the virus
article.articleSummary: Congo’s Ebola outbreak in Bunia has reached 4,018 deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases, the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history, according to health ministry figures released on Thursday (as of 2026-10-02). Announced May 15, the outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo virus, for which there is no known treatment or vaccine. The World Health Organization has warned of rapid geographic spread into new health zones, straining already limited resources. Widespread mistrust of health workers and authorities, including attacks on responders and the death of a local politician last month, has hindered containment. Congo is contending with what is its 17th Ebola outbreak. In response, authorities launched a village-centered approach last month, but resistance persists amid distrust of the government.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、死者4,000人超に 当局はウイルス封じ込めに苦慮
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyoウイルス）が史上最速で拡大し、死者4,000人超・症例8,300人に達し、WHOが地理的拡大を警告するなど複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: ワクチンや治療法が確立していない稀なBundibugyo種による史上最速拡大のアウトブレイク。地域住民の不信感や医療従事者への攻撃により封じ込めが困難化しており、新たな保健区域への拡大もWHOが警告している。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak records more than 4,000 deaths as authorities struggle to contain the virus - WTOP News
article.articleSummary: Outbreak in Congo's Bunia, caused by Bundibugyo virus. As of 2026-10-02, health ministry figures show 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths, making it history's fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak. The outbreak was declared on May 15 and has rapidly spread to new health zones, straining limited resources. The Bundibugyo virus is rare and has no known treatment or vaccine. The World Health Organization has warned about ongoing geographic expansion and mounting containment challenges in Congo. Authorities say nearly half of the confirmed cases have occurred as the virus continues to spread among communities in Bunia and other health zones, underscoring ongoing struggles to contain transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、当局が封じ込めに苦慮する中4,000人以上の死者を記録
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）が史上最速で拡大し、8,300例・4,018死亡という深刻な公衆衛生被害が発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョウイルス型エボラで、史上最速の拡大スピードとされる重大アウトブレイク。WHOも地理的拡大と封じ込め困難を警告しており、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: UE.- El ECDC subraya que el riesgo de ébola en Europa "sigue siendo...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: EU - The ECDC stresses that the risk of Ebola in Europe continues to be...
article.articleSummary: Fourth imported Ebola case in Europe involves a healthcare worker evacuated to the Netherlands; the case is linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak and tested positive for Bundibugyo virus on September 29, 2026. The other three imported cases were previously reported, also among medical or humanitarian workers. The ECDC reiterates that the overall risk to Europe’s general population remains very low, and that patient evacuations are conducted under strict infection prevention and control to minimize transmission. EU/EEA countries should maintain preparedness, guided by published guidelines and Q&A documents for rapid case identification, isolation, infection control, and laboratory procedures. No ongoing European outbreak is indicated.

triage.headline_ja: EU - ECDCは、欧州におけるエボラ出血熱のリスクは「依然として非常に低い」としつつ、4例目の輸入症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関連し、欧州（オランダ）への4例目の輸入症例が確認されたため、国際的拡大のリスクが現実化しているとみなされる。
triage.notes: 記事はECDCによるリスク評価声明であり、感染源となる主要アウトブレイクはDRCで継続中。オランダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết Dengue tăng: Chuyên gia chỉ ra những nhóm có nguy cơ chuyển nặng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever on the rise: Experts identify groups at risk of progression to severe dengue.
article.articleSummary: Published 2026-10-02, dengue fever is rising in southern Vietnam, accounting for 73.1% of national cases, with experts warning that anyone can progress to severe dengue. High-risk groups include the elderly and those with comorbidities, pregnant women, infants under one year, and overweight or obese individuals, who require close monitoring for warning signs. In Ho Chi Minh City, clinicians note elderly patients may show nonclassic symptoms such as lethargy or confusion, while infants can present nonspecifically. Two dengue patients in the Hospital for Tropical Diseases were in critical condition—ages 16 and 21—one needed ECMO for over a month and VND 1 billion; the other required 45 days of continuous dialysis; a 20-year-old death occurred on Sep 8. Da Nang reports 4,251 cases, up 2.4x versus 2025. Prevention relies on three-layer protection: eliminate standing water and protect against bites, seek early medical care for fever, and discuss dengue vaccination with healthcare providers.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱増加:専門家が重症化リスクの高いグループを指摘
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム南部・中部でデング熱症例が増加し重症例・死亡例も報告されているが、季節性流行の範囲内であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは明確でないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムで毎年季節性流行する風土病であり、本記事は専門家による注意喚起的な内容。重症例・死亡例の報告や前年比増加（ダナンで2.4倍）はあるが、異常事態としての明確な指標（国際拡大・渡航制限等）は確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola se descontrola en el Congo con más de 7.700 casos y la violencia bloqueando la respuesta sanitaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spirals out of control in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with more than 7,700 cases and violence blocking the healthcare response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has spread to 63 health zones across seven provinces, with 7,773 cases and 3,759 deaths reported. Ituri remains the epicenter, accounting for the majority of cases (over 6,000). Violence in eastern DRC hampers the response, including a fire at a patient transit center in Ituri’s Kigonze camp and mass displacement of residents; Kigonze housed about 19,000 people before the incident. Attacks and military operations have driven thousands from camps such as Rhoe in Djugu (more than 3,000 displaced since Sept 27), with at least four deaths and seven injuries. Two Ebola responders were killed in Lubero, North Kivu, on Sept 27–28. Surveillance, case finding, and transport of samples and patients are impeded, despite 59 facilities and over 4,000 health workers deployed, and Ituri’s 25 facilities (15 treatment, 10 transit) noted early September. Urgent, time-sensitive isolation and treatment remain essential.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱が制御不能に、7,700件以上の症例と暴力による医療対応の阻害
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が広域に拡大し、死者数も多く、暴力により対応が阻害されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 7,773症例、3,759死亡（致死率約48%）と非常に深刻。暴力・治安悪化により対応要員の死亡や施設破壊が発生しており、国際支援の必要性が極めて高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: El ECDC subraya que el riesgo de ébola en Europa "sigue siendo muy...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The ECDC underlines that the risk of Ebola in Europe continues to be very...
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus remains a very low risk to Europe as of 2 October 2026, despite a fourth imported Ebola case in a healthcare worker evacuated to the Netherlands for specialized care. The patient tested positive on 29 September 2026 and is linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak. The four imported cases involve medical or humanitarian personnel associated with affected RDC regions. Evacuations are planned and conducted with strict infection prevention and control measures, keeping transmission risk to the general population very low. The ECDC urges EU/EEA countries to maintain preparedness, with available guidelines, laboratory protocols, and Q&A resources to enable rapid identification, isolation, and management of suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: ECDCは、欧州におけるエボラのリスクは依然として非常に低いと強調するも、4例目の輸入症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ（ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス）アウトブレイクに関連し、欧州（オランダ）への4例目の輸入症例が確認されており、国際的拡大のリスクと重篤な公衆衛生影響が認められるため。
triage.notes: オランダは対象国リストに含まれないため、感染源であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに記載。既知のDRCエボラアウトブレイクに関連する国際輸入症例の報告であり、ECDCによるリスク評価と注意喚起が継続的に行われている。

article.articleHeadline: Под Иркутском заподозрили случай смерти от чумы. В городе отменили cубботник -- Новая газета
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Near Irkutsk, a suspected case of death from the plague. The city canceled Subbotnik.
article.articleSummary: Plague suspicion in Irkutsk Oblast prompts a quarantine near Irkutsk after a resident was suspected of infection with a highly dangerous disease. On Oct 2, Russia’s Chief Sanitary Doctor Anna Popova arrived; Governor Igor Kobzev said a full anti-epidemic plan is in place; Rospotrebnadzor is conducting measures with all identified contacts under medical observation; neither symptoms nor positive laboratory results have been found to date. In the Shelekhov District Hospital, about 20 km from Irkutsk, a quarantine was imposed. Some local outlets reported a death from pneumonic plague tied to a patient who had returned from Thailand, but these reports were later removed; Mash cited the death of an Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute employee returning from a work trip to Buryatia near the Mongolian border, where pneumonic plague had been reported previously. The city canceled October 3 Subbotnik due to the quarantine. No confirmed cases or deaths have been reported.

triage.headline_ja: イルクーツク近郊でペスト（プレイグ）による死亡疑い例、サブボトニク（清掃奉仕活動）が中止に
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストの疑い例が報告され、保健当局が検疫措置を実施・上級衛生官が現地入りするなど異常性と行政対応が確認されるため、確定前でもフルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 事案はロシア（イルクーツク州・ブリヤート共和国）で発生しており、対象国リストには含まれない。タイからの帰国者という報道は後に削除され未確認情報であるため、タイをverified_locationsに含めない。確定症例・死亡例は現時点で報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en RDC roza el umbral de los 4.000 muertos, con...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC nears the 4,000-death threshold, with....
article.articleSummary: DRC's eastern Ebola outbreak nears 4,000 deaths with 8,224 cases and 3,982 fatalities reported by INSP. In the last 24 hours there were 53 new infections and 28 deaths; case fatality rate stands at 48.4%. There are 851 patients hospitalized or in isolation and 2,121 recovered. Contact tracing covers 78.7% of contacts. The Ituri province remains the epicenter, comprising about 76% of confirmed cases, with seven provinces affected: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, Tshopo, and Ubangi-Sud. Affected health zones total 63 of 167, amid violence hindering response and triggering new displacements. This is the deadliest Ebola outbreak in DRC's history; projections suggest it could surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak of 28,616 cases and 11,325 deaths per WHO. The Kasai outbreak ended in December 2025; DRC remains the most experienced country in Ebola response, tracing origins to Yambuku near the Ebola River.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ流行、死者数4,000人の節目に迫る
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%、史上最悪のDRCエボラ流行であり、7州63地域に拡大、暴力による対応阻害もあるため、IHR・WPRO双方の基準に複数該当する深刻な公衆衛生事象。
triage.notes: 史上最悪のDRCエボラ流行とされ、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行の規模を上回る可能性が指摘されている。暴力により対応が妨げられ、住民の新たな避難も発生。Angolaは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola Outbreak Records More Than 4,000 Deaths as Authorities Struggle to Contain the Virus
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, Congo's Ebola outbreak has claimed 4,018 lives out of 8,300 confirmed cases, making this one of history's fastest-spreading Ebola outbreaks. The May 15 outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo virus, a rare strain with no known treatment or vaccine. The health ministry reported the latest figures, underscoring ongoing transmission. The World Health Organization has raised alarms over rapid geographical spread into new health zones, stretching limited resources. The article centers on Bunia, Congo, where authorities grapple with containment. Details on infection sources or imported/exported cases are not provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、当局がウイルス封じ込めに苦慮する中4,000人以上の死者を記録
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が急速に拡大し、8,300例中4,018人が死亡するなど深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、WHOも懸念を表明しているためフルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 治療法・ワクチンが存在しない稀なブンディブギョ株による大規模流行であり、新たな保健地域への地理的拡大が報告されている。感染源や越境事例の詳細は不明。

article.articleHeadline: АТОР оценила риск заражения туристов лептоспирозом в Таиланде
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ATOR assessed the risk of tourists contracting leptospirosis in Thailand.
article.articleSummary: Russian tour operators association ATOR assessed the risk of leptospirosis for Russian tourists entering Thailand via organized tour companies as low, noting travelers typically stay in hotels and visit areas with proper sanitation. The assessment covers only those using organized tours; independent travelers are not addressed. Leptospirosis, also known as Weil’s disease, is transmitted through water or soil contaminated with rodent urine. ATOR stressed that itineraries for organized tourists are designed to minimize such exposure and that accommodations meet sanitary standards. Thailand remains a popular destination for Russian travelers, with tour operators following guidance from relevant agencies when planning programs. The report provides no case counts, laboratory confirmation, or active outbreak details, and centers on risk assessment and infection-source controls as of 2 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ATOR、タイにおける観光客のレプトスピラ症感染リスクを評価
triage.triage_reason: 実際の症例報告やアウトブレイク情報はなく、旅行会社団体によるリスク評価（低リスクとの見解）に過ぎないため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアの旅行会社団体によるリスク評価であり、実際の症例数・発生状況・検査確認等の情報は含まれていない。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Опасность крысиной лихорадки для россиян в Таиланде оценили
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The risk of rat fever for Russians in Thailand has been assessed.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-02, the Association of Tour Operators of Russia (ATOR) assessed the risk of leptospirosis (rat fever) for Russians traveling to Thailand. ATOR stated that organized tourists traveling through tour operators generally avoid areas where rat fever exposure is likely and stay in hotels in locations with good sanitation; the assessment pertains to organized groups, not independent travelers. The warning follows earlier advisories to Russian tourists and volunteers who went to the flooded city of Rayong to assist, noting that rat fever could be spreading there. The article does not report any confirmed cases; rather, it indicates potential exposure in Rayong, where hundreds of Russians may be present due to flood relief efforts. Emphasis on sanitation and avoiding high-risk environments to reduce leptospirosis risk.

triage.headline_ja: タイでのロシア人に対するレプトスピラ症（ラットフィーバー）のリスクが評価された
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例の報告はなく、洪水被災地レイヨーンでのレプトスピラ症曝露リスクに関する注意喚起にとどまるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事は確定症例を報告しておらず、洪水後のレイヨーンにおけるレプトスピラ症曝露リスクへの注意喚起が主旨。ロシア人旅行者・ボランティア向けの情報であり、タイ国内の公衆衛生状況そのものへの言及は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: وزير الخارجية الفرنسي يزور الكونغو الديمقراطية لتعزيز دعم فرنسا لمواجهة "إيبولا" - بوابة الأهرام
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: French Foreign Minister visits the Democratic Republic of the Congo to bolster France's support to combat Ebola - Al-Ahram Gate
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province, Bunia city) prompts a two-day visit by French Foreign Minister Jean-Nobel Barro. The trip, described by spokesperson Pascal Confavreux as political, humanitarian, and health-oriented, signals a new phase in France’s support for local authorities, UN agencies, and humanitarian groups confronting the crisis. It aims to reinforce France’s commitment to Ebola response, accelerate vaccine research, and bolster frontline workers across NGOs and UN partners. Barro would be the first European foreign minister to visit the DRC since the outbreak began. The current wave is the deadliest among 17, with about 3,900 deaths. The visit also furthers France’s Africa renewal agenda ahead of a Paris humanitarian conference on Oct 6, focusing on meeting urgent needs and limiting spread beyond affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: フランス外相、エボラ対策支援強化のためコンゴ民主共和国を訪問
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ流行は過去17波中最も死者数が多く(約3900人)、国際的な外交・支援活動を伴う深刻な公衆衛生事案であるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: フランス外相の訪問は政治的・人道的・保健的支援強化を目的としており、DRCのエボラ流行（死者約3900人、過去最悪の波）がイベントの主題。フランス・パリは発生国ではなく外交活動地であるため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Musim Pancaroba, Waspada Ancaman Infeksi Virus dan Jangan Asal Pilih Obat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Transition Season: Beware of the Threat of Viral Infections and Don't Just Pick Any Medicine
article.articleSummary: Depok, West Java, Indonesia, as of 2 October 2026, transitional weather (pancaroba) heightens vulnerability to viral infections, with respiratory illnesses most common. Fluctuating temperatures strain the immune system, leading to illnesses such as throat infections and other gastrointestinal infections, but influenza and influenza-like illnesses are especially prevalent. Symptoms typically include fever, nasal congestion, and cough, and infections are often self-limiting, though recovery comes with discomfort. Management emphasizes symptomatic care and immune support, alongside healthy lifestyle measures during extreme weather. The article warns against unchecked self-medication, noting many people seek cough and cold remedies at pharmacies without consulting a pharmacist. Open, detailed communication with a pharmacist helps tailor appropriate treatment, given the variety of cough and cold options and the need to align remedies with specific symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 季節の変わり目：ウイルス感染症の脅威に注意し、薬を安易に選ばないで
triage.triage_reason: 季節の変わり目における一般的なインフルエンザ様疾患に関する健康啓発記事であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の重大な懸念を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 季節性の自己限定的な感染症に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: В Иркутской области пациентка могла умереть от легочной чумы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A female patient in Irkutsk Oblast could have died from pneumonic plague.
article.articleSummary: In Irkutsk Oblast, the Central District Hospital in Shelekhov was quarantined after a patient died amid a suspected dangerous infection. The deceased reportedly arrived from Thailand, and sources say the cause was pneumonic plague, though the infection’s official name has not been disclosed. Regional Rospotrebnadzor has intensified safety measures for a local resident under suspicion of a dangerous infection. Governor Igor Kobzev said Anna Popova, Russia’s Chief Sanitary Doctor, arrived to oversee the situation, and an extraordinary sanitary-epidemiological commission meeting was held. All identified contacts are under medical observation; none show symptoms and laboratory tests are negative. No confirmed infections have been publicly reported; the hospital remains under quarantine while authorities coordinate investigations and containment.

triage.headline_ja: イルクーツク州で患者が肺ペストにより死亡した可能性
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストが疑われる死亡例が報告され、公衆衛生上の重大性と異常性の両方が認められるためIHR基準を2つ満たし、フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空とした。患者はタイから帰国したとの報道があるが、感染確認や発生地としての証拠はなく、タイも対象国から除外した。感染症の公式名称・確定診断は未発表であり、情報の多くは未確認（不明）である。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Malaria di Mimika Capai 117.910 hingga September 2026, Warga Diminta Rutin Periksa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria cases in Mimika reach 117,910 as of September 2026, residents urged to undergo routine checkups.
article.articleSummary: Malaria in Mimika District, Central Papua, Indonesia, recorded 117,910 positive cases from 1,085,347 screenings conducted January–mid September 2026; 2025 had 1,299,815 screenings with about 190,593 positives. Hotspots include Wania, Pasar Sentral, and Timika. Health authorities urge routine checks in communities and health facilities, aiming for 2,075,000 screenings; six to seven checks per person in high-risk areas to detect lingering parasites. Early detection and treatment reduce human parasite load and transmission risk cycles involving mosquitoes. Residents are advised to use bed nets and complete prescribed antimalarial courses. This reflects ongoing malaria control efforts in Mimika as of September 2026. The effort underscores the need for sustained surveillance and community participation to interrupt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ミミカのマラリア感染者数、2026年9月までに117,910人に達し、住民に定期検査を促す
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・ミミカ地区における既知の風土病（マラリア）の定期監視報告であり、異常な増加や新規性は見られず、国際的拡大リスクも低いため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 本記事はパプア州ミミカ地区での定例マラリア監視・検査活動の進捗報告であり、感染者数は多いが既知の流行地域における通常の疾病負荷であり、死亡数やアウトブレイクの急増を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: 又是小卷？景興國小也爆11學生身體不適　蔣萬安：疑似諾羅或腸胃型感冒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another Xiaojuan? Jingxing Elementary School reports 11 students feeling unwell; Chiang Wan-an: suspected Norovirus or gastroenteritis-type illness.
article.articleSummary: 11 students at Jingxing Elementary School in Taipei’s Wenshan District reported illness after lunch; doctors preliminarily suspect norovirus or gastroenteritis-type illness, with Education and Health Bureaus collecting samples for testing. Earlier reports described 12 students at a Wenshan District elementary school developing symptoms after a lunch containing squid, prompting similar investigations in Da’an District’s Jinhua Junior High and Songshan District’s Minzu Elementary. Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an said lab results are pending, and authorities are monitoring affected children and providing support. Councilor Jian Shupei criticized repeated lunch-safety lapses and demanded a full, transparent investigation into sourcing, preparation, and delivery. Officials noted shrimp supply instability due to climate and said substitutes will be used, with other protein sources such as different seafood or fish provided when needed.

triage.headline_ja: またイカ料理？景興小学校でも児童11人が体調不良　蒋万安市長「ノロウイルスまたは胃腸炎の疑い」
triage.triage_reason: 台湾台北市内の小学校における給食由来とみられる集団胃腸炎（ノロウイルス疑い）で、規模が限定的かつ国際的拡大の懸念はなく、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当性が低い。
triage.notes: 対象国リストに台湾は含まれず、また中国本土での発生でもないため verified_locations は空とした。学校給食による食中毒・ノロウイルス集団発生であり、地域の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : des laboratoires mobiles pour accélérer le dépistage d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Mobile laboratories to accelerate Ebola screening.
article.articleSummary: Ebola screening in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo relies on mobile laboratories deployed near treatment centers in Butembo. Installed in a vehicle, the INRB technicians at the Ebola treatment center of the ITAV prepare and analyze blood samples to detect the Ebola virus, with the unit now in operation for two weeks. The mobile labs can be quickly relocated to outbreak hot spots, for example Katwa, as epidemic conditions evolve. This mobility shortens diagnostic turnaround from as long as 72 hours to generally under 24 hours, and in optimal cases to about six hours. Faster results allow rapid triage: confirmed cases receive prompt care, while suspected cases with negative results can be redirected to standard health facilities. The initiative, supported by Uganda, aims to strengthen local screening capacity and accelerate outbreak control in the region.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ検査を迅速化するための移動検査室
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州（ブテンボ、カトワ）でエボラ出血熱の流行が継続しており、移動検査室の導入が報じられている。致死率が高く国際的拡大リスクのある疾患であるため、フルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC北キブ州（ブテンボ、カトワ）における既存のエボラ流行への対応強化（移動検査室導入）を報じたもの。ウガンダは支援国として言及されているが発生国ではないため対象から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Manejo da raiva
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies management
article.articleSummary: Rabies management in Brazil emphasizes prevention, as rabies has no cure. After a bite from a dog thought to be mad, urgent vaccination and, if indicated, rabies immunoglobulin, are necessary. If a dog is known, it can be observed for up to 10 days. If the dog stays healthy for ten days, vaccination is not needed; if it develops illness or disappears, post-exposure vaccination is warranted. Symptoms of rabies in humans include malaise and hydrophobia (inability to swallow water). The piece also uses a social analogy to emphasize controlling anger, but the medical guidance remains. Post-exposure vaccines and rabies serum, when needed, are available in Brazil's Unified Health System (SUS); in the private sector, they are not available. The date provided is 2026-10-02.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病の管理
triage.triage_reason: 一般的な狂犬病予防・管理に関する啓発記事であり、特定の異常な発生や急増を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病の一般的な予防・治療ガイダンスに関する解説であり、具体的な発生事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではないため、ブラジルを含め対象国の verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak records more than 4000 deaths
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ebola outbreak, driven by the rare Bundibugyo virus, has recorded 4,018 deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases, the fastest-growing outbreak to date. The health ministry released the figures after the outbreak began May 15 and it has spread across multiple health zones, prompting WHO to warn of rapid geographical expansion. No treatment or vaccine exists for Bundibugyo, complicating containment. Africa CDC notes a decline in confirmed cases, though insecurity and limited community cooperation in hotspots may distort trends. A local politician, Marie-Celestin Karondwa, was attacked and beaten to death for defending government measures; his house was later set on fire in Butembo, North Kivu. Deep mistrust in authorities and ongoing resistance to public health efforts have hindered the response, with a village-centered approach recently launched amid tensions in Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak. So far, no lab-confirmed infection sources or imported/exported case details are provided in this report, and the focus remains on domestic spread and response challenges, amid ongoing alarm from WHO and regional health bodies.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、死者4000人超を記録
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がコンゴで急速拡大し、8300症例中4018死亡という深刻な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、WHOが地理的拡大を警告していることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療法が存在しないブンディブギョ株による流行であり、治安悪化・コミュニティの不信感が対応を阻害している点が特に懸念される。地方政治家が暴行死する事件も発生しており社会的緊張が高い。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع الإصابات المؤكدة بـ إيبولا في الكونغو لـ 4018 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in confirmed Ebola infections in Congo to 4,018 cases.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola virus disease (EVD) has surged in the current outbreak, with confirmed infections rising to 8,224 and deaths to 4,018, as of the latest counts. Recoveries number 2,121, yielding a case fatality rate around 48.4%. The outbreak has spread across 63 districts in seven provinces. Health authorities emphasize there is no approved treatment or vaccine for the Bundibugyo strain driving this wave. The new outbreak first emerged in Ituri province in May, and response teams are scaling up ground operations to curb transmission and contain spread. No laboratory-confirmed imported or exported case details are provided in the report; ongoing surveillance and containment efforts are underway across affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ確定感染者数が4,018人に上昇
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行が継続し、致死率約48.4%、7州63地区に拡大しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株には承認されたワクチン・治療法がなく、致死率が高い。7州63地区に拡大しており、地域的・国際的拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में इबोला वायरस का कहर, मृतकों का आंकड़ा 4000 के पार; अब तक 8300 मामले कंफर्म - congo ebola outbreak deaths exceed 4000 amid rare strain news in hindi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus ravages Congo; death toll surpasses 4,000; 8,300 cases confirmed so far.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Congo driven by the rare Bundibugyo virus strain; as of 2026-10-02, laboratory-confirmed cases exceed 8,300 with deaths surpassing 4,000 (about 4,018 fatalities; case fatality around 48%). Health authorities report the disease is spreading rapidly across the country, making it the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in history. There is no cure or effective vaccine available specifically for Bundibugyo, complicating containment. The World Health Organization warns of the outbreak expanding into new health districts, stressing already strained medical resources and relief teams. National authorities and international health agencies are mobilizing, but the lack of targeted treatments and vaccines, along with resource constraints, pose severe challenges. The report does not specify infection sources or any imported/exported-case details.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラウイルスが猛威、死者数4000人超え；確認症例数8300件に達する
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約48%・症例8300超・死者4000超の大規模アウトブレイクで、史上最速の拡大と報じられ、有効なワクチン・治療法が存在しないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 稀少株（Bundibugyoウイルス）による大規模アウトブレイクで、WHOが新たな保健地区への拡大を警告。ワクチン・治療法不在が制圧を困難にしている。感染源・輸入/輸出症例の詳細は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola en République démocratique du Congo a fait plus de 4000 victimes | L'actualité
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has claimed more than 4,000 lives.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak update: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ebola epidemic has claimed 4,018 lives, with 8,300 confirmed cases reported by the local Ministry of Health. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine. It marks the DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak and is described as the fastest-spreading in history. The World Health Organization has warned of rapid spread into new health zones, stretching already limited resources. Widespread mistrust of health workers and government response has hampered containment, including violent incidents and the killing of a local political figure last month. A village-focused strategy was launched in September, but resistance persists, with some residents treating Ebola as a hoax.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、死者4,000人超に
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大級かつ最速拡大とされるエボラ流行が進行中で、致死率・感染者数とも深刻、ワクチン・治療薬が存在しない希少株であり、国際的拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限の可能性も高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルスによる稀な株で承認済み治療薬・ワクチンなし。地域社会の不信感や暴力的抵抗が封じ込めを妨げており、WHOも新たな保健地区への急速な拡大を警告している。

article.articleHeadline: Bets chocam mais que 700 mil mortos de Covid e tragédia no Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beds shock more than 700,000 COVID-19 deaths and tragedy in the South.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in Brazil remains deadly, with the country reporting over 700,000 COVID-19 deaths. The column ties this toll to the public-health strain highlighted by the 2024 Rio Grande do Sul floods, describing the ongoing pandemic as a backdrop to national discourse. It criticizes football authorities and clubs for pushing to continue the Brasileirão despite high fatalities and strained hospitals, including a makeshift hospital in RS. The piece portrays a pattern of prioritizing sports revenues and sponsorships—such as betting industry interests—over public health, with Flamengo leading legal challenges against bet restrictions. It condemns political and sports elites for ignoring vaccination lessons and calls for accountability and renewed emphasis on public welfare amid persistent health crises. This reflects how disease impact, regional disasters, and sports politics intersect in Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: ベット業界がCOVID-19死者70万人超と南部の悲劇より衝撃的
triage.triage_reason: スポーツ・政治・賭博業界批判を主題とするコラム記事であり、新規の公衆衛生上の異常事態や急性のアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。累計死者数への言及のみで新規性・異常性はない。
triage.notes: 本記事はスポーツコラムであり、COVID-19の累計死者数を引き合いに政治・サッカー界・賭博業界を批判する内容。新規感染症イベントの報告ではないため、対象国としてもBrazilを含めずDISMISSとした。

article.articleHeadline: La crisis sanitaria en la RDC se agrava al rozar los 4.000 fallecidos por un brote de ébola con 8.200 casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The health crisis in the DRC worsens as the death toll nears 4,000 from an Ebola outbreak with 8,200 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 8,224 cases and 3,982 deaths, with 53 new infections and 28 deaths in the last 24 hours, and a case fatality rate of 48.4%. Since May, Ituri province accounts for about 76% of confirmed cases, with spread to six other provinces: Kivu Norte, Kivu Sur, Alto Uélé, Bajo Uélé, Tshopo, Ubangi Sur, affecting 63 of 167 health zones. There are 851 patients hospitalized or in isolation, and 2,121 survivors. Contact tracing stands at 78.7%. Ongoing violence in eastern DRC hampers containment, causing new displacements and challenging epidemiological surveillance. The outbreak is deadlier than the 2018-2020 RDC epidemic and could surpass West Africa's 2014-2016 outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone), which had 28,616 cases and 11,325 deaths. The DRC has a long Ebola history since 1976, with Kasai outbreak ending December 2025.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の保健危機が深刻化、エボラ出血熱の流行で死者数が4,000人に迫り、感染者数は8,200人に達する
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%、感染者8,224人・死者3,982人という大規模エボラ流行であり、複数州への拡大と武力紛争による対応困難が重なり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にシエラレオネ、アンゴラ、リベリア、ギニアが含まれるが、これらは2014-2016年西アフリカ流行との比較で言及されているのみで、現在の流行地はDRCのみ。致死率・感染規模ともに2018-2020年流行を上回り、西アフリカ流行規模に迫る可能性があるとされ、紛争による接触者追跡の遅延（78.7%）も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: 4 Warga Gunungkidul Positif Antraks Usai Makan Bangkai Kambing
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 4 Gunungkidul residents test positive for anthrax after eating a goat carcass.
article.articleSummary: Four residents of Dadapayu, Semanu, Gunungkidul, Indonesia, tested positive for anthrax after slaughtering and consuming a goat that died suddenly in early September 2026. Health authorities identified seven suspected cases with direct exposure to the ill goat; PCR confirmed four infections. A line-list of contacts revealed 47 people at risk, all given prophylactic antibiotics and monitored for 60 days or two incubation periods. The confirmed patient has recovered; at-risk individuals remain under health surveillance. Authorities emphasize educating the public to avoid slaughtering, processing, or consuming sick or dead animals and to report unexplained animal deaths promptly. Anthrax is caused by Bacillus anthracis spores found in soil; human infection can occur via skin contact, inhalation, or ingestion from contaminated animals or products. Infected animals include cattle, sheep, goats, antelopes, and deer; symptoms vary by infection type and can appear from 1 day to over 2 months after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: グヌンキドゥル住民4人、ヤギの死骸を食べた後に炭疽菌陽性
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの一地域での小規模な人獣共通感染事例で、患者は回復し封じ込め対応がなされているが、炭疽菌の散発的発生として継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 動物由来の人獣共通感染症であり、ヒト-ヒト感染はなく、患者は回復済み。保健当局が47名の濃厚接触者を追跡・予防投薬中で、地域の動物衛生管理の問題として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Ebola transit centre burned down at displacement site in Bunia
article.articleSummary: Ebola transit centre burned in the Kigonze displacement site, Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, on 1 Oct 2026. The eight-bed Ebola transit/treatment facility operated by International Medical Corps, with over 50 staff, was destroyed, undermining the Ebola response by erasing capacity and investments and delaying urgent care. The Kigonze site hosts nearly 19,000 displaced people; since 20 Sept, armed violence and threats have forced families to move, hindering humanitarian access. No laboratory-confirmed Ebola case counts or deaths are provided in the report. OCHA emphasizes that displacement sites must remain civilian and safe, and calls for voluntary, safe, dignified movements. Authorities are coordinating to determine what happened and to ensure health facilities and personnel can deliver life-saving services. The incident highlights security risks to Ebola control efforts and the protection of humanitarian operations and responders.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：ブニアの国内避難民サイトでエボラ出血熱移送センターが焼失
triage.triage_reason: エボラ対応拠点（移送・治療施設）が武装勢力関連の騒乱により焼失し、対応能力喪失と医療アクセス遅延が発生。治安悪化によりヒューマニタリアンアクセスも阻害されており、エボラ流行対応に重大な支障をきたす可能性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事では症例数や死亡者数などエボラの疫学データは報告されておらず、治安事案による対応インフラ損壊が主題。感染拡大状況の続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mobile labs speed up Ebola testing in eastern Congo
article.articleSummary: Mobile laboratories are speeding Ebola testing in eastern Congo, with on-site testing at a lab in Butembo. The mobile unit can be relocated rapidly, e.g., to Katwa during emergencies, enabling faster deployment. Testing times have dropped from as long as 72 hours to 24 hours, and sometimes to six hours. This acceleration allows earlier isolation and treatment of suspected cases, while negative individuals can return to routine care more quickly. Lota Kalubi, doctor at ITAV Ebola treatment centre, recalls the shift from 72-hour results; Andrew Nsawotebba, Uganda mobile lab team lead, notes that patients with two negative results within 72 hours can be guided to the general healthcare pathway. The mobile lab operates at an Ebola treatment center established with Uganda's help at Butembo's Agricultural and Veterinary Technical Institute.

triage.headline_ja: 移動式検査室がコンゴ東部でのエボラ検査を迅速化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）とウガンダの国境地域での継続的な発生・対応活動を示しており、国際的拡大リスクも存在するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部（ブテンボ、カトワ）でのエボラ検査体制強化に関する内容で、ウガンダの支援を受けた治療センターでの活動が言及されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。既存の流行対応に関する報道だが、エボラの重篤性と越境リスクを考慮しPICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Bilanțul epidemiei de Ebola din RD Congo a depășit pragul de 4.000 de morți
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic toll in DR Congo has surpassed the 4,000-death mark.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, the Ebola epidemic toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 deaths. Separately, researchers report metabolic and immune-system changes that distinguish people who exercise regularly from those with a sedentary lifestyle, based on a study published 18 September in Science Advances. The findings indicate potential pathways for managing chronic diseases, illustrating how physical activity might influence biological processes. The two items illustrate ongoing public health challenges in Africa and advances in understanding how lifestyle factors modulate metabolism and immunity. The convergence of these topics underscores the breadth of infectious disease and non-communicable disease research.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行による死者数が4,000人を超えた
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ流行で死者数が4,000人を超えたという重大な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の該当がある。
triage.notes: 記事は死者数4,000人超という節目を報じるのみで、感染拡大状況・対応状況の詳細は不明。続報でフルRRA評価の精査が必要。運動と代謝に関する研究部分は本トリアージと無関係。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola deaths in Congo exceed 4,000, government data shows
article.articleSummary: Ebola-related deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo have surpassed 4,000, according to government data released on Oct 2, 2026. The report cited by Reuters confirms the toll as of Friday, underscoring the ongoing burden of Ebola in the country. The article provides no breakdown by province, no laboratory-confirmed case counts, and no details on symptoms, infection sources, or transmission chains. It also does not include information on new cases, containment measures, or any imported or exported case status. The summary emphasizes the persistent public health challenge posed by Ebola in the DRC. Published on 2026-10-02 by Reuters; reporting by Clement Bonnerot and Anait Miridzhanian, with editing by David Goodman.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数、政府データで4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラによる死者数が4,000人を超えるという重大な公衆衛生上の影響が報告されており、WPRO基準の重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさに該当するため、フルリスク評価への移行が適切と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事は死者数の累計報告のみで、新規症例数・感染源・封じ込め策・国際的拡大の有無などの詳細情報は含まれていない。継続的なアウトブレイクの深刻さを示す数値のため、フルリスク評価で最新の疫学情報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : le gouvernement provincial alerte sur la flambée des cas d'Ebola à Beni - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: the provincial government warns of a surge in Ebola cases in Beni - LePotentiel.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease surges in North Kivu, DR Congo, with Beni city bearing the brunt. The provincial government warns of a new outbreak wave, including infections among frontline health workers and several students. The warning was delivered Oct 1 in Beni by Governor Major General Somo Evariste, with health coordinator Prisca Kamala citing a worrying rise in cases concentrated in Beni. Authorities urge strict adherence to prevention measures and call leaders of churches, mosques, bars, schools, and banks to reinforce controls to curb transmission. Public-place inspection missions will monitor compliance and may sanction non‑compliant individuals or establishments. This alert comes as North Kivu remains a major outbreak hotspot; as of Sept 29, the province reported 1,615 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,013 deaths across about ten health zones.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州:州政府がベニでのエボラ症例急増を警告 - LePotentiel
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という重篤な感染症の症例急増が報告され、医療従事者への感染拡大や多数の死亡者数(1,013人)が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 北キブ州ベニ市を中心にエボラ症例が急増し、医療従事者・学生への感染も報告。既存の大規模流行（累計1,615症例、1,013死亡）の継続拡大であり、国際的な支援ニーズも高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: 4 Warga Gunungkidul Positif Antraks Buntut Makan Daging Kambing Sakit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 4 Gunungkidul Residents Test Positive for Anthrax After Eating Sick Goat Meat
article.articleSummary: Four residents of Pelem Hamlet, Semanu District, Gunungkidul Regency, DI Yogyakarta, Indonesia, tested positive for anthrax after consuming meat from a goat that died suddenly and was suspected to be ill. The cases arose within a context of the local practice known as porak or mbrandu, where households purchase animals that have died to ease the owner’s burden. Initial cases in September presented with nonspecific illness and skin lesions resembling eschars; seven people were initially suspected. Epidemiologic investigation confirmed direct contact with the livestock; PCR testing confirmed four anthrax cases. A risk assessment identified 47 individuals with exposure to the animal or its products. The four confirmed patients received medical care and recovered. Prophylaxis was given to suspects and the at-risk group, with ongoing health monitoring for two incubation periods (60 days). Authorities urge reporting of sudden livestock deaths and avoid slaughter/consumption of sick or dead animals, while coordinating across sectors.

triage.headline_ja: グヌンキドゥル住民4人、病気のヤギ肉を食べた後に炭疽菌陽性
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの既知の慣行（病死家畜の消費）に関連した局地的な皮膚炭疽症例で、患者は回復し人から人への感染リスクも低いが、曝露者への経過観察が継続中であるため注視を要する。
triage.notes: 地元の『porak』または『mbrandu』という病死家畜購入・消費の慣行が原因で、再発性の問題として知られる。患者は回復し、47名の曝露者に60日間の健康観察とプロフィラキシスが実施されている。人から人への感染報告はなく、国際的拡大リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en Congo ya causa más de 4.000 muertes y se intensifica la lucha por contenerlo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo has already caused more than 4,000 deaths, and the fight to contain it intensifies.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused 4,018 deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases as of 2026-10-02, in what health authorities call the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. Originating May 15, the Bundibugyo virus strain has spread to new health zones across the DRC, with no approved treatment or vaccine. The World Health Organization warns of rapid geographic expansion amid strained resources. Africa CDC reports confirmed cases may be declining, but insecurity and limited community cooperation could hinder containment and surveillance. Tensions surrounding the response are evident: a Congolese politician was killed for defending government measures. Village-focused campaigns face resistance from beliefs that Ebola is a hoax, and from deep mistrust of the government stemming from past outbreaks and corruption. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行、死者4,000人を超え、封じ込めの闘いが激化
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで急速に拡大し、8,300症例・4,018人死亡という深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療薬が未承認で、史上最速の拡大ペースとされる大規模アウトブレイク。治安悪化・住民の不信感が対応を阻害しており、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en Congo supera las 4.000 muertes mientras autoridades luchan por contenerlo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Congo has surpassed 4,000 deaths as authorities struggle to contain it.
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 2, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed 4,018 people and sickened 8,300 confirmed cases, making it the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. Announced May 15, the outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine. The Ministry of Health in Bunia released the latest figures. The World Health Organization has warned of rapid geographic spread into new health zones, straining already scarce resources. Africa CDC notes that confirmed case counts appear to be decreasing, but insecurity and limited community cooperation may be contributing factors. Earlier this week a Congolese politician was killed while defending government containment measures, underscoring distrust toward health workers and authorities. A village-focused campaign started last month faces resistance from residents who dub Ebola a hoax. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、死者4000人を超え当局は封じ込めに苦慮
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が死者4,018人・感染者8,300人に達し、史上最速の拡大規模で新たな保健地域への拡散も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療薬未承認のBundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる流行で、治安悪化・住民の不信感が対応を阻害していると報告されている。承認済み医薬品が存在しないため封じ込めが困難で、WHOも地理的拡大を警告している。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Jawa Barat: Influenza Tipe A Mudah Menular dalam Keluarga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Java Provincial Health Office: Influenza Type A Is Easily Transmitted Within Families.
article.articleSummary: West Java's Provincial Health Office warns that Influenza A is easily transmitted within families in Indonesia. As of 2 October 2026, health official Raden Vini Adiani Dewi states transmission occurs via airborne droplets and when droplets contaminate surfaces, entering the body through inhalation or ingestion after touching such objects. Household transmission is particularly likely when a family member is ill, increasing risk if preventive measures are not followed. Isolating sick individuals at home and strict mask use are emphasized as key measures to reduce spread within families. While not identical to conditions during the Covid-19 pandemic, the airborne nature of Influenza A can accelerate person-to-person spread. Attention is urged for vulnerable groups, including young children and older adults with comorbidities, underscoring the need for vigilance and preventative behavior to protect these populations.

triage.headline_ja: 西ジャワ州保健局：インフルエンザA型は家庭内で感染しやすい
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに関する一般的な予防啓発情報であり、異常な流行や重症化、公衆衛生上の重大な影響を示す記述はない。
triage.notes: 地方保健当局による家庭内感染予防の注意喚起記事であり、具体的な症例数・重症度・流行規模の情報はなし。季節性インフルエンザの一般的リスクコミュニケーションと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Molecular evidence suggestive of transovarial transmission of severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome virus in chigger mites
article.articleSummary: Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome virus (SFTSV), a tick-borne viral disease with high case-fatality in East Asia, was investigated in the Republic of Korea. In 2019, across 17 sites, researchers collected spleens from 56 wild rodents and 3,402 Leptotrombidium sp. chigger mites and tested for SFTSV RNA by RT-PCR. SFTSV RNA was detected in 3.6% of rodents and in 2.3% of mite pools (minimum infection rate 0.09%). Phylogenetic analysis showed all sequences belonged to genotype B. Importantly, SFTSV RNA was detected in both parental mites and their F1 larvae, yielding molecular evidence suggestive of transovarial transmission under laboratory conditions. The findings imply chigger mites may contribute to natural maintenance of SFTSV alongside the established primary tick vectors. Further animal model-based studies are needed to clarify vector competence and transmission dynamics.

triage.headline_ja: ツツガムシにおける重症熱性血小板減少症候群ウイルスの経卵巣感染を示唆する分子学的証拠
triage.triage_reason: 2019年に韓国で実施された基礎研究（ダニ媒介ウイルスの伝播様式に関する実験室レベルの分子疫学調査）であり、ヒトの症例報告や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。対象国にも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2019年に韓国（Republic of Korea）で実施されたSFTSVの自然界保有動物（野生齧歯類・ツツガムシ）に関する基礎研究論文であり、ヒト症例やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。発生地域にChina/Shanghaiが付与されているが、記事本文の主題は韓国での研究であり、対象国リストに韓国・中国いずれも該当する実際の発生事象ではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: D/Kongo: Hilfswerk missio Aachen fordert stärkere Maßnahmen zur Ebola-Prävention
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: missio Aachen calls for stronger Ebola-prevention measures
article.articleSummary: Missio Aachen warns of gaps in Ebola prevention in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. In Bukavu, South Kivu, about 1.4 million residents face shortages of clean water, soap, disinfectant and functioning handwashing facilities, hindering outbreak containment. Schools provide at most one handwashing station for up to 300 people; markets, government buildings, church communities and health facilities lack such provisions or report damage. The lack of basic protective measures fuels public anxiety as the Ebola virus spreads more intensively in the eastern region than in previous years. The African Union health agency reports since May 8,000 confirmed infections and 4,000 deaths. Missio Aachen urges the German government and the European Union to prioritize hygiene and prevention in aid packages to prevent spread to less affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: 独/コンゴ：ミシオ・アーヘンがエボラ予防強化策を要求
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部（南キブ州）で5月以降8,000人感染・4,000人死亡という大規模なエボラ流行が継続しており、衛生インフラ不足により感染拡大・国際支援要請の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はドイツのNGOがコンゴ東部のエボラ予防体制の不備を指摘し、ドイツ政府・EUに支援強化を求める内容。感染者数・死亡者数（8,000人感染、4,000人死亡）は非常に大きく、致死率も高いため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。ドイツは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: डेंगू का घनी आबादी में प्रकोप, आठ रोगी और मिले
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue outbreak in a densely populated area, eight more patients found.
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreak expands in Kanpur, with eight new dengue cases reported in densely populated neighborhoods as of 2 October 2026. In Yashoda Nagar, a 16-year-old girl; in Parade area, a 29-year-old man; in Kalyanpur, a 35-year-old man; and in Gujaini, a 33-year-old man tested positive. The Medical College’s laboratory confirmed four additional dengue infections, all residents of crowded city areas. A separate scrub typhus case has also been identified, indicating concurrent vector-borne disease activity in Kanpur. The report highlights ongoing urban transmission in the city’s populous localities, but provides limited details on symptoms, exposure sources, clinical outcomes, or travel-related import/export status. Authorities are monitoring clusters and emphasizing targeted public health measures in high-density neighborhoods.

triage.headline_ja: 密集地域でデング熱の流行が拡大、新たに8人の患者確認
triage.triage_reason: カンプールで季節性のデング熱・つつが虫病の散発例が報告されているが、重症度や拡大の規模に関する情報が限定的であり、国際的影響も認められないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: インドではデング熱は毎年の季節性流行であり、本記事は地域メディアによる局地的な症例報告に留まる。つつが虫病の併発も確認されているが、詳細情報は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Peste 4.000 de oameni au murit în epidemia de Ebola din Congo. Bilanțul real ar putea fi mai mare
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 4,000 people have died in the Ebola epidemic in Congo. The real death toll could be higher.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is ongoing as of October 2, 2026, with 4,018 deaths from 8,300 laboratory-confirmed cases across seven provinces. A total of 2,162 patients have recovered, giving a case fatality rate of 48.4%. Health authorities warn the official death toll may be an undercount, as Doctors Without Borders (MSF) cautions that gaps in monitoring and case detection likely push numbers higher. This epidemic is the largest and most deadly Ebola outbreak ever recorded in the Democratic Republic of Congo and ranks second globally, after the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. The report underscores the severity and sustained transmission within the country, even as recoveries accumulate.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行で4,000人以上が死亡。実際の死者数はさらに多い可能性
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ大規模流行（致死率48.4%、8,300症例・4,018死亡）であり、IHR基準の複数該当と社会的関心の高さからフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーはDRC国内の流行のみに言及しており、Angolaは対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。これはDRC史上最大・最も致死率の高いエボラ流行であり、過小報告の懸念も指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Mer enn 4000 døde i ebola-utbruddet i Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 4,000 died in the Ebola outbreak in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed 4,018 people out of about 8,300 confirmed infections, according to the health ministry. The outbreak began in May and has spread across at least seven provinces, particularly in the northeast. The World Health Organization has warned of rapid regional spread, straining already limited resources. Africa CDC notes confirmed cases are edging downward, though declines may reflect insecurity and limited community cooperation in hard-hit areas. Earlier this week a Congolese politician was attacked and killed after defending government measures against the outbreak. Widespread distrust of health workers and authorities has hindered containment; a village-based approach launched last month faces opposition from residents who deny Ebola’s existence. No vaccine or specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, per the Norwegian Institute of Public Health. Ebola is a severe viral hemorrhagic fever.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行で4000人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行で死者4,000人超・感染者8,300人超、複数州に拡大しWHOが地域拡大を警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 致死率約48%と高く、住民の不信感や治安悪化により封じ込めが困難。ワクチン・特異的治療法は存在しない。政治家殺害事件も発生しており社会的緊張が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết Dengue: Chuyên gia chỉ ra những nhóm có nguy cơ chuyển nặng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever: Experts identify groups at risk of progression to severe dengue.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Vietnam shows a high burden in the Southern region, which accounts for about 73.1% of national cases. High‑risk groups needing close monitoring upon infection include the elderly and those with comorbidities (hypertension, diabetes, cardiovascular disease, chronic kidney disease), pregnant women, and overweight/obese individuals; infants under 1 year and some young children can also have atypical or rapidly progressive disease. However, severe dengue can occur in young, healthy people as well. In Ho Chi Minh City’s Hospital for Tropical Diseases, two severely ill patients aged 16 and 21 required advanced care—one on ECMO for over a month (cost near 1 billion VND) and another on continuous dialysis for 45 days; a death of a 20‑year‑old occurred on September 8. The dangerous window is days 3–7 after onset, even if fever subsides. Warning signs include agitation, persistent abdominal pain, vomiting, bleeding, low urine output, cold extremities, or confusion. Seek urgent care and discuss vaccination and prevention strategies.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱:重症化リスクの高いグループを専門家が指摘
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム南部でデング熱が既知の流行状況にあり、重症例・死亡例の報告はあるが、新規性や国際的拡大の兆候は乏しく、毎年の季節性流行の範囲内と考えられるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムで毎年流行する既知の感染症であり、本記事は医療専門家による注意喚起・啓発記事の性格が強い。重症例・死亡例の報告はあるが、アウトブレイクの急拡大や新規株の出現等の情報はなく、IHR基準の「異常性」には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: MPF abre procedimento para acompanhar aumento de casos de HIV no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MPF opens a proceeding to monitor the increase in HIV cases in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Brazil’s Federal Public Prosecutor’s Office (MPF) has opened an administrative procedure via its Health Commission to monitor public policies addressing the rise in HIV cases in Brazil. Despite advances in reducing AIDS deaths and eliminating mother-to-child transmission of HIV, the MPF notes an uptick in infections, contrasting with global declines. The ordinance cites press and expert alerts about increases, particularly among youth and vulnerable populations. The inquiry will track prevention, diagnosis, control, and response actions by public authorities. In 2024, Brazil reported 39,216 new HIV infections (18.4 per 100,000), up 19% from 2020. From 1991 to September 2025, 175,803 infections occurred in people aged 15–24 (25.7% of total). In 2024, men aged 20–29 accounted for 44.7% of new male cases. MPF will monitor to inform public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: MPF、ブラジルにおけるHIV感染者数増加を監視する手続きを開始
triage.triage_reason: HIV感染者数の増加傾向を政府機関が監視する行政措置であり、急性の公衆衛生緊急事態ではないが、若年層での増加傾向が継続している点は注視が必要。
triage.notes: HIVは慢性感染症であり、世界的な減少傾向に反してブラジルで増加している点が政府機関の関心事項。急性アウトブレイクではなく、長期的な公衆衛生政策の監視事案。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolapatiënt in LUMC: hoe gevaarlijk is dat eigenlijk?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patient at LUMC: how dangerous is that, really?
article.articleSummary: An MSF (Médecins Sans Frontières) employee infected with Ebola, contracted in the Democratic Republic of Congo, was admitted to Leiden University Medical Center (LUMC) in the Netherlands. The patient was transported from DRC to the Netherlands by a private French aircraft, landing at Schiphol around 19:45, with ambulances and Royal Netherlands Marechaussee escorting to LUMC about an hour later. Ebola carries a high fatality rate, estimated at 30–50% for the patient; there is no specific antiviral treatment, only supportive care (fluids, oxygen) as needed. In the Netherlands, the arrival poses no risk to others because the patient is placed in strict isolation. Transmission occurs via bodily fluids; healthcare workers wear protective gear and follow strict donning/doffing protocols. LUMC and Radboud University Medical Center Nijmegen are designated centers for such infections, with turnout training for staff. The patient’s identity remains undisclosed.

triage.headline_ja: LUMCのエボラ患者：実際どれほど危険なのか？
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラに感染したMSF職員がオランダへ搬送され隔離治療中。致死率の高いエボラであり、DRCでの流行継続を示す事例として社会的関心も高く、フルRRAでの背景確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はオランダでの患者隔離対応だが、感染源はDRCでの流行であり、DRC関連のエボラ事例として記録。オランダ・フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 簡舒培再爆吃完營養午餐12人不適 蔣萬安：疑諾羅病毒或腸胃型感冒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jian Shupei again reports 12 people ill after finishing a nutritious lunch; Chiang Wan-an: suspected norovirus or gastroenteritis.
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 2, 2026, a Wenshan District, Taipei elementary school reports a suspected foodborne gastrointestinal illness after a September 23 lunch including small squid. Twelve students developed symptoms post-meal; Jingxing Elementary School currently has 11 ill. Doctors’ initial assessment suspects norovirus or gastroenteritis; Education Bureau and Health Bureau have collected samples for laboratory testing, with results pending to confirm the source. The incident prompted ongoing monitoring and support from school authorities. Mayor Chiang Wan-an addressed the Education Committee, stating the city awaits laboratory results and will continue providing assistance; no confirmed pathogen or institutional outbreak has been announced at this time.

triage.headline_ja: 簡舒培再爆吃完營養午餐12人不適 蔣萬安：疑諾羅病毒或腸胃型感冒
triage.triage_reason: 台湾の小学校での少人数の食中毒様症状事例であり、病原体未確定・小規模で国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。地元当局により調査中で、学校単位の限定的な事例。
