article.articleHeadline: Gejala-gejala Influenza A, Jangan Anggap Remeh Ini Perbedaanya dengan Flu Biasa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Symptoms of Influenza A: Don't Underestimate These Differences Compared to the Common Flu.
article.articleSummary: Jakarta, Indonesia: Symptoms of influenza A can be more severe than the common flu, with abrupt fever, body aches, sore throat, cough, and nasal congestion; early recognition is crucial, especially for high-risk groups. Indonesian Ministry of Health data through 19 September 2026 show influenza-positive specimens at 46% in week 36, up from 35%. Among 86 positives from 185 tested, 76 were influenza A(H1N1)pdm09, 8 A(H3N2), and 2 B(Victoria). Forty-two percent of positive cases occurred in children aged 0–4. Despite the rising proportion positive, overall influenza activity remains low. Influenza A and B circulate, with A also being capable of pandemics. The current circulating influenza A subtypes are A(H1N1)pdm09 and A(H3N2).

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAの症状：通常の風邪との違いを軽視してはいけない
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、インドネシア保健省のサーベイランスデータでも全体の活動は低水準にとどまっている。異常なクラスターや重症化の急増は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザAの症状解説と通常のサーベイランスデータ（H1N1pdm09、H3N2、B型Victoria系統の検出状況）を紹介する啓発記事であり、特定の発生地域における異常なアウトブレイクを報じるものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de Ébola na República Democrática do Congo já matou mais de 4.000 pessoas - Renascença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has already killed more than 4,000 people - Renascença
article.articleSummary: Eight thousand three hundred confirmed Ebola cases have been reported across seven provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 4,018 deaths and more than 2,000 recoveries, as of 2026-10-02. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus and is the largest and deadliest in DRC history, surpassing the 2018–2020 episode; only the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic exceeded its scale. Transmission remains active in eastern DRC, especially Ituri and North Kivu, although authorities note signs of slowing in some zones. Ubangi-Sud province declared an outbreak last month after a man who had traveled from the east died from the disease, signaling cross-regional spread. Health authorities and UN agencies continue containment efforts to interrupt transmission chains and prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで死者4,000人超に - Renascença
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最大規模のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（8,300症例、死者4,018人）が7州に拡大し、国境を越えた伝播兆候も見られるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルスによるアウトブレイクで、2018-2020年の流行を上回りDRC史上最大規模。東部（イトゥリ、北キブ）で活発な伝播が継続し、別州（ウバンギ・スッド）への拡大も確認されている。国連機関を含む封じ込め対応が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: 本港錄一宗外地傳入基孔肯雅熱個案｜METROHK.com.hk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong records one imported dengue fever case
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong reports one imported chikungunya fever case: a 62-year-old woman who had visited Guangdong Province during incubation. She was admitted, treated in a mosquito-free environment, and is stable; two household contacts are under medical surveillance and asymptomatic. HK’s chikungunya total this year is four (three imported, one local). Dengue fever: no new locally transmitted cases since Sept 25; year-to-date 32 cases (30 imported, two local). Globally, dengue incidence remains high: WHO reports over 14 million cases in 2024 and about 2.2 million cases with more than 1,000 deaths from January–August this year. Public health guidance emphasizes environmental hygiene and repellents like DEET; travelers to dengue-affected areas, including parts of Southeast Asia, should take precautions.

triage.headline_ja: 本港、基孔肯雅熱（チクングニア熱）の輸入症例を1件確認
triage.triage_reason: 香港における輸入チクングニア熱の単発症例であり、患者は安定、接触者も無症状で蚊媒介環境管理下にあるため、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本症例は輸入例で地域内伝播なし。デング熱についても新規地域感染なしで安定している。グローバルなデング熱流行状況への言及はあるが、本記事の主眼は香港での管理された輸入症例報告であり、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in DR Congo: meer dan 4000 doden gemeld
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo: more than 4,000 deaths reported.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC): as of 2 October 2026, government figures report more than 4,000 deaths and about 8,300 infections, the largest and deadliest outbreak in the country’s history. The virus continues to spread, especially in eastern Congo, with the northwestern province of South Ubangi identified as the seventh affected province last month. Official counts may underestimate true burden due to registrations gaps amid years of conflict, leaving northern and eastern regions hard hit and government control limited by armed-group violence. President Félix Tshisekedi has urged the UN for greater attention to Congo’s so‑called “silent genocide” and called for an international commission to break the cycle of impunity. By comparison, West Africa’s 2014–2016 Ebola outbreak killed about 11,000 across Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：死者4000人超と報告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最大規模のエボラ流行で死者4000人超、感染者8300人超、7州に拡大しており、紛争地域での統制困難と国際支援要請が示されているためフルRRAへ進むべき重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 西アフリカ（リベリア・ギニア・シエラレオネ）は2014-2016年流行との比較のために言及されているのみで、現在のイベント発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola Outbreak Has Killed Over 4,000 As Authorities Struggle To Contain Virus
article.articleSummary: Congo's Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has caused 4,018 deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases, making it the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history. The May 15 outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo virus, which has no known treatment or vaccine. WHO warns of rapid geographic spread into new health zones, stretching limited resources, while Africa CDC says confirmed cases are falling—potentially due to insecurity and poor community cooperation in hotspots. A Congolese politician, Marie-Célestin Karondwa, was attacked and beaten to death in Butembo, North Kivu, amid tensions over outbreak measures; his house was set on fire. Widespread mistrust of health workers and authorities hampers response, despite a village-centered approach. This remains Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、死者4,000人超—当局はウイルス封じ込めに苦慮
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が過去最速の拡大を見せ、死者4,000人超・感染8,300人規模に達しており、治療法・ワクチンもなく国際的拡大・公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確なため。
triage.notes: 治療法・ワクチンがないブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスによる過去最速の流行。治安不安と地域住民の不信が対応を妨げており、政治家殺害事件も発生するなど社会的緊張が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Caracas d'hippopotames au PNVi : l'ICCN appelle les riverains à la vigilance après la confirmation de l'Anthrax
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hippo carcasses at Virunga National Park: ICCN urges residents to stay vigilant after anthrax confirmation.
article.articleSummary: Laboratory analyses confirm Bacillus anthracis (anthrax) in hippo carcasses found in the Semuliki River near Virunga National Park in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo. The finding, announced September 29, 2026, follows an earlier alert on September 25 and was issued by the ICCN North Kivu provincial directorate after joint work with Virunga Doctors. A rapid response protocol is in place: do not touch, move, cut, bury, or burn carcasses; do not buy, sell, transport, or consume meat from dead or sick animals; keep children, livestock and domestic animals away; avoid using water near carcasses. Report any new carcasses to local authorities, veterinary services, community relays, or ICCN agents, and seek medical care if exposed or if symptoms develop. A prior case was confirmed at Vitshumbi in central Virunga (Kibirizi health zone, Rutshuru). The situation recalls an April 2025 anthrax outbreak around Lake Edward with about 50 hippos dead.

triage.headline_ja: ヴィルンガ国立公園でカバの死骸から炭疽菌を確認、ICCNが住民に警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のヴィルンガ国立公園周辺でカバの炭疽感染が確認され、人への曝露リスクに対する注意喚起が出されているが、現時点でヒトの感染例は報告されておらず、情報が限定的なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 2025年4月にも同地域（エドワード湖周辺）で約50頭のカバが炭疽で死亡した事例があり、再発的な動物衛生イベント。ヒトへの感染例は現時点で報告されていないが、食肉摂取・接触による人獣共通感染のリスクが注意喚起されている。オーストラリア・ルワンダは地理名の誤割当てと判断し除外。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 사망자 넉달반만에 4천명 넘어...치명률 48%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 4,000 in just over four and a half months... case fatality rate 48%.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persists, with cumulative cases reaching 8,300 and deaths surpassing 4,000 (4,018) as of September 30, 2026, yielding a case fatality rate of 48.4%. Recoveries total 2,162. The outbreak, declared May 15 with Uganda at the border, continues amid cross-border transmission risk. Africa CDC notes a slowdown in confirmed cases, but cautions that true spread may be higher due to undercounting, security challenges, and community distrust. MSF also warns official tallies could underestimate infections. Local distrust and security incidents hinder response, including an attack on a UDPS regional chair in Butembo, North Kivu, on September 27 after promoting Ebola prevention. Ongoing surveillance and public health measures are essential to control transmission amid cross-border risk.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴのエボラ死者数、4カ月半で4000人超…致死率48%
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が継続し致死率48%、死者4000人超と深刻な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、ウガンダとの国境を越えた拡大リスクや治安・不信による対応困難も報告されているためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダとの国境地域での感染拡大リスクが指摘されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。治安問題（Butemboでの攻撃事件）が対応を阻害している点も注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Meer dan 4000 eboladoden in Democratische Republiek Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 4,000 Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports more than 4,000 deaths and about 8,300 Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases, the largest and deadliest outbreak in the country’s history. The outbreak is most severe in the north and east, with authorities warning that true counts may be higher due to gaps in surveillance amid years of conflict that hamper control efforts. While Congo and the United Nations said last month that transmission was decreasing, the virus continues to spread in eastern regions. The northwestern South Ubangi Province was noted last month as the seventh province affected by the outbreak. Containment remains challenging amid conflict-affected areas of the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱による死者4,000人超
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大規模・最も致死的なエボラ流行であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、紛争地域での対応困難、国際的拡大リスクが認められるためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 史上最大規模のエボラ流行で死者4,000人・症例8,300人超。7州に拡大し、紛争により監視・封じ込めが困難。伝播減少との報告もあるが東部では継続中。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ΛΔ Κονγκό: Ξεπέρασαν τους 4.000 οι νεκροί από την επιδημία Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: The death toll from the Ebola outbreak has surpassed 4,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to spread, driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with 4,018 deaths and 8,300 laboratory-confirmed cases across seven provinces as of 2 October 2026. More than 2,000 people have recovered. The outbreak is the worst and most deadly in DRC's history and the second-largest globally, after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) which killed over 11,000. Although officials reported signs of containment in Ituri province, transmission remains rapid in eastern DRC. South Ubangi, in the northwest, became the seventh affected province after a man who had traveled from the eastern Congo died of Ebola there. The figures reflect ongoing transmission and the scale of response required to halt spread.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴ：エボラ流行による死者数が4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴ史上最悪・世界第2位規模のエボラ流行が継続し、死者4,000人超・7州に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: リベリア・ギニア・シエラレオネは2014-2016年流行との比較のための言及であり、現在の発生国ではないため除外。南ウバンギ州への拡大は東部からの渡航者による死亡例で、国内拡大として継続注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak has killed more than 4,000 as health workers protest delayed payment
article.articleSummary: Congo's Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, has 4,018 deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases, the fastest-growing outbreak in history. The flare-up began May 15 in Ituri's Bunia. There is no known treatment or vaccine. Health workers protested delayed payments, hampering surveillance; some frontline staff have struck. An MSF aid worker contracted Ebola and was evacuated to the Netherlands, admitted to Leiden University Medical Center. WHO warns of rapid spread into new health zones; Africa CDC notes falling new cases may reflect insecurity and coordination challenges. An attack on local official Marie-Célestin Karondwa in Butembo shows deep mistrust. This is the DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak; village-centered containment faces resistance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行、死者4,000人超え―医療従事者は支払い遅延に抗議
triage.triage_reason: 史上最速の拡大スピードを持つエボラ流行で死者4,000人超、国際的な症例輸出（MSF職員がオランダへ搬送）も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: MSF職員の感染によりオランダ（Leiden）へ搬送された事例は国際拡大リスクを裏付けるが、オランダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。DRCの第17回目のエボラ流行であり、治安・不信感・医療従事者ストライキが対応を困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'Ituri en proie aux violences, Ebola perturbé
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Ituri in the grip of violence, Ebola disrupted.
article.articleSummary: Violence in Djugu, Ituri, eastern DRC, has displaced over 5,000 people and disrupted the Ebola response. Since Sept 27 clashes near the Rhoe IDP site pushed 3,000+ to flee; four were killed and seven wounded, with homes burned in Blukwa. UN OCHA notes security deteriorations after months of calm, with women and children the majority of IDPs. Ebola operations are hampered: movement suspended in Fataki, Drodro, and Lita; the Ebola transit camp at Kigonze was burned on Sept 30. Lab sample transport from Fataki and transfer of confirmed patients from Gina to Fataki have been disrupted. In Gina and Lita, outreach and travel are paused. RN27 road access is threatened, risking aid delivery. In North Kivu, two Ebola workers were killed in Lubero; Masisi has displaced over 24,000 since mid-September. As of Sept 29, WHO reports 3,982 deaths and over 8,224 confirmed Ebola cases across seven provinces and 63 health zones.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：イトゥリで暴力が激化、エボラ対応に支障
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行（累計8,224症例・3,982死亡、7州63保健地域）に加え、イトゥリ・北キヴ州での武力衝突がワクチン接種・検体輸送・患者搬送などの対応を妨げており、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的拡大リスクを伴う。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Ξεπέρασαν τους 4.000 οι νεκροί από την επιδημία Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: The death toll from the Ebola epidemic surpassed 4,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ebola outbreak has surpassed 4,000 deaths (4,018) and 8,300 laboratory-confirmed cases across seven provinces, with over 2,000 recoveries. The epidemic is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain and is the largest and deadliest in DRC history, exceeding the 2018–2020 outbreak and ranking as the second-largest Ebola outbreak globally after West Africa’s 2014–2016 period (over 28,600 cases and more than 11,000 deaths in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone). While there are indications of reduced transmission in Ituri—the outbreak’s origin—the virus continues to spread in eastern DRC. South Ubangi province becomes the seventh affected after a man who traveled from eastern Congo died of Ebola, illustrating cross-provincial transmission and ongoing challenges for containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラ出血熱の流行による死者数が4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行が継続しており、死者4,000人超・7州への拡大が確認され、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にSierra Leone、Angola、Liberia、Guineaが含まれているが、これらは過去の2014-2016西アフリカ流行との比較として言及されているのみで、現在の発生国ではないため除外した。南ウバンギ州への新規拡大が示す越境・越州伝播リスクに注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak has killed more than 4,000, government data shows | CNBC Africa
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo is battling the Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo species, the largest and deadliest in the country’s history. As of 2026-10-02, government figures show 4,018 deaths and 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces, with over 2,000 recoveries. It began in Ituri province and has since spread rapidly into eastern Congo, including North Kivu. South Ubangi declared the outbreak last month after a man who had traveled from eastern Congo died of the virus, marking the seventh province affected. The outbreak is the worst in Congo and second only to the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic, which infected over 28,600 people and killed more than 11,000 across Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone. Authorities and the UN had reported signs of slowing transmission in parts of Ituri, but overall transmission remains high.

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak death toll surpasses 4,000
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, has killed 4,018 people and infected 8,300 across seven provinces as of Oct 1, 2026, with over 2,000 recoveries. The disease, the worst in the country’s history, trails the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic in global totals. Signs of slowing transmission were reported in Ituri province, where the outbreak began, but the virus is spreading in eastern Congo, including North Kivu. South Ubangi province declared its outbreak in September after a traveller from eastern Congo died of the virus, marking the seventh province affected. Ongoing transmission underscores persistent risk despite some containment progress. The figures come from government data released on Oct 2. The outbreak's persistence emphasizes cross-province exposure and the need for continued public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行、死者数が4000人を超える

triage.notes: 史上最悪規模のエボラ流行であり、7州に拡大、国境を越えた移動者による新規州発生も確認されているため、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola death toll hits 4,000 as violence hampers response
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, has 8,224 confirmed cases and 3,982 deaths as of Sept. 29, with over 2,200 recoveries and hundreds hospitalized or isolated; crude case-fatality rate ~48%. Declared May 15, it is the deadliest Ebola epidemic in Congo’s history and the second-largest globally. The outbreak spans 63 health zones across seven provinces, with Ituri as the epicenter and cases in North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, Tshopo and Sud Ubangi. Bundibugyo virus has no approved vaccine or specific therapy; transmission starts from animal contact and spreads human-to-human via blood and secretions, with burial practices amplifying spread. WHO classifies risk as very high inside Congo and high in neighboring countries. Response relies on isolation, contact tracing, safe burials, and expanded lab testing, though insecurity and displacement hinder access. In Kigonze displacement camp near Bunia, clashes displaced thousands; about 1,000 identified contacts remained untraced and a transit center was burned.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数が4000人に到達、暴力が対応を妨げる
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ(ブンディブギョウイルス)流行が8,224症例・死者3,982人、致死率約48%に達し、ワクチン・治療薬不在かつ治安悪化で対応困難という、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際拡大リスクのある事態であるため。
triage.notes: コンゴ史上最も致死性の高いエボラ流行であり、WHOはコンゴ国内リスクを非常に高い、近隣国を高いと分類。治安悪化・住民避難により追跡不能な接触者約1,000人が存在し、対応が著しく妨げられている。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A Belum Ditemukan di Bantul, Warga Diminta Tetap Waspada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A Not Yet Detected in Bantul, Residents Urged to Remain Vigilant
article.articleSummary: Influenza A has not been detected in Bantul's Bumi Projotamansari as of October 1, 2026, according to Bantul Health Office; no confirmed cases reported by October 2, and residents are urged to strengthen clean and healthy living (PHBS) to reduce transmission. Influenza A is a virus type that can cause seasonal illness, with sudden-onset symptoms including fever, chills, muscle and joint pains, cough, headache, fatigue, sore throat, and nasal congestion. In children, nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea can accompany illness. Officials stressed the potential for rapid onset and complications if untreated and noted little link to prolonged dry season, attributing possible spread to viral mutation. Preventive measures include handwashing with soap and running water, masking in crowds or when unwell, adequate rest, nutritious meals, and regular exercise.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAはバントゥルで未検出、住民には引き続き警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 記事はバントゥルでインフルエンザAの症例が確認されていないことを報告する予防啓発内容であり、実際の発生や異常事態は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Asal Mula 4 Kasus Antraks di Gunungkidul, Bermula dari Tradisi Brandu Ternak Sakit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Origins of Four Anthrax Cases in Gunungkidul, Originating from the Brandu Tradition of Sick Livestock.
article.articleSummary: Four confirmed anthrax cases in Gunungkidul Regency, Special Region of Yogyakarta, Indonesia, were identified and laboratory-confirmed by PCR as of 2 October 2026. Seven residents in Dusun Pelem, Kalurahan Semanu, presented with clinical symptoms and had direct contact with sick or suddenly dead livestock; four of the seven tested positive for anthrax. The Gunungkidul Health Office (Dinkes) conducted epidemiological investigation and provided intensive treatment, with all patients recovered and discharged. There were no new cases at the reported time. Tracing indicates the infections originated from a local tradition known as porak or brandu, which involves handling or processing livestock linked to the illness. The response involved rapid medical care and laboratory confirmation to curb the outbreak, with no evidence of ongoing transmission at the time.

triage.headline_ja: グヌンキドゥルでの炭疽菌感染症4例の発端、病気の家畜を扱う「ブランドゥ」の伝統に由来
triage.triage_reason: グヌンキドゥルで確認された炭疽4例は全員回復し新規症例なしだが、病気家畜を扱う地域の伝統（ブランドゥ）が継続する限り再発リスクがあるため、今後の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本事例はインドネシア・グヌンキドゥルで毎年のように報告される炭疽の地域的流行で、全症例が回復し新規感染もないことから重症度・国際的拡大リスクは低い。ただし、病気の家畜を扱う伝統的慣習（brandu/porak）が継続する限り再発の可能性があるため経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: GSK: meningite, adolescenti 'inconsapevoli' ma sono secondo gruppo piu' a rischio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: GSK: Meningitis, adolescents 'unaware' but they are the second-highest-risk group
article.articleSummary: In Italy, invasive meningococcal disease (IMD) shows variable trends, with a rise in cases in 2022–2024 after declines in 2020–2021, and serogroup B predominating across ages. Adolescents are the second-highest risk group with high transmission potential. A global survey by Human8, funded by GSK, across Argentina, Australia, Brazil, France, Spain, and Italy, finds substantial gaps between knowledge and risk perception: 85% of parents and 68% of adolescents know what meningitis is, yet only 28% of parents and a similar share of youths believe someone in the young age could develop it in the next 12 months. Italians also report lower risk awareness than other countries (about one in four vs ~one in three). Physicians remain central to guiding vaccination decisions; social media and AI are used but trust in information is variable.

triage.notes: 本記事はイタリア、フランス、ブラジル、アルゼンチン、オーストラリア、スペインにおける髄膜炎菌感染症に関する意識調査（GSK資金）の結果報告であり、対象国リストに含まれる国（ブラジル）は主題として発生事例が述べられていないため除外。

article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports over 4,000 Ebola deaths and about 8,300 confirmed infections across seven provinces, with more than 2,000 recoveries. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, marks the worst on record for the DRC, surpassing the 2018–2020 epidemic. Globally, it ranks as the second-worst Ebola outbreak, behind West Africa’s 2014–2016 epicenter in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone (over 11,000 deaths and 28,600 infections). While the government and UN say transmission appears to be slowing in Ituri, the outbreak origin, the eastern province of Nord-Kivu continues to see rapid spread. A separate outbreak has been identified in South Ubangi in the northwest, linked to a case imported from the East (a man who died from the virus).

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo: Mehr als 4.000 Todesfälle gemeldet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo: More than 4,000 deaths reported.

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en la RD del Congo supera las 4.000 muertes en medio de crecientes tensiones
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 4,000 deaths amid rising tensions.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed 4,018 people among 8,300 confirmed cases (nearly half of infections). The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, was declared on 15 May and has no known treatment or vaccine. WHO warns of rapid geographic expansion into new health zones, straining scarce resources. Africa CDC states that confirmed-case numbers are decreasing, but attributes this to insecurity and limited community cooperation in some hotspots. Earlier this week, a Congolese politician was killed while defending government measures to contain the disease, underscoring tensions facing health workers. Widespread distrust toward health authorities and government hampers containment; village-focused campaigns launched last month confront beliefs that Ebola is a hoax. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC.

Distrust toward health workers and authorities has hindered containment efforts, underscoring ongoing challenges in controlling Ebola across Central Africa.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラウイルスによる死者数が4000人を超える - シュルーク・ポータル
triage.triage_reason: 死者4,018人・症例8,300件に達する大規模エボラ流行であり、希少なブンディブギョ株で承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在せず、WHOが新たな地域への急速な拡大を警告しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 過去最大規模・最速拡大とされる第7次DRCエボラ流行で、希少株（Bundibugyo）による治療薬・ワクチン未承認の状況下、治安問題や住民の不信感が封じ込めを妨げている。WHOおよびAfrica CDCが対応にあたっており、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : les engagements financiers dépassent 2 milliards $ depuis le début de la crise
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: financial commitments exceed $2 billion since the start of the crisis.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by the Bundibugyo strain continues to strain response efforts. Since May 15, 2026, the outbreak has reached 8,067 cases and 3,901 deaths (case fatality 48.4%). No approved vaccine or therapy exists; vaccines are in clinical trials, with ongoing supply challenges. The virus has spread to Bulu in South Ubangi and Dungu in Upper Uele, near borders with the Central African Republic and South Sudan. International funding now exceeds $2 billion, with $1.3 billion needed immediately for a 180-day contingency plan. The United States has contributed $887 million directly, plus $350 million humanitarian via OCHA. On Sept 30, over $470 million in new funding was announced. Other donors include World Bank $90M, UK $67.5M, Germany $24.8M, Korea $18M, France $16M, Italy $11.3M, UAE $10M, Japan $5M, Australia $3.5M. Response focuses on treatment, safe burials, PPE, surveillance, contact tracing, diagnostics, and vaccine research; security challenges impede operations.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：危機開始以来の財政的コミットメントが20億ドルを突破
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが8,067症例・3,901死亡（致死率48.4%）に達し、国境地域（中央アフリカ共和国・南スーダン方面）へ拡大。国際資金が20億ドルを超え、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストには韓国・米国・スーダン・日本・イタリア・フランス・中央アフリカ共和国・オーストラリア・ドイツ・UAE・英国が含まれるが、これらはいずれも資金拠出国として言及されているのみで、実際の感染発生国はDRCのみ。中央アフリカ共和国・南スーダンへの拡大懸念は記載されているが対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak has killed more than 4,000 as health workers protest delayed payment
article.articleSummary: Congo's Bundibugyo-virus Ebola outbreak in northeastern Ituri's Bunia, DRC, has 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths, the fastest-growing and largest Ebola outbreak ever recorded in the country. Declared May 15, the outbreak has no known treatment or vaccine for Bundibugyo virus. Health workers protest delayed wages, with frontline surveillance teams among those demanding pay, hampering contact tracing. An MSF aid worker contracted Ebola and was flown to the Netherlands for care, underscoring cross-border concerns. More than 50 health workers have died. Insecurity and community resistance hinder containment, with mistrust of authorities persisting. WHO warns of rapid spread into new health zones; Africa CDC notes that declines in confirmed cases may reflect access challenges. A village-centered approach was launched to improve cooperation amid beliefs that Ebola is a hoax.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、死者4,000人超、医療従事者が給与遅配に抗議
triage.triage_reason: DRCで記録上最大・最速拡大のエボラ流行（確定8,300例、死亡4,018人）であり、治療法・ワクチンがないBundibugyoウイルス株、国際的な患者搬送例、WHOによる拡大警告など複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: MSF職員がエボラに感染しオランダへ搬送された事例があるが、発生地域はDRCが主体でありオランダは発生国として含めない。治療薬・ワクチンがないBundibugyoウイルス株であることが重症度・拡大リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: حصيلة ضحايا فيروس إيبولا في الكونغو تتجاوز أربعة آلاف قتيل
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 4,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 deaths, with 4,018 fatalities among 8,300 confirmed cases, roughly half of all confirmed cases in the fastest outbreak wave to date. Declared on May 15, the outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved treatment or vaccine exists. The World Health Organization warns of rapid geographic spread to new health zones, pressuring already limited response resources. The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention notes that confirmed cases appear to be decreasing in the latest briefing, though insecurity and challenges in community cooperation hinder containment. This marks the seventh Ebola outbreak in the DRC, underscoring persistent mistrust of health workers and authorities that complicates efforts to slow transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱による死者数が4000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が大規模流行（8,300症例中4,018死亡）し、地理的拡大とワクチン・治療法の不在、治安・コミュニティ協力の課題が重なり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数に該当するため。
triage.notes: WHOおよびアフリカCDCが対応に関与しており、治療薬・ワクチンが存在しないBundibugyo株による流行。直近では症例減少の兆候が報告されているが、治安情勢とコミュニティの不信が封じ込めを妨げている。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết Dengue: Không chủ quan khi hết sốt, kể cả ở người trẻ khỏe mạnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever: Do Not Be Complacent When the Fever Subsides, Even Among Young, Healthy People.
article.articleSummary: Southern Vietnam accounts for 73.1% of dengue cases, with experts warning that severe dengue can develop in anyone, even the young and healthy. Elderly with immune decline and comorbidities such as hypertension, diabetes, heart or kidney disease face more complex management and may present non-specifically. Infants under 1 year and overweight or obese children are vulnerable; infant symptoms can be unclear and deterioration rapid. Pregnant women require close monitoring due to risks for mother and baby. In Ho Chi Minh City, adults aged 16 and 21 were critically ill: one needed ECMO for over a month and the other CRRT for 45 days; a 20-year-old died on Sept 8. Dangerous phase typically occurs days 3–7 after fever onset, with warning signs such as agitation, persistent abdominal pain, vomiting, bleeding, reduced urine, and cold extremities. Prevention emphasizes three layers: remove standing water, protect against bites, seek early care, and discuss dengue vaccination with health staff.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：解熱後も油断禁物、若く健康な人でも重症化の恐れ
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム南部で季節性デング熱が流行し重症例・死亡例が報告されているが、既知の風土病であり異常性や国際的拡大リスクは低いため、経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は医療啓発・注意喚起を目的とした内容で、デング熱の季節性流行および重症化リスクに関する一般的な報道。新規性・異常性は低いが、重症例・死亡例が報告されているため動向注視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Ahol több a macska, ott magasabb a jóllét - de a toxoplazma árnyalja a képet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Where there are more cats, there is higher well-being — but Toxoplasma casts a shadow over the picture.
article.articleSummary: On Oct 2, 2026, a study by a Mexican team analyzed data from 93 countries to examine links between cat ownership, Toxoplasma gondii, and national well-being. They found a positive association between domestic cat density per 10,000 people and well-being; Finland, Denmark, and Sweden had both high cat density (about 1,700–2,000 cats per 10,000 people) and high well-being. By contrast, prevalence of Toxoplasma gondii tended to align with lower well-being, especially in Lebanon, Yemen, Gabon, and Ethiopia. Saudi Arabia and Brazil were exceptions: high toxoplasma prevalence but relatively favorable well-being. The researchers stress the findings are correlational, not causal, and confounding factors such as income and healthcare could influence both pet ownership and well-being. Notably, more cats did not correspond to higher toxoplasma rates, underscoring a complex relationship among animals, pathogens, and society.

triage.headline_ja: 猫が多い国ほど幸福度が高い――しかしトキソプラズマがその構図に影を落とす
triage.triage_reason: これは感染症アウトブレイクではなく、猫の飼育密度・トキソプラズマ感染率・国民幸福度の相関関係を調べた学術研究記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は93カ国のデータを用いた相関研究の紹介であり、具体的な発生事例や公衆衛生上の対応を要する事象ではない。ブラジルは例外事例として言及されているが、トキソプラズマ症のアウトブレイクではなく統計的分析対象の一国に過ぎないため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolaudbrud i DR Congo har kostet over 4.000 mennesker livet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed more than 4,000 people.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed more than 4,000 people, with the death toll rising to over 4,000 according to government figures reported on Friday. The update confirms the outbreak remains uncontained, underscoring its severity. Only one previous Ebola outbreak has killed more people than the ongoing DR Congo outbreak, placing this event among the deadliest on record. The article provides no further detail on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or whether cases have been imported or exported. Date: 2026-10-02.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の流行により4,000人以上が死亡

triage.notes: 記事は死者数のみの報告で、感染経路や封じ込め状況など詳細情報が不足しているため、フルRRAで最新の疫学データ確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết Dengue: Chuyên gia chỉ ra nhóm có nguy cơ chuyển nặng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever: Experts identify groups at risk of progression to severe disease.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, two dengue fever patients aged 16 and 21 were admitted in critical condition to Ho Chi Minh City’s Hospital for Tropical Diseases; one spent over a month on ECMO at nearly 1 billion VND, the other required 45 days of continuous renal replacement therapy. A separate 8 September death occurred in a 20-year-old with severe dengue. Dengue cases in the southern region account for about 73.1% of national infections. While anyone can progress to severe disease, the elderly, people with comorbidities, young children, pregnant women, and overweight/obese individuals are higher risk. Elderly may present with non-specific signs; infants under 1 year and overweight/obese children with comorbidities are especially vulnerable. Pregnancy can lead to maternal/fetal complications. Warning signs include agitation or drowsiness, severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding, reduced urination, and cold extremities; beta-blocker users may not have tachycardia. Prevention emphasizes three-layer protection: eliminate standing water, prevent mosquito bites, and use bed nets day and night; discuss vaccination with clinicians.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：専門家が重症化リスクのある集団を指摘
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はベトナムで毎年流行する風土病であり、本記事は重症化リスク因子や注意すべき症状に関する一般向け啓発情報であって、新規の異常な流行拡大を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は重症例の臨床像と予防策に関する啓発記事であり、新規アウトブレイクの検知情報ではない。デング熱はベトナム南部で季節性に流行しており、全国症例の73.1%を占めるという記述はあるが、これは例年の季節的傾向を示すものと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: 景興國小11生吃完午餐身體不適 蔣萬安：疑諾羅病毒或腸胃型感冒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jingxing Elementary School: 11 students fall ill after lunch; Chiang Wan-an says suspected norovirus or gastroenteritis.
article.articleSummary: Jingxing Elementary School in Taipei's Wenshan District reported after-lunch illness affecting 11 students, following a September 23 nutrition lunch that included calamari; initial reports also indicated 12 students with symptoms and several seeking medical care. Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an said authorities currently have 11 students with symptoms; doctors preliminarily suspect norovirus or a gastroenteritis-type illness, with some students experiencing only gastrointestinal discomfort. Health and education authorities immediately collected samples for laboratory testing. The incident is part of multiple recent lunch-time illness reports across districts (Chengyuan, Jinhua, Songshan) prompting parental concern. While investigations proceed and results await confirmation, the school continues to monitor pupils and provide support. In response to free-lunch policy logistics, next week's menu may feature steamed shrimp, but the school is ensuring allergy checks and substituting other protein if needed due to shrimp supply stability.

triage.headline_ja: 景興国小の11名の児童、昼食後に体調不良 蔣萬安市長「ノロウイルスまたは胃腸型感冒の疑い」

triage.notes: 本件は台湾（対象国リスト外）の学校給食に関連した集団食中毒疑い事例。中国（People's Republic of China）が発生地域に含まれているが、記事の主題は台湾台北市の事例であり、中国本土での発生は確認されないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: ΛΔ Κονγκό: Ξεπέρασαν τους 4.000 οι νεκροί από την επιδημία Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: The death toll from the Ebola epidemic has surpassed 4,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has claimed 4,018 lives and infected 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces, with over 2,000 recoveries. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain and is the largest and most deadly in DRC’s history, surpassing the 2018–2020 epidemic and ranking as the second-largest globally after the 2014–2016 West Africa crisis (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone). In September, the government and UN reported signs of containment in Ituri, where the outbreak began, but transmission continues rapidly in eastern DRC. South Ubangi Province, in the northwest, has become the seventh affected province after a man who traveled from eastern DRC died there.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ出血熱による死者数が4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行が進行中で、死者4,000人超・感染者8,300人超、7州に拡大しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: リベリア・ギニア・シエラレオネは2014-2016年の過去流行との比較のために言及されているのみで、現行イベントの発生地域ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 又有國小生吃營養午餐身體不適！蔣萬安：初判是諾羅或腸胃型感冒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another elementary school student falls ill after eating the school lunch! Chiang Wan-an: initial diagnosis is norovirus or gastroenteritis-type flu.
article.articleSummary: Taipei City, Taiwan — Eleven students at Jingxing Elementary School in Wenshan District fell ill after lunch on Sept 23. Doctors’ initial assessment suspects norovirus or gastroenteritis-type flu; the Taipei Health Bureau has collected samples for laboratory testing and awaits results. Since Sept 1, the city’s free school lunch program has been linked to several gastrointestinal illness events: 87 people affected at Chengyuan High School on Sept 8; 10 students at Da Fu High School on Sept 10; vomiting and GI symptoms at Jinhua Junior High; and vomiting/diarrhea at Minzu Elementary School on Sept 24 after squid-containing meals. On Sept 23, a different Wenshan elementary school lunch that included squid led to 12 students becoming ill. Authorities are monitoring, providing support, and awaiting test outcomes; no pathogen has been confirmed yet. The article notes a possible link to squid-containing meals, with investigations ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: またも国小生が給食を食べて体調不良！蔣萬安氏：初期診断はノロウイルスまたは胃腸型インフルエンザ
triage.triage_reason: 台北市の学校給食に関連した胃腸炎（ノロウイルス/インフルエンザ疑い）の集団発生であり、局所的な食品衛生事案として市当局が対応中。国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクは見られず、病原体も未確定。
triage.notes: 発生地域に『Taiwan』『China』が含まれるが、記事は台北市内の学校給食に関する国内事案であり、対象国リストの中国（中華人民共和国）とは無関係のため、verified_locationsは空とした。台湾は対象国リストに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Число жертв вспышки Эболы в ДР Конго возросло до 3982
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo has risen to 3,982.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola Virus Disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo reaches 8,224 confirmed cases and 3,982 deaths with 2,121 recoveries (CFR 48.4%). The outbreak spans 63 districts across seven provinces, with ongoing treatment, transmission prevention, and capacity-building for medical teams. Ebola virus, first identified in 1976 near the Ebola River, gave the disease its name. The text recalls the 2013–2017 West Africa epidemic in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone, which infected about 30,000 people and killed over 11,000. In eastern DR Congo’s Ituri Province, a May declaration followed 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths. For the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, there is currently no approved specific treatment or vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ流行による死者数が3,982人に増加
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴで致死率48.4%の大規模エボラ流行が63地区・7州に拡大しており、IHR基準の複数項目（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事中のギニア・リベリア・シエラレオネは2013-2017年西アフリカ流行の歴史的言及であり、現在の発生国ではないため除外。イトゥリ州のBundibugyoエボラウイルス亜型による別クラスターも言及されているが、主要事例はDRC国内の大規模流行。

article.articleHeadline: Balai Karantina Sumbar Suntik Vaksinasi Rabies Gratis untuk Ratusan Hewan di Padang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Sumatra Quarantine Office Administers Free Rabies Vaccinations for Hundreds of Animals in Padang
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination drive by West Sumatra's Animal, Fish, and Plant Quarantine Office in Padang, Indonesia, administering 235 free vaccine doses to animals across two sites in celebration of World Rabies Day and the quarantine office's 149th anniversary. Fifty doses were given at the main Quarantine Office location and 185 doses at Padang Selatan District Office on Oct 1, 2026. The effort, attended by Padang's Deputy Mayor, includes animal health checks, vaccination, animal-care education, and biosecurity measures to prevent disease spread and safeguard communities and the environment. RM Ende Dezeanto, head of the West Sumatra Quarantine Office, described the initiative as direct public service and a preventive measure against rabies. The program highlights ongoing preventive health outreach in Padang, West Sumatra.

triage.headline_ja: 西スマトラ検疫局、パダンで数百頭の動物に無料狂犬病ワクチン接種を実施
triage.triage_reason: 世界狂犬病デーに合わせた予防的ワクチン接種活動を報じる内容であり、実際の感染拡大や公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的なワクチン接種キャンペーンの告知であり、狂犬病症例の発生や流行を示す内容ではない。マレーシア（Negeri Sembilan）は記事主題に含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Tercatat 387.215 Kasus Influenza A di Banten dan Penyebaran Cepat, Dinkes Imbau Tak Perlu Panik
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 387,215 cases of Influenza A recorded in Banten and rapid spread; the Health Office urges not to panic.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, Banten Province, Indonesia reports 387,215 Influenza A cases, a surge driven by intensified screening and early detection across health facilities, including all Puskesmas, clinics, and private hospitals. Dinkes Banten head Ati Pramudji Hastuti urged the public not to panic, noting the rise reflects proactive surveillance rather than a public health emergency. Influenza A is described as a self-limiting illness that typically resolves with good immunity; antivirals are not routinely required. To curb transmission, authorities continue rapid-management education for detected patients and encourage those with respiratory symptoms to seek care promptly at nearby facilities. Public guidance highlights maintaining immunity through rest, adequate fluids, balanced nutrition, and regular handwashing, especially during the hot season. The report emphasizes early detection and prompt care to prevent wider spread.

triage.headline_ja: バンテン州でインフルエンザA 387,215例を記録、急速な感染拡大も保健局はパニック不要と呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 症例数は多いものの、当局はサーベイランス強化による検出増加であり自己限定性疾患で公衆衛生上の緊急事態ではないと明言しており、異常性・重篤性の根拠に乏しい。
triage.notes: 症例数（387,215）は大きいが、当局はサーベイランス強化による早期検出の結果と説明し、季節性・自己限定性のインフルエンザAであるとして公式にパニック不要と発表している。重症度・死亡例の情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de leptospirose atinge áreas alagadas da Tailândia e alerta russos em Rayong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak of leptospirosis hits flooded areas of Thailand and alerts Russians in Rayong
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis outbreak in flooded areas of Thailand, with Rayong city hardest hit. Russian volunteers and tourists in flooded Rayong are at heightened risk; first Russian volunteer groups left Pattaya for Rayong on 29 September, and hundreds of Russians may be in the disaster zone. The Thai Ministry of Public Health confirmed standing floodwaters are contaminated with Leptospira bacteria, enabling infection when contact occurs with mucous membranes or broken skin via soil or water. The illness, sometimes called rat fever, can affect the liver, kidneys, and nervous system. As of 2 October 2026, 46 deaths have been reported nationwide. High-risk activities include debris removal, cleaning, and walking through flooded streets without protection. Symptoms to seek care for: high fever, muscle pains, and jaundice. Travelers should avoid bathing in freshwater after rains, refrain from walking barefoot, and wear tall rubber boots when crossing flooded areas.

triage.headline_ja: タイの洪水地域でレプトスピラ症が流行、ラヨーンのロシア人に警告
triage.triage_reason: タイ国内で洪水関連のレプトスピラ症流行により46名の死亡が報告されており、重症度・継続曝露の観点で懸念があり、タイ保健省やメディアの関心も高いため。
triage.notes: 洪水によるレプトスピラ症の季節性アウトブレイクだが、死者46人という規模と、ロシア人ボランティア・観光客への影響が報じられている点で社会的関心が高い。ヒト-ヒト感染はないため国際的拡大リスクは低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Meningite, il rischio che non si vede. Il ruolo del medico e l'importanza della vaccinazione - Daily Health Industry
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningitis, the unseen risk. The physician's role and the importance of vaccination - Daily Health Industry
article.articleSummary: Invasive meningococcal disease (Neisseria meningitidis) can cause meningitis and sepsis with rapid progression and substantial mortality (10–15%), and about 20% of survivors sustain permanent sequelae such as hearing loss, neurological damage, amputations, or scarring. In Italy, serogroup B predominates across ages, with adolescents at high transmission risk; after a decline in 2020–2021, cases rose during 2022–2024. A global survey across Argentina, Australia, Brazil, France, Spain and Italy shows substantial knowledge among parents and youths but underestimation of risk: only 28% expect disease in the next year; 26% of youths know it can be fatal; 8% recognize it can threaten life within hours. Vaccine uncertainty is notable: 30% of Italian adolescents doubt their vaccination status, and 12% of parents are unsure if their child is vaccinated. Physicians play a crucial role; advocate for including adolescent meningococcal vaccination in the national calendar, as regional implementation varies.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎、見えないリスク。医師の役割とワクチン接種の重要性
triage.triage_reason: イタリアを中心とした髄膜炎菌感染症に関する啓発・ワクチン接種意識調査の記事であり、具体的な集団発生や急激な症例増加の報告ではなく、対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン等）にも該当しない。
triage.notes: 発生地域にBrazilが含まれるが、記事はイタリア・フランス・ブラジル・アルゼンチン・オーストラリア・スペインを対象とした意識調査であり、ブラジル固有の発生事例ではないため除外。対象国に該当する具体的発生国は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: حصيلة ضحايا فيروس إيبولا في الكونغو تتجاوز أربعة آلاف قتيل
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus death toll in Congo exceeds 4,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 deaths. The Congolese Ministry of Health reports 4,018 fatalities among 8,300 confirmed cases as of Oct 1, 2026, roughly half of confirmed cases in the fastest outbreak wave. The outbreak, declared May 15, is due to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no known treatment or vaccine to date. The World Health Organization has warned of rapid geographic spread into new health zones, straining already limited outbreak response resources. The report notes laboratory-confirmed cases and ongoing containment efforts, with authorities racing to curb transmission amid expanding reach of the virus within the country.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラウイルス死者数、4000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約48%の大規模エボラアウトブレイクで、ワクチン・治療法が確立していないブンディブギョ株による急速な地理的拡大が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療薬が存在しない稀少株（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）による大規模流行であり、WHOも地理的拡大と対応資源の逼迫を警告している。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Konsumsi Daging Kambing, 4 Warga Gunungkidul Positif Antraks
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Goat Meat Consumption: 4 Gunungkidul Residents Test Positive for Anthrax.
article.articleSummary: Anthrax outbreak in Gunungkidul, Indonesia: Four residents of Dusun Pelem, Semanu were PCR-confirmed positive for Bacillus anthracis after consuming goat meat from animals that died suddenly in early September 2026. The cluster followed the local practice of porak/mbrandu, where people buy dead livestock to alleviate owners' losses and share the carcass. Seven people are under investigation as suspects, and epidemiological tracing linked exposure to a goat that appeared weak before dying. In total, 47 individuals who had contact with the animals or their products were identified and given preventive treatment. All four confirmed patients are reportedly improving. Authorities continue two 60-day incubation-monitoring cycles, with no new cases to date. Ongoing risk communication advises against processing or consuming meat from sick or suddenly dead animals and to report such livestock promptly; cross-sector coordination remains active.

triage.headline_ja: ヤギ肉の摂取、グヌンキドゥル住民4人が炭疽陽性
triage.triage_reason: 炭疽菌感染が確認されたが、患者は回復傾向で死亡者なし、ヒト-ヒト感染もないため深刻度は限定的。ただし47名が曝露し監視が継続中であり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 炭疽は家畜由来の人獣共通感染症であり、地域の風習(porak/mbrandu)による感染拡大が原因。ヒト-ヒト感染はなく、患者は回復傾向。47名への予防的治療済み、60日間の潜伏期監視継続中で新規患者なし。

article.articleHeadline: حصيلة ضحايا فيروس إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية تتجاوز 4 آلاف قتيل
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceeds 4,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 4,000, with 4,018 fatalities among 8,300 confirmed cases, roughly half of the confirmed cases in the fastest surge to date. The Ministry of Health disclosed these figures, noting the outbreak began on 15 May and is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no known cure or licensed vaccine. The World Health Organization has warned of rapid geographic spread into new health zones, stretching already limited response resources. The Africa CDC, in a recent briefing, reported a decline in confirmed cases. Authorities continue to combat ongoing transmission across multiple districts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラウイルスによる死者数が4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が大規模流行し、死者4,000人超・症例8,300人に達し、複数地域へ急速に拡大しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOは新たな保健地域への急速な地理的拡大を警告している一方、Africa CDCは症例数の減少を報告しており、情報源間で状況評価に差異がある。ワクチン・治療薬が存在しない希少株（ブンディブギョ株）である点にも留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Lonjakan kasus ISPA di Jatim
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Surge in Acute Respiratory Infection cases in East Java.
article.articleSummary: Acute Respiratory Infection (ARI) activity in East Java, Indonesia, rose sharply in 2026, with the East Java health office reporting an average of about 147,000 ARI cases per month from January through September, and a peak of 211,000 cases in August. The report, dated October 2, 2026, references the Tulungagung area in East Java (illustration from Kauman Puskesmas). No details on laboratory confirmation, transmission source, or imported/exported cases are provided. The figures indicate a sustained surge in ARI, signaling heightened respiratory illness pressure through the first nine months of 2026, with August acting as the apex of the outbreak period. Ongoing public health monitoring is implied by the provincial health office's monthly aggregation.

triage.headline_ja: 東ジャワ州でのARI（急性呼吸器感染症）症例急増
triage.triage_reason: 東ジャワ州でARI症例数が急増しているが、病原体の特定・重症度・院内確認データが不明であり、フルリスク評価に進むには情報不足。
triage.notes: 記事は東ジャワ州保健局の月次集計データに基づくもので、病原体の種類、検査確認、重症度（入院・死亡）に関する情報が欠如している。継続的な動向監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 사망 4000명 넘어
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 4,000.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ebola death toll has surpassed 4,000. As of Sep 30, cumulative cases reached 8,300 with 4,018 deaths (case fatality rate 48.4%) and 2,162 recoveries, noting about 1,000 more deaths in roughly one month. In Bunia, outside the Elikya Ebola Treatment Center, healthcare workers protested over two months of unpaid salaries, highlighting outbreak response strain. The African CDC says recent case growth has slowed, but undercounting remains possible due to limited cooperation and security concerns. Médecins Sans Frontières cautions that the true scale could exceed official tallies amid public distrust of health authorities since the outbreak began. The DRC and Uganda declared Ebola on May 15, with ongoing cross-border concerns.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴのエボラ死者数、4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%の大規模エボラ流行が継続し、累計8,300例・死者4,000人超、医療従事者の未払い給与によるストライキや過少報告の懸念もあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として記載されているが、記事本文では『DRCとウガンダが5月15日にエボラを宣言』との記述のみで、主な流行状況はDRC（ブニア含む）に関するもの。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。医療従事者の給与未払いによる抗議や過少報告の懸念は対応能力・透明性への懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Эбола не отступает
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Does Not Retreat.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persists: 2,121 people have recovered and the case-fatality rate stands at 48.4%. Response covers 63 districts across seven provinces, focusing on treatment, transmission prevention, and strengthening medical teams. The Ebola virus, which causes hemorrhagic fever, was first identified in 1976 in Nzara, Sudan, and Yambuku, in what is now the DR Congo, with the name derived from the Ebola River near Yambuku. The 2013–2017 West Africa outbreak infected about 30,000 people and killed more than 11,000 across Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. Authorities declared a new outbreak in eastern Ituri province on May 15, with 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths reported. For the Bundibugyo variant, there is currently no approved specific treatment or vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: エボラは後退しない
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で致死率48.4%のエボラ出血熱が7州63地区に拡大しており、新変異株（ブンディブギョ株）には承認済みの治療法・ワクチンがなく、公衆衛生上重大かつ異常な事態と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事にはスーダン(Nzara)、シエラレオネ、リベリア、ギニアも言及されているが、これらは1976年の発見地や2013-2017年西アフリカ流行の歴史的文脈であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクはDRCのみ。ブンディブギョ変異株には有効なワクチン・治療法がなく、管理可能性の観点で外部支援が必要と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Mehr als 4000 Ebola-Tote im Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 4,000 Ebola deaths in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of government reports, the Democratic Republic of Congo has recorded more than 4,000 Ebola deaths and 8,300 confirmed infections across seven provinces, with over 2,000 recoveries. This marks the worst Ebola outbreak in DRC history and the second-worst globally, behind West Africa's 2014–2016 epidemic (more than 11,000 deaths and over 28,600 cases in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone). The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain. While transmission appears to slow in Ituri, where the outbreak originated, in the eastern provinces including Nord-Kivu the virus continues to spread rapidly. Authorities also noted a new outbreak in Sud-Ubangi in the northwest after a man arriving from the east died there. These figures and developments were reported on 2026-10-02 by the government and UN.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ死者4000人超
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪規模のエボラ流行で死者4000人超・感染者8300人超に達し、複数州で感染拡大が継続しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事に記載のシエラレオネ・アンゴラ・リベリア・ギニアは2014-2016年の西アフリカ流行との比較対象として言及されているのみで、現行イベントの発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外。現行の流行はDRC国内（イトゥリ州、北キヴ州、南ウバンギ州）に限定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolos protrūkis Konge jau pareikalavo daugiau kaip 4 tūkst. gyvybių
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo has already claimed more than 4,000 lives.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo is experiencing its worst Ebola outbreak on record. As of 2 October 2026, government data show more than 4,000 deaths and 8,300 confirmed infections across seven provinces, with over 2,000 recoveries. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo virus variant and has surpassed the 2018–2020 outbreak in the country. Globally, it ranks as the second-most deadly Ebola epidemic, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak which killed more than 11,000 and infected about 28,600 in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. Last month, authorities and the United Nations reported signs of slowing in parts of Ituri province where the outbreak began, but in the east, including North Kivu, transmission continues to rise. In the northwest, South Ubangi province recorded a new outbreak after a man from the eastern region died there.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、死者数すでに4000人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCで記録的規模のエボラ流行が継続し死者4000人超・感染8300人超、複数州に拡大しており国際的拡大リスクと重大な公衆衛生影響があるためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: リベリア・ギニア・シエラレオネは2014-2016年の過去流行との比較として言及されているのみで、現行イベントの発生国ではないため除外。
