article.articleHeadline: 今年流感夏天就開始民眾有感 彰化縣村里注射站大排長龍
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year's flu already started in the summer, and the public is feeling it, with long lines at Changhua County's village vaccination stations.
article.articleSummary: Influenza is circulating early this year in Taiwan, with sustained activity since July. In Changhua County, public flu vaccines started October 1; from October 2, vaccination centers, including village stations, began offering flu and COVID-19 vaccines to residents aged 65 and older. On opening day at a village station, long queues formed. Dr. Ma Ruishan, chief of pediatrics at Changhua Hospital, described common flu symptoms: high fever with chills, body aches, severe headache, fatigue, plus cough, sore throat, runny nose and sneezing; children may have vomiting and diarrhea. Surveillance shows influenza A, predominantly A(H1N1), accounting for about 87.7% of circulating strains, with an estimated 150,000 infections this week; last week, 30 severe influenza A deaths nationwide, mainly among seniors and those with chronic diseases. Transmission often starts from children to households. Regions like Japan, Korea, and Hong Kong are in flu season; travelers are advised to vaccinate two weeks before travel.

triage.headline_ja: 今年のインフルエンザは夏から流行開始、彰化県の村里予防接種会場に長蛇の列
triage.triage_reason: 台湾で季節性インフルエンザ（A型H1N1主体）が例年より早く夏から継続的に流行し、重症死亡者数（週30人）や推定感染者数（週15万人）が報告され、住民の関心（長蛇の列）と自治体の対応（ワクチン接種拡大）が確認されるため。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾（彰化県）の季節性インフルエンザ流行とワクチン接種状況が主題。日本・韓国・香港は『流行期にある』として簡潔に言及されるのみで主題ではないため、いずれも対象国リストに含まれる香港（中国）も含め verified_locations には含めない。台湾自体も対象国リストに該当しないため空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Mehr als 4.000 Ebola-Tote im Kongo - Chronik | stol.it
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 4,000 Ebola deaths in the Congo - Chronicle | stol.it.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus, has surpassed the 2018–2020 outbreak to become one of the deadliest. With more than 4,000 deaths reported, it stands behind the West Africa outbreak of 2014–2016, which killed over 11,000 and infected more than 28,600 in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. In Ituri Province, the outbreak’s origin area, transmission appears to be slowing, but in the eastern provinces, including North Kivu, the virus continues to spread rapidly. Authorities in South-Ubangi in the northwest also reported a new outbreak after a man arriving from the East died from the virus. The findings reflect ongoing transmission and cross-regional differences, with international bodies and national authorities monitoring imported cases and regional spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ死者4,000人超 - 年表 | stol.it
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが4,000人以上の死者を出し2018-2020年の流行を上回る規模となり、新州への拡大（South-Ubangi）も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ギニア・リベリア・シエラレオネは2014-2016年の過去アウトブレイクとの比較として言及されているのみで、現在の発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。South-Ubangi州での新規発生は東部からの輸入例とされ、国内拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Doação de sangue tem novas regras no Brasil; veja idade, prazos e teste para malária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Blood donation has new rules in Brazil; see age, timeframes, and malaria test.
article.articleSummary: Brazil implemented nationwide blood donation reforms under Portaria GM/MS 11.685/2026, taking effect Oct 30, 2026. Regular donors with a history of voluntary donation may continue past age 70 if healthy and medically cleared; first-time donors must be under 60 to later donate in the 60–69 bracket. Adolescents 16+ may apply with a guardian’s authorization. Deferral periods for tattoos, permanent makeup, certain cosmetic procedures, and piercings are adjusted: seven days if sanitary conditions can be verified, otherwise four months; mouth or genital piercings require four months after removal. Endoscopy and non-prescription anabolic steroids deferrals reduce from six to four months. Malaria testing becomes mandatory in all screening; the NAT Plus assay now detects malaria in addition to HIV and hepatitis B/C, shortening malaria-exposure deferral to 30 days. Blood bag and sample labeling adopt ISBT 128 to improve traceability. Platelet concentrates may be stored up to seven days.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで献血に新規則、年齢・待機期間・マラリア検査について
triage.triage_reason: 感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、献血制度の行政的な規則改正に関する記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は献血制度に関する規則改正（マラリア検査義務化、保存期間変更等）を報じたものであり、実際の感染症流行事例ではない。マラリア・HIV・B型肝炎は検査項目として言及されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: PH recognizes Hungary bird flu zoning, keeps poultry trade
article.articleSummary: PH grants Hungary bilateral recognition of its HPAI status, ensuring continued poultry trade as of 2026-10-02. The Department of Agriculture formalized removal of countrywide import restrictions on domestic and wild birds and their products (Department Circular No. 52). Hungary will export only from regions free of high-path avian influenza, under regionalization terms (Administrative Circular No. 09) and current DA regulations. Exporters can secure bilateral recognition to protect food security amid rising poultry demand. The circular notes that whole-country bans limit sources of day-old chicks, parent stocks, and poultry meat, driving up prices. Hungary's application for regionalization was reviewed by the Bureau of Animal Industry, which concluded the country maintains sufficient veterinary oversight and control measures against HPAI. This recognition lowers import risk from designated zones. Hungary exported 5,000 kilograms of meat to the Philippines from January to August, per BAI data; in 2025, shipments reached 67,574 kg.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピン、ハンガリーの鳥インフルエンザ・ゾーニングを承認し家禽貿易を継続
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は動物衛生に関する貿易規制の行政措置（ゾーニング承認）を報じるものであり、ヒトへの感染や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はハンガリーの家禽（動物）における鳥インフルエンザ発生地域の区分（ゾーニング）をフィリピン当局が承認し、貿易制限を緩和したという行政・貿易関連の内容。ヒト感染事例や公衆衛生上のリスクは言及されていない。発生地域にPhilippinesが含まれるが、フィリピンは輸入国側であり疾病発生国ではないため、対象国リストとの整合性から verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Meningite, sondaggio: "La conosce l'85% dei genitori, ma solo il 28% ne percepisce il rischio"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningitis, survey: "85% of parents know it, but only 28% perceive its risk."
article.articleSummary: Global survey across six countries (Argentina, Australia, Brazil, France, Spain, Italy) shows Italy lags in risk perception for meningitis despite high knowledge. In Italy, 85% of parents and 68% of adolescents know the disease, but only 28% of parents—and a similar share of youths—expect a young person to develop it in the coming year. Italian risk perception remains lower than in other nations. Among adolescents, only about a quarter understand meningococcal disease can be fatal, and only a small minority recognizes that it can progress within hours. Vaccination awareness is uneven: about 30% of Italian adolescents doubt they were vaccinated; 12% of parents are unsure if their child is vaccinated. More than half actively seek vaccine information, yet a majority distrust online sources, and misinformation reduces vaccine trust. Experts urge physicians, schools, and digital channels to offer clear, evidence-based messaging and to consider adding adolescent meningitis vaccination to the national calendar. Invasive meningococcal disease caused by Neisseria meningitidis can cause meningitis and sepsis, with mortality 10–15% and up to 40% in sepsis; about 20% of survivors have permanent sequelae. Early diagnosis is crucial; initial symptoms are non-specific.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎に関する調査:「親の85%は知っているが、リスクを認識しているのはわずか28%」
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生ではなく、髄膜炎に対する認識度調査に関する記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態は見られない。
triage.notes: 本記事は疫学的アウトブレイク情報ではなく、6か国（アルゼンチン、オーストラリア、ブラジル、フランス、スペイン、イタリア）における髄膜炎リスク認識に関する世論調査の結果報告。対象国リストに該当する国（ブラジル）も記事の主題は発生事例ではなく調査結果であるため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll in DR Congo tops 4,000
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 4,000 deaths. As of October 2, 2026, 4,018 deaths have been reported among 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces, with 2,162 recoveries and a case fatality rate of 48.4%. The outbreak is the largest and deadliest on record in the DRC and the second-largest globally after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. Médecins Sans Frontières warns the true toll is likely higher due to gaps in surveillance and case detection. Africa CDC cautions that a recent decline in reported cases may reflect surveillance disruptions rather than reduced transmission, noting spread from three health zones in mid-May to 63 health zones across seven provinces, with 45 zones still reporting active transmission. Insecurity and community resistance impede surveillance and response, raising concerns about undetected infections.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでのエボラ死者数が4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおける過去最大規模のエボラ流行で、致死率約48%、7州63保健地域に拡大しサーベイランス不全や治安悪化が懸念されるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行で、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行に次ぐ世界第2位の規模。治安不安とコミュニティの抵抗によりサーベイランスが阻害され、実際の被害はさらに大きい可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Cifra de muertos por ébola en RDC sobrepasa los cuatro mil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll from Ebola in the DRC exceeds four thousand.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ebola outbreak has surpassed 4,000 fatalities, with 4,018 deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces, yielding a case-fatality rate of 48.4%. As of Sept 29, 851 patients remained in isolation or hospitalized, and 2,121 had recovered. Data from the National Public Health Institute (INSP) accompany ongoing government briefings led by Health Minister Roger Kamba in Kinshasa to review the epidemic trajectory, field actions, and response questions. Religious leaders at the Caritas reception center emphasized reinforcing prevention messaging and community engagement to bolster protective measures. Declared May 15, this is the deadliest Ebola epidemic in the DRC to date and currently the second-deadliest globally among Ebola outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数が4000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ流行が8,300症例・4,018死亡（致死率48.4%）に達し、7州に拡大する過去最悪規模の流行であり、国際的拡大・公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確なため。
triage.notes: DRC史上最悪のエボラ流行であり、世界的にも2番目に死者数の多い流行とされる。継続的なモニタリングとフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll in Congo tops 4,000 in fastest-growing outbreak of the disease on record
article.articleSummary: In the DRC's northeastern Ituri province, the Bunia-centered Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak is the fastest-growing on record. As of Oct 2, 2026, 4,018 deaths and 8,300 confirmed cases have been reported, with over 2,000 recoveries. The May 15 outbreak has no approved treatment or vaccine. Frontline workers have staged wage protests, hindering containment; more than 50 health workers have died. An MSF aid worker infected with Ebola was repatriated to the Netherlands for care at Leiden University Medical Center. WHO warns of rapid spread to new health zones; Africa CDC notes falling confirmed cases, hindered by insecurity and community resistance. A Butembo official in North Kivu was killed amid tensions over outbreak measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数が4,000人を突破、史上最速の拡大を見せる流行
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模エボラ流行（死者4,018人、症例8,300件）が承認済み治療・ワクチンなしで急速拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: MSF職員がオランダへ搬送され治療を受けているが、これは医療搬送であり現地流行ではないためオランダは対象国リストにも含まれず除外。北キブ州での治安悪化・保健従事者殺害など、対応困難性を示す情報あり。

article.articleHeadline: Physical Relations With Female Tenant, 2 Cousins Die After Testing HIV Positive in Bijnor; Panic Grips Area: What Happened?
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, two cousins in Bijnor, Uttar Pradesh, tested HIV-positive and subsequently died — the elder after failing to breathe on oxygen; the younger on Wednesday night. They had been ill for some time and were treated locally before hospitalization in Bijnor, Rishikesh, and Dehradun, where HIV infection was laboratory-confirmed. A local woman who had lived in the area is mentioned as a possible contact, but officials have not confirmed any transmission link. Relatives say the elder spoke of contact with the woman and that his cousin visited her rented room; the woman’s identity and HIV status remain undisclosed. Health authorities stress that two infections do not prove a transmission chain and that medical records and investigations are required. Further findings are awaited.

triage.headline_ja: 女性入居者との性的関係、ビジュノールでHIV陽性と判明したいとこ2人が死亡…地域に恐怖広がる
triage.triage_reason: 個別の2症例（いとこ同士）のHIV感染・死亡事例であり、感染経路も未確認で、公衆衛生上の異常な集団発生やアウトブレイクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 地元住民の間で不安が広がっているという報道だが、感染経路は未確認であり、公的機関も伝播の確証を示していない。HIVは既知の性感染症であり、本事例は散発的な個別症例と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو.. إيتوري تحت مقصلة إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo... Ituri under the Ebola scalpel.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is ongoing in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 8,224 confirmed infections, 4,018 deaths and 2,121 recoveries across 63 health zones in seven provinces. The crude case fatality rate stands at about 48.4% among registered cases. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or targeted treatment. Health teams confront logistical and organizational challenges as they intensify response efforts. Current measures emphasize strict isolation of cases, meticulous contact tracing, and risk communication campaigns to reduce transmission and prevent further spread. Since May, authorities have reported the outbreak and are continuing containment efforts in the affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ…イトゥリ州、エボラの刃の下に
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州で致死率約48.4%、感染者8,224人・死者4,018人に達する大規模エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続しており、ワクチン・治療薬が存在しない異常事態であるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 7州63健康区域に拡大、承認済みワクチン・標的治療薬なし。5月以降継続中の長期流行であり、国際的な支援と監視強化が必要と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de Ebola no Congo já causou mais de 4.000 mortes, segundo dados do governo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has already caused more than 4,000 deaths, according to government data.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused 4,018 deaths and 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces as of 2 October 2026. It is the country’s worst outbreak and the second deadliest globally after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone), which together logged more than 28,600 cases and 11,000 deaths. Over 2,000 patients have recovered. Transmission began in Ituri, with signs of slowing there, but the virus persists in eastern DRC, including North Kivu. South Ubangi Province declared a seventh outbreak last month after a person who had traveled from the east died from Ebola. Government and UN reports indicate ongoing transmission and expansion within the country.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱流行、政府データによると死者数は既に4000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最悪規模（8,300症例、4,018死亡）のエボラ流行が7州に拡大中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAに進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの流行を主題としており、リベリア・ギニア・シエラレオネは2014-2016年の過去の流行との比較として言及されているのみで現在の発生国ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola u DR Kongu odnijela više od četiri tisuće života
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo has claimed more than four thousand lives.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) driven by the Bundibugyo strain has reached 4,018 deaths and 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces, with more than 2,000 recoveries. The deadly outbreak, the worst in DRC history, surpasses the 2018–2020 epidemic and ranks as the second-largest globally after the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone), which had over 28,600 cases and more than 11,000 deaths. The outbreak began in Ituri, where transmission has slowed in some areas, but the virus continues to spread in the east, including North Kivu. Last month, South Ubangi became the seventh province affected after a man died who had arrived from the eastern part of the country.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ出血熱、死者4000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が7州に拡大し死者4000人超・症例8300例に達しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスクの観点からIHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にLiberia, Guinea, Sierra Leoneが含まれるが、これらは2014-2016年の過去の流行との比較として言及されているのみで、現行イベントの発生国ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Броят на жертвите на епидемията от ебола в ДР Конго надхвърли 4000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from the Ebola epidemic in DR Congo has surpassed 4,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has claimed 4,018 lives among 8,300 confirmed cases, making this the fastest-spreading outbreak and the 17th Ebola event in the country. The Bundibugyo virus, which has no approved treatment or vaccine, began May 15 in Bunia, Ituri province, with the northeast Ituri region bearing the epicenter. Frontline health workers have protested overdue pay, hindering response; more than 50 health workers have died from infection. MSF reports a staff member contracted Ebola while working in the country and was evacuated to the Netherlands for treatment at Leiden University Medical Center. WHO warns the outbreak is spreading to new areas, straining limited resources, while Africa CDC notes a decline in reported cases, possibly due to reporting gaps and community engagement challenges. Distrust toward health workers and authorities, including a deadly attack on a politician in Butembo, North Kivu, further complicates containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行による死者数が4000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ流行が8300例・4018死亡と大規模化し、新規地域への拡大、ワクチン未承認（Bundibugyoウイルス）、医療従事者の感染死、国際的な患者搬送（MSFスタッフのオランダ移送）など複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: オランダ(Leiden)への患者搬送は治療目的の医療避難であり、現地発生国はDRCのみ。承認されたワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyo種であること、医療従事者の未払い賃金による抗議やコミュニティの不信感が対応を阻害している点は重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Crni rekord u Kongu: Od ebole umrlo više od 4000 ljudi, ima i oporavljenih
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Grim record in Congo: More than 4,000 people have died from Ebola, and there have been recoveries.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 4,018 Ebola deaths and 8,300 confirmed cases from the Bundibugyo strain, with more than 2,000 recoveries across seven provinces. This outbreak is the largest and deadliest in the DRC’s history, surpassing the 2018–2020 epidemic. Globally, it ranks as the second-largest by deaths after the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone), which saw over 28,600 infections and more than 11,000 deaths. The outbreak began in Ituri province; authorities report signs of slowing in parts of Ituri, but transmission remains rapid in the east, including North Kivu. Southern Ubangi became the seventh province to declare an outbreak last month after a man died who had traveled from the eastern part of the country. The government and UN continue coordinated response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの暗い記録：エボラで4000人以上が死亡、回復者も
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行が継続しており、死者数が4000人を超え7州に拡大、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: リベリア・ギニア・シエラレオネは2014-2016年流行との比較のために言及されているのみで、現行の発生国ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: In Leiden vecht een ebolapatiënt voor zijn leven. Dit is wat we weten
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Leiden, an Ebola patient is fighting for his life. This is what we know.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, a man working for Doctors Without Borders arrived at Leiden University Medical Center in the Netherlands with Ebola, contracted in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. A confirmatory test on Thursday night established infection with the Bundibugyo variant, which carries about a 40% case fatality rate. The hospital has not publicly disclosed the patient’s exact illness stage. He is treated in a high-level isolation unit on a dedicated ward, with an airlock and negative-pressure measures, and all waste streams kept separate; care is provided by a specialized team. If the patient dies, officials say the outcome will be announced relatively quickly, following European arrangements for repatriation of sick aid workers to facilities in the Netherlands. The Netherlands has prior experience with isolated cases of dangerous pathogens, and supportive care focuses on fluids and electrolytes to prevent dehydration, a common Ebola symptom.

triage.headline_ja: ライデンでエボラ患者が生死をさまよう。わかっていることとは
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で感染したエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株、致死率約40%）患者がオランダへ搬送され治療中であり、重篤性・異常性・国際的な患者移動という複数のIHR基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 患者はコンゴ民主共和国で感染し、オランダ・ライデンの大学病院で高度隔離治療を受けている。発生地域としてNetherlandsが挙げられているが対象国リストに含まれず、感染源国であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに計上した。DRCにおける根底のエボラ流行状況については記事内で詳細不明。

article.articleHeadline: Francia con intención de apoyar investigación sobre ébola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: France intends to support Ebola research in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: France's Minister for Europe and Foreign Affairs, Jean-Noël Barrot, arrives in the Democratic Republic of Congo on Oct 2, 2026, for a diplomatic, humanitarian, and health-focused visit. He will travel to Bunia in Ituri Province, epicenter of the current Ebola outbreak, to reinforce France's support for frontline teams and Ebola research, including vaccine development, and to bolster aid from humanitarian organizations and UN agencies operating in affected zones. French Foreign Ministry spokesperson Pascal Confavreux said the trip will underscore France's commitment to the response and that Barrot would be the first European prime minister to visit the region since the outbreak began. The visit precedes the National Humanitarian Conference in Paris on Oct 6, expected to draw more than 300 humanitarian actors, donors, researchers, and civil-society representatives.

triage.headline_ja: フランス、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ研究支援を表明
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国における進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する国際的な外交・支援活動であり、既存の深刻な公衆衛生事案として注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はフランス外相のDRC訪問に関する外交ニュースだが、背景として進行中のエボラアウトブレイク（イトゥリ州ブニア）の存在が確認される。フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Lito Sousa: o que são os príons, que causaram a doença que levou à morte do influenciador
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lito Sousa: What prions are, which caused the disease that led to the influencer's death.
article.articleSummary: Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease (CJD) is a prion disease causing progressive mental deterioration. Brazilian pilot and influencer Lito Sousa was diagnosed, highlighting prions’ role in neural decline. Normal prion protein supports neuron protection, memory, oxidative-stress defense, myelin maintenance, and immune regulation; when misfolded into an infectious form, prions aggregate, injure neurons, and create holes in brain tissue, a spongiform encephalopathy. CJD presents in iatrogenic and hereditary forms. Iatrogenic CJD arises from exposure to abnormal prions during medical procedures, including non-sterile deep brain electrodes, corneal transplants, human growth hormone and pituitary-derived gonadotropins from cadavers, liver transplants, neurosurgery, dura mater grafts, blood transfusions, and surgical instruments. Hereditary CJD is autosomal dominant via PRNP gene mutations, with about a 50% transmission risk to each child. The report centers on Sousa’s case within Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: リト・ソウザ：インフルエンサーを死に至らしめた病気の原因となったプリオンとは何か
triage.triage_reason: 単一個人のCJD症例に関する解説記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や感染拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりは確認されない。
triage.notes: CJDは伝染性疾患ではなく、個人の医学解説記事。公衆衛生イベントとしての緊急性なし。

article.articleHeadline: Bereits mehr als 4000 Ebola-Tote im Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Already more than 4,000 Ebola deaths in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-02, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused more than 4,000 deaths, with over 2,000 patients recovered. This is the worst outbreak in the country's history and the second-worst Ebola epidemic ever recorded worldwide. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, and it surpasses the 2018–2020 outbreak in the DRC. Globally, only the West Africa outbreak of 2014–2016 was deadlier, with more than 11,000 deaths and over 28,600 infections reported in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで既にエボラ死者4000人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおける過去最悪規模のエボラ流行で死者4000人超、国際的拡大・公衆衛生への深刻な影響のリスクがあり、IHR基準複数該当のためフルRRAへ。
triage.notes: リベリア・ギニア・シエラレオネは2014-2016年の過去の流行事例として言及されているのみで、現行イベントの発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil confirma 547 casos de doença de Creutzfeldt-Jakob em 17 anos, aponta levantamento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil confirms 547 cases of Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease in 17 years, according to a survey.
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports 547 confirmed Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease cases from 2005–2021, out of 1,576 suspected notifications; only about a third confirmed. None linked to the bovine variant (variant CJD). Influencer Lito Sousa, 59, died recently; diagnosis announced by his wife on Aug 21. CJD is rare, progressive, incurable; about 90% die within six months to a year after onset, average survival around five months. Geographically, São Paulo leads with 202 cases (37%), followed by Minas Gerais (57), Paraná (44), Rio de Janeiro (38), Rio Grande do Sul (35); these five states account for 376 cases (69%). Most cases are in adults 55–74 (60.2%), with mean age 66; the common form is sporadic, typically 60–80 years old. The report notes 290 deaths among notifications; rapid progression. Suspected rise may reflect enhanced surveillance; RT-QuIC CSF test shows high specificity.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、17年間でクロイツフェルト・ヤコブ病547例を確認、調査で判明
triage.triage_reason: 2005〜2021年の累積統計を報告する過去の疫学調査記事であり、散発性プリオン病（非感染性・人対人伝播なし）について述べている。急性のアウトブレイクや新規公衆衛生上の脅威ではない。
triage.notes: Bluedotの疾患タグ'Classical Swine Fever'は誤りで、記事内容はヒトのクロイツフェルト・ヤコブ病（CJD）に関する過去17年間の統計報告。変異型CJD（ウシ由来）との関連は確認されておらず、孤発性プリオン病として説明されている。感染症のアウトブレイクではないため、トリアージ上はDISMISS相当。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Gunungkidul sebut empat pasien positif antraks telah sembuh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Gunungkidul Health Office says four anthrax-positive patients have recovered.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, Gunungkidul Regency, Yogyakarta Special Region, reported four PCR-confirmed anthrax patients who have recovered after intensive treatment. The cases originated from seven suspects in Dusun Pelem, Kalurahan Semanu, who had contact with sick or dead livestock. PCR testing confirmed four positives; an epidemiologic investigation and treatment were provided, and there are currently no new cases, signaling completion of the outbreak there. Preventive measures included antibiotic prophylaxis for the surrounding population at risk: 54 people total, 47 at risk, monitored for 60 days (two incubation periods). The infections were linked to the community practice known as brandu, in which residents pool resources to buy and slaughter sick or dead animals to share meat. Contacts, consumption, and slaughtering of affected animals were traced. Authorities emphasize avoiding slaughter of such animals and burying them instead, with ongoing outreach to curb brandu.

triage.headline_ja: グヌンキドゥル保健局、炭疽陽性患者4人が回復したと発表
triage.triage_reason: 既知の地域流行パターン（brandu慣習による家畜由来感染）で、新規症例なく収束済み。公衆衛生上の深刻性・国際拡大リスクは低く、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: インドネシア・ジョグジャカルタ特別州グヌンキドゥル県での炭疽集団発生は患者4名全員回復し新規症例なしで終息。brandu（病死家畜の肉の共同購入・解体・分配）という既知の地域慣習が原因で、予防的抗生剤投与と60日間の経過観察が実施済み。地方レベルの局地的事例でヒト-ヒト感染なし。

article.articleHeadline: Инфекционист призвал россиян в Таиланде избегать сомнительных водоемов из-за лептоспироза
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An infectious-disease specialist urged Russians in Thailand to avoid dubious bodies of water due to leptospirosis.
article.articleSummary: Russian tourists in Thailand are advised to avoid bathing in dubious water bodies and drinking water from unverified sources due to leptospirosis risk. Leptospirosis is a bacterial disease transmitted from animals; most often contracted through water contaminated with animal excreta and also via drinking such water. The infection risk is higher during summer and autumn and more common in rural areas. Diagnostics and treatments exist, so no major obstacles in prevention and treatment. Thai authorities warned of leptospirosis risk during the rainy season and floods. From the start of 2026 through September 23, 2026, Thailand reported 3,303 leptospirosis cases and 46 deaths. Risk increases with contact with water, soil, or mud contaminated with infected animal excreta.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症専門医、タイのロシア人観光客にレプトスピラ症への注意を呼びかけ、怪しい水域を避けるよう勧告
triage.triage_reason: タイの雨季に毎年見られる季節性のレプトスピラ症に関する旅行者向け注意喚起記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はタイ国内の雨季における季節性レプトスピラ症流行についてロシア人観光客への注意喚起を目的としたもの。Russiaは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。症例数・死亡者数は一定規模だが、既知の季節性疾患であり新規性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 4018 وفاة بالإيبولا في الكونغو.. التفشي الأسرع على الإطلاق في البلاد | سبق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 4,018 deaths from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo... the fastest outbreak ever recorded in the country | Sabq
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,018 deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases, the fastest outbreak in the country. Initiated by Bundibugyo virus on May 15, the outbreak is spreading to new health zones, with over 2,000 recoveries and more than 50 healthcare workers dead. There is no approved treatment or vaccine. A Médecins Sans Frontières aid worker contracted the virus and was airlifted to the Netherlands, admitted to a high-security isolation unit at Leiden University Medical Center. Containment is hindered by unpaid-salary protests in Bunia, Ituri Province’s northeastern hotspot, where demonstrators called for action and data on cases. WHO warns of geographic expansion; Africa CDC notes declines in confirmed cases may reflect surveillance challenges amid insecurity. Security tensions include an attack on local official Mari-Celestin Karundwa in Botembo, North Kivu, who later died in hospital.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラによる死者4,018人…同国史上最速の流行拡大
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで史上最速ペースで拡大し、国際医療従事者の感染・国外搬送や治安悪化による対応阻害も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するため。
triage.notes: オランダ(Leiden)は感染者の治療搬送先であり発生地ではないため除外。対象国リストにない国への搬送事例として参考情報とする。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية الجائحة المقبلة لن تنتظر وتفشى إيبولا وهانتا يؤكد خطر الأوبئة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global health: The next pandemic won't wait; Ebola and Hantavirus outbreaks confirm the danger of epidemics.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, speaking to the Americas regional committee, said WHO remains under the 14th General Programme of Work committed to strengthening health systems, services, and protections. The organization maintains its largest field presence in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, supporting the government’s Ebola outbreak response in close coordination with Africa CDC to ensure a unified effort. Earlier this year, WHO played a pivotal role in containing a hantavirus outbreak aboard the cruise ship MS Hondius, working with multiple countries and partners under the International Health Regulations. The Director-General also thanked Argentina and Chile for backing epidemiological investigations and for donating reference materials to laboratories in 15 countries.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）：次のパンデミックは待ってくれない—エボラとハンタウイルスの流行が疫病の危険性を裏付ける
triage.triage_reason: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国(DRC)のエボラ出血熱対応に最大規模の現地展開を継続中であると明言しており、深刻な公衆衛生リスクと国際的拡大の懸念があるため、フルリスク評価に進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はWHO事務局長の全般的な声明であり、DRCのエボラ流行への継続対応とクルーズ船(MS Hondius)上でのハンタウイルス流行（既に制圧済み、国特定不可）に言及。チリ・アルゼンチンは疫学調査支援国として言及されるのみで発生国ではないため対象国リストに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: خطر الأوبئة يتزايد مع تفشي إيبولا وهانتا حسب الصحة العالمية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The threat of epidemics is increasing as Ebola and Hantavirus outbreaks rise, according to the World Health Organization.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease persists in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with WHO maintaining its largest on-ground presence to support the government in coordination with the African CDC. Separately, WHO helped contain a Hantavirus outbreak aboard the MS Hondius cruise ship earlier this year, in collaboration with multiple countries under the International Health Regulations. Argentina and Chile are thanked for aiding epidemiologic investigations and supplying laboratory reference materials to 15 countries. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus emphasizes that Ebola and Hantavirus demonstrate the persistent global risk of epidemics and pandemics regardless of income level. He underscored the urgency of completing negotiations on the Pathogen Access and Benefit-Sharing Annex (PABS) to open the Pandemic Instrument for signature and entry into force, and outlined five requests to member states, including approving an upcoming increase in assessed contributions at the World Health Assembly to strengthen WHO's resilience and independence.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関によると、エボラとハンタウイルスの流行拡大により、感染症の脅威が高まっている
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の継続的な流行にWHOが最大規模の現地対応を維持しており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるため、フルリスク評価に進めるべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: ハンタウイルスのアウトブレイクはクルーズ船（MS Hondius）上で発生したものであり、特定の対象国での発生ではないため地域検証から除外。ChileとArgentinaは疫学調査支援・検査材料提供国として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: حصيلة ضحايا فيروس إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية تتجاوز 4 آلاف قتيل
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceeds 4,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000, with 4,018 deaths reported among 8,300 confirmed infections, according to the Ministry of Health. The figures, updated yesterday, reflect nearly half of confirmed cases in what officials call the fastest outbreak wave on record. The DRC outbreak began on May 15 and is driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, for which there is no known approved treatment or vaccine. The data underscore ongoing transmission and the public health challenge of containment, signaling continued need for surveillance, containment measures, and supportive therapies as authorities monitor the evolving epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱による死者数が4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で致死率約48%、4,018人死亡・8,300人感染という深刻な規模のエボラ流行が進行中であり、ワクチン・治療法未確立の稀少株（ブンディブギョ株）による『史上最速の流行波』とされ、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC保健省の最新統計に基づくもので、致死率が非常に高く、ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないブンディブギョ株による流行であることが強調されている。国際的拡大や渡航制限の有無については記載がなく『不明』とした。

article.articleHeadline: 本港新增一宗外地傳入基孔肯雅熱個案　患者潛伏期曾訪廣東省
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong reports one new imported dengue fever case; the patient had visited Guangdong Province during the incubation period.
article.articleSummary: One new imported dengue fever case reported in Hong Kong on 2 October 2026. The patient is a 62-year-old woman who had travelled to Guangdong Province during the incubation period; the Centre for Health Protection regards the infection as travel-associated and imported. She has been admitted to hospital in a no-mosquito environment and remains in stable condition. Two household contacts are under medical surveillance and are currently asymptomatic. The Centre will continue epidemiological investigations and has notified Guangdong Provincial health authorities. Through this year, Hong Kong has recorded four confirmed dengue fever cases: three imported and one locally transmitted.

triage.headline_ja: 香港で新たに国外から持ち込まれたチクングニア熱（記事本文はデング熱と記載）症例を1件報告　患者は潜伏期間中に広東省を訪問
triage.triage_reason: 単発の輸入症例で、患者は安定しており家庭内接触者も無症状。地域内での流行拡大の兆候はなく、定型的な監視対応で管理可能なため、フルリスク評価の必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 原文見出しは『基孔肯雅熱（チクングニア熱）』と記載されているが、記事サマリーおよびBluedot疾患分類では『デング熱』とされており、疾患名に不整合がある。続報で疾患の確定情報を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de Ebola no Congo já causou mais de 4.000 mortes, segundo dados do governo - Saúde e Bem-estar | Portal do Holanda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo has already caused more than 4,000 deaths, according to government data - Health and Well-being | Holland Portal.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues, with government data as of Oct 2, 2026 showing 4,018 deaths and 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces, and over 2,000 recoveries. It is the largest and deadliest outbreak in Congo’s history, surpassing the 2018–2020 epidemic and second only to West Africa’s 2014–2016 Ebola crisis that killed more than 11,000 in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. Transmission appeared to ease in Ituri last month, but the eastern provinces, including North Kivu, still see rapid spread. South Ubangi province declared a new outbreak last month after a man who traveled from the east died from the virus, marking the seventh province affected. The response involves ongoing government and UN coordination to contain and monitor transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、政府データによると既に4,000人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大規模のエボラアウトブレイクが進行中で、死者4,000人超・症例8,300件、7州に拡大しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが明確である。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ポルトガル語メディアによる報道だが、内容はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラ流行に特化している。シエラレオネ・アンゴラ・リベリア・ギニアは過去の2014-2016年流行との比較文脈で言及されているのみで、現行イベントの発生国ではないため除外。Ituriは発生地域リストにあるがDRC国内の州のため、国レベルでDRCとして集約。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll in DRC exceeds 4,000
article.articleSummary: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 4,000 in the current outbreak, with 4,018 laboratory-confirmed deaths and 8,300 total cases, for a case fatality rate of 48.4%. As of 2 October 2026, 842 patients with Ebola symptoms are hospitalized or in isolation, and contact tracing stands at 80.6%. Seven of DRC's 26 provinces have been affected. The outbreak began in the DRC and Uganda on May 15, marking the second-deadliest outbreak in Africa on record. Ugandan authorities declared the outbreak ended on July 28; the World Health Organization confirmed this on August 25. The DRC's current outbreak is the 17th recorded in the country since 1976, when the first human Ebola case was documented.

triage.headline_ja: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の死者数が4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが死者4,000人超・致死率48.4%に達し、アフリカ史上2番目に死者数の多いアウトブレイクとされる重大な公衆衛生事案であるため。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの関連アウトブレイクは2026年7月28日に終息宣言済み（WHOが8月25日に確認）であり、本記事の主題はDRCにおける継続中のアウトブレイクであるため、ウガンダは対象国リストにも含まれず verified_locations からも除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola treatment centre burned down as Congo death toll passes 4,000
article.articleSummary: DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, has 4,018 deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases—the fastest-growing outbreak in history. Declared May 15 in Ituri's Bunia, the crisis worsened after a transit/treatment centre at Kigonze was burned by soldiers, displacing about 19,000 people. Health workers protest unpaid wages and frontline surveillance teams have strikes, hindering containment. An MSF aid worker contracted Ebola and was flown to the Netherlands for isolation at Leiden; MSF notes more than 50 health workers have died. WHO warns of rapid spread into new health zones; Africa CDC reports falling new cases, yet insecurity and resistance persist. From mid-July to September, cases and deaths rose about 33%, with September averaging roughly 490 cases and 230 deaths per week. In Butembo (eastern North Kivu), local official Marie-Celestin Karondwa was attacked and died amid tensions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ治療センターが焼失、コンゴの死者数が4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速の拡大を見せるエボラ流行が続き、死者4,000人超・医療従事者の国際搬送（オランダ）も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: MSF職員が感染しオランダ（ライデン）に隔離搬送されたことで国際的拡大の実例が確認されている。治安悪化・医療従事者のストライキ等により封じ込めが困難化しており、WHOも新たな保健区域への急速な拡大を警告している。

article.articleHeadline: Europa registra un cuarto caso importado de ébola mientras el ECDC mantiene muy bajo el riesgo para la población general
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Europe reports a fourth imported case of Ebola while the ECDC maintains the risk to the general population very low.
article.articleSummary: Fourth imported Ebola case linked to the current outbreak; Bundibugyo virus. A healthcare worker from the Democratic Republic of the Congo was evacuated to the Netherlands on September 29 after testing positive, and is receiving specialized care. The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) maintains a very low risk of Ebola transmission to the general population in Europe; imported cases among healthcare workers and outbreak responders can occur due to occupational exposure, but do not change the overall risk assessment. Medical transports to Europe follow strict infection prevention and control measures, with very low transmission risk when implemented correctly. The ECDC provides tools and guidelines for case identification, isolation, laboratory diagnosis, and healthcare worker resources. In the DRC, the Ebola outbreak continues: as of September 29, 2026, 8,224 confirmed cases and 3,982 deaths; 851 in isolation; 2,121 recovered; 53 new cases and 28 deaths in the last 24 hours. 63 of 167 health zones are affected; contact tracing covers 78.7% of identified contacts.

triage.headline_ja: ECDCが一般市民へのリスクを非常に低いとする一方、欧州でエボラの輸入症例が4例目を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行（8,224症例、3,982死亡）が継続しており、医療従事者の症例が欧州（オランダ）へ輸入されるなど国際的拡大がみられるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: オランダは輸入症例の発生国だが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでの流行規模（63/167保健地区が影響、死亡率約48%）は極めて深刻であり、継続的な監視と支援が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Baden-Württemberg: Sindbis-Fieber in Deutschland - was man dazu wissen muss
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Baden-Württemberg: Sindbis Fever in Germany — What You Need to Know.
article.articleSummary: Germany reports its first locally acquired Sindbis virus (SINV) infection. A 60-year-old man from Baden-Württemberg fell ill on 12 July; SINV was confirmed in September after chikungunya testing due to exposure to Asian tiger mosquitoes (Aedes albopictus). SINV circulates mainly among birds and is transmitted by mosquitoes; there is no human-to-human transmission. Most infections are mild or asymptomatic; when symptomatic, fever, itchy rash, and joint pain occur, with arthritis persisting for months in some. Overall risk is low; no specific high-risk group is identified. No targeted therapy exists; treatment is supportive with analgesics and anti-inflammatory drugs. Prevention follows general mosquito protection. SINV is found across Eurasia and Africa; Europe has had detections in Finland and Sweden, with Germany previously reporting SINV in mosquitoes (Weinheim, 2009). Clinicians should consider SINV in patients with fever, rash, and arthralgia during mosquito season, even without travel, and test after negative dengue/chikungunya results.

triage.headline_ja: バーデン=ヴュルテンベルク州：ドイツで発生したジンビス熱 — 知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: ドイツ国内での単発の軽症例であり、ヒト-ヒト感染なし、対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン等）に該当する発生はないため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 疾患タグはChikungunya/Dengueとなっているが、実際はSindbis virus(SINV)の初発例。発生地域にThailand(Bangkok)が含まれるが、記事の主題はドイツ国内の症例でありタイでの発生ではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。対象国リストに該当する国なし。

article.articleHeadline: 亞運／跆拳道王薇嘉賽前感染諾羅奪銅牌　教練出奇招笑稱負面心法奏效
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Asian Games / Taekwondo: Wang Weijia Infected with Norovirus Before Competition, Wins Bronze; Coach Unveils Unconventional Tactic, Joking That the Negative-Mindset Approach Works
article.articleSummary: Wang Weijia of Taiwan won bronze in the women’s 67 kg taekwondo at the Nagoya, Aichi 2026 Asian Games after contracting Norovirus a week before departure, severely limiting training. Coach Su Tai-yuan reported rapid recovery with medical help from Dr. Lin Sheng-zhang, and he credits an unconventional “negative mindset” motivational tactic—telling her she would lose—to spur a comeback, praising her resolve as “over 100 points.” In the event, Wang defeated China’s Xing Jianni in the quarterfinals before losing 3–14, 5–7 to Iran’s Saghar Moradi in the semifinals, earning Taiwan’s first taekwondo medal of the Games. This marked Wang’s first Asian Games appearance, following prior world championships and Universiade disappointments, and she expressed satisfaction with her performance despite not reaching the gold-medal match.

triage.headline_ja: アジア大会／テコンドー・王薇嘉、大会前にノロウイルス感染も銅メダル獲得　コーチが奇策明かす「負の暗示が功を奏した」
triage.triage_reason: 個人アスリートの単発的なノロウイルス感染症例であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生や拡大リスクを示す情報がないため見送り。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾選手個人のノロウイルス感染とスポーツ競技結果に関するもので、公衆衛生イベントとしての意味合いはない。対象国での集団感染の記載もなし。

article.articleHeadline: Över 4 000 döda i ebolautbrottet i Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 4,000 dead in the Ebola outbreak in Congo.
article.articleSummary: An outbreak of the unusual Bundibugyo variant of Ebola in Congo has been widely known since mid-May, with over 8,000 confirmed cases and more than 4,000 deaths, making it the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. Frontline health workers in the epicenter have repeatedly gone on strike due to insufficient funding and resources needed to curb transmission. In September, healthcare personnel began vaccination against the outbreak, but the vaccine used was developed for a different Ebola variant, and its protective effect remains unclear. The rapid surge in cases, medical personnel shortages, and cross-variant vaccination efforts highlight ongoing public health challenges in Congo and potential implications for international response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱の流行で4,000人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴで異例のブンディブギョ株によるエボラ流行が8,000人超の感染・4,000人超の死亡に達し、史上最速の拡大ペースとされる。医療従事者のストライキやワクチンの株不一致など公衆衛生上の深刻な課題があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ワクチンが異なるエボラ株向けに開発されたものであり、交差防御効果が不明である点、及び医療従事者のストライキによる対応能力の低下が特に懸念される。史上最速の拡大ペースとされる規模の大きさから優先度は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola deja más de 4,000 muertos en El Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak leaves more than 4,000 dead in Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has resulted in 4,018 deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases, according to the latest update from the DRC’s National Institute of Public Health (INSP). Declared May 15 in the eastern DRC, the outbreak remains ongoing. The toll surpasses 4,000 fatalities, reflecting sustained transmission over several months. Laboratory-confirmed cases are included in the INSP figures. The report underscores the continuing public health burden in the region and the need for ongoing surveillance, clinical management, vaccination campaigns where available, and community engagement to curb transmission. Data are current as of Oct 2, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱の流行、死者4,000人超
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRC東部で継続的にヒト-ヒト感染を起こし、8,300症例・4,018人死亡という深刻な被害を出しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日に宣言されたDRC東部のエボラ流行は継続中で、致死率約48%と高い。国際的な支援とサーベイランス継続が必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Жертвите от ебола в ДР Конго вече са над 4000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola victims in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are now over 4,000.
article.articleSummary: Dr Congo Ebola outbreak has produced 4,018 deaths from 8,300 confirmed cases, as of 02 Oct 2026. The Bundibugyo strain, with no approved treatment or vaccine, sparked the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC after it was declared on 15 May. WHO warns of rapid geographic spread into new health zones, straining already limited resources. Africa CDC reports a decline in confirmed cases, but says reductions may reflect insecurity and access challenges rather than true transmission abatement. Tensions over control measures rose after a Congolese politician, Marie-Celestin Karondva of the Union for Democracy and Social Progress, was attacked and died; his house in Butembo, North Kivu, was burned. Widespread distrust of health workers and authorities hinders containment, with some residents denying Ebola's existence and opposing interventions, amid long-standing corruption concerns.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者による死者数が4000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 死者4,018人・感染者8,300人に達し、WHOが新たな保健区域への急速な地理的拡大を警告するなど、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するためフルRRAに進めるべき事案。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株による第17次DRCエボラ流行。承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在せず、治安不安や住民の不信感・医療従事者への攻撃が封じ込めを妨げている。Africa CDCは症例減少を報告しているが、真の収束ではなくアクセス制限による過小報告の可能性を指摘。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع وفيات إيبولا في الكونغو إلى أكثر من 4000 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola deaths in Congo rise to more than 4,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused 4,018 deaths from 8,300 confirmed cases, per the Congolese Ministry of Health. The outbreak, declared May 15, is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which no approved treatment or vaccine exists. The World Health Organization warns of rapid geographic spread to new health zones, straining already limited response resources. Africa CDC’s latest briefing indicates confirmed cases are declining, but insecurity and gaps in community cooperation hinder containment efforts. This is the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in the DRC. Distrust toward health workers and authorities has impeded containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおけるエボラ死者数が4000例超に増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の大規模流行（8,300例確認、死亡4,018例）が継続中で、新規健康地域への拡大、治療・ワクチン未承認、治安不安による対応困難等、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 致死率約48%と高く、WHOは新規地域への拡大を警告。治安不安と住民の不信感が封じ込めを阻害しているため、国際支援の必要性が高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo registra três novos casos de sarampo; total chega a 40 este ano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo reports three new measles cases; total reaches 40 this year.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, São Paulo state has 40 confirmed measles cases in 2026, with 36 in the capital, plus 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, 1 in Guarulhos, and 1 in Santo André. Three new cases in São Paulo city involve two men (ages 18 and 21) and a 1-year-old girl, linked to transmission chains identified since June. Despite the rising total, health authorities report a trend toward reduced transmission. Of the 40 patients, 30 had no vaccination or incomplete schedules; the 21-year-old and the infant had one vaccine dose, while the 18-year-old was unvaccinated. Key symptoms include high fever, red rash, dry cough, runny nose, eye irritation, and oral white spots. Vaccination—free via SUS—follows a 12-month/15-month schedule; adults 30–59 should have at least one dose. Coverage rose to 93.24% by July 2026, short of the 95% target.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で麻疹の新規3例を確認、今年の累計は40例に
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州での麻疹累計40例、未接種者が多く伝播が継続しているが、当局は減少傾向と報告しており重症例の報告もないため、現時点ではフルRRAに進む緊急性は低いが推移注視が必要。
triage.notes: 麻疹はブラジルで周期的に発生しており、今回のアウトブレイクは2026年6月以降の伝播連鎖が続いているもの。ワクチン未接種者（40例中30例）が多く、接種率も95%目標未達（93.24%）のため今後の推移を注視する必要がある。重症例や死亡の報告はなく、当局は減少傾向と評価している。

article.articleHeadline: Ξεπέρασαν τις 4.000 οι νεκροί στη ΛΔ Κονγκό από την επιδημία Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll in the DRC from the Ebola outbreak surpassed 4,000.
article.articleSummary: Official government data released today confirm that the Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 4,000, marking the worst outbreak ever recorded in the country. The figure illustrates a sustained and deadly trajectory of the epidemic, with health authorities appearing unable to limit the virus's spread. The update emphasizes the gravity of the situation within the DRC and underscores ongoing public health challenges in controlling transmission across affected areas. As of the 2026-10-02 release, the country faces a severe Ebola outbreak, with mortality continuing and containment efforts evidently struggling to stem transmission in affected regions today.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行による死者数が4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最悪規模のエボラ流行が継続し、死者数が4,000人を超え、当局の封じ込めが失敗している深刻な公衆衛生上の緊急事態であり、国際的拡大リスクも懸念される。
triage.notes: 過去最悪のエボラ流行として報告されており、フルリスク評価が必要。続報で国際的な感染拡大や渡航制限の有無を確認すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемијата на ебола во Конго веќе одзеде над 4.000 животи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in Congo has already claimed over 4,000 lives.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus drives a Democratic Republic of Congo Ebola outbreak with 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths across seven provinces, and over 2,000 recoveries. The crisis is the largest and deadliest in Congo’s history, surpassing the 2018–2020 epidemic, and the second-largest globally after West Africa’s 2014–2016 outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) which had over 28,600 infections and more than 11,000 deaths. Transmission shows signs of slowing in Ituri, but the eastern region remains highly active, including North Kivu. Last month, the northwestern South Ubangi province declared an outbreak after a man who traveled from the eastern part of the country died from the virus. As of 2 October 2026, government data indicate ongoing spread across multiple regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、既に4,000人以上の死者
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大規模のエボラ流行が継続しており、死者4,018人・確認症例8,300例、複数州への拡大、南ウバンギ州での新規発生報告もあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: 発生地域にシエラレオネ、アンゴラ、リベリア、ギニアが含まれているが、これらは過去の2014-2016年西アフリカ流行への言及であり、現在の主題はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）における進行中の流行。よって検証済み地域はDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Bicho-Geográfico: Saiba Como Ocorre a Transmissão, Quais São os Sintomas e Como Prevenir
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cutaneous Larva Migrans: Learn How Transmission Occurs, What the Symptoms Are, and How to Prevent
article.articleSummary: Cutaneous larva migrans (creeping eruption) is caused by hookworm larvae penetrating the skin after contact with soil or sand contaminated with animal feces, typically at beaches, parks, or areas frequented by dogs and cats. Transmission occurs via direct skin contact with contaminated ground; insect bites do not transmit the infection. The larvae migrate within the epidermis, producing red, serpiginous tracks that resemble a map and may advance about 1 cm per day. Intense itching, often worse at night, along with redness, swelling, and inflammation along the tract are characteristic. Although larvae may die spontaneously after weeks, symptoms can be burdensome and lead to medical care. Treatments include antiparasitic drugs such as thiabendazole, albendazole, or ivermectin, administered topically or orally depending on extent. Prevention centers on wearing footwear, avoiding direct contact with contaminated sand or soil, deworming pets, and promptly cleaning up pet feces; do not attempt self-removal of larvae.

triage.headline_ja: 皮膚幼虫移行症：感染経路、症状、予防法について学ぶ
triage.triage_reason: 一般的な教育・啓発記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告するものではない。疾患自体も風土病的で重篤性・国際拡大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の発生国に関するものではなく、一般的な疾患解説記事。ブラジルは発生地域として付与されているが、本文はブラジル固有の事例に言及していないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A Meningkat, Klaim Rawat Inap Allianz Melonjak 47 Persen hingga September 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A on the rise, Allianz inpatient claims jump 47 percent through September 2026.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A activity in Indonesia shows rising signals. Allianz Life Indonesia reports inpatient influenza claims up 47% year-on-year for January–August 2026, totaling more than Rp13.8 billion for 1,857 cases as of the second week of September 2026. Separately, Indonesia’s Ministry of Health (MoH) surveillance of influenza-like illness (ILI) shows the proportion of positive tests rising to 58.59% in week 37 of 2026, up from 53.71% the prior week. Among 198 specimens tested that week, 105 were positive for Influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 and seven for Influenza A(H3N2). The report cautions that 58.59% reflects specimen positivity within surveillance, not population prevalence, and trends should be interpreted cautiously. The findings underscore influenza A activity in Indonesia and the need for ongoing monitoring, considering data from different populations and surveillance systems.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAが増加、アリアンツの入院保険金請求が2026年9月までに47%急増
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1pdm09が主体)の陽性率上昇と入院保険金請求増加が報告されているが、重症度や異常性を示す具体的データ（死亡率、新規変異株等）は不明であり、通常の季節性流行の範囲内である可能性が高い。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1pdm09が主体、H3N2少数)の通常のサーベイランス動向と保険金請求データ。病原性変化や新規変異株の情報なし。続報での重症度・死亡例の有無を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Elszabadult az ebolajárvány: Rengeteg a halálos áldozat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak has spiraled out of control: A large number of fatalities.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has claimed at least 4018 lives and infected over 8300 people, spanning seven provinces. The epicenter remains Ituri Province, but the virus has reached North Kivu and South Ubangi, including a September case of a man who traveled from the eastern part of the country and died there. The outbreak began in May and is the largest and deadliest Ebola episode in DRC history. Response is impeded by armed conflict, insecurity, public mistrust, and an overburdened health system; a treatment center was destroyed by soldiers, and some health workers protested over delayed salaries. The WHO says regional risk is high at land borders, while global risk remains low. Authorities and partners continue contact tracing, isolation, treatment, and community outreach; more than 2000 patients have recovered.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が制御不能に:多数の死者
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)が7州に拡大し死者4018人・感染者8300人超と大規模化、WHOが地域リスクを高いと評価しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 史上最大規模のDRCエボラ流行であり、武力紛争・医療体制崩壊により対応が困難。国境地帯での地域リスクが高いとWHOが指摘している点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola treatment centre was burned down as death toll in Congo passes 4,000
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) driven by the Bundibugyo virus has surpassed 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths, making it the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history. Declared May 15, the outbreak centers on Ituri province’s Bunia; Bundibugyo has no known treatment or vaccine. Health workers have staged strikes over unpaid wages, hampering surveillance and containment. A transit and treatment centre was burned in Kigonze on Bunia’s outskirts, forcing about 19,000 people to flee; the UN says this destroys critical capacity for care. An MSF aid worker contracted Ebola and was evacuated to the Netherlands, entering Leiden University Medical Centre’s isolation unit. More than 50 health workers have died. WHO and Africa CDC report mixed dynamics, with September averages around 490 new cases and 230 deaths, while insecurity and mistrust continue to impede response. Attacks in Butembo reflect mounting political tension.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでの死亡者数が4000人を超える中、エボラ治療センターが焼失
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウイルス）流行が史上最速の拡大を見せ、死者4000人超、医療従事者の国際搬送事例も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: MSF職員がエボラに感染しオランダ（ライデン大学医療センター）に搬送された事例は国際的拡大リスクの証左だが、対象国リストに含まれないためvery_locationsには含めていない。治安悪化・医療従事者ストライキ・治療施設焼失など対応能力の著しい低下が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Sector privado garantiza disponibilidad de vacuna contra fiebre amarilla para viajeros
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Private sector guarantees availability of yellow fever vaccine for travelers.
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever vaccine supply is guaranteed in the private sector for travelers from Costa Rica after a new travel-health rule took effect Oct 1, 2026. Costa Rican travelers heading to Bolivia, Ecuador, Paraguay, Venezuela, Colombia, Brazil, Peru, and several African nations must be vaccinated against yellow fever to enter; the shot must be administered at least 10 days before departure, and travelers must carry the international vaccination certificate. Private pharmacies and vaccination centers report adequate stock, with doses priced roughly between 60,000 and 80,000 Costa Rican colón. The CCSS also offers vaccination, subject to appointment availability and possession of a flight ticket to risk destinations. Digital vaccination certificates are accessible via the Ministry of Health Virtual Office, the EDUS app, and the Pura Vida Móvil platform. Massimo Manzi of the Chamber of Health affirmed sufficient private-dose supply.

triage.headline_ja: 民間セクター、旅行者向け黄熱病ワクチンの供給を保証
triage.triage_reason: コスタリカにおける渡航者向け黄熱病ワクチン供給体制の案内記事であり、対象国での実際の感染症発生・流行を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はコスタリカの渡航医療制度に関する内容で、黄熱病の発生報告ではない。ブラジルは渡航先として言及されているが、ブラジル国内での流行についての記述はない。対象国リストのうちBrazil以外（ペルー、ボリビア、ベネズエラ、パラグアイ、エクアドル、コロンビア、コスタリカ）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Собирающихся в Таиланд россиян предупредили о других инфекциях на фоне крысиной лихорадки
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russians planning to travel to Thailand were warned about other infections amid leptospirosis (rat fever).
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-02, Russian epidemiologist Gennady Onishchenko told TASS that Russian tourists planning holidays in Thailand face infections beyond leptospirosis (rat fever). He cautioned that in Thailand one can contract hepatitis and gastrointestinal infections in addition to leptospirosis. The warnings come after attention to the flooded city of Rayong, where aid volunteers and tourists – potentially hundreds of Russians – may be present. The article notes leptospirosis is spreading in the resort country, but stresses it is not the sole risk. No case counts or laboratory confirmation are provided in the report. The guidance emphasizes exposure risk to common infections for travelers and aid workers in flood-affected areas, highlighting imported exposure among Russians in Rayong. No outbreaks or fatalities are reported in the article.

triage.headline_ja: タイ旅行を予定するロシア人、ネズミ熱（レプトスピラ症)に加え他の感染症にも注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: タイ・ラヨーン県の洪水に伴いレプトスピラ症や肝炎等のリスクが指摘されているが、具体的な症例数や死亡者数、アウトブレイクの確認はなく、ロシア人旅行者向けの一般的注意喚起に留まるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアの専門家によるタイ旅行者向けの一般的な感染症注意喚起であり、具体的な症例数・死亡数・アウトブレイクの確認情報は含まれていない。洪水被害地域（ラヨーン）での曝露リスクに言及しているが、詳細情報不足のためWATCHと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Smart Early Warning System Sharpens Hospital Infection Surveillance, Study
article.articleSummary: In Guangzhou, China, at The Affiliated Guangdong Second Provincial General Hospital of Jinan University, a retrospective study evaluated an intelligent early warning system integrated with active surveillance for healthcare-associated infections (HAIs). The eight-year analysis compared pre-intervention (2018–2022) versus post-intervention (2023–2025) periods using interrupted time-series methods. The hospital identified 2,600 HAI cases in the pre period and 1,697 in the post period. Delayed reporting declined from 32.85% to 28.23% (p=0.001); time-series estimates showed a sustained quarterly drop of 1.240 percentage points (95% CI −2.408 to −0.078; p=0.033). Pre-discharge reporting rose from 74.54% to 89.69% (p<0.001), with an immediate level increase of 13.453 percentage points (CI 3.143–23.763; p=0.012). Median delays shortened: onset-to-discharge 11→9 days; reporting-to-discharge 9→7 days (both p<0.001). The findings support the value of combining intelligent analytics with active surveillance to accelerate detection, isolation, and care in hospital infection control.

triage.headline_ja: スマート早期警報システムが病院内感染サーベイランスを強化、研究で判明
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は病院内感染サーベイランスシステムの研究報告であり、特定の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 疾患名にCoccidioidomycosisが付与されているが、記事内容は病院内感染（HAI）サーベイランスシステムの研究であり、特定疾患のアウトブレイクとは無関係。Bluedotのタグ付けが不適切な可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية الجائحة المقبلة لن تنتظر وتفشى إيبولا وهانتا يؤكد خطر الأوبئة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The next pandemic won’t wait, and Ebola and Hantavirus outbreaks confirm the danger of epidemics.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus told the Regional Committee of WHO for the Americas that Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and hantavirus cases aboard the MS Hondius underline the persistent epidemic threat to all nations. WHO notes its largest field presence is in the DRC, aiding the government’s Ebola response in coordination with Africa CDC. Argentina and Chile supported epidemiological investigations and donated reference materials for laboratories in 15 countries. Tedros warned the next pandemic won’t wait and pressed five priorities: accelerate negotiations on the PABS annex to open the Pandemic Accord for signature and entry into force; secure a higher assessed funding level at the World Health Assembly; reform the global health architecture; invest in primary health care; and strengthen WHO’s resilience and independence. He cited Washington meeting constraints but reaffirmed PAHO-WHO unity and the need for global solidarity.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:次のパンデミックは待ってくれない――エボラとハンタウイルスの流行が感染症リスクを裏付ける
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長がDRCでのエボラ出血熱の流行とハンタウイルス症例を挙げ、世界的な感染症リスクを強調しており、重症度・流行性・国際支援の必要性からフルリスク評価の対象とすべきシグナルと判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はWHO事務局長の演説が中心であり、DRCでのエボラ出血熱の継続的流行（WHOが最大級の現地支援を展開）が具体的事例として言及されている。ハンタウイルス症例はクルーズ船（MS Hondius）での発生であり、対象国（アルゼンチン・チリ）は支援国としての言及であり発生地ではないため、verified_locationsには含めていない。詳細な症例数・地域拡大状況が不明なため、フルRRAでの精査を推奨する。

article.articleHeadline: Över 4 000 döda i ebolautbrottet i Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 4,000 dead in the Ebola outbreak in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in Congo-Kinshasa (the Democratic Republic of the Congo) has claimed over 4,000 lives among more than 8,000 laboratory-confirmed cases, making it the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak documented to date. The epicenter is facing ongoing transmission challenges as health workers repeatedly strike due to shortages of funds and resources. In September, frontline staff began vaccination for the outbreak using a vaccine developed for a different Ebola variant; the effectiveness of this vaccine against Bundibugyo ebolavirus is currently unclear. The report notes rapid spread and persistent strain on health systems, with no specific infection source described and no details provided on imported or exported cases. Authorities are pursuing vaccination alongside resource mobilization to halt transmission, amid uncertainty about vaccine efficacy against this variant.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱の流行で4,000人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死数4,000人超・症例8,000人超の過去最速拡大のエボラ流行であり、医療従事者のストライキやワクチン有効性の不確実性も重なり、国際的拡大・公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明白なためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 過去最速の拡大規模とされ、使用中ワクチンの変異株（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）への有効性が不明である点がリスク評価上の重要な論点。医療従事者のストライキによる対応能力低下も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en el Congo se ha cobrado la vida de más de cuatro mil personas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has claimed the lives of more than four thousand people.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused 4,018 deaths among 8,300 laboratory-confirmed cases, according to the DR Congo's National Institute of Public Health (INSP). The outbreak was declared on May 15 in the eastern region. The latest INSP update, dated 2 October 2026, provides these figures and notes no additional details on clinical symptoms or infection sources in the report. The data show ongoing transmission in the region, underscoring the sustained public health response required to control the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、死者4000人超に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（8,300症例、死者4,018人）が継続中であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき案件。
triage.notes: 致死率は約48%と高く、継続的な感染拡大が示唆される。臨床症状や感染経路の詳細は報告されていないため、フルRRAでの追加情報収集が必要。
