article.articleHeadline: Influenza A Subclade K Sudah Terdeteksi di 20 Provinsi, Ini Kelompok Usia yang Banyak Ditemukan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A Subclade K Has Been Detected in 20 Provinces; This Is the Age Group Most Commonly Found.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A(H3N2) subclade K has been detected in 20 Indonesian provinces, with 188 laboratory-confirmed detections through week 37 of 2026. The highest case distribution is among children aged 0–4, 5–9, and 10–17 years. The provinces reporting the most findings are DKI Jakarta, East Java, and South Kalimantan, though the 188 figure reflects detections rather than a uniform provincial burden. Ministry of Health data, as of 26 September 2026, notes that 188 detections are not the total influenza A activity in Indonesia. In the same monitoring period, detections of other influenza A subtypes—A(H1N1)pdm09 and A(H3N2)—were identified in examined specimens. The article provides no details on transmission routes or travel-linked cases.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA Subclade K、インドネシア20州で検出済み ― 多く見られる年齢層は
triage.triage_reason: 新規サブクレードKのインフルエンザA(H3N2)がインドネシア20州に拡大し、小児に多く検出されている点でWPRO基準（異常性・流行しやすさ）を満たし、公的機関データに基づく報道で社会的関心も認められるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 新しいH3N2サブクレードKの検出で、重症度・感染経路・渡航関連情報は記事に記載なし。WHO等国際機関での監視動向の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak: DRC death toll climbs above 4,000
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) caused by the Bundibugyo strain has reached 4,018 deaths and 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces as of 2026-10-02, with more than 2,000 recoveries. It is the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in the DRC, surpassing 2018-2020, and the second deadliest globally after 2014-2016 West Africa. Transmission had begun slowing in parts of Ituri Province, the outbreak’s origin, but remains widespread in eastern DRC, including North Kivu. South Ubangi Province in the northwest reported its first affected area last month after a man who traveled from eastern DRC died there, marking imported/internal spread to a seventh province. The figures reflect ongoing containment challenges faced by Congolese authorities and UN partners.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク：コンゴ民主共和国での死者数が4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおける過去最大規模のエボラ流行で死者数4,000人超、7州に拡大しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが明確に認められるためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: DRC史上最大・最悪のエボラ流行であり、国内7州に拡大、UNを含む国際支援が継続している。続報で国境を越えた感染拡大の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 彰化市2例登革熱相距百米　4鄉鎮清潔隊兵分8路防堵
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two dengue fever cases in Changhua City are 100 meters apart, as four township sanitation squads deploy along eight routes to contain the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Two locally acquired dengue fever cases in Changhua City, Taiwan, are about 100 meters apart, prompting emergency containment on Oct 2, 2026. The city reported the second local case earlier, with both patients living in Changhua City; infection sources are under investigation as their activities have not overlapped. In response, the Environmental Protection Bureau, with the Health Bureau, mobilized cleanup squads from Changhua City, Hemei, Xiushui, and Pitou to operate eight routes, spraying insecticides within a 400-meter radius of the cases to curb transmission. Fogging and spraying equipment were used following an outside-in, large-to-small approach. This marks the year's second locally transmitted dengue case; vector-control measures include ongoing epidemiological investigation. Separately, Sept 17–19 mosquito-breeding surveys identified 12 hotspots in Dongxing and Minquan wards, many abandoned or vacant properties; eight sites did not comply and were fined under the Infectious Disease Prevention and Control Act, with a per-incident daily penalty.

triage.headline_ja: 彰化市2例登革熱相距百米　4鄉鎮清潔隊兵分8路防堵
triage.triage_reason: 台湾・彰化市での局地的なデング熱症例2例に対する通常の防疫対応であり、規模は小さく国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 台湾はBluedot対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。地方自治体レベルでの通常の媒介昆虫対策であり、国レベルの対応や国際的関心は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola v Kongu si vyžiadala už viac ako 4 000 obetí. Epidémia sa šíri rekordne rýchlo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo has claimed more than 4,000 lives. The epidemic is spreading at a record pace.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has claimed over 4,000 lives as of the latest Ministry of Health data. In 8,300 confirmed cases, 4,018 fatalities (case fatality ~49%). The outbreak, declared May 15, is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a strain with no approved treatment or vaccine. The World Health Organization warns of rapid geographic spread into new health zones, straining already limited resources. Africa CDC notes a decline in confirmed cases but cautions that insecurity and community mistrust impede response, with local residents this week assaulting a politician who publicly backed government measures. Authorities have launched village-level strategies to slow transmission, but deep-rooted distrust of government—rooted in mismanagement of past outbreaks and corruption—poses a major barrier. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱、死者数が4,000人を超える。流行は記録的な速さで拡大している
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、4,000人超の死者を出し、ワクチン・治療法未承認の株による拡大が続くなど、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAに進むべき事案。
triage.notes: WHO・Africa CDCが関与し、治療薬・ワクチン未承認のBundibugyo株による第17回目のDRC国内エボラ流行。治安悪化・住民の政府不信が対応の障壁となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Броят на жертвите на епидемията от ебола в ДР Конго надхвърли 4000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from the Ebola epidemic in DR Congo exceeded 4,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 4,000 deaths, with 4,018 fatalities among 8,300 confirmed cases as of 2 October 2026. The outbreak, which began on 15 May, is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no approved treatment or vaccine exists. It centers in Bunia, the capital of Ituri province in the northeast. Frontline health workers have protested unpaid salaries, hindering contact tracing efforts. Médecins Sans Frontières reports a staff member infected while working in the country, evacuated to the Netherlands for treatment at Leiden University Medical Center; MSF says the human toll is unprecedented, with over 50 health workers dead. WHO warns the virus is spreading to new areas, straining scarce resources, while Africa CDC notes a decline in confirmed cases that may reflect reporting gaps and community engagement challenges. In Butembo, North Kivu, local official Mari-Celestin Karondva was attacked and died, underscoring rising unrest and distrust toward health workers and authorities, which hampers containment.

triage.headline_ja: DR コンゴのエボラ流行による死者数が4000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ流行が8,300症例・4,018死亡に拡大し、医療従事者感染や新地域への拡大、治安悪化により封じ込めが困難化しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: MSFスタッフがオランダへ搬送された事例があるが、これは治療目的の移送であり、オランダ国内での感染拡大ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。給与未払いによる医療従事者の抗議、地域住民の不信・暴力など、封じ込めを阻害する社会的要因が顕著。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en la RD del Congo ha matado ya a más de 4.000 personas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has already killed more than 4,000 people.
article.articleSummary: Since the Ebola outbreak was declared on May 15 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola has killed over 4,000 people. The latest INSP report tallies 4,018 deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases, with a case-fatality rate around 48%. About 2,162 have recovered; 842 are hospitalized or in isolation; contact tracing is 80.6%. The epidemic covers 63 health zones across seven provinces, led by Ituri (epicenter) with Tshopo, Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, North Kivu, South Kivu, and South Ubangi affected. This is the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak; the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak remains the deadliest (≈28,000 cases, ≈11,000 deaths). Bundibugyo strain has no specific treatment; Phase 1 vaccine trials are underway, and Ervebo has been used in a DRC vaccination campaign, showing positive signals in animals. Uganda reported 20 cases (15 imported from the DRC) and 2 deaths, with the WHO ending its outbreak there on Aug 26. Transmission is by direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and hemorrhage.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、死者数が4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なエボラ流行（8,300症例、致死率約48%）が7州63保健地域に拡大し、国際的な拡大（ウガンダへの波及）も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダへの波及（20例、2死亡、WHOは8月26日に終息宣言）にも言及しているが、主題はDRCの流行であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。アンゴラは流行地域として挙げられているが記事本文中に具体的言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Más de 4.000 personas han muerto por el brote de ébola en la RD del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 4,000 people have died from the Ebola outbreak in the DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: By 2 October 2026, the Ebola outbreak declared on 15 May in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has caused 4,018 deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases (case fatality rate 48.4%). Recoveries total 2,162; 842 patients remain hospitalized or in isolation; contact tracing stands at 80.6%. The outbreak spans 63 health zones across seven provinces, led by Ituri in the east. The Bundibugyo strain drives the epidemic; there are no specific treatments yet. WHO is testing two vaccines in Phase 1 trials, with months to go. Congo began vaccination with Ervebo in late August; though designed for the Zaire strain, it has shown positive signals against Bundibugyo in animals. The outbreak has also reached Uganda, where the WHO ended the cross-border event on 26 August after 20 confirmed infections (15 imported from DRC) and two deaths. Transmission is via contact with bodily fluids, causing fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and hemorrhage.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行で4,000人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%、8,300症例・4,018死亡という大規模流行で、7州63保健地区に拡大し国境を越えてウガンダにも波及しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境事例はWHOにより8月26日に終息宣言済みのため、現在進行中の主要発生国はDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Больницу в Иркутской области закрыли на карантин из-за "особо опасной инфекции". По данным СМИ, одна из пациенток умерла от легочной чумы -- Meduza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A hospital in Irkutsk Oblast was quarantined due to an especially dangerous infection. According to media reports, one of the patients died of pneumonic plague — Meduza.
article.articleSummary: An inpatient department of Shelekhov District Hospital in Irkutsk Oblast was closed and quarantined over a suspected especially dangerous infection, while the clinic remains open. Media reports claim a 28-year-old patient, Darya Shipilova, died of pneumonic plague after returning from Thailand; another version identifies a laboratory technician from the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute who allegedly broke a plague culture vial, with illness onset on September 29 and death two days later. Official confirmation of death was not provided. Governor Igor Kobzev described an extraordinary sanitary-epidemiological commission meeting, attended by Russia’s chief sanitary doctor Anna Popova. Rospotrebnadzor is conducting full anti-epidemic measures; contacts are under medical observation with no signs of disease. REN TV cites about 200 contacts, 189 hospitalised for observation. Global plague cases 2010–2015 totaled 3,248 with 584 deaths; Russia’s last case was in 2016 in Altai Republic (a 10-year-old). A plague vaccine exists for at-risk settings.

triage.headline_ja: イルクーツク州の病院が「特に危険な感染症」のため隔離封鎖、報道によれば患者の一人が肺ペストで死亡 — メドゥーザ
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストによる死亡例が報告され、約200人の接触者が観察下（189人入院）に置かれるなど、公衆衛生上重大かつ異例の事態であり、IHR基準の2項目（深刻性・異常性）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア・イルクーツク州（対象国リスト外）。タイは患者の渡航歴として言及されているのみでイベント発生国ではないため除外。死亡原因は研究所内感染説と海外渡航後発症説の2説があり、公式確認はまだない。

article.articleHeadline: Konqoda Ebola virusundan ölənlərin sayı 4018-ə çatıb
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola virus deaths in Congo has reached 4,018.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 8,300 confirmed infections and 4,018 deaths as of October 2, 2026. The May-start epidemic is driven by the rare Bundibugyo variant, with Ituri and Haut-Uele provinces showing some slowing while transmission continues in other regions. No effective vaccine is available for this variant. The World Health Organization notes the high case fatality rate reflects challenges in timely detection and rapid access to medical care. Health authorities report persistent transmission and the outbreak’s expansion beyond initial hotspots, underscoring the need for enhanced surveillance, early clinical management, and community outreach. The report highlights ongoing outbreak dynamics within the Democratic Republic of Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラウイルスによる死者数が4,018人に達した
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なエボラ流行（8,300例確認、4,018人死亡）で、稀なBundibugyo株に有効なワクチンがなく、感染拡大が継続しているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 致死率が高く(約48%)、有効なワクチンがないBundibugyo株による流行で、初期発生地を超えて拡大が続いている。WHOも致死率の高さを懸念しており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）本轮埃博拉死亡病例数超4000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo (Kinshasa) Ebola outbreak death toll surpasses 4,000
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kinshasa) as of October 2, 2026: 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths across seven provinces, with 2,162 recoveries and a case fatality rate of 48.4%. The outbreak began on May 15 and remains ongoing. Médecins Sans Frontières warned on October 1 that limited surveillance and case finding likely undercount actual infections. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stated on August 12 that this is the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ（キンシャサ）、今回のエボラ出血熱の死者数が4000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%、7州にわたる8300症例・4000人超の死者が確認され、WHOが史上2番目に大規模な流行と評価するなど、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するため。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が史上2番目の規模と言及し、国境なき医師団がサーベイランス不足による過小評価の可能性を指摘。国際的な支援ニーズが高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza A di Medan Naik pada September, Dinas Kesehatan Keluarkan Surat Kesiapsiagaan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A cases in Medan rose in September, the Health Department issued a Preparedness Letter.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases in Medan, North Sumatra, rose in September 2026, with 15 confirmed Influenza A cases and 3 Influenza B cases reported from January–September. In response, the Medan Health Department issued a preparedness letter to all health facilities—Puskesmas and hospitals—to bolster readiness to detect and manage respiratory infections. High-risk groups include the elderly, individuals with comorbidities, and travelers returning from abroad. Public health guidance emphasizes hygienic practices: regular soap-and-water handwashing, cough and sneeze etiquette, and mask use for those with symptoms. Citizens are urged to seek care at primary health care facilities when presenting fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, malaise, or myalgia, as early testing can enable timely treatment. Authorities stress vigilance without panic.

triage.headline_ja: メダンでインフルエンザA型の症例が9月に増加、保健局が準備体制に関する通知を発行
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常範囲内の増加であり、症例数も少なく（A型15例、B型3例）、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 保健局による予防的な注意喚起であり、季節性インフルエンザの通常の管理対応と判断される。重症例や死亡例の報告はなく、通常の監視活動の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: СМИ: в Конго число жертв Эболы превысило четыре тысячи человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The media: the number of Ebola victims in Congo has surpassed four thousand.
article.articleSummary: Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo has caused 4,018 deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces, with a case-fatality rate of 48.4% and 2,162 recoveries. As of September 16, the outbreak persists and continues to threaten neighboring countries, according to Africa CDC Director Jean Kasaya, with transmission staying active within the DRC. INSP-based data cited via Actualite provides the figures. A civil protection worker is shown disinfecting a coffin prior to burial of an Ebola victim. The report notes ongoing public health efforts and mentions that Russia is nearing completion of studies on new vaccines for Marburg and Ebola, reflecting broader vaccine development activity. The piece underscores the substantial mortality burden and the need for continued outbreak response as seven provinces remain affected.

triage.headline_ja: メディア報道：コンゴのエボラ犠牲者数が4000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確定症例8,300人、死亡4,018人（致死率48.4%）に達する大規模エボラ流行が7州に及び、近隣国への拡大懸念もあることからIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ロシアはマールブルグ・エボラワクチン開発に関する言及のみで、発生地域ではないため verified_locations から除外。記事サマリーより9月16日時点の情報であり、続報での致死率・拡大状況の確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Murtaja e Ruminantëve të Vegjël, sëmundja fatale që prek bagëtitë e imëta, është shfaqur në Lepenicë të Selenicës.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Peste des petits ruminants, the fatal disease affecting small ruminants, has appeared in Lepenicë, Selenicë.
article.articleSummary: Peste des petits ruminants (PPR) has appeared in Lepenicë, Selenicë, Albania. Signs were first detected at the end of August, with cases emerging in the first two weeks of September across four farms. More than 700 head of small ruminants (sheep and goats) have been culled. Local shepherds report it is the first time they confront such a disease, and Arjani, a village butcher, says the outbreak threatens shepherds and their livelihoods. The Vlorë Directorate of Agriculture and Veterinary Services has implemented culling measures and the situation is being monitored. The outbreak poses a serious risk to tens of additional farms in the Lumit area of Vlorë since livestock share grazing lands and water sources, raising the potential for further spread.

triage.headline_ja: 小反芻獣疫（致死性の家畜感染症）がアルバニア・セレニツァ県レペニツェで発生
triage.triage_reason: PPR（小反芻獣疫）は人獣共通感染症ではなく動物のみに影響する疾患であり、公衆衛生上のリスクは認められない。発生地もアルバニアであり対象国に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はアルバニア・ヴロラ県レペニツェでの家畜（羊・ヤギ）における小反芻獣疫発生を報じており、人への感染リスクはない。インドが発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文に言及なし。アルバニアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空。

article.articleHeadline: Epidémia eboly v Konžskej demokratickej republike má už vyše 4 000 obetí | Info.sk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has already claimed more than 4,000 lives.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has claimed more than 4,000 lives. The DRC Ministry of Health reported on October 1 that there are 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths, a case fatality near 49%. The outbreak, declared May 15, is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no approved treatment or vaccine. The World Health Organization warns of rapid geographic expansion into new health zones, straining already limited resources. Africa CDC noted that confirmed cases are reportedly declining, but AP cites security challenges, persistent instability, and resistance from some communities as factors. An attack this week saw a Congolese politician killed after publicly backing government containment measures, highlighting distrust. A September village-focused strategy aims to slow spread amid widespread skepticism about Ebola and government efforts, rooted in past mismanagement and corruption. Ongoing, 17th outbreak in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、死者数が4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、8,300人感染・4,000人超死亡という深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、地理的拡大とワクチン・治療法未承認の珍しい株（ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス）であることからIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: WHOは新規保健区域への地理的拡大を警告。Africa CDCは症例減少を報告する一方、AP通信は治安問題・コミュニティの抵抗・政治家殺害事件など社会的不安定要因を指摘。DRCにおける17回目のエボラ流行。

article.articleHeadline: 3.394 Burung Selundupan dari Vietnam di Sidoarjo Negatif HPAI, 161 Mati
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 3,394 Smuggled Birds from Vietnam in Sidoarjo Negative for Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI), 161 Dead
article.articleSummary: 3,394 birds smuggled from Vietnam were seized in a warehouse in Kepatihan Village, Tulangan District, Sidoarjo, East Java. Initial laboratory tests showed negative for Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI) or H5N1, but 161 birds were found dead, prompting further investigations including necropsies to determine health status and look for HPAI signs. Vietnam continues to report HPAI H5N1, underscoring the risk of importing birds without animal health certificates or quarantine inspection. If subsequent tests confirm HPAI, authorities will cull the affected birds; if results remain negative, the birds will be auctioned per regulations. The case highlights biosecurity concerns surrounding imported avian commodities and the need for strict inspections to prevent H5N1 introduction into Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア・シドアルジョでベトナムから密輸された鳥3,394羽、HPAI検査陰性も161羽が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 密輸された鳥のHPAI検査は陰性だが161羽が死亡し追加検査中であり、結果次第でリスクが変わるため続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 現時点では検査結果が陰性であり、ヒトへの感染事例は報告されていない。追加の検死結果（陽性/陰性）によって評価を更新する必要がある。ベトナムは鳥の出所国として言及されているが、記事の主題はインドネシアでの密輸鳥検疫事案であるため、Vietnamはverified_locationsに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 4달 만에 4천명 '사망'...치명률 48% '이 병' 공포 확산
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 4,000 deaths in four months... 48% fatality rate, fear that 'this disease' is spreading.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths (case fatality rate 48.4%) as of Sept 30, and 2,162 recoveries. The outbreak, declared May 15 with Uganda near the border, persists amid concerns of underreporting and security-related surveillance gaps; Africa CDC notes reported growth may have slowed but real transmission could be higher, and MSF highlights monitoring limitations. In North Kivu’s Butembo, a UDPS regional leader promoting Ebola prevention was killed, reflecting public trust challenges. Early symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal pain, potentially progressing to hemorrhage and leukopenia. Korea reports no imported cases yet; readiness measures include 1339 for suspected cases and a Sept 15 Safe Korea drill simulating importation and response.}

triage.headline_ja: 4ヶ月で4000人死亡…致死率48%、『この病気』への恐怖拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の大規模流行が継続しており、致死率48.4%・死者4000人超と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、報告の過小評価や治安問題による監視の困難さから国際的拡大リスクも懸念される。
triage.notes: ウガンダは国境付近として言及されているが、確定症例の発生は確認されていないため対象国リストに含めず。韓国は輸入症例ゼロで備え態勢のみの言及。

article.articleHeadline: Nhóm nguy cơ chuyển nặng khi mắc sốt xuất huyết Dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Risk Groups for Progression to Severe Dengue.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in southern Vietnam accounts for 73.1% of national cases, with experts warning that anyone can progress to severe disease. High‑risk groups requiring close monitoring include the elderly, young children (especially under one year), pregnant women, and overweight or obese individuals; however severe dengue can strike healthy youths too. In a Ho Chi Minh City briefing by HCDC and Takeda Vietnam, clinicians noted that older patients may present atypically—restlessness, confusion, or fatigue rather than fever—and require careful fluid management. In children, infants and those with obesity or comorbidities are at risk of shock from plasma leakage, and signs can be subtle. Severe dengue can cause hemorrhage and multi‑organ failure. Recent Ho Chi Minh City cases included two youths (16 and 21) in critical care, with ECMO and dialysis; a 20‑year‑old died on Sep 8. Prevention emphasizes three layers: eliminate standing water, seek fever assessment, and discuss vaccination with providers.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱重症化のリスクグループ
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はベトナム南部で流行し重症例・死亡例も報告されているが、季節性疾患であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、通常の公衆衛生啓発記事の範囲に留まるため継続監視とする。
triage.notes: ベトナム南部（ホーチミン市）でデング熱が流行し、全国症例の73.1%を占める。重症化リスク群に関する啓発記事であり、死亡例・重症例（ECMO・透析）も報告されているが、デング熱は同地域で季節的に発生する既知の疾患であり、新規性や国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемијата на ебола во Конго однесе 4.018 животи, потврдени 8.300 случаи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in Congo has claimed 4,018 lives, with 8,300 cases confirmed.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths across seven provinces, with more than 2,000 recoveries. The epidemic is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, making it the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in Congo's history, surpassing the 2018-2020 crisis. Globally, it ranks as the second-largest outbreak, behind West Africa's 2014-2016 epidemic that infected over 28,600 people and killed more than 11,000 in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. The DRC government reports signs of slowing transmission in Ituri Province, but the virus continues to spread rapidly in the eastern regions, including North Kivu. Last month, South Ubangi Province declared its seventh outbreak after a man arriving from the east died of the disease, signaling cross-provincial spread and ongoing transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、死者4,018人・感染確認8,300人に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、歴史上最大規模という異常性、複数州への拡大）に加え、WPRO基準も複数該当するため、フルリスク評価に進めるべき重大シグナルと判断。
triage.notes: シエラレオネ・アンゴラ・リベリア・ギニアは2014-2016年西アフリカ流行の歴史的比較として言及されているのみで、現在の発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。現在の流行はDRC国内（イトゥリ州、北キブ州、南ウバンギ州など7州）に限定される。

article.articleHeadline: Meer dan 4000 eboladoden in Democratische Republiek Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 4,000 Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed more than 4,000 people, with the virus spreading in the north and east, including South Ubangi province. The Bundibugyo variant is circulating, and there is no approved vaccine for this form. Since August, the government has begun vaccinating with a vaccine developed for a different Ebola variant in an effort to curb transmission. True case and death counts are likely higher, as many cases go unregistered and victims are rapidly buried or burned, obscuring identities and figures. Ongoing violence hampers access to clinics and relief work, while thousands in overcrowded refugee camps facilitate spread. President Félix Tshisekedi has urged the UN for more international attention and an investigative commission. By contrast, the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak killed about 11,000 across Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone.

article.articleHeadline: Вирус се шири источним делом земље: Епидемија еболе у Конгу однела више од 4.000 живота
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The virus is spreading in the eastern part of the country: The Ebola epidemic in Congo has claimed more than 4,000 lives.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) now tallies 4,018 deaths among 8,300 cases across seven provinces, marking the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in the country's history. The Bundibugyo virus strain is responsible. The outbreak ranks as the second-largest globally, behind West Africa 2014–2016 (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) with over 28,600 cases and more than 11,000 deaths. Over 2,000 patients have recovered. Government and UN data last month indicated transmission showed signs of slowing in Ituri province where the outbreak began, but the virus continues spreading rapidly in the east, including North Kivu. Last month, the northwestern part of South Ubangi province became the seventh province to declare an outbreak after a man who died from the virus had traveled from the east.

article.articleHeadline: An Ebola treatment center was burned down as the death toll in Congo passes 4,000
article.articleSummary: DRC's northeastern Ituri province, centered on Bunia, reports 4,018 Ebola deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases since the outbreak began May 15, caused by Bundibugyo virus, which has no approved treatment or vaccine. An MSF aid worker infected with Ebola was evacuated to the Netherlands for care. A transit/treatment center in Kigonze, near Bunia, was burned earlier this week, forcing about 19,000 people to flee. Front-line health workers have protested unpaid wages, hindering surveillance; more than 50 health workers have died. The outbreak is described as the fastest-growing in the country’s history. WHO warns of rapid spread into new health zones amid insecurity and limited cooperation; Africa CDC notes a recent slowdown in confirmed cases in some areas, but persistence elsewhere. Attacks and mistrust complicate response, with village-centered measures facing resistance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ治療センターが焼失、死者数が4,000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウイルス）が急速拡大し、死者数4,000人超・症例8,300件に達し、治安悪化と医療従事者不足で対応が困難化しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当する。
triage.notes: オランダはMSF職員の退避先であり発生国ではないため除外。WHOおよびAfrica CDCが関与し、国際的な懸念と支援ニーズが高いイベント。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola deja más de 4 mil muertos en la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola leaves more than 4,000 dead in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has caused 4,018 deaths out of 8,300 confirmed cases, with 2,162 recoveries and 842 still hospitalized or in isolation; overall case fatality rate 48.4%. The epidemic spans 63 health zones across seven provinces: Ituri (east, epicenter), Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélè, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Ubangi del Sur. It is the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak globally, behind 2014–2016 West Africa (≈28,000 cases, ≈11,000 deaths). The Bundibugyo strain lacks specific treatments; WHO is testing two vaccines in Phase 1, with safety shown so far. The DRC began a vaccination campaign using Ervebo (Zaire strain–focused) late August, showing positive signals against Bundibugyo in animals. The outbreak spread to Uganda, where 20 confirmed cases (including 15 imported from the DRC) and two deaths were recorded. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids, causing hemorrhagic fever.

triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行で死者4,018人・致死率48.4%、7州63保健地域に拡大し、ウガンダへの越境感染も確認されており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: مرگ و میر ناشی از شیوع ایبولا در کانگو از مرز چهارهزار نفر گذشت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed four thousand.
article.articleSummary: As of October 2, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak has 4,018 deaths and 8,300 confirmed cases, the worst in the country's history, with over 2,000 recoveries. Transmission is waning in parts of Ituri, yet the virus continues to spread rapidly in eastern regions, including North Kivu. South Ubangi in the northwest became the seventh province to declare an outbreak after a man infected in the east died there. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain resists control efforts, and there is no vaccine or approved treatment for this strain. Most new infections occur outside supervised groups, indicating faster spread than surveillance can track. The strain was first identified in 2007 in western Uganda (37 deaths) and had a smaller outbreak in 2012 in the DRC.

The surge began on May 15, linked to the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which no proven treatment or vaccine exists. Ongoing transmission is complicated by distrust toward health workers and authorities, hindering surveillance and response efforts, with no details on imported/exported cases provided.

article.articleHeadline: Число жертв эпидемии Эболы в Конго превысило 4 тыс. человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from the Ebola epidemic in Congo has surpassed 4,000 people.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-02, the Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo has caused 4,018 deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases, with 2,162 recoveries. The case fatality rate is 48.4%, per the National Institute of Public Health (INSP) cited by RIA Novosti. Reported cases are spread across seven provinces. Statistics reference laboratory-confirmed infections. The World Health Organization warned last week of expansion of the outbreak in Congo. article.articleHeadline: Haos u DR Kongu: Broj smrtnih slučajeva od ebole premašio 4.000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chaos in DR Congo: The Ebola death toll has surpassed 4,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-02, Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 deaths, with 4,018 fatalities among 8,300 laboratory-confirmed cases reported across seven provinces, according to the latest data released on Friday by the Congolese health authorities. A total of 2,162 patients have recovered, yielding a case fatality rate of 48.4%. The international humanitarian group Doctors Without Borders (MSF) warned that the true toll is likely higher due to surveillance and case-detection gaps. This outbreak is the largest and deadliest Ebola epidemic recorded in the DR Congo and the second-largest globally, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak, per Xinhua.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll surpasses 4,000 as DR Congo struggles to suppress outbreak
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak has killed 4,018 and infected 8,300 across seven provinces, making it the worst and deadliest in the country’s history. The Bundibugyo strain drives the epidemic, declared May 15, and now the DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak. Ituri Province’s Bunia remains epicenter; a transit centre for infected patients was burned by soldiers, forcing 19,000 to flee. Weak infrastructure, remoteness, and ongoing conflict near borders with South Sudan, Uganda, and Rwanda hinder response. Mistrust toward health workers and authorities compounds challenges, including the beating and death of Marie-Celestin Karondwa, a UDPS official in Butembo. The WHO warns the outbreak is far from over and could surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (over 11,000 deaths). No approved vaccine or treatment exists yet; several candidates are in trials. More than 2,000 patients have recovered, and Africa CDC reports falling confirmed cases, though insecurity limits reporting.

triage.notes: 南スーダン、ウガンダ、ルワンダとの国境付近での紛争により越境リスクが懸念されるが、これら国々での感染確認は記事中に明記されていないため、DRCのみを verified_locations とした。ワクチン・治療薬未承認、治安悪化による報告制限も重大な懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil tem 547 registros de Creutzfeldt-Jakob, doença que matou Lito Souza | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil has 547 cases of Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease, the disease that killed Lito Souza | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: Brazil registered 547 Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease cases from 2005–2021, with 1,576 suspected notifications, according to the Ministry of Health. Lito Souza, a 59-year-old influencer, died October 1, 2026, 41 days after diagnosis; his funeral was in São Paulo on October 2. Most cases are in the Southeast, South, and Northeast; São Paulo state had 512 suspected cases (capital: 101 deaths since 2007), followed by Paraná (189) and Minas Gerais (158). The majority are aged 55–74; about 53.6% of suspects are female. There is no proven treatment; roughly 90% die within a year. In September, Anvisa authorized import of the experimental ALN-6457 from the United States for Lito Souza; it has not been used in humans and required approval due to rapid, lethal progression and lack of sponsor. Creutzfeldt-Jakob is a fatal prion-induced neurodegenerative disease with dementia, memory loss, speech and movement impairment, tremors; no evidence of sustained human transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで克雅氏病(クロイツフェルト・ヤコブ病)547例を記録、インフルエンサーLito Souzaさんが死亡 | CNN Brasil
triage.triage_reason: クロイツフェルト・ヤコブ病は孤発性プリオン病であり、本記事は2005-2021年の累積統計と著名人死亡を報じる内容で、ヒト-ヒト感染のエビデンスもなく、新規アウトブレイクやシグナルとしての異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 疾患分類としてBSEタグが付与されているが、記事内容は孤発性クロイツフェルト・ヤコブ病(CJD)に関する統計報告であり、BSE(牛海綿状脳症)やvCJDのアウトブレイクではない。著名インフルエンサーの死去による社会的関心の高まりはあるが、感染症危機管理上のシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, the number of deaths from Ebola has exceeded 4,000.
article.articleSummary: Deaths from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) have risen above 4,000, with 4,018 fatalities and 8,300 confirmed cases as of October 2, 2026, according to government data cited by Reuters via Armenpress. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. It is the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 2018–2020, though smaller in scale than the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. The transmission has affected seven provinces, with over 2,000 people recovered. Authorities and the UN reported in September signs of slowed transmission in Ituri, where the outbreak began, but the virus continues to spread in the eastern regions, including North Kivu. In September, South Ubangi became the seventh province with confirmed cases, including a death of a man who had arrived from the eastern region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで、エボラ出血熱による死者数が4000人を超えた
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2018-2020年以降最大・最悪規模のエボラ流行となっており、死者数が4000人を超え、7州に拡大し国際的拡大リスクもあるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラ流行（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）の継続拡大を報じており、死者4,018人、症例8,300人、7州に拡大、南ウバンギ州で新たな死亡例が確認された。

article.articleHeadline: Viral Warga Gunungkidul Makan Bangkai Kambing, Apa Bahayanya?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gunungkidul residents eat goat carcass: what are the risks?
article.articleSummary: As of October 2, 2026, four residents of Gunungkidul, Indonesia, have been confirmed with anthrax after consuming a goat that was lethargic and died suddenly in Dadapayu, Semanu, in early September 2026. Seven people were initially suspected; PCR tests confirmed four infections. Contact tracing identified 47 individuals at risk due to direct exposure to the affected animal. The confirmed patients were treated and recovered; all at-risk contacts received antibiotic prophylaxis, with monitoring for 60 days (two incubation periods). Authorities advised against slaughtering, processing, or consuming animals that are sick or have died suddenly, and education campaigns were deployed on reporting animal deaths promptly. Anthrax, caused by Bacillus anthracis, can be contracted via skin contact, inhalation, or ingestion of contaminated meat; symptoms vary by route and can include fever, abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and sore throat with neck swelling in some forms. Rapid treatment reduces severe outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: グヌンキドゥル住民がヤギの死骸を食べる、その危険性とは？
triage.triage_reason: 確認された炭疽菌感染者4名は全員回復し、接触者は予防投薬と経過観察下にあり、地域の既知の慣習（病死した家畜の食用）に起因する局所的・管理された事例であるため、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: インドネシアでは病死・病気の家畜を食べる慣習に起因する炭疽菌感染が散発的に報告されており、本事例も地方当局により迅速に対応（PCR確認、接触者追跡、抗生物質予防投与、60日間の監視）されている。人-人感染の報告はなく、国際的拡大リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Конго захлебнулось: Эбола убивает каждого второго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo choked: Ebola kills every second person.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused 4,018 deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces, for a case fatality rate of 48.4 percent. Of those infected, 2,162 have recovered. Transmission occurs by direct contact with blood and bodily fluids of infected individuals. The outbreak requires isolation of patients, extensive contact tracing, and strict infection-control measures in health facilities, while the multi-province spread complicates localization of transmission foci and requires expanded surveillance of contacts. The virus threatens neighboring countries, according to Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya. Past outbreaks in 2018–2020 saw vaccination and experimental therapies deployed, but logistics in remote areas remain a major constraint. The current situation is described as the deadliest Ebola outbreak in the history of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴが窒息状態：エボラが2人に1人を殺している
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%・8,300例の確認症例・7州にまたがる拡大、DRC史上最悪のエボラ流行とされ、近隣国への波及リスクも指摘されておりIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: Africa CDC所長が近隣国への脅威を指摘。史上最悪規模の流行であり、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情死亡破4000人！剛果防疫無法落實，民眾認為病毒是「政府騙局」
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak deaths surpass 4,000! The Democratic Republic of the Congo's prevention measures cannot be implemented, and the public believes the virus is a government hoax.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persists into its 17th wave, with as of Oct 1: 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths (case fatality rate ~48.4%). The Bundibugyo virus strain is responsible, for which there are no approved therapies or vaccines. The epicenter includes North Kivu’s Butembo, but spread has reached additional health zones. WHO warns the virus is crossing borders rapidly, straining scarce medical supplies, while Africa CDC notes apparent declines in weekly cases reflect insecurity, disrupted surveillance, and community resistance to testing and isolation rather than true control. A local official, Marie-Célestin Karondwa, was killed after supporting isolation measures, highlighting public distrust and safety risks for responders. The government has shifted frontline prevention to village-centered strategies, but frontline teams still face significant safety and trust challenges hindering containment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の死者数4000人超！コンゴ民主共和国で防疫策が実施できず、住民は『政府の嘘』と認識
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行が継続し、死者4000人超・致死率約48%、承認済み治療薬・ワクチンなし、国境を越えた拡大がWHOにより警告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 治療薬・ワクチン未承認で致死率約48%と高く、現地の治安不安・住民の不信感により対応が困難な状況。WHO・Africa CDCも懸念を表明しており、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de Ébola na RDCongo ultrapassou a barreira dos 4.000 mortos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo surpasses 4,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern DR Congo has reached 4,018 deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases, the fastest-spreading in the country’s history. The outbreak, declared May 15, is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no licensed vaccine or treatment exists. In Bunia, Ituri province, health workers demanding back pay disrupted surveillance efforts. A transit and treatment center in Kigonze near Bunia was burned by soldiers, forcing about 19,000 people to flee. The UN- and WHO-backed response faces security challenges and community resistance, hindering containment. Africa CDC notes a recent decrease in new confirmed cases, though insecurity and limited community cooperation complicate progress. The outbreak is the deadliest in DR Congo; authorities warn it could surpass West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone), which recorded 28,616 cases and 11,325 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、死者数が4,000人の壁を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が8,300症例・4,018死亡と深刻化し、ワクチン・治療法未承認のブンディブギョ株によるヒューマン-ヒューマン感染が継続。治安悪化・医療従事者ストライキにより封じ込めが困難で、国際的拡大リスクと支援必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（イトゥリ州ブニア）でのエボラ流行に焦点。リベリア・ギニア・シエラレオネは2014-2016年の過去の流行との比較として言及されているのみで、現在の発生地ではないため除外。致死率約48%と高く、治安悪化・医療従事者の賃金未払いストライキ・治療施設焼失による避難（約19,000人）など、封じ込めを著しく困難にする要因が多数存在する。

article.articleHeadline: More than 4,000 deaths recorded in DR Congo Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, has killed 4,018 of 8,300 confirmed cases as of Oct 2, 2026. The May 15 outbreak in eastern North Kivu's Ituri province and Bunia has become the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history, with no approved treatment or vaccine. WHO warns of spread into new health zones as resources strain. Confirmed cases slowed mid-July to about 850 per week and 470 deaths, but September data show ~490 cases and 230 deaths, a 33% rise in both metrics through September. Widespread mistrust and attacks on health workers have hampered control; a local official was killed defending response measures, and frontline staff protested unpaid wages; a transit centre in Bunia's Ituri was burned, displacing about 19,000. An MSF aid worker contracted Ebola and was evacuated to the Netherlands; 50 health workers have died. It is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行で死者4,000人超を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目に該当し、WPRO基準も全5項目該当する重大なエボラアウトブレイク。史上最速の拡大速度、高い致死率、国際的な医療従事者感染・避難例があり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: オランダはMSF職員の退避先であり発生地域ではないため verified_locations から除外。承認された治療法・ワクチンがない状況下で、史上最速の拡大ペース、医療従事者への攻撃、地域コミュニティの不信感により対応が極めて困難化している。WHOが新たな保健地域への拡大を警告しており、国際支援の緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Belum Ada PJJ di Tengah Merebaknya Virus Influenza A, Pemkot Bandung Imbau Sekolah Siaga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There has been no remote learning yet amid the spread of the Influenza A virus; Bandung City Government urges schools to stay alert.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-02, Bandung City Government reported no plan for remote learning amid concerns about the spread of Influenza A virus, noting that approval from the relevant ministry is required for distance learning. Authorities urge heightened vigilance, especially for the elderly and children, as symptoms include fever, cough, runny nose, body aches, and diarrhea. The Bandung Municipal Education Department issued circulars to all TK, PAUD, SD, and SMP, both public and private, to bolster school readiness and surveillance. Schools should manage suspected cases through Usaha Kesehatan Sekolah (UKS); if cases exceed capacity, they should coordinate with nearby puskesmas (health centers). Sick students must be examined at puskesmas; if a doctor clears them to return, they may rejoin classes with a mask; otherwise they should go home until recovered. Coordination with the Health Department continues.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型ウイルスの流行が広がる中、遠隔学習は未実施 ― バンドン市政府が学校に警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA型の流行拡大に伴う学校での注意喚起であり、重症度や異常性を示す情報は乏しいが、子供・高齢者への感染拡大や監視体制強化の動きがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザAの流行に対する地方自治体レベルの対応であり、重症例や死亡者数など具体的な疫学データは記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Campinas tem mais de 30 bairros com maior risco para dengue; confira a relação - Portal Veloz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas has more than 30 neighborhoods at higher risk of dengue; see the list - Portal Veloz.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Campinas, Brazil: As of Sep 28, 2026, Campinas reports 4,053 confirmed dengue cases this year, with no deaths. The 40th Alerta Arboviroses Campinas (Oct 1) designates 32 bairros as higher transmission risk in the last week, by region: East — Vila Itapura, Vila 31 de Março, Vila Lafayette Álvaro, Parque Brasília, Jardim Flamboyant, Vila Nogueira; Northwest — Vila Padre Manoel de Nóbrega, Jardim Garcia, Conjunto Parque São Bento, Parque da Floresta, Cidade Satélite Íris I; North — Bonfim, Botafogo, Vila Proost de Souza, Jardim Chapadão; Southwest — Porto Seguro, Vida Nova, Vila Vitória, DIC V and DIC VI, Jardim Melina, Jardim Aeronave de Viracopos; South — Jardim Puccamp, Jardim Columbia, Jardim San Diego, Parque das Camélias, Jardim Mercedes, Vila Abaeté; Southeast — Parque Jambeiro, Jardim Santa Judith, Jardim Leonor, Ponte Preta. From Jan 1 to Sep 23, 2026, health teams conducted 1,270,445 home visits for breeding-site control and 53,382 outdoor nebulizations to curb Aedes aegypti. Community participation is essential; 80% of breeding sites are inside homes. Recommendations include eliminating standing water, refreshing plant water every two days, cleaning plant saucers weekly, and sealing unused water tanks.

triage.headline_ja: カンピーナスで30以上の地区がデング熱の高リスク地域に;リストを確認
triage.triage_reason: 地域の定例的なデング熱サーベイランス報告であり、死亡例なし、通常の対策（防疫活動・住民啓発）が実施されている既知の季節的流行状況のため、特段の異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ブラジル・サンパウロ州カンピーナス市における毎年恒例のデング熱サーベイランス報告。死亡者なし、地方自治体による通常の防疫対応（家庭訪問・噴霧消毒）が行われており、WATCHやPICKUPに該当する重大性は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Dog bites over 40 people in East Burdwan in one day | Kolkata News
article.articleSummary: Ketugram-I block, East Burdwan, witnessed a string of dog bites on Thursday afternoon and evening, when a stray dog in Hatkaluha village began attacking and spread to neighboring areas. The dog had recently given birth to puppies, behaviour said to have changed after a jackal allegedly killed the litter. More than 40 people, including a child, were bitten; local reports put the tally above 50, with around 40 cases registered at health facilities in the worst-affected areas. The dog was cornered and killed in the evening to stop further attacks. Injured individuals are being treated and monitored for possible rabies exposure. The cause of the attacks could not be independently established, and no laboratory confirmation of rabies is mentioned in the report.

triage.headline_ja: インド東バードワーンで1日に40人以上が犬に噛まれる被害
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の検査確認はなく単発の犬咬傷事例だが、多数の被害者が発生し曝露後対応が必要なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 狂犬病の実験室確認は報告されておらず、原因動物の行動変化の背景も特定されていない。続報があれば確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Katastrophe im Kongo: 4.000 Tote, niedergebrannte Stationen und ermordeter Politiker
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola catastrophe in the Congo: 4,000 dead, burned-down stations, and a murdered politician.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo virus, has killed 4,018 of 8,300 confirmed infections (case fatality ~49%), making it the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in history. Began May 15 in Ituri province’s Bunia; the World Health Organization warns of rapid spread to additional health zones, straining already limited resources. There is no approved treatment or vaccine. Frontline healthcare workers have protested over unpaid wages, hindering containment efforts. A transit station for infected people in Kigonze near Bunia was burned by soldiers, displacing about 19,000. More than 50 health workers have died; an MSF worker contracted Ebola and was evacuated to Leiden, Netherlands. Africa CDC notes weekly cases decreasing (mid-July ~850 infections/470 deaths; September ~490/230), but security and community mistrust complicate control. Local politician Marie-Célestin Karondwa was attacked in Butembo and died later; distrust and rumors persist.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ大惨事：死者4,000人、焼失した施設、暗殺された政治家
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、8,300例中4,000人超の死亡、史上最速拡大とされるエボラ流行であり、治療薬・ワクチンもなく、医療従事者の死亡や治安悪化で封じ込めが困難なため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生事象。
triage.notes: MSF医療従事者がオランダ・ライデンへ搬送されたが、これは治療目的の移送であり、オランダ国内での感染拡大事例ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。Bundibugyo virus species記載だが疾患カテゴリはEbolaとして処理。治安不安・医療従事者の未払い賃金・コミュニティの不信感が封じ込めを阻害しており、国際支援が強く必要とされる状況。

article.articleHeadline: Вирус наступает: Эбола убивает каждого второго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The virus advances: Ebola kills every second person.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo is facing an Ebola outbreak with a current case fatality rate of 48.4%, meaning about half of confirmed cases end in death. A total of 2,162 people have recovered from the illness among those affected. The outbreak is documented in seven provinces, complicating localization of transmission chains and demanding expanded contact tracing. Jean Kaseya, director of Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention, warned that the virus threatens neighboring countries as spread continues within the DRC. Ebola is transmitted through direct contact with blood and bodily fluids of an infected person. Containment requires isolation of patients, rigorous contact tracing, and strict infection-control measures in medical facilities. The DRC has endured Ebola outbreaks previously (2018–2020), during which vaccination and experimental therapies were used, though logistics in remote areas remained a major constraint.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス進撃：エボラが2人に1人を死に至らしめる
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%の深刻なエボラ流行がDRCの7州に拡大し、近隣国への波及リスクも指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: Africa CDC長が近隣国への拡大リスクを警告しているが、具体的な国名は本文中に明示されていないため国際拡大の詳細は不明。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो लोकतांत्रिक गणराज्य में इबोला से मरने वालों की संख्या 4 हजार के पार - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has crossed 4,000 - Punjab Kesari
article.articleSummary: As of October 2, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 deaths, with 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces and 4,018 fatalities. About 2,162 patients have recovered, yielding a case-fatality rate of 48.4%. Doctors Without Borders warns the true toll may be higher due to gaps in surveillance and case finding. This is the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in DRC’s history; globally, it is the second-largest since the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. Africa CDC cautions against viewing a recent drop in reported cases as a downturn, noting surveillance disruptions could hide ongoing transmission. The outbreak has expanded from three health zones to 63 health zones across seven provinces, with 45 zones still experiencing transmission. Ongoing challenges include insecurity and community resistance that hinder monitoring and response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラによる死者数が4000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行で死者4000人超、7州63保健地域に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 致死率48.4%、CFR高く、監視体制の不備や治安悪化・地域社会の抵抗が対応を阻害。Africa CDCは報告症例減少を楽観視すべきでないと警告しており、継続的な注視が必要。記事中のAngolaは発生地域リストに含まれるが本文では言及なしのため除外。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يحصد أكثر من أربعة آلاف روح في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola claims more than four thousand lives in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) surpass 4,000 deaths, with 4,018 fatalities among 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces as of October 2, 2026. The current Bundibugyo virus outbreak in the DRC is the largest and deadliest in the country’s history, ranking second only to the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. The infection source is the Bundibugyo virus; the WHO confirmed outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda in May 2026 under complex humanitarian and security conditions and high cross-border movement. Transmission remains active in eastern regions, including Ituri and North Kivu, with spread reaching South Ubangi in September; more than 2,000 recoveries reported. No licensed vaccine or specific treatment exists; WHO notes ongoing testing of promising options. Ebola spreads via direct contact with blood or body fluids, contaminated surfaces, and objects.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で4000人以上の死者を出す
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）流行が死者4000人超・7州に拡大し、史上2番目の規模となっており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・アンゴラも発生地域に含まれるが対象国リスト外のため除外。記事はDRC（イトゥリ、北キブ、南ウバンギ）の流行拡大を主題としている。

article.articleHeadline: ALARMA EN ÁFRICA: EPIDEMIA DE ÉBOLA SUPERA LAS 4.000 MUERTES - HSB NOTICIAS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarm in Africa: Ebola Epidemic Surpasses 4,000 Deaths - HSB News
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is contending with an Ebola outbreak linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, reporting 4,018 deaths from roughly 8,300 confirmed cases. There is no specific treatment or vaccine for this variant. The response is hampered by resource shortages, security challenges, and community resistance to public health measures. A patient transit center for Ebola cases was destroyed during a military operation seeking weapons, precipitating large-scale displacement. Health workers have protested overdue salaries, further straining the response. Authorities and international bodies continue epidemiological surveillance, but the outbreak persists as a major threat to public health in the region.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカで警戒:エボラ流行が死者4,000人を超える - HSBニュース
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる大規模流行(死者4,018人、症例約8,300件)が継続し、治療薬・ワクチン不在、治安悪化や医療従事者の抗議など対応能力の問題もありIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 致死率が非常に高く(約48%)、治療薬・ワクチン未確立の亜型であること、治安・資金・コミュニティの抵抗など対応上の重大な課題が存在する。続報での症例推移・国際対応の進展を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो लोकतांत्रिक गणराज्य में इबोला से मरने वालों की संख्या 4 हजार के पार

Over the past 4–5 weeks, cases have been largely stable, with a recent weekly drop, but no definitive control, as insecurity and community resistance hamper surveillance and response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱による死者数が4000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおける過去最大規模のエボラ流行で死者4,000人超・CFR48.4%と深刻であり、複数州への拡大、治安問題による対応困難が重なりIHR複数基準・WPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: Angolaは発生地域に含まれるが記事主題はDRCのみであり対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。MSFおよびAfrica CDCがサーベイランスの不備と真の被害規模の過小評価リスクを指摘しており、治安・コミュニティの抵抗が対応を妨げている点は要注視。

article.articleHeadline: У Конго спалили центр лікування Еболи на тлі понад 4000 смертей під час спалаху
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, an Ebola treatment center was burned amid more than 4,000 deaths during the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has caused 4,018 deaths from 8,300 confirmed cases, according to government data released on Thursday, making it the fastest-growing outbreak in the country’s history. The May 15 flare-up is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no known treatment or vaccine. Strikes, violence, and deep distrust hinder containment. In Bunia, Ituri province, frontline staff protested over back pay, and a transit center near Kigonze was burned by soldiers during a weapons search, forcing about 19,000 people to flee. The UN warns that burning the camp worsens spread and undermines response; MSF reports more than 50 health workers dead and an infected staffer evacuated to the Netherlands. Africa CDC notes mixed trends—declines in some zones but accelerations elsewhere—and attacks on officials, including Mari-Celestine Karondva in Butembo, underscoring security challenges.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ治療センターが放火、流行による死者4000人超の中
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は死者4018人・症例8300件に達し史上最速拡大とされ、治療法・ワクチンがないBundibugyo株であること、国際的な感染者移送（オランダへの退避）も確認されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: オランダへの感染スタッフ退避は発生国ではなく医療搬送であり対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。治安悪化・暴力・医療従事者への攻撃が対応を阻害しており、今後の拡大・国際的対応強化の可能性に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: An Ebola Treatment Center Was Burned Down As The Death Toll In Congo Passes 4,000
article.articleSummary: 4,018 Ebola deaths among 8,300 cases have been reported since the outbreak was declared in eastern Congo’s Ituri Province on May 15, making it the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history. The outbreak risks surpassing West Africa’s 2014–2016 toll of about 11,000 deaths. Weekly totals show a decline mid-year (about 850 cases/470 deaths per week in July) and 490 cases/230 deaths in September, but spread to new health zones continues amid insecurity and community resistance. In Bunia, a transit center near the city was burned by soldiers, displacing about 19,000 people; frontline workers report wage arrears. An MSF aid worker contracted Ebola and was evacuated to the Netherlands for isolation—an exported case. At least 50 health workers have died. Mobile labs in Butembo now deliver results in six hours, aiding rapid detection and response in Katwa and other zones.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ死者数が4,000人を超える中、治療センターが焼き討ちされる
triage.triage_reason: 死者4,000人超・史上最速拡大のエボラ流行であり、国際輸出例（オランダへの退避）も発生しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: オランダへの退避例は国際拡大の証左だが、オランダ自体は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。治安悪化・地域社会の抵抗により対応が困難な状況が継続している。

article.articleHeadline: Rusijoje - įtariamas maro protrūkis: valdžia slepia informaciją, mirusioji galėjo dirbti laboratorijoje
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Russia, a suspected plague outbreak: the government is hiding information, the deceased woman could have worked in a laboratory.
article.articleSummary: Suspected plague outbreak in the Irkutsk region, Russia, after a hospital in Shelechovo district was closed for quarantine following the death of a patient believed to have had plague. The deceased, 28-year-old Darya Shipilova, may have died from pneumonic plague; one version says she contracted it after travel to Thailand, another that she was a laboratory technician at the Irkutsk Plague Prevention Institute who accidentally shattered a vial of Yersinia pestis. Reported contacts approach nearly 200, with 189 hospitalized for observation. Authorities imposed restrictions amid a suspicion of an especially dangerous infection; an emergency sanitary and epidemiological commission met with Rospotrebnadzor chief Anna Popova. All contacts are monitored and asymptomatic, with negative test results. Plague is caused by Yersinia pestis and has bubonic, pneumonic, and septicemic forms; pneumonic plague can spread between people via respiratory droplets. The last Russian plague case was in 2016 in Altai Republic.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでペスト流行の疑い：当局が情報を隠蔽か、死亡した女性は研究所勤務の可能性
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストによる死亡例と約200人の接触者（189人入院観察）が発生し、ヒト-ヒト感染のリスクがある稀少な感染症の異常発生であり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（イルクーツク州）であり、タイは感染源として一つの説で言及されているに過ぎず、実際の発生国ではないため対象国リストには該当しない（Thailandは除外）。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго сожгли центр лечения Эболы на фоне более 4000 смертей во время вспышки
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, an Ebola treatment center was burned amid more than 4,000 deaths during the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, centered on Bunia, has caused 4,018 deaths among 8,300 laboratory-confirmed cases as of October 2, 2026. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no approved treatment or vaccine. Frontline responders have faced repeated strikes and community resistance, hindering containment. A transit and treatment camp near Bunia’s outskirts at Kigonze was burned by soldiers seeking weapons, displacing about 19,000 people. An MSF humanitarian worker infected with Ebola was evacuated to the Netherlands and placed in high-level isolation at Leiden; MSF notes over 50 health workers have died. WHO warns of rapid spread to new medical zones; Africa CDC reports slowing new cases in some areas but ongoing delays due to distrust. By September, weekly cases were about 490 and deaths about 230, a 33% rise from mid-July.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ治療センターが焼失、流行中の死者は4000人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の大規模流行が継続し、8300症例中4018人死亡という深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、国際的な拡大（オランダへの医療従事者搬送）も発生しているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: オランダ(Leiden)への感染者搬送は治療目的の隔離であり、現地流行発生国はDRCのみ。オランダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ferdi Sambo dan 500 Warga Binaan Lapas Cibinong Jalani Cek Kesehatan, Ada Keluhan Tensi Tinggi dan Skabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ferdi Sambo and 500 Cibinong Prison inmates undergo health checks, with hypertension and scabies.
article.articleSummary: At Lapas Kelas IIA Cibinong, Bogor Regency, Indonesia, 500 inmates underwent free health screening as part of the GOTD Limitless – Love Without Limits social service on Oct 2, 2026. Ferdy Sambo was among participants, receiving medical evaluation and laboratory tests. Screening proceeded with registration, blood pressure measurement, and general health checks, followed by laboratory tests as indicated. Dr. Yenny Chandrawaty reported a high prevalence of scabies among inmates, prompting hygiene education and guidance on sun-drying bedding to reduce mite transmission. Medications were provided free when needed, alongside education on clean-living practices. Sambo’s lab results showed normal glucose, uric acid, and cholesterol, but a somewhat elevated blood pressure. The event emphasized preventive care and health education for prisoners, with patient-centered screening and free access to medications. Keywords: infectious disease, scabies, outbreak prevention, prison health.

triage.headline_ja: フェルディ・サンボ氏と500人のチボノン刑務所収容者が健康診断を受診、高血圧と疥癬の訴えあり
triage.triage_reason: 刑務所内での健康診断イベントであり、疥癬は既知の軽症皮膚疾患で既に衛生教育等の対応がなされている。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大の懸念はない。
triage.notes: 疥癬（疥癬虫感染症）は閉鎖施設内で蔓延しやすいが、既に対応（衛生指導・投薬）が行われており、現時点で深刻な公衆衛生イベントとは言えない。著名人（Ferdi Sambo）の健康診断という社会的関心はあるが、感染症アウトブレイクとしての重大性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго померли 4000 людей через найшвидше поширюваний спалах Еболи в історії
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, 4,000 people died from the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in history.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths (about half). The outbreak is described as the fastest-spreading in history, with no known treatments or vaccines for Bundibugyo virus. As of 2 October 2026, the WHO warns of rapid geographic spread into new medical zones, straining scarce resources. Africa CDC reports a decline in confirmed cases at its latest briefing, but instability and difficulties mobilizing communities in some epicentres may distort the trend. Earlier this week, a government official defending response measures was attacked and killed; a house was burned and the official died in hospital. Authorities are rolling out a rural-focused strategy, though mistrust of Ebola and government actions—stemming from past outbreaks and corruption concerns—hampers containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最速の拡大を見せるエボラ流行により4000人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の大規模流行で死者4000人超、治療法・ワクチンなしとされ国際的拡大・資源逼迫が報告されておりIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: WHO・Africa CDCが関与し、治療薬・ワクチン未確立のブンディブギョ型エボラの大規模流行。政府関係者への暴力事件も発生し社会的混乱・不信感が拡大を助長している。

article.articleHeadline: CDC's Monkey Problem; 3 Dead in Medical Chopper Crash; 988 for LGBTQ+ Youth Restored
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Congo has reached 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths, with a treatment center burned as the outbreak expands. Separately, the CDC’s move away from animal testing leaves about 130 monkeys needing new homes, with the placement location and costs undetermined. In public health, the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline has restored the LGBTQ+ youth-specific option (Press 3) to provide targeted mental-health support. Additional items include a medical helicopter crash off Catalina Island that killed three, and ongoing discussions about FAA policy on medical-kit stock and related health surveys. Collectively, the digest highlights persistent outbreaks, transitions in animal-testing policy, and renewed mental-health access in 2026.

triage.headline_ja: CDCの「サル問題」；医療用ヘリ墜落で3人死亡；LGBTQ+若者向け988回線が復活
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱が確定症例8,300件・死亡4,018人に達し、治療センターが焼失するなど流行が拡大しているとの記述があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価に進めるべきと判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はニュースダイジェスト形式で複数の無関係なトピック（CDCの動物実験方針、ヘリコプター墜落、メンタルヘルス支援）を含む。エボラに関する詳細情報（感染経路、地域内訳、WHO対応状況など）は本文からは確認できず、続報での確認が望ましい。
