article.articleHeadline: Смертельный вирус нашли в старых Евангелиях - это убивает 3700 лет
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deadly virus found in ancient Gospels — it has been killing for 3,700 years.
article.articleSummary: DNA of the sheep pox virus was found on parchment from York Gospels, produced by Anglo-Saxon scribes in Canterbury in the late 10th century and later at York Minster. Parchment came from skins of sheep, goats, and calves, and molecular analysis detected traces on sheep parchment as well as on calf- and goat-skin pages, suggesting transmission through mixed livestock keeping or during hide processing. Researchers compared the viral DNA with material from Bronze Age sheep teeth and recovered 21 viral genomes; earliest samples date to about 1700 BCE. Data show that sheep pox circulated among Eurasian livestock for over 3,700 years, and the viral genome remained remarkably stable over the last 3.5 millennia, with key host-adapting changes arising before this period. Sheep pox remains a serious threat to livestock today; ancient genomes aid understanding of evolution and may inform new control methods. Archives may hold further traces of infections worldwide.

triage.headline_ja: 古い福音書から致死性ウイルスが発見——3700年にわたり感染を引き起こしてきた
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は歴史的・考古学的研究（古代羊痘ウイルスのゲノム解析）であり、現在進行中の公衆衛生上の脅威や動物疫病の発生事例ではないため、トリアージ対象外。
triage.notes: 記事は考古学・古代DNA研究に関するもので、現代の家畜感染症の発生事例ではない。発生地域に記載されたタイ・英国等は研究対象地の歴史的背景（福音書の作成地等）であり、現在の感染症イベントとは無関係。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो लोकतांत्रिक गणराज्य में इबोला से मरने वालों की संख्या 4 हजार के पार | Ituri: Health workers respond to Ebola outbreak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ebola death toll has surpassed 4,000 | Ituri: Health workers respond to Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 deaths with 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces. Official figures show 4,018 deaths and 2,162 recoveries, yielding a case fatality rate of about 48.4%. Medecins Sans Frontieres warns the true toll may be higher due to gaps in surveillance and case detection. This outbreak is the largest and deadliest in DRC history and the second-largest globally since the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. Africa CDC cautions against reading a recent decline in reported cases as signs of control, citing surveillance disruptions that could mask ongoing transmission. An Africa CDC official noted the outbreak expanded from three health zones in May to seven provinces and 63 health areas, with 45 areas still experiencing transmission. Over the past four to five weeks, the epidemic curve has largely plateaued, but insecurity and community resistance continue to hinder monitoring and response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱による死者数が4000人を超える | イトゥリ：保健従事者がエボラ流行に対応
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱が過去最大規模で拡大し死者4000人超・致死率約48%と深刻な公衆衛生被害が出ており、国際的拡大・支援の必要性も認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: Angolaは発生地域に含まれるが記事本文では言及なしのため除外。DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行であり、治安悪化・住民の抵抗がサーベイランスを阻害している点に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: DRK: Ponad 4 tys. ofiar śmiertelnych wirusa ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRK: More than 4,000 Ebola virus fatalities.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues, with more than 4,000 deaths and 8,300 confirmed cases, according to government figures cited by Reuters. Since the start of the outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo variant of the Ebola virus, about 2,000 patients have recovered. The current outbreak is the deadliest since the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, which killed about 11,000 people in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. Authorities and the UN said last month that transmission appears to be waning in parts of Ituri province, the epicenter, while new cases have emerged in neighboring North Kivu and elsewhere in the country. Ongoing monitoring and response efforts remain focused on containing spread and protecting affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラウイルスによる死者4,000人超
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクが継続中で、死者4,000人超・症例8,300人超と深刻な公衆衛生への影響があり、周辺地域への拡大も確認されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にシエラレオネ・アンゴラ・リベリア・ギニアが含まれるが、これらは2014-2016年の過去の流行への言及であり、今回のアウトブレイクの発生国はDRCのみ。2014-2016年西アフリカ流行との比較のため過去流行国名が地域リストに混入したと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Жертвите на ебола в ДР Конго надхвърлиха 4000 души
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola deaths in DR Congo surpassed 4,000.
article.articleSummary: By 2 October 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, has reached 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths, making it the fastest-growing Ebola crisis in history. The outbreak was officially declared on 15 May and has affected seven provinces and 63 health zones, with Ituri Province’s Bunia city a focal point. Despite some regional declines, WHO warns transmission continues and access to several communities remains difficult. Health authorities emphasize early detection, contact tracing, and supportive care, as there is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo. More than 50 health workers have died; a Doctors Without Borders employee was evacuated to the Netherlands after infection. A fire in a transit center in Ituri displaced about 19,000 people. The outbreak underscores challenges from conflict, resource shortages, and distrust in authorities.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ死者数が4000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が複数州に拡大し、死者4000人超・感染者8300人以上に達する史上最速の流行であり、ワクチン・治療薬未承認かつ医療従事者死亡や治安不安も伴う深刻な公衆衛生危機であるため。
triage.notes: オランダは感染した医療従事者の搬送先であり発生国ではないため除外。ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないブンディブギョ株による流行であり、致死率・拡大速度ともに極めて深刻。既にWHO等による国際的対応がなされている可能性が高いが、記事からは継続的な警戒が必要と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC cautions against premature optimism over DRC Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak remains active in 45 health zones across seven provinces despite a recent decline in reported cases. Africa CDC reports 8,224 confirmed cases and 3,982 deaths (case fatality rate 48%) as of Sept 29. The outbreak expanded from three health zones in mid-May to 63 zones, though the epidemic curve plateaued for four to five weeks and fell in the latest week, raising concerns that insecurity and community resistance are obscuring ongoing transmission. Seven zones have been without reporting for more than 42 days; 11 for 21–42 days. The outbreak has reached border areas with Uganda, Burundi, Rwanda, South Sudan, the Central African Republic, and the Republic of the Congo, underscoring cross-border coordination needs. In Ituri, cases declined ~32% in the latest three weeks; North Kivu rose ~4%. About 254 healthcare worker infections and 50 deaths; nearly 80% of new cases detected outside known contact lists; average contacts per case ~14 vs ~60 expected. UN warns escalating violence hamstrings response.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに対する早期楽観論に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: DRCで8,224症例・致死率48%の大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、国境地域への拡大や治安悪化による対応困難など国際的拡大リスクが高く、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事では隣接国（ウガンダ、ブルンジ、ルワンダ、南スーダン、中央アフリカ共和国、コンゴ共和国）との国境地域への拡大懸念が述べられているが、実際の症例発生は確認されていないため対象国として含めず。コンゴ共和国（Republic of the Congo）はDRCとは別国で対象国リストにも含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Antraks Kembali Ditemukan di Gunungkidul, Ini Penyebabnya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anthrax cases reappear in Gunungkidul; here is the cause.
article.articleSummary: Anthrax cases reappear in Gunungkidul Regency, Daerah Istimewa Yogyakarta (DIY), Indonesia, after goats that appeared weak died suddenly and were suspected to be processed and consumed by residents. Seven people in Dusun Pelem were identified as suspected cases by Semanu I Public Health Center, with epidemiological tracing identifying 47 individuals who had contact with the affected animals or their products. Four suspected/positive cases have recovered after treatment at local primary health facilities. Prophylaxis and health monitoring are being provided for suspected cases and at‑risk contacts, with ongoing epidemiological investigations to identify risk factors and potential additional cases. Monitoring will cover all contacts for two incubation periods, about 60 days. Authorities urge community education on risks of slaughtering, processing, or consuming sick or dead animals and call for improved cross‑sector coordination (village government, Department of Animal Husbandry, Puskesmas) with regular reporting to the Gunungkidul Health Office.

triage.headline_ja: グヌンキドゥルで炭疽菌の症例が再発、その原因とは
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・グヌンキドゥルで炭疽菌の再発事例が報告されているが、疑い例は7名で全員軽症・回復傾向にあり、既知の地域的な繰り返し事象であるため緊急性は低いが、接触者47名への継続監視が必要なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 炭疽菌はグヌンキドゥル地域で過去にも繰り返し発生している既知の人獣共通感染症。死亡したヤギの処理・消費が感染経路とされ、地元保健当局により接触者追跡・予防投薬・健康モニタリング（約60日間）が実施されている。人-人感染の証拠はなく、国際的な拡大リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Plague in Siberia: Woman dies of pneumonic infection at Irkutsk hospital
article.articleSummary: Suspected pneumonic plague in the Irkutsk region remains unconfirmed as of October 2, 2026. A 27-year-old employee of a plague research institute is alleged to have contracted the infection, but authorities have not confirmed plague, pneumonic form, or infection route. Shelekhov District Hospital has suspended admissions and discharges and is under quarantine. All identified close contacts are under medical observation; they show no symptoms and laboratory tests are negative. Regional authorities, including Anna Popova of Rospotrebnadzor, arrived for an emergency sanitary-epidemiological commission meeting and are implementing anti-epidemic measures. Media reports have driven the hypothesis; government sources have not confirmed the diagnosis, and some officials, like Gennady Onishchenko, consider the plague hypothesis unlikely. Pneumonic plague can spread via respiratory droplets and has a 1–3 day incubation; early antibiotic treatment is advised if suspected. Globally, WHO reports 3,860 suspected cases (2019–2025) in ten countries, with 423 deaths, mainly in DRC and Madagascar.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアでペスト疑い：イルクーツクの病院で肺炎感染症により女性死亡
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペスト疑いの未確認事例だが、研究所職員の感染・検疫実施・当局の緊急対応会議開催など社会的・行政的関心が高く、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性がある稀少感染症のためフルRRAでの確認が妥当。
triage.notes: 事例はロシア・イルクーツク州で発生しており対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。記事中のDRC・マダガスカルはWHOの世界統計（2019-2025年の疑い例）文脈での言及であり、本事例の発生国ではないため除外した。診断は未確定（当局内でも見解が分かれている）であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: സംസ്ഥാനത്ത് പകർച്ചപ്പനി രൂക്ഷം; 14‑കാരി കൂടി മരിച്ചു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe smallpox in the state; a 14-year-old girl also dies.
article.articleSummary: Severe smallpox outbreak reported in Kerala as of 2 October 2026. A 14-year-old girl from Kottoppadam-Venga in Mannarkkad taluk, Palakkad district, died after fever and loss of consciousness, despite hospital care. The state recorded nine fever-related deaths yesterday. Hospital admissions are high, with 8,407 people seeking treatment across facilities. Malappuram district now exceeds 2,000 daily cases, while Palakkad, Kasaragod, and Thiruvananthapuram districts show sharp rises. Influenza and dengue cases have also surged. Health officials blame persistent medicine shortages and delayed deliveries due to unsettled arrears, and have urged the Finance Department for an immediate 500 crore rupees. Yet procurement and tender processes may keep new stock from arriving for months, likely extending shortages through November. The situation indicates a severe febrile outbreak straining public hospitals.

triage.headline_ja: 州内で感染性発熱が深刻化；14歳の少女がさらに死亡
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州で発熱性疾患（デング熱・インフルエンザ等）の流行により死亡者・入院者が急増し、医薬品不足も深刻化しているため、WPRO基準の複数該当と社会的関心の高さからフルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 疾患タグに'Smallpox（天然痘）'とあるが、原文マラヤーラム語の『പകർച്ചപ്പനി』は『伝染性発熱』を意味し、天然痘ではなく季節性のデング熱・インフルエンザ等による発熱性疾患の流行を指していると考えられる。疾患分類は誤りの可能性が高い。医薬品不足により状況が11月まで悪化する見込みで、継続的な注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: أكثر من 4 آلاف وفاة بإيبولا في الكونغو.. والمخاوف من اتساع التفشي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 4,000 Ebola deaths in Congo, with fears of the outbreak widening.
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 2, 2026, government data show 4,018 Ebola deaths and 8,300 confirmed cases from the Bundibugyo strain in seven provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with more than 2,000 recoveries. The outbreak—the largest and most deadly in DR Congo—remains centered in Ituri and is spreading in eastern provinces, including North Kivu; Ubangi South became the seventh province to report cases last month. Fleeing thousands from the Kigonzi IDP camp in Ituri have raised concerns about wider transmission, with about 1,000 Ebola contacts living there but only roughly five traced. UNHCR reports 88 confirmed infections and 56 deaths in Congo’s camps, though actual figures may be higher. Response is hampered by overcrowding, weak health services, and decades of conflict displacing more than 5 million people in Ituri and North/South Kivu; a border crossing center for isolating suspected cases was destroyed.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱による死者4000人超…流行拡大への懸念
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行（死者4,018人、症例8,300件）が7州に拡大中で、紛争・避難民により接触者追跡が困難なため、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: DRC史上最大・最も致死的なエボラ流行とされ、IDPキャンプからの避難民による接触者追跡の困難、国境の隔離施設破壊など対応能力の限界が報告されている。続報でWHO/IHR通知状況や国際対応の詳細を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Pilibhit News : जिला कारागार में चिकन पॉक्स के 3 केस मिलने से हड़कंप, सभी बंदियों की हुई स्क्रीनिंग
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pilibhit News: Three chickenpox cases detected in the district jail spark panic; all inmates screened.
article.articleSummary: Three chickenpox cases confirmed in Pilibhit district jail, triggering screening of all inmates. The health department reports all inmates and detainees screened; so far no transmission detected outside those three. Four days earlier, one prisoner deteriorated with convulsions and fever; admitted to the jail hospital, then referred to Meerut Medical College due to limited facilities there. The next day, two more inmates developed chickenpox; all three were moved to Meerut for treatment. A jail health team reviewed the inmates' histories. All contacts have been tested. WHO has been asked to file a report. Surveillance has been stepped up; teams are active in flood-affected areas where similar infections have occurred in the past. The jail hospital doctors have been instructed to remain alert as investigations continue.

triage.headline_ja: ピリビート発:刑務所内で水痘3例確認、全収容者をスクリーニング
triage.triage_reason: 水痘は一般的な感染症で刑務所内の限定的な発生に留まり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 水痘(Varicella)は既知の一般的な感染症であり、刑務所内の局所的な小規模発生（3例）に限定され、他への感染拡大も確認されていない。公衆衛生上の重大な懸念には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo, brucia il campo sfollati di Bunia epicentro dell'Ebola: 19.000 in fuga, 1.000 contatti a rischio di contagio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Bunia IDP camp burns; Ebola epicenter: 19,000 flee, 1,000 contacts at risk of infection
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak centers on Bunia's Kigonze IDP camp in Ituri, where 19,000 people fled after soldiers clashed with residents and the camp burned, destroying a transit center for suspected cases. Health authorities report 4,018 deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces, with over 2,000 recoveries and more than 50 health workers dead. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain drives the epidemic; there is no approved vaccine or therapy, with candidates in frontline trials since September. About 1,000 contacts linked to patients were in the camp; only roughly 20% have been traced. The UN warns containment is harder as the camp is abandoned. In Butembo, a government party leader who defended the virus’s existence was killed; health workers face attacks and pay strikes; MSF evacuated an infected colleague to the Netherlands. The outbreak is the worst in DRC’s history and may surpass West Africa’s 2014-2016 toll of over 11,000; declared May 15.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：ブニアの避難民キャンプが炎上、エボラの震源地で1万9000人が避難、感染リスクのある接触者1000人
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最悪規模のエボラ流行が継続し、死者4,018人・感染者8,300人に達し、治安悪化で封じ込めが困難化、国際搬送例もあるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: オランダは国際搬送先として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれず、感染拡大の主体はDRCのため除外。治安不安（兵士との衝突、キャンプ焼失、保健従事者への攻撃）が感染対策をさらに複雑化させている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: സംസ്ഥാനത്ത് പനി ബാധിച്ച് ഒരു മരണം കൂടി; പകർച്ചപ്പനി വ്യാപനം തുടരുമ്പോഴും മരുന്ന് പ്രതിസന്ധിക്ക് അയവില്ലാതെ സർക്കാർ ആശുപത്രികൾ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One more fever-related death in the state; as measles continue to spread, government hospitals face no relief from the drug shortage.
article.articleSummary: Kerala reports another fever-related death as measles continues to spread. A 14-year-old girl from Mannarkkad died after fever; she first reached Mannarkkad taluk hospital around 8 pm, deteriorated, and died despite treatment. Yesterday, 8,407 fever cases sought care and 9 deaths were reported across the state. Malappuram district exceeds 2,000 daily fever patients, with rising case loads in Palakkad, Kasaragod, and Thiruvananthapuram. In Ottapalam, one dengue death was reported. Influenza confirmations rose to 48 yesterday, with Ernakulam recording the highest number of cases. Government hospitals face ongoing drug shortages despite the outbreaks; the health department cites supplier delays. The health department has requested 500 crore in emergency funding. KMSCL board approved re-tender for nine items, but stock delivery is expected to take up to two months; shortages could persist through November as inter-state stock coordination lags.

triage.headline_ja: 州内で発熱による死者がさらに1人、麻疹の流行が続く中でも政府病院の薬不足は改善せず
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州で発熱・デング熱・インフルエンザが同時に流行し複数死亡者が出ている一方、政府病院は深刻な薬不足に直面しており、WPRO基準を複数満たし社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はケララ州内の発熱（デング熱・インフルエンザ含む）流行と医薬品不足を主題としており、複数疾患（麻疹・インフルエンザ・デング熱）が混在して報告されている点に注意。州政府は500クロールの緊急予算を要請しており、国内レベルでの管理課題が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: le chef de la diplomatie française se rend à Kinshasa pour une visite centrée sur la lutte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: France's foreign minister travels to Kinshasa for a visit focused on the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On 2 October 2026, French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot arrives in Kinshasa for a two-day visit focused largely on the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. He will fly to Bunia in Ituri province on Saturday, the epicenter of the 17th Ebola epidemic, to meet authorities and response teams and to assess the on‑the‑ground situation amid intertwined security and humanitarian crises. Back in Kinshasa, Barrot will discuss gender-based violence with Justice Minister Guillaume Ngefa, including the case of French UNICEF worker Karine Buisset who was killed in Goma in March, reportedly by a drone strike. No audience with President Félix Tshisekedi is planned. He is also to meet MONUSCO leadership and, Saturday night, speak with his French counterpart Thérèse Wagner before departing; other topics may include investigations into opposition protests in Kinshasa and other cities.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:フランス外相がエボラ対策を中心とした訪問のためキンシャサを訪問
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で進行中の第17次エボラ流行に関する事案であり、フランス外相の訪問という形で国際的な政治・外交的関心が高まっているため、フルリスク評価に進むべきと判断。
triage.notes: 記事自体はフランス外相の外交訪問に関する内容だが、背景にあるのはイトゥリ州ブニアを震源とする進行中の第17次エボラ流行であり、治安・人道危機と絡んだ継続的な公衆衛生事案として注視が必要。フランスはBluedotの発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストに該当しないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases in QC top 5,000; weekly cases exceed threshold
article.articleSummary: Quezon City, Philippines: dengue cases reach 5,589 as of Sept. 24, 2026, with 24 dengue-related deaths (case fatality rate 0.43%). The figure is 35.01% lower than the same period last year, though weekly morbidity rose above the alert threshold. In MW 36, dengue cases totaled 356—the highest weekly count in 2026 and 44 more than MW 34’s 312; MW 37 fell to 317 but remained above the threshold. Health officials urge intensified prevention, including eliminating mosquito breeding sites and using personal protection. DOH promotes the 4Ts—Taob (turn over), Taktak (shake), Tuyo (dry), Takip (cover)—as part of the Alas Kwatro Kontra Mosquito campaign, encouraging residents to check and clean breeding sites and protect against bites at 4 p.m.

triage.headline_ja: ケソン市のデング熱症例が5,000人を超える;週間症例数が警戒閾値を上回る
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は地域的流行性疾患であり前年より症例数は減少しているが、週間症例数が警戒閾値を超えており、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱は毎年フィリピンで季節性に発生する風土病であり、今回のケースは前年比で減少しているが週間閾値超過が継続している点に留意。致死率は0.43%と比較的低い。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en la RD del Congo supera las 4.000 personas fallecidas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 4,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 deaths, with 4,018 fatalities among 8,300 laboratory-confirmed cases. The case-fatality rate is 48.4%. Recovery stands at 2,162, while 842 patients remain hospitalized or in isolation. Contact tracing coverage is 80.6%. The outbreak spans 63 health zones across seven provinces: Ituri (east, epicenter), Tshopo (center-north), Bas-Uele (north), Haut-Uele (northeast), North Kivu (east), South Kivu (east), and South Ubangi (northwest). Declared on 15 May in the eastern DRC, the epidemic continues to drive high mortality; no treatments or vaccines are mentioned in the article. Laboratory confirmation underpins the reported figures, and ongoing surveillance with contact tracing remains critical.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、死者数が4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%の大規模エボラ流行がDRCの7州63保健地域に拡大し、公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ワクチンや治療薬に関する言及がなく、致死率が極めて高い（48.4%）。7州63保健地域にまたがる大規模流行であり、続報とフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola outbreak death toll crosses 4,000 as authorities struggle to contain spread
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo's Bundibugyo virus–driven Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, centered on Bunia, has infected more than 8,300 people and killed 4,018, making it the fastest-growing Ebola epidemic on record. Declared May 15, the Bundibugyo strain has no known vaccine or treatment. Front-line health workers report funding and staffing shortages and strikes over unpaid wages, while mistrust from communities hampers contact tracing and isolation. A transit centre for patients in Ituri was burned, displacing about 19,000 people; a local politician defending government measures was killed amid outbreak tensions. WHO and Africa CDC describe mixed trends—slowing transmission in some zones but acceleration in others amid insecurity and resistance—with mid-July weekly averages around 850 cases and 470 deaths, and September about 490 cases and 230 deaths (roughly 33% increases).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行、死者4,000人を超える 当局は感染拡大の抑制に苦慮
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ株による史上最速のエボラ流行で、致死率・感染者数とも深刻かつ治安悪化により対応が困難なため、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれも複数該当する。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療法未確立のブンディブギョ株による大規模流行であり、治安悪化・住民の不信・資金不足などにより封じ込めが困難化している。WHO・Africa CDCも監視を継続中であり、フルRRAでの詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 陸多地爆豬瘟 豬農：打疫苗仍然發病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Classical swine fever outbreaks across many mainland regions; pig farmers: vaccination still results in illness.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, farmers in Guangxi, Hunan, and Jiangxi report suspected African swine fever outbreaks spanning Eastern, Southern, and Southwestern China, with mass pig deaths and herd clearance at multiple farms. In Guangxi, two outbreaks have occurred this year; vaccinated sows reportedly abort or give dead piglets, and nursing pigs fall ill. Similar patterns emerge in Hunan and Jiangxi, where large operations say vaccination does not prevent illness, with farmers naming Guangdong- and Zhongmu股份 vaccines. Official MARA notices have not acknowledged these events, aside from a September foot-and-mouth disease case in Chongqing. Some regions claim 80–90% of farms are affected, forcing low-price sales of live pigs (about 5 yuan per jin) and disposal of sick or dead animals into cold storage or sausage processing. Sausage origins reportedly include sick pigs and culled sows. No independent laboratory confirmation is available; infection sources and transmission chains remain unverified.

triage.headline_ja: 中国各地で豚コレラ（アフリカ豚熱疑い）が多発、養豚農家は「ワクチン接種しても発病する」と証言
triage.triage_reason: 広西・湖南・江西など複数地域で豚の大量死亡が報告されているが、公的機関（農業農村部）による確認がなく、独立した検査結果も存在しないため、現時点では続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 本事案は動物衛生（アフリカ豚熱・口蹄疫疑い）に関するもので、人への直接感染は報告されていない。ただし病死豚がソーセージ等食品に混入しているとの未確認情報があり、食品安全・経済的影響の観点から継続監視が必要。公的機関による公式発表・検査確認がないため、情報の信頼性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Violence Disrupts Ebola Response in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Violence disrupts Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo, halting critical services and fuelling displacement. In Ituri province, a key Ebola patient transit centre was destroyed, and thousands fled the Kigonze displacement camp after reports of military activity and gunfire. Fighting across Ituri has displaced thousands and disrupted transport of laboratory samples and Ebola patients. In North Kivu, two people involved in the Ebola response were killed. The outbreak has spread to seven provinces, with more than 8,000 confirmed infections and about 4,000 deaths reported as of 2 October 2026. The World Health Organization is expanding treatment beds, burial teams, and health facilities, but warns that more than 1,400 additional health workers are needed to scale up the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ対応が暴力により混乱
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱が7州に拡大し8,000例以上・死者約4,000人と深刻化。さらに武力衝突により対応活動（患者搬送・検体輸送・医療従事者の安全）が阻害されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 武力紛争による医療・対応インフラの破壊が感染拡大リスクを増大させており、WHOは1,400人以上の追加医療従事者が必要と表明。治安情勢の悪化が今後の対応能力に重大な影響を与える可能性が高い。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: 流感疫情未歇　出國先打疫苗　醫師籲長者防A流 - OwlNews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The influenza outbreak is not over yet; get vaccinated before traveling abroad; doctors urge the elderly to guard against influenza A.
article.articleSummary: Influenza remains prevalent in Changhua County, Taiwan, with free community vaccination starting Oct 1. The first site at Ming Sheng Temple in Pu Xin Township drew long lines of seniors 65+, amid early-season concerns. The county plans outreach from Oct 2–31, with vaccination at institutions from Oct 10, campuses from Oct 12, and kindergartens from Oct 14. Nationally, influenza A-type is dominant, with A(H1N1) accounting for about 87.7% of circulating strains; last week saw 30 severe influenza deaths, mainly among those 65+ and with chronic diseases. The outbreak began in July and persists. Typical symptoms include sudden high fever, chills, muscle/joint pains, severe headache, fatigue, plus respiratory symptoms; children more often experience vomiting/diarrhea. For travelers, Japan, Korea, and Hong Kong are in flu seasons; China and Singapore show rising activity. Vaccination about two weeks before travel is advised, and children should be vaccinated as they can spread the virus.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ流行はまだ収まっていない　海外渡航前にワクチン接種を　医師が高齢者にA型インフルエンザへの警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 台湾彰化県における季節性インフルエンザ（A型・H1N1優勢）の流行で重症死亡例が報告されているが、対象国（台湾は対象外）での主要発生は確認されず、日本・韓国・中国・シンガポールについては流行期にあるという一般的言及に留まるため、現時点では経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾（彰化県）の季節性インフルエンザ流行であり、台湾は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空とした。中国・日本・韓国・シンガポール等は渡航者向けの一般的な流行期情報として言及されているのみで、記事の主題として具体的な発生状況は記述されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Mehr als 4.000 Ebola-Tote im Kongo | Wissenschaft
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 4,000 Ebola deaths in the Congo | Science
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused more than 4,000 deaths, with 8,300 lab-confirmed cases and 4,018 fatalities reported. About 842 people are in treatment or isolation, and 2,162 have recovered; case-fatality stands at 48.4%. In the outbreak’s 20th week, cases are roughly 4.6 times higher than in the same week of the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak, and deaths are more than fourfold higher, with transmission suspected since February. For Bundibugyo ebolavirus, there is no specific vaccine or approved therapy yet; early symptoms can be mistaken for malaria, delaying isolation. Since July, two antivirals are in clinical trials, and two studies test whether Ervebo offers protection against Bundibugyo. Children are especially affected: at least 2,071 infections in those under 18 and 961 deaths, including 623 deaths in children under five; 0–4-year CFR is 61%.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ死者4,000人超 | 科学
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）アウトブレイクで死者4,000人超・致死率48.4%と深刻な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、ワクチン未承認で小児の高致死率も確認されるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスで特異的ワクチン・治療法未承認、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行と比較し症例・死者数が顕著に多い。初期症状がマラリアと類似し隔離遅延のリスクあり。Angolaは記事サマリー上で主題として言及されておらず対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola zbiera tragiczne żniwo w DRK. Ponad 4 tys. zmarłych
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola takes a tragic toll in the DRC. More than 4,000 dead.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues with over 4,000 deaths and 8,300 confirmed cases as of 2 October 2026. Centered in Ituri Province, the Bundibugyo variant drives transmission that, despite signs of slowdown in parts of Ituri, has sparked new infections in North Kivu and elsewhere. Since the start, about 2,000 patients have recovered. Reuters notes this is the worst outbreak since the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic that killed about 11,000 in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. Government and UN officials say authorities do not have full control across the country amid ongoing internal conflict, especially in the eastern regions, complicating containment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがDRCで深刻な被害をもたらす。死者4000人超
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで4,000人超の死者を出し、国内紛争により制御困難な状況にあるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: リベリア・ギニア・シエラレオネは2014-2016年の過去流行との比較として言及されているのみで、今回の発生地域ではないため除外。北キブ州への拡大も報告されており国内拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza A Sedang Meningkat di Indonesia, Ini 6 Obat Tradisional yang Ampuh Sembuhkan Flu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A cases on the rise in Indonesia: Here are six traditional remedies that effectively cure the flu.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases are rising in Indonesia, with Ministry of Health data through September 19, 2026 showing a 46% influenza positivity rate among 185 specimens in week 36 (86 positives), up from 35% the prior week. Of positives, 76 were influenza A (H1N1)pdm09, 8 were influenza A (H3N2), and 2 were influenza B (Victoria). About 42% of detections occurred in children aged 0–4 years. Influenza A, a respiratory virus, spreads primarily by droplets and continues to mutate into new variants. While flu symptoms often resolve within 7–10 days, the article highlights six traditional remedies to ease symptoms, including honey for adults and children over 1 year, vitamin C–rich oranges, and ginger (gingerol) thought to reduce infection risk. The piece references Jakarta and publicly available Kemenkes data, framing these findings within ongoing Indonesia-wide surveillance.

triage.notes: 既知の季節性インフルエンザウイルス（H1N1pdm09、H3N2、Bビクトリア）による陽性率上昇であり、Kemenkesのサーベイランスデータに基づく通常の季節的報告。重症例・死亡例の情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, oltre 4 mila morti e un centro per le cure incendiato: dal G20 470 milioni, 10 dall'Italia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, more than 4,000 deaths and a treatment center burned: 470 million from the G20, 10 from Italy.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. As of October 2, 2026, 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths across seven provinces, up from 8,067 infections and 3,901 deaths on September 26. A transit center for Ebola patients at Kigonze in Bunia, Ituri, was burned during a Congolese military operation, displacing about 19,000 people and hindering surveillance, case finding, and care. Tracing contacts and reconstructing transmission chains will be harder amid mass movements. Transmission has slowed in parts of Ituri but remains active in eastern DRC; Africa CDC cautions against declaring a general decline due to regional differences and access challenges. International response includes over $470 million pledged by the G20 and donors (US$267m, World Bank $90m, UK £67.5m, Germany €24.8m, Korea $18m, France €16m); Italy adds €10m (total now €12.8m) for vaccines trials and essential supplies. No Bundibugyo-specific vaccine exists; Ervebo targets Zaire ebolavirus, with uncertain human protection; trials ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、死者4,000人超・治療センター焼失:G20から4億7,000万ドル、うちイタリアから1,000万ユーロ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）大規模アウトブレイクで8,300症例・4,018死亡、治療センター焼失による監視・対応の悪化、国際的な大規模資金拠出があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: 韓国、米国、イタリア、フランス、ドイツ、英国は資金拠出国として言及されているのみで、発生地域ではないためverified_locationsから除外。ワクチン（Ervebo）はザイール型対象でブンディブギョ型への有効性は不明との記載あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola goes after Congo's children, killing an average of seven daily
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo continues to hit children hard. Since May 15, 2026, about 2,071 children under 18 have contracted Ebola, with 961 deaths, averaging seven child fatalities per day. About two-thirds of child deaths occur in children under five, roughly 623 fatalities. The overall outbreak figures from Congo’s health ministry show 4,018 deaths among 8,300 cases since May 15. The case fatality rate for children aged 0–4 is 61%, higher than the overall outbreak CFR of 48%. Save the Children cites MOH figures and urges stronger protection for the youngest children as the outbreak expands across eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、コンゴの子どもたちを襲う―1日平均7人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で進行中のエボラ流行は致死率48%（小児0-4歳では61%）と極めて深刻で、感染拡大・公衆衛生への重大な影響があり、国際支援の必要性も示唆されるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 死亡者数8,300例中4,018人、致死率48%と非常に高く、特に小児の被害が深刻。Save the Childrenが国際的な支援・保護強化を訴えている。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果東部叛軍控制區再傳疫情　通報新增6起伊波拉病例 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Eastern Congo's rebel-controlled areas report another outbreak, with six new Ebola cases - Minshi News Network
article.articleSummary: Six new Ebola cases were reported in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo’s rebel‑controlled North Kivu and South Kivu, with the transmission traced to the government‑controlled city of Butembo. The AFC/M23 rebel group, which seized large swaths of North and South Kivu last year, had previously claimed no outbreak, but confirmed cases reappeared in Kayna health zone in early September. A Kayna patient recovered after 26 days in a treatment center and was discharged. On Friday, rebels announced two new Kayna cases and four in Alimbongo Health Zone near Lubero, close to frontline clashes. All six belong to the same transmission chain; four were diagnosed post‑mortem from community deaths, while two are in isolation as contact tracing continues. As of 2026-10-02, DR Congo has reported more than 8,300 cases and over 4,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部の反乱軍支配地域で再び疫病発生、エボラ新規6症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部の紛争地域でエボラの新規感染連鎖が確認され、累計8,300症例・4,000人超の死者という大規模流行が継続中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 反乱軍（AFC/M23）支配地域での感染確認・接触者追跡が困難であり、紛争による対応制約が感染拡大リスクを高めている。死後診断された症例が含まれる点からサーベイランスの不備も示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Rebel-held eastern Congo records six new Ebola cases
article.articleSummary: Six new Ebola cases were recorded on Friday in rebel-held North and South Kivu, Congo, with two in Kayna and four in Alimbongo near Lubero. All six belong to the same transmission chain stemming from a case that came from the city of Butembo in government-held territory. Four cases were identified through post-mortem testing of people who died in the community, while the other two patients are receiving treatment at Ebola treatment centres. A Kayna case diagnosed in early September was discharged after spending 26 days there. Rebels had declared areas Ebola-free in late June, but the outbreak, declared May 15, has now caused more than 4,000 deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases, according to government data released on Friday. The health zones are near the front line with government forces, and contact tracing is underway.

triage.headline_ja: 反政府勢力支配下の東コンゴでエボラ新規6例を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラアウトブレイクが8,300例・4,000人超の死亡に達し、反政府勢力支配地域という複雑な情勢下で感染連鎖が継続しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 既存の大規模エボラアウトブレイク(2026年5月15日宣言)の継続事例。反政府勢力支配地域と政府支配地域の境界で発生しており、紛争下でのアクセス制限・接触者追跡の困難さが懸念される。一度エボラフリー宣言された地域での再燃という点も異常性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Rebel-Held Eastern Congo Records Six New Ebola Cases
article.articleSummary: Six new Ebola cases (Bundibugyo strain) were recorded in rebel-held eastern Congo areas of North and South Kivu, specifically Kayna and Alimbongo health zones near Lubero, with investigations showing the six are part of a single transmission chain originating from a case in Butembo in government-held territory. Four cases were identified through post-mortem testing; two patients are currently in treatment. The rebels, who control large swaths of the region, had declared Ebola-free in late June after previously reporting only four cases, and had discharged an active case on Tuesday after 26 days at Kayna treatment center. Contact tracing efforts are underway. Since the outbreak was declared May 15, government data released on Friday report more than 4,000 deaths among about 8,300 confirmed cases as of Oct 2, 2026.

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa aprova medicamento para tratar esquistossomose em crianças a partir de 3 meses | Só Notícia Boa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa approves a medication to treat schistosomiasis in children from 3 months of age | Só Notícia Boa
article.articleSummary: Anvisa approves Farmanguinhos Arpraziquantel for schistosomiasis in children from 3 months to 6 years. Produced by Farmanguinhos/Fiocruz, the 150 mg dispersible tablet dissolves in water and targets Schistosoma mansoni and Schistosoma haematobium. This pediatric formulation fills a gap, as Brazil’s SUS previously used praziquantel 600 mg tablets unsuitable for under 2 years. The approval expands treatment options for young children, with trials conducted in endemic regions and efficacy/safety assessed in Bahia and Sergipe. Schistosomiasis is contracted by contact with freshwater containing infected snails (caramujos) and remains a neglected tropical disease linked to poor sanitation. In Brazil, about 1.5 million people live in risk areas. The drug’s mechanism paralyzes and damages the parasite, aiding clearance; registration approved by Anvisa, but not yet giving a rollout date.

article.articleHeadline: Kunjungan RS Naik 30 Persen, Dinkes Kuningan Sebut Belum Tentu Kasus Influenza A |Republika Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hospital visits rise 30 percent, Kuningan Health Office says not necessarily Influenza A cases | Republika Online
article.articleSummary: Kuningan Regency, Indonesia: hospital visits have risen about 30% recently, but the Health Office cautions this does not confirm an Influenza A surge. Health Office head Edi Martono says laboratory confirmation is required to attribute illnesses to Influenza A, as symptoms overlap with other respiratory infections and cannot be diagnosed clinically. Influenza testing needs lab work, including prior COVID-19 testing, which can be costly. The transitional weather period (pancaroba) can trigger coughs and colds, and the increased visits involve various conditions, not solely influenza. Public should not panic; seek care if symptoms worsen or shortness of breath develops. Authorities emphasize interpreting the rise proportionally while awaiting laboratory results to confirm any Influenza A cases.

triage.notes: ラボ確定前の段階であり、季節の変わり目（pancaroba）による呼吸器症状増加の可能性も示唆されている。確定診断待ちのため続報を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: 流感疫情未歇　出國先打疫苗　醫師籲長者防A流
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The flu outbreak is not over yet; vaccinate before traveling abroad; doctors urge seniors to protect against Influenza A.
article.articleSummary: Changhua County, Taiwan, launched public-funded influenza and COVID-19 vaccination on Oct 2, beginning at Ming Sheng Temple in Puxin Township where many seniors (65+) queued. The flu season started early, continuing since July, with Influenza A dominating; circulating A(H1N1) strains account for about 87.7%. National data report 30 severe influenza deaths last week, predominantly among elderly and those with chronic diseases. Typical symptoms include sudden high fever, chills, myalgias, severe headache, fatigue, plus cough, sore throat, runny nose; children are more prone to vomiting and diarrhea. The vaccination campaign runs Oct 1 onward: vaccines available at contracted clinics and health centers; community clinics Oct 2–31; workplaces Oct 10; schools Oct 12; kindergartens Oct 14. For travelers abroad, especially seniors and chronically ill, vaccination about two weeks before departure is advised due to rising activity in Japan, Korea, Hong Kong, and increasing trends in China and Singapore.

The article does not provide details on infection source, laboratory confirmation beyond confirmed cases, or data on imported or exported cases. These figures reflect the situation as of the publication date 2026-10-02 and highlight the continuing public health challenge posed by Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

article.articleHeadline: RDC : Ebola franchit la barre des 4 000 morts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Ebola crosses the 4,000-death threshold.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo virus) has surpassed 4,000 deaths, with 4,018 fatalities among 8,300 laboratory-confirmed cases as of Oct 2, 2026, spanning seven provinces (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, Tshopo, Sud-Ubangi). Declared May 15, 2026, it is the largest and deadliest outbreak in the DRC, with a case fatality rate of 48.4%. MSF warns the official tally likely underestimates the true burden due to surveillance gaps; about 68% of Ebola deaths occur in the community. Approximately 2,162 recovered and 842 currently isolated or hospitalized; contact tracing coverage 80.6%. Vaccination with Ervebo, effective against Zaire ebolavirus, is not approved for Bundibugyo and is used only in research protocols. Key response remains early detection, isolation, supportive care, safe burials, and follow-up of contacts, though insecurity and distrust hinder control.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ出血熱の死者数が4,000人の大台を突破
triage.triage_reason: DRC最大規模のエボラ（Bundibugyoウイルス）流行で致死率48.4%、7州に拡大しており、ワクチン未承認・治安不安など対応困難な要素が多い重大な公衆衛生事案。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoウイルスに対する承認済みワクチンがなく、研究プロトコルのみでの使用に限定されている点、コミュニティでの死亡が68%を占める点が流行制御上の重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Dokter RS Pertamina Balikpapan Beber Kelompok Rentan yang Berisiko Terkena Influenza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pertamina Hospital Balikpapan Doctor Reveals Vulnerable Groups at Risk of Influenza
article.articleSummary: Influenza is a viral disease caused by diverse influenza viruses, with presentations that can be seasonal or occur year-round. In Balikpapan, East Kalimantan, Indonesia, Dr. Rony Kharisma, a general practitioner and head of the OHIH at Pertamina Balikpapan Hospital, says all ages are at risk, though children and the elderly are more susceptible to influenza-related respiratory complications due to developing lungs and aging physiology. The public is urged to remain vigilant as respiratory disturbances rise in the surrounding environment. Poor air quality, including haze from smoke, can exacerbate risks, as airborne particles may contribute to influenza. The discussion, reported on October 2, 2026, emphasizes environmental health and targeted protection for vulnerable populations, without citing specific case counts or laboratory confirmations.

article.articleHeadline: RD Congo : le ministre Jean-Noël Barrot attendu pour soutenir la lutte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Minister Jean-Noël Barrot expected to back the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo is contending with its 17th Ebola outbreak. Health authorities have deployed mobile laboratories in the eastern region to accelerate screening, aiming to produce results in under 24 hours to improve isolation and contact tracing. Frontline workers face distrust and attacks on health facilities, complicating containment and care. The article notes no specific case counts or fatalities. French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot is expected to visit the DRC to express France's support for authorities and humanitarian workers and bolster international engagement in the outbreak response. Ongoing international engagement underscores continued support for the outbreak response.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola deaths in the DR Congo hits 4000 mark
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, has killed more than 4,000 people with about 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces and over 2,000 recoveries since it began in May. It is the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in DR Congo and the world’s second-largest after 2014–2016 West Africa. Médecins Sans Frontières warns the true toll may be higher due to insecurity and surveillance gaps hampering case detection. An MSF staff member responding to the outbreak has tested positive and is being evacuated to the Netherlands. Separately, a fire destroyed a key Ebola treatment transit center at the Kigonze displacement camp in Ituri province, prompting thousands to flee in eastern DR Congo. The UN notes escalating violence in eastern Congo disrupts the response, and mass displacement could complicate contact tracing and transmission containment.

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Lito Souza: Brasil teve 547 casos confirmados em 16 anos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lito Souza's Disease: Brazil had 547 confirmed cases in 16 years.
article.articleSummary: Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease (CJD) in Brazil: Influencer and airplane specialist Lito Sousa died at 59, weeks after diagnosis. CJD is a rare, invariably fatal prion disease and has been a notifiable illness in Brazil since 2005. National surveillance logged 1,576 suspected cases from 2005–2021 across the country, with São Paulo reporting 512 (32.5%), Paraná 189 (12%), and Minas Gerais 158 (10%). Of those suspected, 547 were confirmed by testing, led by São Paulo with 202 cases (37%), Minas Gerais 57 (10%), and Paraná 44 (8%). Underdiagnosis and underreporting are acknowledged due to rarity and diagnostic risks; confirmation typically requires brain biopsy, usually post-mortem. Prions cause cognitive and movement symptoms; there is no cure, and about 90% die within one year of symptom onset. Most cases are sporadic (~85%), with rare familial; occupational exposure is uncommon, and foodborne transmission from bovine prion disease is not known in Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: リト・ソウザ病：ブラジルでは16年間で547例が確定診断された（クロイツフェルト・ヤコブ病）
triage.triage_reason: 有名人の死去を契機とした過去16年間のCJD確定症例数に関する統計報道であり、新規の異常発生やアウトブレイクを示すものではなく、散発性症例として既知の管理下にある。
triage.notes: CJDは致死率が高い疾患だが、本記事は著名人の死去報道に付随した過去の国家サーベイランスデータ（2005-2021年）の紹介であり、散発性(約85%)で牛由来のプリオン病（BSE）との関連も確認されていない。ヒトーヒト感染や新規アウトブレイクの兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Gia Lai giám sát người phơi nhiễm sau khi phát hiện ca bệnh Whitmore
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gia Lai monitors exposed individuals after identification of a melioidosis case.
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis (Burkholderia pseudomallei) case identified in Gia Lai Province, Vietnam. A 47-year-old male farmer from Ple Oi hamlet, Chư A Thai commune, developed fever, rigors, cough, dyspnea and chest pain on 7 Sept after injuring his left thumb washing a rainwater barrel. Blood culture on 23 Sept confirmed Burkholderia pseudomallei; diagnosis: septicemia due to melioidosis. He was transferred to Gia Lai General Hospital on 24 Sept; condition stable at reporting. Epidemiology linked exposure to farming with overnight stays in a shack in a rubber garden near the Chu Se Pass, 4 km from home; frequent contact with soil, mud and rainwater without boots or gloves; damp with two stagnant pools. Interventions included Chloramin B disinfection, water treatment, removal of standing water, and health education. Exposed contacts monitored for 21 days; no additional cases detected. Authorities urge protective gear for those in soil/water and prompt reporting of fever, pneumonia or abscess.

triage.headline_ja: ザーライ省、類鼻疽（ホイットモア病）症例確認後、曝露者を監視
triage.triage_reason: 単発の類鼻疽（土壌・水由来の非伝染性感染症）症例であり、ヒト-ヒト感染のリスクがなく、既に21日間の接触者監視で追加症例なし。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de ebola no Congo ultrapassa 4 mil mortes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo surpasses 4,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has reached 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths across seven provinces, with more than 2,000 recoveries. As of Oct 2, 2026, transmission persists in eastern DRC, though authorities note signs of reduced spread in Ituri, where the outbreak began, while it has spread to North Kivu. Ubangi-Sud in the northwest declared a seventh province outbreak after a man who had traveled from the east died. The current outbreak is the largest in Congo’s history, surpassing the 2018–2020 epidemic, and is second only to West Africa’s 2014–2016 outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) in total impact. Figures come from the Congolese government and the United Nations.

article.articleHeadline: Cricket match held in Coimbatore to raise awareness of dengue prevention
article.articleSummary: Dengue prevention awareness event in Coimbatore: On October 1, 2026, the Coimbatore Corporation organized a cricket match at the Kumarasamy Lake multi-sports turf in R.S. Puram to promote dengue prevention. The game opened with a pledge against dengue; teams represented the Aedes mosquito and public health measures. Posters at the venue highlighted breeding sources such as coconut shells, discarded tyres, and containers. The public health team batted first after winning the toss, with the Aedes mosquito team chasing the target. The initiative attracted youths and educated spectators on eliminating breeding sites and preventive practices. Similar dengue-awareness cricket matches are planned at schools, colleges, and other public spaces in coming days, according to the corporation. No dengue case data or laboratory confirmation is reported in connection with this event.

article.articleHeadline: Video. Mobile ebola laboratory cuts diagnosis times for patients in Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola testing via a mobile laboratory deployed in Butembo, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, accelerates diagnosis. The truck-based facility, equipped with a negative-pressure system, tests suspected Ebola samples on-site near affected communities. Results previously taking up to 72 hours are now available within 24 hours, and in some cases as quickly as six hours. The mobile unit can be relocated to outbreak hotspots to maintain rapid testing and improve patient triage and timely treatment. The report does not provide case or death counts. This approach supports faster laboratory confirmation of Ebola infection and helps guide public health responses, communications, and infection control measures during evolving outbreaks.

article.articleHeadline: Video. In Congo il laboratorio mobile per l'ebola accelera le diagnosi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video. In Congo the mobile laboratory for Ebola speeds up diagnoses.
article.articleSummary: Mobile Ebola laboratory in Butembo, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, speeds up diagnoses by testing samples from suspected cases within a truck-based facility featuring a negative-pressure system to protect staff and the surrounding environment. The mobile unit can be relocated to other outbreak areas to bring testing closer to affected communities. Diagnostics that formerly took up to 72 hours are now delivered in 24 hours, and in some cases as quickly as six hours. Faster results enable prompt patient triage, expedite referral to appropriate care, and ensure confirmed cases receive treatment sooner. The initiative highlights how moving diagnostic capacity closer to outbreaks can improve response efficiencies in the DRC’s Ebola surveillance.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video: Mobile Ebola laboratory in Congo significantly shortens patients' time to diagnosis.
article.articleSummary: Mobile Ebola laboratory in Butembo, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, significantly shortens diagnostic turnaround for suspected cases. Technicians operate inside a truck-based unit equipped with a negative-pressure system that protects staff and the surrounding community. The mobile facility can be relocated to other outbreak-affected areas, enabling testing nearer to affected populations. The unit has reduced results time: previously up to 72 hours, now within 24 hours, and in some cases as quick as six hours. Faster testing directs patients to appropriate care centers earlier and accelerates access to treatment for confirmed Ebola cases, improving outbreak response and management in the region.

article.articleHeadline: Vídeo. Congo: laboratório móvel de ébola acelera diagnósticos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video. Congo: Mobile Ebola Laboratory Speeds Up Diagnoses.
article.articleSummary: Mobile Ebola laboratory in Butembo, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, speeds up diagnostics by testing samples in trucks with negative-pressure systems to protect staff and surroundings. The relocatable unit can be moved to outbreak hotspots, enabling testing near affected communities. Turnaround times have dropped from as long as 72 hours to under 24 hours, and in some cases as quick as six hours. Faster results allow timely patient referral to appropriate care and earlier treatment for confirmed cases, potentially reducing transmission. The mobile facility demonstrates flexible, field-based Ebola diagnostics during ongoing outbreaks in the region, improving rapid deployment and shortening the interval between sample collection and public health action.

article.articleHeadline: Genetic Typing of Tuberculosis Isolates in Kerala Reveals Rare BCG Disease
article.articleSummary: In Kerala, India, a retrospective study of 239 MTBC isolates (2017–2024) using gyrB PCR-RFLP and RD1/RD4 markers finds 232 (97.1%) M. tuberculosis and 7 (2.9%) M. bovis BCG. No wild-type M. bovis or M. orygis detected. Four BCG isolates come from vaccinated children (including disseminated disease in some cases) and three from adults receiving intravesical BCG therapy for bladder cancer, highlighting that BCG infection can occur in both vaccination and therapy contexts. M. bovis BCG is naturally resistant to pyrazinamide, impacting standard four-drug regimens and treatment duration. This marks the first species-level MTBC map for Kerala, suggesting human-to-human transmission dominates locally with no zoonotic MTBC detected in this cohort. The approach—PCR-RFLP of gyrB plus RD1/RD4 assays—provides rapid, cost-effective speciation with important implications for laboratory workflows and clinical management in tuberculosis care and public health surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州における結核分離株の遺伝子型別検査で稀なBCG病が明らかに
triage.triage_reason: 過去8年分(2017-2024)の後方視的な菌種同定研究であり、新規アウトブレイクや急性の公衆衛生リスクを示すものではない。BCGワクチン/治療由来の稀な症例報告であり、流行や拡大の兆候はない。
triage.notes: 本研究はMTBC株の種同定（検査手法論文）が主題であり、BCG関連の稀な症例（ワクチン接種児・膀胱癌治療患者）の報告にとどまる。人獣共通感染（M. bovis野生型等）は検出されておらず、アウトブレイクの性質はない。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Les confessions religieuses s'engagent davantage dans la lutte contre Ebola en RDC | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Religious denominations are stepping up their involvement in the fight against Ebola in the DRC | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Religious leaders in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have agreed to intensify their involvement in the Ebola response with a common roadmap devised during a Kinshasa forum on October 1, with simultaneous sessions in Bunia and Beni, led by Caritas Congo ASBL. Under the SHIELD project, with financial support from Catholic Relief Services and Caritas Internationalis, the plan assigns actions, responsibilities, and deadlines to mobilize faith communities nationwide. Key measures include raising awareness among adherents about prevention, encouraging prompt medical care for suspected cases, discouraging self-medication, and promoting safe funeral practices in collaboration with health teams. Leaders also pledged to counter rumors, misinformation, stigma, and discrimination toward patients, survivors, families, and health workers, and to urge communities to rely on official health authorities. The 29 September update notes the response in 7 provinces and 63 health zones, totaling 8,224 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases.

triage.headline_ja: ニュース | コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ対策に宗教団体がさらに関与を強化 | mediacongo.net
triage.triage_reason: DRCで7州63保健地域にわたり8,224例の検査確定エボラ症例が報告されている大規模進行中のアウトブレイクに関する続報であり、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事自体は宗教団体による対応強化の報道だが、背景にあるエボラアウトブレイク（8,224例確認、7州63保健地域）は既に大規模かつ継続中であり、フルリスク評価の対象として扱うべき。

article.articleHeadline: In a drier world, some infectious diseases are unexpectedly thriving
article.articleSummary: New research synthesized nearly 100 studies to show that drier conditions, driven by warming, can intensify some infectious diseases while suppressing others. The drought-disease paradox notes that water scarcity often concentrates hosts and vectors at remaining water sources, boosting transmission. In California, droughts contributed to thousands of valley fever cases, and a 2014 drought correlated with West Nile virus spikes; a 2017 Somalia drought led to about 80,000 cholera cases and over 1,000 deaths. In Brazil, dengue risk rises in the months after drought. By contrast, prolonged drought can curb certain pathogens, or alter water chemistry to be hostile (hotter, saltier, low oxygen), and even eliminate organisms like Vibrio vulnificus after long droughts. Globally, about 77% of land is drier than 30 years ago. The study highlights the role of animal movements around shrinking water sources in shaping outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 乾燥が進む世界で、一部の感染症が予想外に拡大している
triage.triage_reason: 特定の現在進行中のアウトブレイクではなく、乾燥と感染症の関連性に関する研究総説記事であり、具体的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態の報告ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は気候変動と感染症の関係性に関する学術研究（約100件の研究を統合したレビュー）を紹介する科学解説記事であり、特定の国における現在進行中のアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。カリフォルニア（渓谷熱、2014年の西ナイルウイルス）、ソマリア（2017年のコレラ流行）、ブラジル（干ばつ後のデング熱リスク）は過去の事例・一般的傾向として言及されているのみで、現時点での緊急シグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: AAJI Sebut Ada Peningkatan Klaim di Beberapa Asuransi Jiwa Akibat Kasus Influenza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: AAJI says there has been an increase in claims at several life insurers due to influenza cases.
article.articleSummary: Influenza cases have risen in Indonesia in recent weeks, though the Health Ministry says the situation remains within alert range and not yet worrisome. The Indonesian Life Insurance Association (AAJI) notes the uptick corresponds with higher life-insurance claims, though not at a mass level. Allianz Life Indonesia reported influenza-related claims from January 2026 through the second week of September 2026 totaling over Rp 13.8 billion for 1,857 cases, with hospitalizations up 47% year-on-year from January–August 2026. OJK says no industry data on influenza claim increases has been received yet, but monitoring will continue. Vaccination and government preventive measures are expected to curb the surge and limit health-insurance impact. Influenza A is the primary strain to watch, with symptoms such as fever, cough, sore throat, and fatigue; complications may include pneumonia, bronchitis, and pharyngitis. High-risk groups include children, the elderly, pregnant women, and those with chronic disease or weakened immunity.

triage.headline_ja: AAJI、インフルエンザ症例増加により一部生命保険で保険金請求が増加していると発表
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザ症例・入院の増加が報告されているが、保健省は「警戒範囲内」とし深刻な公衆衛生上の異常とは位置付けていないため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（Influenza A）の症例・入院増加に伴う保険金請求増加に関する経済・保険業界視点の記事。保健当局は警戒レベルで深刻視しておらず、WHO通知相当の基準には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'épidémie d'Ebola franchit le seuil des 4 000 morts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Ebola outbreak crosses the 4,000-death threshold.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 deaths. As of October 1, INSP reports 4,018 fatalities among 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, Tshopo and Sud-Ubangi. Case fatality is 48.4%; 2,162 recovered and 842 currently hospitalized or in isolation; contact tracing coverage at 80.6%. Declared in May, the outbreak caused by Ebola Bundibugyo virus is the deadliest in the DRC, with ongoing geographic spread though transmission slows in some areas. Public health actions include intensified religious-led outreach; Kinshasa Caritas discussions to improve prevention messaging and reduce stigma, led by Mgr Donatien Nshole (CENCO). Campaigns in Bunia reach over 2,000 students; in Butembo, elders disseminate prevention messages. Media in Beni receive training to counter misinformation. G20 presidency announced over $470 million in new aid, boosting total international commitments to over $2 billion to support treatment centers, safe burials, PPE, surveillance, and contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラ出血熱の流行が死者4,000人の閾値を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは死者4,000人超・致死率48.4%と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、複数州への地理的拡大が継続しているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: DRCで5月に宣言されたエボラ・ブンディブジョウイルスによる流行は同国史上最悪とされ、7州に拡大中。G20による4.7億ドル超の追加支援を含む国際支援総額が20億ドルを超えており、既にフルRRA及び継続的モニタリング対象と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Βίντεο. Κινητό εργαστήριο για τον Έμπολα μειώνει τον χρόνο διάγνωσης ασθενών στο Κονγκό

article.articleSummary: Mobile Ebola laboratory in Butembo, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, dramatically shortens diagnostic turnaround. Healthcare workers in Butembo use a field unit housed inside trucks with a negative-pressure system to test samples from suspected Ebola cases, protecting staff and the surrounding environment. The unit can be relocated to other outbreak areas as needed, ensuring testing is closer to affected communities. Diagnostics that previously required up to 72 hours are now available within 24 hours, and in some cases as quickly as six hours. Faster results direct patients to the appropriate care and enable confirmed cases to receive treatment earlier, improving patient outcomes and outbreak response in the region.

triage.triage_reason: DRC東部ブテンボでのエボラ対応能力（移動式検査室）に関する報道であり、新規感染拡大や症例急増を示す情報はないが、エボラという疾患の性質上、背景にある流行状況の継続を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行への対応能力強化（移動式検査室の導入）に関する内容であり、新規症例数や感染拡大の具体的情報は含まれていない。既存のDRCにおけるエボラ流行状況の一環として経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Vídeo. Un laboratorio móvil de ébola reduce el tiempo de diagnóstico de los pacientes en Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video. A mobile Ebola laboratory reduces patients' time to diagnosis in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Mobile Ebola laboratory deployed in Butembo, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, dramatically shortens diagnostic times. Healthcare workers operate inside mobile trucks with negative-pressure systems to protect staff and the surrounding environment. The unit can be relocated to outbreak sites to perform testing closer to affected communities. Tests, which previously took up to 72 hours, now yield results within 24 hours, and in some cases as quickly as six hours. Faster laboratory confirmation guides patients to appropriate medical care and allows confirmed cases to begin treatment sooner. By bringing testing to the field, this mobile setup supports flexible outbreak response and reduces delays in diagnosis and potential transmission. The article does not provide specific case counts.

triage.headline_ja: 動画：エボラ出血熱の移動式検査室がコンゴ(DRC)で患者の診断時間を短縮
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州ブテンボでのエボラ対応能力向上（移動検査室導入）に関する報道だが、新規症例数や発生状況の具体的なデータが示されておらず、現時点での新規アウトブレイク発生の確認情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部ブテンボにおけるエボラ診断用移動検査室の導入による診断時間短縮（72時間→24時間、最短6時間）を報じているが、具体的な症例数やアウトブレイクの規模・発生状況については言及がない。エボラは既知の高リスク病原体であり継続的なモニタリングが必要だが、本記事単独では新規シグナルとしてのフルリスク評価移行の根拠は不十分。

article.articleHeadline: فيديو. مختبر متنقل للكشف عن إيبولا يقلص زمن تشخيص المرضى في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video: A mobile laboratory for detecting Ebola shortens the time to diagnose patients in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: A mobile Ebola testing laboratory in Butembo, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, uses trucks with negative-pressure systems to safely process samples from suspected Ebola cases. The portable facility can be relocated to outbreak sites, bringing diagnostics closer to affected communities. By shortening transport and processing times, it now provides diagnostic results within 24 hours, and in some cases as quickly as six hours, down from about 72 hours. Faster results enable rapid triage and referral to appropriate medical care, allowing confirmed patients to begin treatment sooner and reducing transmission risk. The mobile lab’s adaptability supports deployments to new hotspots as outbreaks evolve, enhancing surveillance and response in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 動画：移動式エボラ検査ラボがコンゴの患者診断時間を短縮
triage.triage_reason: エボラは重大疾患であり継続監視が必要だが、本記事はDRC東部での既存アウトブレイク対応における診断技術の改善を報じるものであり、新規発生や異常事態を示す情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事はブテンボにおける移動式エボラ検査ラボの導入による診断時間短縮の技術報道であり、新規症例数や流行規模、死亡者数などの疫学情報は含まれていない。既存のエボラ流行への対応改善として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: ویدیوها. آزمایشگاه سیار ابولا زمان تشخیص بیماران در کنگو را کاهش می‌دهد
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Videos. The mobile Ebola laboratory reduces the time to diagnose patients in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Mobile Ebola laboratory in Butembo, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, markedly shortens diagnostic time for suspected Ebola cases. Inside specially equipped trucks, technicians operate with negative-pressure systems to protect staff and the surrounding environment. The mobile unit can be relocated during new outbreak waves, bringing testing closer to affected communities. Tests that previously took up to 72 hours are now available within 24 hours, and in some cases as quick as six hours. Faster diagnostics help guide patient care and enable confirmed cases to receive treatment sooner. This movable laboratory capacity strengthens outbreak response by delivering rapid laboratory confirmation near communities in eastern DRC, supporting timely isolation, triage, and treatment during Ebola outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 動画：モバイル・エボラ検査室がコンゴの患者診断時間を短縮
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱に関する報道だが、内容は新規検査機材の導入による診断迅速化に関するもので、新規症例数や発生状況の急変を示す情報はないため、継続的な経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部での既存のエボラ対応体制強化（移動式検査室）に関する内容であり、新規アウトブレイクや症例急増の情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Видео. Мобильная лаборатория по выявлению Эболы сокращает время диагностики пациентов в Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video: A mobile laboratory for Ebola detection reduces the time to diagnosis for patients in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Mobile laboratory in Butembo, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, sharply shortens Ebola diagnostics by bringing testing closer to communities. Technicians operate inside specially equipped trucks with negative-pressure systems to protect staff and the surrounding environment. The mobile unit is readily transportable to other districts as needed, enabling on-site analyses for suspected Ebola cases. Diagnostic results are now available within 24 hours, and in some instances as quickly as six hours, down from previous turnaround times of up to 72 hours. This acceleration facilitates faster triage and directs patients to appropriate treatment sooner, potentially improving outcomes for confirmed Ebola cases and enabling earlier initiation of therapy. The approach enhances outbreak responsiveness by decentralizing laboratory capacity and reducing delays between sample collection and diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: 動画：移動式エボラ診断ラボがコンゴの患者の診断時間を短縮
triage.triage_reason: エボラ自体の新規発生や感染拡大に関する情報ではなく、診断体制改善を伝える内容だが、コンゴ東部のエボラ流行継続を示唆するため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行対応の技術的改善（移動式検査ラボ）を報じるもので、新規症例数や発生状況の詳細は記載されていない。既知のDRCにおけるエボラ流行の継続的な文脈として扱うべき。

article.articleHeadline: Medicamento para esquistossomose em crianças recebe aprovação da Anvisa | Portal Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Drug for Schistosomiasis in Children Receives ANVISA Approval | Fiocruz Portal
article.articleSummary: Anvisa authorized on 29 September the registration of arpraziquantel, a pediatric formulation for schistosomiasis in preschool children (3–6 years). The therapy will be included in Brazil’s SUS catalog and produced by Fiocruz via a technology transfer with Merck, in the 150 mg dispersible oral tablet form designed to be palatable, water-dispersible, and resilient to heat and humidity in tropical endemic settings. An adult praziquantel formulation has been provided by Farmanguinhos/Fiocruz since 1996. The Consórcio Praziquantel Pediátrico led development to address treatment gaps for children. International recognition includes EMA’s favorable opinion (December 2023) and WHO prequalification (May 2024); since 2025, the drug has been used in Uganda and other Sub-Saharan Africa under the ADOPT program to assess incorporation into health systems. Schistosomiasis, a neglected tropical disease caused by Schistosoma, spreads via contaminated freshwater and predominantly affects children; the effort aims to expand access and progress toward elimination by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: 小児用住血吸虫症治療薬、ANVISA(ブラジル国家衛生監督庁)の承認を取得 | Fiocruzポータル
triage.triage_reason: 医薬品承認に関する行政・製薬ニュースであり、新規感染症の発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: ウガンダは薬剤使用プログラム(ADOPT)の文脈で言及されているが、記事の主題はブラジルでの薬事承認であり、ウガンダでの発生事例を報告するものではないため除外。対象国リストにウガンダは含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Глава Бурятии в своём канале в Max подтвердил смерть лаборантки в Иркутской области от чумы. В Telegram он назвал эту причину смерти предположительной - ЭХО
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The head of the Republic of Buryatia confirmed in his Max channel the death of a laboratory technician in Irkutsk Oblast from plague. On Telegram he called this cause of death tentative — ECHO.
article.articleSummary: Darya Shipilova, 28, a laboratory technician at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute, died October 2 in Irkutsk Oblast after a vial containing the pneumonic plague agent (Yersinia pestis) shattered on September 25. Rospotrebnadzor and the Republic of Buryatia government say she did not travel to Buryatia; there are no plague foci in Buryatia, including near the Mongolia border, and the infection source is not linked to Buryatia. About 200 people who had contact with Shipilova have been placed under quarantine and are being tested. The Shchelkhov District Hospital quarantined several departments due to a reported 'highly dangerous infection,' with authorities not disclosing the disease. Mash Telegram channel reported she was connected to the anti-plague institute and had recently returned from a trip to Buryatia near Mongolia; another health source says she returned from Thailand. The case concerns pneumonic plague; investigations into exposure source are ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: ブリヤート共和国首長、イルクーツク州における検査技師のペストによる死亡を自身のMaxチャンネルで確認。Telegramでは死因を「推定」とした — ECHO
triage.triage_reason: 抗ペスト研究所の検査技師が肺ペスト菌曝露事故により死亡し、約200人が隔離・検査対象となっている。研究所内事故という異常性と肺ペストの重篤性からIHR基準2つ以上に該当する。
triage.notes: 事件はロシア連邦イルクーツク州（抗ペスト研究所）での検査技師の実験室内感染事故であり、対象国リストにロシア・モンゴルは含まれない。タイへの渡航歴は未確認情報（「another health source」による伝聞）であり、タイでの発生事例ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : Ebola frappe durement les enfants, près de sept morts chaque jour
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Ebola hits children hard, nearly seven deaths per day.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to heavily affect children. Since May 15, 2,071 people under 18 have been infected and 961 have died, according to Save the Children. Children under five are disproportionately affected: 623 pediatric deaths (about two-thirds of all pediatric fatalities) with a 61% case fatality rate, versus 48% overall. The outbreak is accelerating: confirmed cases rose from 6,604 on Sept 5 to 8,116 on Sept 27, and deaths from 3,175 to 3,924 in about three weeks. Notably, 81.5% of deaths in the three weeks to Sept 27 occurred in communities rather than treatment centers. At least 180 children have lost both parents or primary caregivers. Calls to boost infection prevention, medical management, case detection, and psychosocial support; emphasize access to services and community trust. Save the Children has operated in DRC since 1994, with 13 local partners.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラ出血熱が子供たちを激しく襲う、1日あたり約7人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクが急速に拡大しており、致死率も高く、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な懸念があるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 致死率48%〜61%、症例数・死亡者数が3週間で急増しており、既存のエボラ流行の深刻化を示す。国際支援（Save the Children等）の必要性も明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: 4000명 넘게 사망" 걸리면 둘 중 하나 죽는 에볼라 안 멈추는 민주콩고... '예방 홍보' 정치인 피살되기도
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 4,000 deaths: Ebola, with a one-in-two fatality rate, in the Democratic Republic of the Congo that shows no sign of stopping... A politician was assassinated over 'prevention campaigns.'
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak continues to surge in the Democratic Republic of the Congo five months after declaration. As of Sept. 30, 2026, the DRC reports 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths (case fatality 48.4%), with 2,162 recoveries. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC; the Bundibugyo variant is implicated, linked to Bundibugyo, Uganda, and previously seen in DRC (2012). Fruit bats are the suspected reservoir. There is no vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo, unlike Zaire ebolavirus. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or body fluids or contaminated objects; incubation 2–21 days. Early symptoms include fever, sore throat, and myalgia, progressing to chest pain, shock; a skin rash around days 5–7, with bleeding in about 40% and multi-organ failure risk. Containment is hampered by security issues, road conditions, and reporting gaps; MSF and Africa CDC warn counts may understate the outbreak, noting a fatal assault on a prevention advocate.

triage.headline_ja: 死者4000人超、罹患すれば2人に1人死亡するエボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で止まらない…『予防啓発』の政治家が殺害される事態も
triage.triage_reason: DRCで8300症例・致死率48.4%の大規模エボラ流行が継続し、ワクチン未承認の変異株であること、治安問題で封じ込めが困難なこと等、複数のIHR/WPRO基準に該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株はウガンダ由来の過去流行株であり国境地域に関連するが、記事の主題はDRC国内の流行拡大であるためウガンダは対象国リストに含まれず除外。ワクチン・治療薬が存在しない変異株である点は重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Le laboratoire mobile contre Ebola réduit les délais de diagnostic des patients en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The mobile laboratory fighting Ebola reduces the time to diagnosis for patients in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Mobile Ebola laboratory deployed in Butembo, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, analyzes samples from suspected Ebola virus disease cases inside negative-pressure trucks, protecting staff and the surrounding environment. The unit’s mobility allows relocation to other sites as outbreaks unfold, bringing diagnostics closer to affected communities. Diagnostic turnaround has dropped from as long as 72 hours to about 24 hours, and in some cases six hours. Faster results enable timely clinical decisions, guiding patients to appropriate care and allowing confirmed cases to start treatment earlier, potentially improving outcomes and reducing transmission. The initiative illustrates how on-site, rapid testing enhances outbreak response in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対策の移動式検査室がコンゴ民主共和国における患者の診断時間を短縮
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州ブテンボでの既知のエボラ対応における診断体制改善に関する記事であり、新規アウトブレイク発生の報告ではないが、エボラという重大疾患の継続状況を示すため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は新規感染拡大の報告ではなく、既存のエボラ対応における検査体制の技術的改善（移動式検査室）に焦点を当てている。症例数や感染拡大状況など、現行アウトブレイクの規模に関する情報が記事中に記載されていないため、詳細はWATCHとして続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : plus de 8 200 cas confirmés d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: more than 8,200 confirmed Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 8,224 confirmed Ebola cases and 3,982 deaths. The outbreak response continues across seven provinces and 63 health zones, with 851 patients in isolation or hospitalized and 2,121 recoveries. The case fatality rate stands at 48.4%, while contact tracing coverage reaches 78.7%. Authorities emphasize ongoing operations centered on patient care, community-based prevention, and capacity building for care teams. The outbreak remains persistent in multiple regions, underscoring the need for sustained public health measures and rapid isolation of suspected cases. The ministry encourages reporting symptoms or suspected Ebola cases by calling the toll-free number 151 to enable timely response and containment.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラ確認症例8,200件超
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%の大規模エボラアウトブレイクが7州63保健地区に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数項目に該当するため。
triage.notes: 致死率48.4%、症例数8,224件・死亡者3,982人と大規模かつ継続的な流行であり、既存の大規模アウトブレイクの最新状況報告。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果史上最慘伊波拉疫情　官方證實逾4000人不幸病歿 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The deadliest Ebola outbreak in Congo’s history; officials confirm more than 4,000 people have died - Minshi News Network.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports the deadliest Ebola outbreak in its history, with more than 8,000 confirmed cases and over 4,000 deaths. The outbreak was first detected in mid-May and has progressed amid ongoing instability and armed conflict in the region, which have severely hampered public health and medical response efforts to contain the virus. The convergence of a large Ebola outbreak with insecurity strains the country's capacity to respond and protect communities, highlighting the challenges faced by authorities and partners in delivering care and control measures in a volatile Central African environment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ史上最悪のエボラ疫病流行、当局が4000人以上の死亡を確認
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国における過去最悪規模のエボラ流行（8000例超、死者4000人超）であり、重篤性・異常性・国際拡大リスクともに高く、治安不安により対応能力も限定的なためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 武力紛争下での大規模流行であり、国際的な支援ニーズが高いと考えられる。続報での感染拡大状況・国際対応の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en la RDC deja ya más de 4.000 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC has already killed more than 4,000 people.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, declared 15 May, has 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths (case fatality 48.4%). Seven of 26 provinces have reported cases; 2,162 recovered and 842 are hospitalized or in isolation, with contact tracing at 80.6%. The Bundibugyo strain drives this outbreak, the second-deadliest on record, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (≈28,000 cases, ~11,000 deaths). The outbreak has reached Uganda, which reported 20 infections (15 imported from DRC) and saw the WHO declare the Ugandan outbreak over on 26 August. No specific treatment exists; two vaccines are in early-phase trials, while a large-scale Ervebo campaign began in late August, targeting the Zaire variant. Health workers in Bunia protested delayed salaries, hampering containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、死者数はすでに4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%、死者4,000人超、ウガンダへの越境拡大を伴う史上2番目に致死的なエボラアウトブレイクであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの感染拡大（20例、うち15例がDRCからの輸入例）は確認されたが、WHOは8月26日にウガンダでのアウトブレイク終息を宣言済み。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。保健従事者の給与遅配が封じ込め活動に支障をきたしている点は管理可能性の懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: 中疾控發十一長假健康風險提示　流感中低流行水平波動
