article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China CDC issues health risk alert for the 11-day holiday: influenza activity fluctuates at a low-to-moderate level.
article.articleSummary: China CDC warns during the 11‑day National Day holiday that influenza activity fluctuates at a low-to-moderate level, while COVID‑19 remains at a low transmission level. With increased holiday travel, mask use is advised in transit hubs and indoor public venues. In southern provinces, mosquito‑borne diseases remain active, with dengue fever and chikungunya fever presenting multi‑point sporadic cases and local clusters; residents are urged to eliminate standing water, overturn containers, and tidy waste, and to install screens and mosquito nets and maintain personal protection when out. As influenza season begins after October, vaccination is encouraged to gain early protection. Food safety during gatherings should emphasize handwashing, separating raw and cooked foods, and safe drinking water to reduce norovirus and hand‑foot‑mouth disease risks. For outbound travel, monitor destination infectious disease risks and report overseas travel history upon return.

triage.headline_ja: 中国疾病予防コントロールセンター、国慶節10連休に向け健康リスク情報を発表　インフルエンザは低～中程度の流行水準で推移
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節性感染症（インフルエンザ・デング熱・チクングニア熱・ノロウイルス）に関する定例の健康注意喚起であり、異常な公衆衛生事象や社会的関心の高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: 国慶節連休に向けた中国CDCの定例的な健康リスク情報提供であり、季節性・地域的に既知の感染症（インフルエンザ、デング熱、チクングニア熱、ノロウイルス）の低～中程度の流行状況を伝える内容。新規または異常な事象は確認されない。

article.articleHeadline: RT-Duits: Kongo: Tausende fliehen aus Ebola-Lager
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RT-German: Kongo: Thousands flee from Ebola camp.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo worsens as thousands flee the Kigonze internally displaced persons camp near Bunia, the capital of Ituri province in eastern Congo. Reuters reports clashes and fires erupted after security forces searched the camp for weapons, triggering a mass exodus of more than 19,000 IDPs. UN Ebola response chief Julien Harneis notes the displacement occurred last Tuesday, compounding an already dire situation where Ebola has caused fatalities within the camp. Up to 1,000 Ebola contacts were believed to be present in Kigonze, but only about 20% have been located. UNHCR confirms Ebola deaths in the camp, with higher numbers possible. A key Ebola treatment transit center in Ituri reportedly burned down, heightening the risk of further transmission and complicating containment efforts. The report references events around Oct 1, 2026, with the article published Oct 2, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: RT-ドイツ語:コンゴ:数千人がエボラキャンプから避難
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部イツリ州でエボラ流行が悪化し、接触者追跡不能・治療施設焼失など流行拡大・管理困難のリスクが明確に認められるため、フルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: IDPキャンプからの大量避難により接触者追跡が困難化し、治療施設焼失も重なり感染拡大リスクが高い。続報でのWHO・UNHCR対応状況確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo: Tausende fliehen aus Ebola-Lager
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kongo: Thousands flee from an Ebola camp.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo reports a deepening Ebola crisis as thousands flee Kigonze, a displacement camp near Bunia in Ituri province, after soldiers searched the site, triggering clashes and fires. More than 19,000 internally displaced persons fled; up to 1,000 Ebola contact persons were in the camp, with only about one-fifth located. Ebola fatalities have occurred in Kigonze, and UNHCR confirms deaths there. A transit center was burned, compromising isolation, testing, and treatment capacity. Separately, over 3,000 people fled the Rhoe camp in Djugu district on Sept 27 amid renewed fighting. In Nord-Kivu, two health workers died during outbreak response. Ituri first reported Ebola cases in May 2026, with declines there, while Nord-Kivu saw a surge. Vaccination and treatment trials are underway for the Bundibugyo variant, with over 8,000 lab-confirmed cases and nearly 4,000 deaths from hemorrhagic fever. Violence and poverty hinder contact tracing and outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：数千人がエボラキャンプから避難
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ流行がIHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響・国際拡大リスク）に該当し、治安悪化による接触者追跡の困難、医療従事者の死亡など流行制御の危機的状況がある。
triage.notes: 8,000件以上の検査確定例、約4,000人の死亡という大規模流行。紛争・避難民の大量移動により接触者追跡が破綻し、感染拡大リスクが高い。UNHCRやWHO等の国際支援が既に関与している可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola Outbreak Exceeds 4,000 Deaths, Struggling to Control
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-02, the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ebola outbreak has killed 4,018 people and confirmed 8,300 cases across seven provinces, the worst in the country’s history. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment, though several candidates are in trials; more than 2,000 patients have recovered. Weak infrastructure, remoteness, and ongoing armed conflict near borders with South Sudan, Uganda, and Rwanda hinder containment and community cooperation. An Ebola-hit camp housing a transit center was burned by soldiers, displacing about 19,000 people. In Butembo, a local official was beaten to death during awareness efforts and his house burned, illustrating security and mistrust challenges. The WHO warns the outbreak is far from over and on track to surpass the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic. Africa CDC notes falling confirmed cases, though insecurity may affect reporting. This is DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak, declared May 15.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、死者4,000人を超え制御に苦慮
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、WPRO基準も全項目該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、南スーダン、ルワンダとの国境付近での紛争が封じ込めを妨げているが、これら国での症例確認は記事に記載されていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含めた。17回目のエボラ流行であり、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行を超える可能性がWHOにより警告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Kerala Fever Crisis Deepens As Teen Dies Amid Severe Medicine Shortage In Government Hospitals
article.articleSummary: Kerala reports a worsening fever outbreak with 14-year-old Sivaranjini of Mannarkkad dying last night as government hospitals contend with severe medicine shortages. The state recorded one more fever death today, following nine fever deaths reported yesterday. A total of 8,407 people sought fever treatment yesterday, with Malappuram accounting for more than 2,000 fever patients daily; Palakkad, Kasaragod, and Thiruvananthapuram also report sharp spikes. Ottapalam saw one dengue death yesterday. Influenza was confirmed in 48 people yesterday, with Ernakulam reporting the maximum number of cases. Hospitals allege suppliers are delaying purchases due to uncleared old dues, worsening the crisis. The finance department has been asked to release Rs 500 crore immediately. The KMSCL board approved a re-tender for nine medical items, including cotton; new stock will take at least two months. Pooling stock with other states is delayed, and the crisis is expected to persist at least until November.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州の熱病危機が深刻化、政府病院での深刻な医薬品不足の中、10代の少女が死亡
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州で発熱患者が急増（1日8,407人）し複数の死亡例が続く中、政府病院の深刻な医薬品不足が危機を悪化させており、社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱・インフルエンザ・原因不明熱が混在するケララ州の公衆衛生危機。医薬品供給不足による医療システムの機能不全が主要な懸念点。11月まで危機継続の見込み。

article.articleHeadline: На востоке ДР Конго выявили шесть новых случаев Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six new Ebola cases identified in eastern DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, six new Ebola virus disease cases were identified in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, in areas controlled by the AFC/M23 rebel group. Two cases occur in the Kaina medical zone, North Kivu, and four in the neighboring Alimbongo zone. Epidemiological investigation links all six to a single transmission chain connected to a patient who arrived from Butembo, a government-controlled city. Four cases were detected post-mortem among deceased residents; two patients are currently receiving treatment. Contact tracing is ongoing to identify and monitor people who had contact with the infected. Earlier AFC/M23 areas were declared Ebola-free, but a new case was confirmed in Kaina in early September. The eastern DRC Ebola outbreak was declared May 15; government data indicate about 8,300 confirmed cases and over 4,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラウイルス病の新規症例6件を確認
triage.triage_reason: 進行中の大規模エボラ流行（累計約8,300例、死者4,000人超）に加え、反政府武装勢力支配地域での新規感染連鎖が確認されており、公衆衛生上の深刻性と国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 反政府勢力支配地域（AFC/M23）での感染確認により接触者追跡や対応が困難化しており、紛争地域特有のアクセス制限がアウトブレイク制御の障害となっている点に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en la República Democrática del Congo deja ya más de 4.000 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has already left more than 4,000 dead.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) as of 02 Oct 2026 has killed over 4,000 people. Declared 15 May in the eastern DRC, the outbreak has spread to seven of 26 provinces, with a case fatality rate of 48.4%. The INSP reports 4,018 deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases, 2,162 recoveries, and 842 currently hospitalized or in isolation; contact tracing is 80.6% complete. The Bundibugyo strain is implicated; there are no specific treatments, though two vaccines are in early human trials and Ervebo is being deployed at scale in the DRC, originally for the Zaire lineage. Bunia, Ituri Province (NE DRC) is the epicenter. Uganda’s outbreak linked to DRC ended on 26 Aug after 20 confirmed cases (15 imported from the DRC). Frontline workers have protested unpaid salaries, hindering containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、死者4,000人超に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%の大規模エボラ流行で7州に拡大し、隣国ウガンダにも越境伝播歴があるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境感染は既に終息(8月26日)しているため、現在進行中の主要発生国はDRCのみと判断。ウガンダは対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。医療従事者の未払い賃金による抗議活動が封じ込め対応を妨げている点にも留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو تسجل 6 حالات إصابة جديدة بفيروس إيبولا.. وجهود مستمرة لفحص المخالطين
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo reports 6 new Ebola virus infections; ongoing efforts to screen contacts.
article.articleSummary: Six new Ebola virus infections have been reported in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, in areas controlled by the M23 alliance near Lubero. Cases were detected in Kaïna Health Zone and the neighboring Alimbongo Health Zone, with the transmission chain anchored to a case from Butembo in government-controlled territory. Four cases were identified post-mortem in communities; two patients are receiving treatment, and authorities are actively tracing contacts. This follows earlier M23 claims in late June that Ebola was cleared in their areas, though a new case was confirmed in early September and the patient was discharged after 26 days in care. Since the outbreak began on May 15, government data released on Friday report more than 4,000 deaths among about 8,300 confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラウイルスの新規感染6例を報告…濃厚接触者の検査継続
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の新規感染確認と死後診断例・継続的な感染連鎖があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: M23支配地域での新規感染確認であり、紛争地域での対応困難さが懸念される。累計死者4000人超、確定症例8300例という大規模アウトブレイクの継続事案。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : l'engagement communautaire au centre d'une formation sur la riposte contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: Community engagement at the center of a training on the Ebola response - ACP
article.articleSummary: Community engagement and involvement of traditional healers and guardians of local norms were central to a Kisangani, in Tshopo Province, Democratic Republic of Congo training on Ebola virus disease (EVD) response. Organized by the provincial Health Division (DPS/Tshopo), the session aimed to strengthen community actors’ knowledge and boost prevention, surveillance, and early warning to interrupt transmission in Kisangani. Dr. Franck Mmbwa outlined medical aspects of EVD—history, epidemiology, transmission, prevention, and case trajectories—while Marie Lebe discussed community involvement, surveillance, early alert, rumor control, risk communication, and local collaboration. The workshop stressed community-based death management and the need for cooperation among health facilities, local authorities, traditional practitioners, and neighborhood chiefs to enhance acceptance of response measures and prevent new infections. Mayor Delly Likunde Litawe pledged to personally engage with ETD leaders to sensitize residents about the Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州:エボラ対応研修の中心にコミュニティ関与 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はエボラ対応に関する研修・コミュニティ啓発活動の報告であり、実際の感染者発生や症例報告を示すものではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行そのものではなく、コミュニティエンゲージメントを中心とした対応能力強化研修の実施報告。新規症例や流行の兆候についての言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: Mobiles Ebola-Labor verkürzt Diagnosezeiten für Patientinnen und Patienten im Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mobile Ebola Lab Shortens Time to Diagnosis for Patients in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Mobile Ebola laboratory in Butembo, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, shortens time to diagnosis by bringing tests closer to communities. Technicians operate inside lab vehicles equipped with a negative-pressure system to shield staff and surroundings from contamination. The unit is relocatable to serve different areas as needed. Times to diagnosis have fallen from up to 72 hours to typically 24 hours, and in some cases as little as six hours. Faster results help route patients to appropriate care sooner and enable targeted treatment for confirmed Ebola cases. By reducing transport time for samples and reducing exposure risk, the model strengthens outbreak containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: モバイルエボラ検査室がコンゴの患者の診断時間を短縮
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という重篤疾患に関する内容だが、本記事は診断体制改善の技術的トピックであり、新規アウトブレイクや症例急増等の情報は含まれていないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部ブテンボでのエボラ検査体制強化に関する内容。現在進行中のアウトブレイクの規模や死亡者数等の詳細情報は記事内に記載がなく、リスク評価のための情報は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Kisangani : renforcement des capacités des prestataires d'une zone de santé sur la riposte d'Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kisangani: Capacity-building for health-zone providers in the Ebola response - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in Kisangani's Makiso-Kisangani health zone, Tshopo province. From Sept 29 to Oct 2, 2026, private healthcare providers were trained to bolster the Ebola response, with emphasis on risk communication, infection prevention and control (IPC), and comprehensive case management. The goal is to extend the response across the health zone and strengthen coordination within the local health system. In Tshopo, 45 Ebola cases have been reported, with more than 20 in the Makiso-Kisangani zone. Supported by the World Health Organization (WHO), the training aims to improve prevention, detection, and management within private facilities and to ensure suspected or confirmed cases are promptly addressed to protect the community.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニ:エボラ対応における医療圏提供者の能力強化 - ACP通信
triage.triage_reason: DRCコンゴ東北部で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（Tshopo州で45症例、うちMakiso-Kisangani圏で20例超）であり、WHO支援下で対応体制強化が行われている。重症度・流行可能性の観点からフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱は既知の継続的アウトブレイクであり、WHO支援のもと民間医療提供者への研修が実施されている段階。症例数（45例、うち20例超が特定圏内）と公衆衛生上の重大性からフルRRAへの移行を推奨する。

article.articleHeadline: Collector appeals to people to stop breeding of dengue-causing mosquitos at grama sabha meeting
article.articleSummary: On 2 October 2026, Virudhunagar Collector Sharanya Ari addressed a grama sabha at Vadamalakurichi in Virudhunagar union, Tamil Nadu, urging residents to curb dengue by preventing Aedes mosquito breeding in stagnant rainwater and discarded items. She emphasized removing water-collecting articles and promoting waste segregation to ease door-to-door collection and protect the environment. Dengue prevention was framed within broader governance, with mentions of welfare schemes and infrastructure needs, including upgrading the Government High School to a higher secondary, a bus shelter, protected drinking water, and sewerage cleaning, with commitments to pursue these requests. The meeting reviewed Panchayat expenditure from April 1 to September 30 and included an AIDS awareness pledge. Attendees included Project Director (DRDA) Vanathi, Joint Director of Agriculture Mohandoss Sowmiyan, Deputy Director of Horticulture A. Arumugam, Assistant Director (Panchayats) Muruganandam, and Sattur Revenue Divisional Officer Kanagarajan.

triage.headline_ja: 行政官、グラマ・サバ会議でデング熱を媒介する蚊の繁殖防止を住民に呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な患者数や流行拡大の報告はなく、行政官による日常的な予防啓発活動の内容であり、シグナルとしての異常性や緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の具体的な発生状況ではなく、蚊の繁殖防止を呼びかける予防啓発活動に関する地域行政のルーチン報告。対象国としてインドが挙がるが、記事内容は日常的な公衆衛生活動でありシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa aprova medicamento para tratar esquistossomose em crianças a partir de 3 meses | Tribuna Ourinhense
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa approves drug to treat schistosomiasis in children from 3 months of age | Tribuna Ourinhense
article.articleSummary: Anvisa approved Arpraziquantel, a 150 mg dispersible tablet produced by Farmanguinhos/Fiocruz, for treating schistosomiasis in children from 3 months up to 6 years old. Indicated for infections with Schistosoma mansoni and Schistosoma haematobium. Schistosomiasis, also known as bilharzia, is acquired by contact with contaminated freshwater harboring infected snails. In Brazil, roughly 1.5 million people live in areas at risk. The dispersible tablet dissolves in water and targets a pediatric gap, since praziquantel tablets (600 mg) are commonly used but not recommended for children under 2. Arpraziquantel thus expands treatment options within Brazil’s public health system (SUS) for early childhood schistosomiasis. The approval was announced on Sept 30, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: Anvisa、生後3カ月からの小児を対象とした住血吸虫症治療薬を承認 | Tribuna Ourinhense
triage.triage_reason: 新薬承認に関する行政・規制ニュースであり、アウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は新規治療薬（Arpraziquantel）のブラジル規制当局による承認発表であり、感染症の発生・流行報告ではない。既存の風土病対策の一環としての薬事承認ニュース。

article.articleHeadline: La RDC face à sa pire épidémie d'Ebola : plus de 4.000 morts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC faces its worst Ebola outbreak: over 4,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused more than 4,000 deaths and over 8,000 confirmed cases, the worst outbreak in the country’s history, according to data released on Friday by Congolese authorities. The DRC declared mid-May its 17th Ebola outbreak, with progression in troubled regions where renewed armed clashes and violence have impeded the response in recent days. The figures reflect confirmed cases and deaths reported by authorities as of 2026-10-02. The ongoing crisis underscores the impact of conflict on outbreak control, complicating vaccination, surveillance, and treatment efforts in affected provinces.

triage.headline_ja: DRC、史上最悪のエボラ流行に直面：死者4,000人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪のエボラ流行（死者4,000人超、症例8,000人超）が進行中であり、武力紛争により対応が妨げられ国際的拡大・支援の必要性が高い。IHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 武力紛争によりワクチン接種・監視・治療活動が妨げられており、現地対応能力を超えた国際支援が必要とされる可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola outbreak killed more than 4,000: official figures
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak—the worst on record in the country—has killed 4,018 people out of 8,300 confirmed cases, with 2,162 recoveries (fatality rate 48.4%), according to official data. Detected mid-May in Ituri, the outbreak has spread to seven provinces in the north and east, including North Kivu, where four deaths have been reported among six cases in M23-controlled areas of the northeast. Violence and resource shortages, along with widespread mistrust of authorities, have hampered response efforts. About 5,000 people have been displaced, a transit centre for patients was burned, and a health contractor was killed in North Kivu. International aid includes France committing 13.4 million euros (Jan–Jul) and the U.S. releasing $267 million. Vaccines and treatments target the Bundibugyo strain; Ervebo doses have begun for frontline staff as part of a clinical trial.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、公式統計で死者4,000人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCで記録的規模のエボラ流行（8300症例・4018死亡）が7州に拡大し、武装勢力支配地域や国際援助を要する深刻な状況であるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 米国・フランスは資金援助国であり発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。M23支配地域での感染拡大や医療従事者殺害など治安悪化が対応を一層困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: കോംഗോയില്‍ എബോള മരണം 4,000 കടന്നു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola deaths in Congo surpass 4,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo total 4,018, with over 8,300 confirmed cases and more than 2,000 recoveries. Ituri Province accounts for about 6,250 cases and 2,885 deaths, while North Kivu records 1,570 cases and 931 deaths. The outbreak has crossed borders into Uganda and South Sudan; Uganda reported 20 cases and 2 deaths in May–June, with transmission described as contained by August. A single case in France has been confirmed in a health worker returning from Congo. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo virus, for which there are no widely effective vaccines or treatments; only experimental therapies are used, and the case-fatality rate is around 48%. Ongoing eastern Congo conflicts, attacks on health workers, and local distrust hinder response. The main Ebola treatment center near Bunia was burned, displacing about 19,000 people from the Kigonse refugee camp and hampering care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ死者数が4,000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模エボラ流行が国境を越えてウガンダ・南スーダンに拡大し、フランスでも輸入症例が確認されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダン・フランスへの感染拡大が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。致死率約48%、ワクチン・治療法が限定的で、紛争による対応阻害が深刻な懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de Ebola no Congo já causou mais de 4 mil mortes - Brazil Urgente
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo has already caused more than 4,000 deaths - Brazil Urgente
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-02, the Democratic Republic of Congo is facing an Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with a death toll of 4,018 and 8,300 confirmed cases reported by the government across seven provinces; more than 2,000 patients have recovered. Public health authorities describe this as the largest and deadliest outbreak yet seen in the country, surpassing the 2018-2020 epidemic, and it remains behind the record West Africa outbreak of 2014-2016, which affected Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone and resulted in roughly 28,600 cases and over 11,000 deaths. The government data released on Friday indicate ongoing challenges in containment as transmission continues.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱の流行、死者数が4000人を超える - Brazil Urgente
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の死者4,018人、症例8,300人と報告され、過去最大規模の流行とされており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラ流行のみを主題としており、ギニア・リベリア・シエラレオネ・アンゴラは2014-2016年流行の歴史的比較として言及されているのみで、現在の発生地域ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: T.N. recoding around 200 dengue cases a day, numbers remain steady: DPH
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Tamil Nadu remains steady at about 200 daily cases, with new infections reported in Chennai and surrounding districts, and in Coimbatore and Madurai. Officials say the trend is static, not an outbreak, though higher facility density and testing in these areas may bias reporting. The Directorate of Public Health and Preventive Medicine has instructed expanded testing (statewide including more than 4,500 government and private laboratories) to improve surveillance and detect clusters. Aedes breeding pools are being targeted, and density is slowly falling due to source reduction. About 25,000 Domestic Breeding Checkers are deployed across the state (roughly 20 per block). Daily monitoring with District Health Officers covers case trends, laboratory tests, fever triage, and discharge policies. Fogging and public awareness continue. With October–November rains possible, households are urged to keep environments clean and containers closed to prevent transmission.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州、デング熱症例が1日約200件で横ばい：公衆衛生局
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は現地で流行性があり監視体制も強化されているが、当局は「アウトブレイクではなく横ばい」と説明しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められないため、経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性デング熱の定例的な監視報告であり、当局は流行ではなく横ばい状態と評価。州内での対策（検査拡大、蚊の繁殖地対策、啓発活動）は通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: Риск заражения в Таиланде нарастает: самостоятельные путешественники рискуют попасть под удар
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The risk of infection in Thailand is rising: solo travelers are at risk of getting infected.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis risk in Thailand is rising, with solo travelers at greater risk. Russian tourists traveling to Thailand via tour operators face minimal infection risk because organized itineraries stay in hotels meeting sanitary standards and avoid high-risk zones, according to the Association of Tour Operators of Russia (ATOR) in a statement to RIA Novosti. The situation concerns the organized travel segment; independent travelers may fall outside safety nets. A leptospirosis outbreak was reported in Rayong, a city hit by severe floods. The disease is rodent-borne and spreads through contaminated water, making flooded areas high-risk. Experts warn risk increases with contact with floodwaters and participation in volunteer work in affected areas. In Rayong, hundreds of Russian citizens may be present, some as independent travelers or volunteers. Tourists heading to disaster-affected regions should avoid open water and flooded sites and follow local sanitary authorities' guidance.

triage.headline_ja: タイでの感染リスクが高まる：個人旅行者が感染の危険にさらされる
triage.triage_reason: タイ・ラヨーン県で洪水後のレプトスピラ症発生が報告されているが、症例数・死亡者数などの詳細情報が不足しており、IHR基準の該当は確認できない。
triage.notes: 洪水被害を受けたタイ・ラヨーン県でのレプトスピラ症発生に関する記事。ロシア人観光客向けの注意喚起が中心で、現地の症例数や公衆衛生当局の対応状況など詳細情報は不明。続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Doença que matou Lito Sousa já possui 547 casos registrados no Brasil | A TARDE
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Disease that killed Lito Sousa already has 547 registered cases in Brazil | A TARDE.
article.articleSummary: Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease (CJD) in Brazil shows 547 registered cases since 2005 when it entered the National Notifiable Diseases list, with 1,576 suspected notifications nationwide. Digital influencer Lito Sousa, 59, died on Oct 1, 2026, 41 days after diagnosis; his funeral was planned for Oct 2 in São Paulo. Regional distribution centers on Southeast, South, and Northeast, with Bahia reporting 21 confirmed cases from 2020–2026. The 55–74 age group dominates (about 53.6% female, 46.3% male). There is no proven cure; roughly 90% die within a year. No broadly approved treatments exist in Brazil; SUS provides supportive care. Anvisa authorized in September an experimental drug, ALN-6457, for urgent use in Sousa’s case, not yet used in humans. CJD is a fatal neurodegenerative disease caused by prions; most cases are sporadic (≈85%), 10–15% hereditary, and transmission is not considered contagious, with rare post-surgical occurrences.

triage.headline_ja: リト・ソウザ氏を死亡させた病気、ブラジルで既に547件の登録例
triage.triage_reason: CJDは非伝染性のプリオン病で、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大のリスクはなく、ブラジル国内で既知のサーベイランス対象疾患として一定数発生している既存事象であるため。
triage.notes: 著名人（デジタルインフルエンサー）の死亡により国内メディアの関心は高いが、CJDは2005年から法定監視対象であり毎年一定数の症例が報告されている既知の疾患。プリオン病で伝染性はなく、散発性が約85%を占める。公衆衛生上の緊急性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Más de 4.000 muertos por brote de ébola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 4,000 dead from Ebola outbreak in the DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of October 2, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has claimed 4,018 lives among 8,300 cases since its May 15 declaration in the eastern region, making it the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in the DRC's history. The epicenter is Ituri province, with Bunia as a focal city. Frontline health workers have protested for overdue salaries (August–September), hindering surveillance and response. Authorities have not resolved payroll delays, and UN officials warn that the loss of treatment centers reduces capacity and access to care. A displacement camp near Bunia in Kigonze was burned during a security operation, forcing about 19,000 people to flee. A Médecins Sans Frontières worker contracted Ebola and was evacuated to the Netherlands for isolation in Leiden. Overall, at least 50 health workers have died in this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行、死者4,000人超
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な拡大速度、国際的拡散＝医療従事者のオランダ搬送）し、WPRO基準も複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: オランダ（ライデン）は国際医療搬送先であり発生国ではないため対象国リストに含めず除外。コンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州、ブニア中心）が主たる発生地域。給与未払いによる医療従事者のストライキ、治療センター喪失、避難民発生など、流行制御に深刻な支障が生じている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Hospital in Russia's Irkutsk region quarantined amid reports that a patient died of pneumonic plague -- Meduza
article.articleSummary: Quarantine at Shelekhov district hospital, Irkutsk region, after reports of a suspected 'particularly dangerous infection'; inpatient department closed, outpatient clinic remains open. Media claim pneumonic plague as the cause of death for a patient—28-year-old Darya Shipilova—but no official confirmation. Accounts vary: one says return from Thailand; another ties death to a lab technician at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute who broke a plague sample. Governor Maxim Modin convened a regional sanitation/epidemic commission; Anna Popova attended. Rospotrebnadzor says epidemic-control measures are in place; those exposed placed under medical observation. About 200 contacts, with 189 hospitalized for observation. An update cited Buryatia’s leader saying the woman died of plague, later edited to state she 'may have' died of plague; no Buryatia outbreak. Historical: 2010–2015 worldwide plague 3,248 cases, 584 deaths; Russia’s last case in 2016 (Altai Republic). A plague vaccine exists, recommended in natural foci and for workers handling live cultures.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア・イルクーツク州の病院が肺ペストで死亡したとの報道を受け検疫措置
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストによる死亡例が報告され、病院が検疫下に置かれ約200人の接触者が経過観察されるなど、公衆衛生上重大かつ異常な事態であるためフルリスク評価に進むべきと判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（イルクーツク州・ブリヤート共和国）であり対象国リストに含まれない。タイへの渡航歴は一部報道にのみ言及され、確定情報ではないためThailandは除外。公式な死因確認（ペストか否か）はまだ得られていない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola dépasse les 4000 morts en République du Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak surpasses 4,000 deaths in the Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases, with 2,162 recoveries (case fatality rate 48.4%), as of 2 October 2026. It is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the country and the deadliest on record, beginning in Ituri (northeast) and spreading to seven northern and eastern provinces, including North Kivu (six cases, four deaths). The response is hampered by armed groups, notably M23, with violence, displacement (>5,000 people), a transit center for patients burned, and the death of a health worker at a checkpoint; a MSF clinician was evacuated after testing positive. International aid includes France: €13.4 million (Jan–Jul) and the US: $267 million. Ervebo vaccine doses have been given to frontline staff; about 70,000 doses were allocated in August, targeting Bundibugyo strain, though Ervebo's Zaïre-efficiency is cited. WHO notes encouraging signs; Africa CDC says the outbreak is not under control; MSF warns it is moving.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、死者数が4000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%、史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が7州に拡大し、武装勢力による対応妨害、国際支援の投入など深刻な公衆衛生・社会的影響が確認されるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 史上最悪のエボラ流行（17回目）。武装勢力M23による妨害、医療従事者死亡、避難民5000人超、国際支援（仏・米）投入中。Africa CDCは「制御下にない」と評価、MSFは拡大継続を警告。地域リストにUS/Franceがあるが、これらは支援国として言及されているのみで発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Creutzfeldt-Jakob, de Lito Sousa, Atingiu 547 Pessoas no Brasil em 17 Anos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease, by Lito Sousa, Affected 547 People in Brazil Over 17 Years
article.articleSummary: CJD in Brazil: 547 confirmed cases from 2005–2021 among 1,576 suspected notifications, per the Ministry of Health. São Paulo leads with 202 diagnoses (37%), followed by Minas Gerais (57), Paraná (44), Rio de Janeiro (38), and Rio Grande do Sul (35); these five states account for about 70% of confirmed cases. Age distribution shows 60.2% of notifications are 55–74 years old; mean age is 66. The disease is rare, progressive and fatal, with about 90% dying within six months to a year after onset; 290 deaths were recorded. No link to bovine spongiform encephalopathy variant has been recorded in Brazil since 2005; sporadic CJD is most common. Diagnosis uses clinical assessment, brain MRI, lumbar puncture with CSF analysis, EEG, and other tests; RT-QuIC CSF assay offers near-100% specificity, though sensitivity varies. Influencer Lito Sousa disclosed the diagnosis Aug 21; within a month he had mobility, speech, and vision difficulties.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンサー、リト・ソウザのクロイツフェルト・ヤコブ病、ブラジルで17年間に547人が罹患
triage.triage_reason: 疾患タグは豚コレラ（Classical Swine Fever）だが、実際の記事内容は散発性クロイツフェルト・ヤコブ病（CJD）に関する統計的解説記事であり、急性感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態には該当しない。BSEとの関連も否定されている。
triage.notes: Bluedotの疾患タグ（Classical Swine Fever）は記事内容と一致しない誤分類。記事は人のCJD（散発性）に関する疫学統計の紹介であり、動物由来感染症や豚コレラとは無関係。感染症危機管理上の緊急対応は不要。

article.articleHeadline: تفشي فيروس إيبولا في شرق الكونغو وتأثيره على المناطق المتمردة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo and its impact on rebel-held areas.
article.articleSummary: Six new Ebola infections reported in rebel-held eastern Democratic Republic of Congo by the Congo River Alliance/M23, with two cases in Kaïna and four in adjacent Alimbongo near Lubero, close to the frontline with government forces. This follows the discharge of the only previously known active Ebola patient from treatment earlier this week. Four cases were identified post-mortem among fatalities and two others are receiving treatment. Authorities say contacts are being traced. These developments challenge prior rebel declarations, made in late June, that Ebola-free zones had been achieved in their areas. Ebola was declared in eastern DRC on May 15; government data today cites over 8,300 confirmed cases and more than 4,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部でのエボラ出血熱の流行と反政府勢力支配地域への影響
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部の紛争地域で新たなエボラ感染6例が報告され、反政府勢力が以前宣言した「エボラフリー地域」の正当性が揺らいでいる。重症度・異常性・拡大リスクが高く、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 反政府勢力支配地域での感染拡大であり、政府による統制・接触者追跡が困難な状況。紛争地域特有の管理困難性が懸念される。累計症例数（8,300件超、死亡4,000人超）は政府発表に基づくが、情報源の信頼性確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉疫情嚴峻　染疫死亡人數破4千人 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; death toll surpasses 4,000
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports the deadliest Ebola outbreak on record, with 8,300 confirmed cases, 4,018 deaths and 2,162 recoveries (CFR 48.4%) as of Oct 3, 2026. Originating in Ituri province in the northeast, the outbreak has spread to seven northern and eastern provinces; North Kivu’s M23-controlled areas report 6 cases and 4 deaths. Armed conflict and distrust hinder control efforts; militias have displaced over 5,000 people, a transfer center was burned, and a testing-site worker was killed. International aid includes US$267 million; France’s foreign minister visited Bunia to show support. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus; vaccines and therapies are in development, with Ervebo administered to frontline volunteers in trials.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行が深刻化、死者数が4000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約48%、8,300症例・4,018死亡という史上最悪規模のエボラ流行で、複数州への拡大、武力紛争による対応困難、国際支援の動員があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 米国・フランスは支援国・訪問国として記事に登場するが発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外。史上最多規模のエボラ流行であり、武装勢力の妨害や治安悪化が対応を困難にしている点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de ebola na RDC ultrapassa 4.000 mortos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in the DRC surpasses 4,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 8,300 cases and 4,018 deaths as of 2 October 2026, a case fatality rate of 48.4%. The surge, beginning in Ituri province in the northeast, is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. There are no vaccines or approved specific therapies for this strain. The outbreak has spread to six provinces in the north and east, regions where state presence is weak and armed groups operate. In early phases Bundibugyo can cause mild symptoms, potentially delaying detection. Multiple treatments and vaccines are in testing against this relatively poorly characterized strain. By contrast, the Zaire ebolavirus has historically driven most outbreaks in the DRC. Ongoing monitoring and response are challenged by governance and security conditions in affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、死者4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%の大規模エボラ流行（症例8,300、死者4,018）が6州に拡大し、治療薬・ワクチン未承認の新規株によるものでIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行で、ワクチン・治療薬が未承認、治安不安定な地域での対応が課題。複数の治療薬・ワクチンが治験中。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de Ébola deja 4.000 muertos en República del Congo y es la segundo más letal en la historia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic leaves 4,000 dead in the Republic of the Congo and is the second deadliest in history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has caused 4,018 deaths from 8,300 confirmed cases across seven of 26 provinces, with a 48.4% case fatality rate. Recoveries total 2,162 and 842 patients remain hospitalized or in isolation; contact tracing is 80.6%. The Bundibugyo strain drives this outbreak, which ranks as the second-deadliest globally, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (≈28,000 cases, ≈11,000 deaths). The outbreak extended to Uganda, which reported 20 infections (15 imported from the DRC) before its August 26 end. There is no targeted treatment for Bundibugyo; two vaccines are in Phase 1 trials, while the DRC began mass vaccination with Ervebo (for the Zaire strain) at the end of August. In Bunia, Ituri province, frontline health workers protested unpaid salaries, including surveillance teams, hindering containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ流行、死者4,000人に達し史上2番目の致死的流行に
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なエボラ流行（8,300症例、致死率48.4%）が7州に拡大し、ウガンダへの越境伝播も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダは越境流入が報告されているが8月26日に終息しており、記事の主題はDRCでの継続中の流行。対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため除外。医療従事者の未払い給与によるストライキが対応を妨げており、管理能力の課題を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Santé. Épidémie d'Ebola en RDC : la barre des 4 000 morts franchie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health. Ebola outbreak in the DRC: death toll passes 4,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has surpassed 8,300 total cases and 4,018 deaths with 2,162 recoveries, yielding a case fatality rate of 48.4%. The 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC's history has spread from Ituri to seven northern and eastern provinces, with North Kivu reporting six cases (including four deaths) in areas under M23 control. The response is hampered by armed conflict, insecurity, and population displacement—over 5,000 people have been displaced in Ituri recently; a transit center for Ebola patients was set on fire after security forces entered a displacement site. A contractor in charge of case detection was killed at a health checkpoint in North Kivu. An MSF clinician tested positive and was evacuated to the Netherlands. The WHO noted encouraging signs in mid-September, but Africa CDC says the outbreak is not under control and is shifting geographically.

triage.headline_ja: 保健:コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱流行、死者4,000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%の大規模エボラ流行が7州に拡大し、武力紛争により対応が妨げられている。国際医療従事者の感染・避難も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: オランダはMSF医療従事者の避難先であり発生国ではないため除外。武力紛争（M23支配地域）が対応を著しく妨げており、地理的拡大が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: République démocratique du Congo : l'épidémie d'Ebola a fait plus de 4 000 morts selon les chiffres officiels
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: the Ebola outbreak has killed more than 4,000 people according to official figures.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) officially detected mid-May. As of latest figures, 8,300 cases and 4,018 deaths (case fatality 48.4%), with 2,162 recoveries. The epidemic has expanded from Ituri into seven northern and eastern provinces; in Nord-Kivu, four of six deaths occurred in areas controlled by the M23 group. Violence and distrust hinder the response, with clashes disrupting medical aid and displacing more than 5,000 people; a transit center for Ebola patients was burned in Ituri, and a case-detection contractor was killed in Nord-Kivu. France pledged 13.4 million euros (Jan–Jul) for outbreak response, while the United States announced an additional 237 million euros. Vaccination efforts target Bundibugyo strain; early doses of Ervebo have been given to frontline workers as part of a clinical trial, with prior efficacy against Zaïre strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ流行、公式統計で死者4000人超に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%、8300症例・死者4000人超という大規模流行で、複数州へ拡大し武装勢力による対応妨害も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 米仏による資金拠出や国際的な関心、武装勢力による対応妨害など、継続的なリスク評価（RRA）が必要な重大事例。米国・フランスは支援国であり発生地域ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Un centre de transit pour patients Ebola détruit par un incendie en Ituri - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Transit center for Ebola patients destroyed by fire in Ituri - ACP
article.articleSummary: Transit center for Ebola patients in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, was destroyed by a fire at the Kigonze displacement camp. The facility, part of the Ebola response, housed about 19,000 displaced people and is now abandoned. UN Ebola response chief Julien Harneis warned that the loss of transit and treatment centers erodes response capacity and deprives communities of essential care. The fire occurred Tuesday evening, with the UN releasing the information in a 2 October 2026 press statement. Humanitarian teams are coordinating with authorities to safeguard health infrastructure as insecurity continues to hamper Ebola operations across the region. No Ebola case counts or laboratory confirmations are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州でエボラ患者用トランジットセンターが火災で焼失 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ対応拠点（約1.9万人の避難民を収容する施設）が火災で破壊され、国連責任者が対応能力の著しい低下を警告しており、既存流行の悪化・拡大リスクに直結するためフルRRAでの確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事自体には新規感染者数や検査確認情報は含まれないが、既存のDRCエボラ流行対応インフラの喪失という重大な間接的インパクトがあり、治安不安が対応を妨げている点から続報・公式統計の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Isiro: multiplication des barrières sanitaires au point de contrôle d'Ebola dans les zones touchées (Hygiène aux frontières) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Isiro: Multiplication of sanitary barriers at the Ebola checkpoint in the affected areas (Border Hygiene) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Isiro, 2 October 2026: Ebola response in Haut-Uélé, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, plans to intensify border hygiene by multiplying sanitary barriers at entry points Tsaka-tsaka and Batatoa to bolster control and surveillance in affected zones. Christine Langa, border hygiene program coordinator, said the intensified checkpoints respond to administrators’ requests to catch moto-taxi drivers and other transporters who bypass health checks along the main road and side routes such as Mataku-Bomamgbetu and Obongoni. The planning session was chaired by the interim provincial health division chief of Haut-Uélé and included partners and all pillars of the Ebola response. The measures follow prior preventive steps, including a temporary closure of the Wamba route to curb spread, as deviations through bypass routes persist. The report does not provide case counts or laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: イジロ:エボラ検問所における衛生バリアの増設（被害地域での国境衛生対策）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行対応における国境管理強化の記事であり、Ebolaは致死率が高く国際的拡大・渡航制限のリスクを伴う疾患のためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存のエボラ対応における国境衛生管理強化の措置についての報告であり、新規症例数や検査確定情報は含まれていない。既知の流行対応の一環として継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Bunia : une société de transport en commun renforce les mesures préventives - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Bunia: a public transport company strengthens preventive measures - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Bunia, Ituri, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, has prompted preventive action by a local public transport operator. MS Translux announced strengthened measures by reducing the number of passengers per vehicle to help break the transmission chain, following the outbreak disclosed by health authorities in Bunia. Ghislain Amayo, the company’s spokesperson for Ituri, stressed that no driver or loader should increase earnings by overloading vehicles, and those who violate the rule will face law enforcement. The policy, implemented in Bunia and across Ituri, aims to support broader prevention and control efforts as authorities reinforce measures against Ebola. The article notes the outbreak was announced by health authorities, but provides no specific case or death counts.

triage.headline_ja: ブニアでのエボラ出血熱：公共交通機関が予防対策を強化 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準に該当しやすい重大疾患であり、DRCブニアでの発生が公的機関により発表され、民間企業が予防措置を強化するなど社会的関心も確認できるため。
triage.notes: 記事には具体的な症例数・死亡数の記載がなく、アウトブレイクの規模や重症度は不明。保健当局による発表があったことのみ確認できる。

article.articleHeadline: Butembo: formations de 30 journalistes aux techniques de communication sur Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Butembo: 30 journalists trained in Ebola communication techniques - ACP.
article.articleSummary: October 2, 2026, Butembo, Nord-Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo: Thirty journalists from Butembo were trained in Ebola virus disease communication techniques to counter misinformation that spreads during health crises. The session aimed to equip media professionals and radio/television reporters with verified information and risk-communication practices to reassure communities and help curb panic surrounding the Ebola situation in the region. Nicephore Aguiar, risk-communication and community engagement officer with the IFRC, stressed the need to verify facts before broadcasting and to use media to educate, sensitize, and reassure populations currently anxious about circulating misinformation. Participants said the training met their needs and would strengthen frontline information work, given journalists' pivotal role in informing the public during the ongoing Ebola outbreak. The program was organized by the Butembo-Lubero Red Cross chapter with support from the IFRC.

triage.headline_ja: ブテンボ：エボラ出血熱に関するコミュニケーション技術研修を30人のジャーナリストが受講 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 記事はエボラ流行下での広報・リスクコミュニケーション研修に関するものであり、新規症例数や感染拡大等の疫学的な新情報は含まれていない。ただしコンゴ民主共和国北キブ州で進行中のエボラ流行の継続を示唆しており、関連動向として注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事本文は空欄で、サマリーのみに基づき評価。内容はジャーナリスト向けのリスクコミュニケーション研修に関するもので、新規感染者数や拡大状況など具体的疫学情報は含まれていないため、新規シグナルというよりは既存アウトブレイクの継続を示す背景情報として扱う。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Mambasa : les élèves et enseignants d'une école sensibilisés à la prévention - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Mambasa: Students and teachers of a school educated about prevention - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 2 October 2026, in Mambasa, Ituri Province, northeast Democratic Republic of Congo, students and teachers at a local school received Ebola virus disease (EVD) prevention education from civil society actors. Prefect of studies Josias Kathungu of the Manya Institute commended the outreach, noting Ebola can affect people regardless of social status. He urged pupils to apply lessons and share them with parents, emphasizing that risk arises both at school and at home. Barrier measures should be observed at all levels to curb the outbreak. Kathungu also asked for stronger school prevention infrastructure, including additional handwashing facilities and infrared thermometers (thermo-flash) to improve prevention and the early detection of suspected cases. Despite limited resources, a few handwashing basins have been installed; further thermoflash devices are being sought.

triage.headline_ja: マンバサのエボラ：ある学校の生徒と教師が予防教育を受ける - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州マンバサで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関連し、学校での予防啓発活動が報じられている。既知のアウトブレイクではあるが、重症度・ヒト-ヒト感染リスク・外部支援の必要性などWPRO基準に複数該当し、行政機関（学務部長）の関心も確認されるため、フルリスク評価への移行を検討する。
triage.notes: 記事自体は新規症例報告ではなく、既存のエボラアウトブレイクに対する学校での予防教育活動を伝えるもの。資機材（手洗い設備、赤外線体温計）不足から外部支援の必要性が示唆されている。続報でアウトブレイクの規模・症例数の推移を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Beni : renforcement de la riposte d'Ebola, des appareils de communication remis aux leaders communautaires - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: Strengthening the Ebola response, communication devices handed over to community leaders - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 2 October 2026 in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, a benefactor handed over a batch of 22 walkie-talkie communication devices to community leaders to strengthen Ebola alert transmission. Dr. Germain Kitoko of the 'A Dieu la gloire' laboratory explained that the equipment will improve rapid reporting of all Ebola cases and suspected cases to health authorities for timely response. Nelson Kavombano, general director of 'A Dieu la gloire International,' emphasized that swift information flow and community signaling can curb transmission chains. Twelve more walkie-talkies are expected so that each base chief and youth leaders can be equipped. Recipients welcomed the gesture, noting its emphasis on health security as well as community safety, beyond the material aid, in the ongoing Ebola response in the region.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ：エボラ対応強化、地域リーダーに通信機器を配布 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 既存のエボラ対応強化に関する運用面の記事であり、新規症例や流行拡大等の具体的な疫学情報は含まれていないが、進行中のアウトブレイク対応として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ対応の通信インフラ強化（トランシーバー配布）に関する運用ニュースであり、新規感染者数や流行状況の変化についての記述はない。既存のアウトブレイク対応の一環として継続監視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Beni: la participation inclusive des PVH souhaitée dans la riposte contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: Inclusive participation of PVH desired in the Ebola response - ACP.
article.articleSummary: On 2 October 2026 in Beni, North Kivu, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, a dialogue on Ebola emphasized inclusive participation of people living with disabilities (PWD). The event sought to empower PWD to voice concerns and propose solutions to ensure no one is left behind in the Ebola response. Recommendations included adapting awareness messages for accessibility across disability categories, systematically involving PWD in community sensitization, prevention, and response activities, and improving their access to health facilities and services while accounting for their specific needs. Proponents argue these measures would reduce barriers and enable fuller participation in outbreak actions. The initiative aligns with broader community engagement efforts and awareness campaigns as key strategies in eradicating Ebola in the region.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ:エボラ対応における障害者(PVH)の包摂的参加が望まれる - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 記事はエボラ対応における障害者の包摂的参加を議論する会合の報告であり、新規症例数や感染拡大状況などの具体的な公衆衛生情報が含まれていないため、フルRRAに進むには情報不足。DRCでのエボラ発生自体は継続監視対象。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行対応における障害者参加のコミュニティエンゲージメント活動に関するもので、新規感染状況の数値データは含まれない。既存のエボラ対応の一環としての継続監視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: تفشي إيبولا وهانتا يدفع الصحة العالمية للتحذير من تأخير الاستعداد للجائحة المقبلة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola and Hantavirus outbreaks push the WHO to warn against delaying preparedness for the next pandemic.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged rapid completion of arrangements to activate the Pandemic Accord, warning that delaying preparedness does not stop health threats. He pressed negotiators to finish the annex on the Access to Pathogens and Benefit Sharing (PABS) so the agreement can be opened for signature and ratification. He cited the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and hantavirus aboard the cruise ship Hondius as reminders of ongoing pandemic risks. WHO supports DRC authorities with Africa CDC, and thanked Argentina and Chile for aiding investigations and providing reference materials to laboratories in 15 countries. He called for higher mandatory contributions, reform of the global health architecture, continued investment in primary health care, and country-focused results. This was his last regional meeting before his term ends in August 2027.

triage.headline_ja: エボラとハンタウイルスの流行がWHOに次のパンデミック対応準備の遅延を警告させる
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱の流行はWHOが支援を行うほどの公衆衛生上の重大な懸念であり、国際的な関心・支援要請も高いためフルリスク評価の対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事はWHO事務局長の演説が主題だが、DRCでのエボラ流行への言及があり継続的な公衆衛生上のリスクを示す。ハンタウイルスはクルーズ船（Hondius号）での発生であり対象国に該当しないため除外。チリ・アルゼンチンは検査支援国として言及されているのみで発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: TRAGEDIA EN EL CONGO: EL ÉBOLA SUPERA LAS 4.000 MUERTES - HSB NOTICIAS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tragedy in the Congo: Ebola surpasses 4,000 deaths - HSB News
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the worst Ebola outbreak in the country’s history has reached 4,018 deaths and about 8,300 confirmed cases across seven eastern provinces as of 2 October 2026. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, began in May 2026 and has spread mainly through eastern regions where conflict, population displacement, and limited access to health services hinder containment. Authorities and international agencies maintain surveillance, diagnosis, and treatment services to slow transmission. Ongoing challenges include community mistrust and attacks on facilities and health workers, which disrupt response efforts. The World Health Organization warns that the outbreak unfolds in a complex humanitarian context and that geographic spread increases the risk of transmission to neighboring border areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの悲劇：エボラ出血熱による死者数が4,000人を超える - HSBニュース
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最悪規模のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（死者4,018人、確定症例約8,300例）が継続し、紛争・人口移動により封じ込めが困難で、国境を越えた拡大リスクもWHOが警告しているため。
triage.notes: WHOが国境地域への拡大リスクを警告しており、人道危機下での対応困難（施設・医療従事者への攻撃、コミュニティの不信感）が継続している。フルRRAによる詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de Ebola na República Democrática do Congo ultrapassa 4 mil mortos; taxa de letalidade é de 48,4%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 4,000 deaths; the case fatality rate is 48.4%.
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 2, 2026, the Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 deaths, with 8,300 cases and a case fatality rate of 48.4%. This outbreak, the deadliest in the country’s history, began in Ituri province in the northeast and is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no vaccines or approved targeted therapies exist. The disease has spread to six northern and eastern provinces where state presence is weak and armed groups operate. In its early phase Bundibugyo can cause mild symptoms, delaying detection. Several treatments and vaccines are in trials for this strain, though the more familiar Zaire ebolavirus has accounted for most past outbreaks in the DRC. The ongoing spread and high lethality highlight the need for enhanced surveillance, containment measures, and accelerated development of targeted interventions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、死者4,000人超え、致死率48.4%
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国における同国史上最悪のエボラ流行で死者4,000人超・致死率48.4%、6州に拡大し武装勢力地域での対応困難を伴うため、重大な公衆衛生イベントとしてフルRRAへ進む。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行で、ワクチン・承認された標的治療法が存在しない点が特に懸念材料。武装勢力の活動地域での封じ込めの困難さも指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola outbreak killed more than 4,000 - official figures
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak—now the worst in the country—has 4,018 fatalities from 8,300 confirmed cases (2,162 recoveries; 48.4% fatality rate) as of 2 October 2026. Detected mid-May, the outbreak began in Ituri and has spread to seven north/east provinces, including North Kivu in M23-controlled areas. Violence, displacement (over 5,000 in Ituri), and mistrust hinder response; a transit centre for patients was burned, and a case-detection contractor was killed at a North Kivu health facility. Vaccination includes the Ervebo vaccine in frontline staff as part of a clinical trial, though the Bundibugyo strain drives the outbreak. Several vaccines and treatments are under study. France allocated €13.4 million (Jan–Jul); the United States pledged $267 million to help curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、死者4,000人超—公式統計
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最悪規模のエボラ流行（致死率48.4%）が複数州に拡大し、紛争地域での対応困難、国際支援も発動されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 米国・フランスは資金支援国であり発生国ではないため対象国リストから除外。M23支配地域での治安悪化、患者輸送拠点の焼失、医療従事者殺害など対応阻害要因が深刻。Bundibugyo株による過去最大規模の流行で、既にDRC国内で国際的拡大（複数州）が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: República Democrática do Congo: surto de Ébola faz mais de 4 000 mortos, segundo dados oficiais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Ebola outbreak has killed more than 4,000 people, according to official data.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the largest in the country’s history, has killed 4,018 people out of 8,300 confirmed cases (2,162 recoveries; case fatality 48.4%). Detected in mid-May, the outbreak began in Ituri and spread to seven northern and eastern provinces, including Nord-Kivu where 4 deaths occurred among 6 cases in M23-controlled areas. Conflict, violence, and resource shortages, plus distrust of authorities, hinder response. The UN reports over 5,000 people displaced in Ituri recently; a transit center for Ebola patients was burned, and a health-detection technician was killed in Nord-Kivu. France pledges €13.4 million (Jan–Jul) and the United States €237 million to curb spread. Vaccines and treatments for Bundibugyo strain are under study; first Ervebo doses were given to frontline volunteers as part of a clinical trial, though Ervebo is proven for the Zaire strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラ出血熱の流行で公式データによると4000人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ史上最大規模のエボラ流行で致死率48.4%、複数州への拡大、紛争による対応阻害、国際支援(仏米)が実施されておりIHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 米国・フランスは資金拠出国として言及されているのみで発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。Bundibugyo株に対するワクチン・治療薬は研究段階、Ervebo(Zaire株用)の臨床試験が開始されている点は重要情報。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Deaths Rise To Over 4000 In DR Congo As Government Battles Worsening Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed 4,018 people and recorded 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces as of 2026-10-02, making it the deadliest Ebola epidemic in the country’s history. The outbreak, driven by the Bundibugyo strain, became the largest and deadliest in DRC after surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak. Response efforts are hampered by weak infrastructure, remote eastern corridors, and ongoing conflict near borders with South Sudan, Uganda and Rwanda. The UN reports about 19,000 people were forced to flee an Ebola-affected camp in Ituri Province after a transit center for patients in Bunia was burned by soldiers. Mistrust toward health workers and officials, and the killing of a local Butembo official, further complicate containment. WHO warns the epidemic is far from over; no approved vaccine or treatment exists, though trials are underway. Over 2,000 patients have recovered; Africa CDC notes confirmed cases may be declining due to insecurity and access limits.

triage.headline_ja: エボラによる死者、DRCで4000人を超える―政府が悪化する流行に対応
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪となるエボラ流行が7州に拡大し、死者4000人超・確定症例8300例に達しており、国境地域での紛争により対応が困難化、近隣国への越境リスクもあるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダ、ルワンダ、南スーダンとの国境地帯の紛争が対応を妨げていると述べているが、これらの国での感染事例は報告されていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含めた。ワクチン・治療薬未承認で封じ込めが困難な状況が続いている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola dans la Tshopo : un nouveau cas confirmé porte à 46 le cumul - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Tshopo: a new confirmed case brings the cumulative total to 46 - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Tshopo province reports a new laboratory-confirmed case in Makiso-Kisangani’s Boyoma health area, Kisangani, raising the cumulative confirmed Ebola cases in Tshopo to 46 as of October 1, 2026. Dr. Franck Mebwa, head of the response operations for the Ebola virus disease team in the Tshopo provincial health division, confirms the new case in Boyoma, which now accounts for 23 confirmed cases since the outbreak began. The updated epidemiological table shows 18 deaths among confirmed cases, 25 recoveries, and 3 active cases currently treated at the Ebola Treatment Center (CTE). In other health zones, totals are: Bafwasende 8, Kabondo 6, Mangobo 6, Tshopo 1, Wanie-Rukula 1, and Lubunga 1. Ongoing outbreak context remains centered in Kisangani and surrounding zones.

triage.headline_ja: ツショパ州のエボラ出血熱：新たな確定症例で累計46例に - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクが継続中で、累計46例・18死亡と重篤な公衆衛生上の影響があり、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクのある致死性疾患のため国際的拡大リスクも懸念される。
triage.notes: DRCツショパ州でのエボラアウトブレイクが継続中。致死率が高く（18/46）、複数の保健地域（Bafwasende, Kabondo, Mangobo, Lubunga等）に拡大しており、既知のWHO通知対象疾患であるため継続的なモニタリングとフルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يضرب مجددًا شرق الكونغو.. 6 إصابات جديدة في مناطق المتمردين
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola strikes again in eastern Congo... six new infections in rebel-held areas.
article.articleSummary: Six new Ebola infections have been confirmed in rebel-held areas of eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the Congo River Alliance and the March 23 Movement (M23) reporting cases in North Kivu and adjacent South Kivu. The six infections come after a known patient completed a 26-day treatment and was discharged last week. The group says two cases were detected in Kaina, North Kivu, and four in nearby Alimbongo near Lubero, close to the frontline with government forces. Four cases were identified through post-mortem testing, while two patients are currently receiving treatment, with contact tracing ongoing. Ebola was declared in eastern DRC on May 15; government data show more than 4,000 deaths among about 8,300 confirmed cases to date. Rebels had claimed Ebola-free status in late June, but a new case emerged in early September in Kaina.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ東部で再び発生…反政府勢力支配地域で新たに6人感染
triage.triage_reason: 死亡率の高いエボラ出血熱が紛争地域で再燃し、一時終息宣言後に新規感染が確認されたため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 反政府勢力（M23/コンゴ川同盟）支配地域での発生のため、政府・WHOによる接触者追跡やアクセスに制約がある可能性が高い。累計症例数8,300超、死者4,000人超という既存の大規模流行の継続事案であり、6月に一度終息宣言後の再燃という点で異常性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: സംസ്ഥാനത്ത് പകർച്ചപ്പനി വ്യാപനം രൂക്ഷം; മണ്ണാർക്കാട്ട് 14 കാരി കുഴഞ്ഞുവീണു മരിച്ചു, ഇന്നലെ മാത്രം റിപ്പോർട്ട് ചെയ്തത് ഒമ്പത് മരണം; പ്രതിദിന രോഗികൾ എണ്ണായിരത്തിലേറെ; സർക്കാർ ആശുപത്രികളിൽ മരുന്ന് പ്രതിസന്ധി തുടരുന്നു; കുടിശ്ശിക നൽകാൻ ധനവകുപ്പിനോട് 500 കോടി രൂപ ആവശ്യപ്പെട്ട് ആരോഗ്യവകുപ്പ്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Statewide outbreak of contagious fever; a 14-year-old girl collapsed and died in Mannarkkad; nine deaths reported yesterday alone; daily cases exceed ten thousand; drug shortages persist in government hospitals; Health Department has sought 500 crore rupees from the Finance Department to clear arrears.
article.articleSummary: Statewide outbreak of contagious fever in Kerala; nine deaths and over 8,400 fever admissions in a day. A 14-year-old girl, Shivaranjini, 14, from Kottappadam in Palakkad’s Mannarkkad taluk, died after fever. She was taken to Mannarkkad Taluk Hospital around 8 PM and collapsed with loss of consciousness by 11 PM. Across the state, 8,407 fever patients sought treatment yesterday; nine fever deaths were reported. Malappuram district records over 2,000 daily fever cases, with spread also in Palakkad, Kasaragod and Thiruvananthapuram. One dengue death occurred in Ottapalam; influenza infections are rising, with Ernakulam reporting most confirmed. Drug shortages in government hospitals have sparked protests; delays in medicine delivery due to late supplier payments. The Health Department has sought 500 crore rupees from the Finance Department to clear arrears. KMSCL approved re-tender for nine items, including cotton; stock arrival may take at least two months, with shortages likely through November.

triage.headline_ja: 州全体で感染性発熱が深刻化；マンナールカッドで14歳少女が倒れて死亡、昨日だけで9人の死亡例を報告；一日あたりの患者数は1万人超；政府系病院で薬不足が継続；保健省が未払い分清算のため財務省に500クロールルピーを要請
triage.triage_reason: 多数の死亡例と1日8,000人超の発熱患者報告、デング熱・インフルエンザの流行拡大、医療資源（薬剤）不足による対応能力の懸念があり、WPRO基準の複数項目（重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・ケララ州における季節性発熱（デング熱・インフルエンザ含む複合的な感染症流行）とそれに伴う医療資源不足・行政対応に関する報道。国際的拡大や渡航制限の情報はなし。地域はインド国内（ケララ州）に限定される。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고, 에볼라 사망자 4천 명 넘어서···치사율 48.4%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Ebola death toll surpasses 4,000, with a 48.4% case-fatality rate.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 8,300 confirmed cases, with 4,018 deaths and 2,162 recoveries, for a case-fatality rate of 48.4% as of October 2, 2026, according to AFP citing Congolese authorities. The current surge, identified in mid-May, marks one of the deadliest Ebola waves in the country. Responders face severe obstacles from armed clashes, violence, and chronic resource shortages across the vast central African nation, hampering control and patient care. Official counts are reported by authorities; the report provides limited detail on infection sources or on imported/exported cases. The situation underscores the substantial challenges in stabilizing outbreaks within conflict-affected areas of the DRC and the urgent need for enhanced public health response and security to reach affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴ、エボラ死者4000人超え…致死率48.4%
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%・8300例の大規模エボラ流行で、紛争地域における対応困難が国際的拡大と公衆衛生への深刻な影響を示唆するため、IHR基準複数該当でフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 武装衝突・資源不足により制御が困難な状況が継続しており、国際支援の必要性が高い。感染源や越境事例の詳細情報は不足している。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: 中國十一長假疫情擴大 青壯年猝死激增 | 中國新冠疫情 | 新冠變異株 | 流感疫情
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Epidemic Expands During China's 11-Day National Day Holiday; Sudden Deaths Among Young and Middle-Aged Surge | China's COVID-19 Pandemic | COVID-19 Variants | Influenza Outbreaks
article.articleSummary: China faces a renewed COVID-19 surge during the 11-day National Day holiday, with hospitals overcrowded as travel spreads infection and schools report widespread illness. Doctors warn that SARS-CoV-2 variant PJ.2.1 is the fastest-growing, most virulent current strain, linked to high viral loads and rapid disease progression (roughly two days to deterioration); BA.3.2 is also being closely monitored by WHO. Recurrent infections are suggested to raise mortality risk, especially in individuals with underlying heart conditions, including myocarditis, myocardial infarction, heart failure, and sudden cardiac death. Concurrent influenza A(H3N2) activity is described as highly virulent, contributing to hospitalizations. In Harbin, reports indicate a rise in sudden deaths among young adults, including a 36-year-old food-delivery worker who died at home. No exact case counts or laboratory data are provided, while pharmaceutical supply chains prepare for peaks.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の国慶節10連休中に流行拡大、若年・中年層の突然死が急増 | 中国新型コロナウイルス感染症 | 新型コロナ変異株 | インフルエンザ流行
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19変異株PJ.2.1やH3N2インフルエンザの同時流行、若年層の突然死増加が報じられているが、具体的な症例数・検査データがなく、政治色の強い単一メディア（NTDTV）のみの報道で公式確認が取れていないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 情報源が政治的傾向の強いメディア（新唐人電視台）であり、症例数・検査データ等の一次情報が欠如。中国当局やWHOからの公式発表・裏付け情報の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: République démocratique du Congo : l'épidémie d'Ebola a fait plus de 4 000 morts selon les chiffres officiels
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: The Ebola outbreak has killed more than 4,000 people according to official figures.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak, officially detected in mid-May, has reached 8,300 cases with 4,018 deaths and 2,162 recoveries (case fatality 48.4%). The epidemic began in Ituri and spread to seven provinces in the north and east, including North Kivu where 4 of 6 cases have died in areas controlled by the M23 anti-government group. The response is hindered by armed clashes, resource shortages, and deep distrust of authorities. The conflict has displaced more than 5,000 people; a transit center for Ebola patients was burned, and a health contract tracer was killed in North Kivu. France has pledged €13.4 million (Jan–Jul) and the United States has unlocked an additional €237 million. Vaccines and therapies are being studied for Bundibugyo Ebola virus, with Ervebo doses administered to frontline staff in a clinical trial, building on prior efficacy against Zaïre strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ流行による死者が公式統計で4,000人超に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱が複数州に拡大し8,300症例・致死率48.4%と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、武装勢力による対応妨害で国際支援が行われているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 米国・フランスは資金援助国として言及されているのみで発生国ではないため除外。Ituri・North Kivu等は国内地域のためDRCに集約。

article.articleHeadline: R.D. del Congo supera los 4.000 fallecidos por brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo surpasses 4,000 deaths from Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is severe, with laboratory-confirmed totals of 8,300 cases and 4,018 deaths, a case-fatality rate of 48.4%. The National Institute of Public Health confirmed these figures. The outbreak formally began on 15 May 2026, when health authorities declared an epidemiological alert and instituted biosanitary containment protocols in affected zones. The hospital system is treating 842 symptomatic patients. Epidemiological brigades are tracing contacts, with 80.6% of contacts being followed to cut transmission chains. The report emphasizes containment and surveillance measures within the African nation; no details on specific districts or infection source are provided.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ流行による死者数が4000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%、8,300症例・4,018死亡という大規模流行であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大・支援の必要性が認められるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率48.4%と非常に高く、エボラ流行として大規模。具体的な感染地域や国際的拡散の有無については記事に記載がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: En République du Congo, l'épidémie d'Ebola franchit le cap des 4 000 morts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Republic of the Congo, the Ebola epidemic has surpassed 4,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 2, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 4,000 deaths among about 8,300 laboratory-confirmed cases, with 2,162 recoveries and a case fatality rate around 48.4%. Originating in Ituri (northeast), the outbreak has spread to seven northern and eastern provinces, including North Kivu, where six cases (four deaths) have been reported in areas controlled by the M23 group. The response is hampered by armed conflict, community distrust, and access constraints; clashes have displaced more than 5,000 people and a treatment center was burned in Ituri. France plans a Bunia visit to express support, with 13.4 million euros allocated for the Ebola response (Jan–Jul 2026). The United States announced an additional 267 million dollars to bolster Ebola control in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ共和国で、エボラ出血熱の流行が死者4,000人の大台を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ流行が4,000人超の死者と8,300例超の確定症例を伴い、複数州に拡大、武力紛争による対応困難、国際支援（仏・米）が動いているためIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 米国・フランスの資金援助が報じられているが、発生国はDRCのみ。米国・フランスは支援国であり発生地域ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Agentes de Endemias promovem conscientização sobre a dengue em escola de Conceição da Barra de Minas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Endemic disease control agents promote dengue awareness at a school in Conceição da Barra de Minas.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-02, endemic disease control agents in Conceição da Barra de Minas conducted an educational outreach at Adílio José Borges State School to raise dengue awareness and promote Aedes aegypti vector control. The session emphasized keeping yards and homes free of water-collecting containers and other simple practices to eliminate breeding sites. It stressed youth engagement and that dengue prevention relies on broad community participation. The initiative reinforces that prevention is the primary tool against dengue, with the municipality urging residents to remove mosquito habitats. Reported by Eric Brito, the activity exemplifies ongoing public health efforts to empower communities to reduce transmission through everyday actions.

triage.headline_ja: コンセイソン・ダ・バーラ・デ・ミナスの学校でデング熱啓発活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防啓発活動の報告であり、具体的な症例数・流行状況の記載がなく、異常性や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は定例的な公衆衛生啓発活動の報道であり、実際の感染拡大や症例報告は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: 【禁聞】中國多地豬瘟 養殖戶陷生存困境 | 養殖戶生存困境 | 市場恐慌 | 低價拋售
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [Forbidden News] African swine fever across multiple regions in China | Farmers face a survival crisis | Market panic | Dumping at low prices
article.articleSummary: African swine fever outbreaks span Guangxi, Yunnan, Anhui, Jiangxi, Shandong, Henan, and Shanxi in China, with large-area pig mortality and widespread culling. Jiangxi is the most affected, about 80% of smallholders and 40% of large farms infected; other provinces report substantial losses and price shocks. Slaughterhouses handle more small pigs as prices fall; live-pig values drop to roughly 1–2 yuan per jin, while pre-Mid-Autumn prices in Shandong reached about 4 yuan per jin. Despite vaccination, many herds still fall ill; some farmers hold pig insurance and pursue claims. Laos also reports ASF outbreaks, with rumors of diseased pigs entering China for deep processing, raising cross-border concerns. Farmers face ongoing costs for feed, labor, and biosecurity amid market panic and disposal expenses, reflecting severe economic strain on pig producers.

triage.headline_ja: 【禁聞】中国各地でアフリカ豚熱（ASF）流行、養豚農家が生存危機に | 養殖戸の生存危機 | 市場パニック | 安値での投げ売り
triage.triage_reason: 中国7省にまたがるASF流行で大量死・淘汰が発生し、価格崩壊と越境（ラオス）への拡大懸念があり、貿易・経済影響が深刻なため。
triage.notes: ASFは人獣共通感染症ではなく直接的な公衆衛生リスクは低いが、広域流行による食料安全保障・経済・越境貿易への影響が大きいためフルリスク評価の対象として識別。ラオスでの発生も言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola na RDC ultrapassa 4 mil mortos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC surpasses 4,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by Bundibugyo virus has reached 8,300 cases and 4,018 deaths (case fatality ~48.4%) as of 2 October 2026. Originating in Ituri province in the northeast, the outbreak has spread to six northern and eastern provinces amid weak government presence and armed-group activity, hindering control efforts. Early Bundibugyo infection can present with mild symptoms, delaying detection and containment. No vaccines or approved treatments exist for this strain; several therapies and vaccines are in trials. Previously, Zaire ebolavirus drove most DRC outbreaks, making this surge particularly challenging for public health authorities. Security and access limitations complicate surveillance, case management, and outbreak response across the affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ、死者4000人超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約48%・8300症例・4000人超の死者が報告されており、ワクチン・治療法未承認の珍しい株(Bundibugyo)による大規模流行で、複数州に拡大し武装勢力活動により対応が困難化しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 通常のザイール型と異なりBundibugyo型による流行で、ワクチン・治療薬が未承認である点が特異。複数州への拡大と治安悪化により国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: تسجيل ‌6 إصابات جديدة بفيروس إيبولا في شرق الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six new Ebola cases reported in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Six new Ebola virus disease cases were reported on October 2, 2026, by the Congo River Alliance/M23 Movement in their eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo-controlled areas. Two cases were detected in Kaina and four in the neighboring Alimbongo area; four cases were identified through post-mortem testing of deceased individuals, while the remaining two patients are receiving treatment. Contact tracing is underway. The outbreak, declared May 15 in eastern DRC, has resulted in more than 4,000 deaths among about 8,300 confirmed cases to date. The Congo River Alliance/M23 controls large parts of North Kivu and South Kivu since last year, underscoring ongoing transmission risk in conflict-affected regions with limited health access.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国東部で新たに6例のエボラ出血熱患者を確認
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が大規模な死者数（4000人超）を伴い継続流行しており、紛争地域で保健アクセスが制限されているため国際的拡大・管理困難性のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: 紛争地域（M23/コンゴ川同盟支配地域）での発生であり、保健アクセスの制限と検死後確認例の存在から、実際の感染規模が過小評価されている可能性がある。既存の大規模アウトブレイク（2026年5月15日宣言、8300例・4000人超死亡）の継続拡大事例。

article.articleHeadline: Incendian centro de tratamiento del ébola en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They burn down an Ebola treatment center in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri Province with Bunia as a key city, has claimed 4,018 lives among 8,300 confirmed or registered cases since it was declared on May 15, making it the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. Frontline health workers in Bunia have been striking over delayed salary payments for August and September, hindering surveillance and response. A UN official noted that early this week soldiers burned a displaced-persons camp housing an Ebola transit center near Bunia during an operation to search for weapons in Kigonze, forcing about 19,000 people to flee. Repeatedly, authorities warn that creating Ebola transit and treatment centers requires funding and personnel, which are scarce; losing a center equates to lost capacity and disrupted access to care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ治療センターが放火される
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州で記録上最速の拡大を見せるエボラ流行（8,300症例中4,018人死亡）が継続中であり、医療従事者のストライキや治療センター放火など対応能力の著しい低下が確認されるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は医療従事者の賃金未払いによるストライキや、避難民キャンプ内のエボラ移送センターが軍事作戦中に焼失した事例を報告。これにより約19,000人が避難し、対応能力がさらに低下している。致死率約48%と非常に高く、資金・人員不足が深刻な課題として指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: गुजरात: 'एकता दिवस' परेड दल में डेंगू का प्रकोप, 24 की रिपोर्ट पॉजिटिव आई
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gujarat: Dengue outbreak in the Unity Day parade contingent, 24 tested positive.
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreak among the National Unity Day parade contingent in Gandhinagar, Gujarat. As of Oct 2, 2026, at least 24 personnel undergoing Unity Day preparations have laboratory-confirmed dengue at Gandhinagar Civil Hospital. About 34 staff were admitted on Thursday, with 23 testing positive; by Friday evening, five more admissions included one positive and four suspected cases. By Friday afternoon roughly 10 patients had been discharged; others remain stable with no complications. Most affected are aged 25–30 and presented with fever and body pain. The personnel came from Uttar Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Maharashtra, Kerala and Bihar to participate in the Oct 31 Unity Day parade at Unity Nagar, and all are staying in a single Gandhinagar hostel. The hostel source is not identified; state and district epidemiology teams will assess sources while clinicians continue treatment.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州：『統一デー』パレード隊でデング熱発生、24人が陽性
triage.triage_reason: 単一宿舎に滞在する全国統一デーのパレード要員の間でデング熱クラスターが発生し、24名以上が陽性となるなど異常な集団発生であり、州・県の疫学チームが調査中で社会的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: デング熱自体はインドで季節的に流行する疾患だが、全国から集まったパレード要員が単一施設に滞在し集団感染した点が異常。感染源（蚊の発生源か宿泊施設内の環境要因か）は現時点で不明で、州・県の疫学調査結果待ち。重症例・死亡例の報告はなく、全員安定している。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en el Congo se cobra más de 4.000 vidas, según datos del Gobierno
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Congo has claimed more than 4,000 lives, according to government data.
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 2, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has killed 4,018 and infected 8,300 across seven provinces, with more than 2,000 recoveries. It is the Congo’s worst and deadliest outbreak to date, surpassing the 2018-2020 epidemic and ranking behind the West Africa 2014-2016 outbreak (over 28,600 cases and 11,000 deaths). Transmission began in Ituri province, where some slowdown has been observed, but the east remains a hotspot, including North Kivu.
