Last month South Ubangi Province reported its seventh outbreak after a man who traveled from the east died. Government and UN officials report signs of deceleration in parts of Ituri, yet ongoing spread highlights containment challenges in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、政府データによると死者4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国における過去最悪規模のエボラ流行で、死者数・感染者数ともに甚大かつ複数州に拡大しており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 史上最悪規模のエボラ流行とされ、7州に拡大、新たな州（南ウバンギ）でも発生報告あり。国際支援の必要性が高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Nine Years of Insurance Data Reveal Indonesia's Stubborn Typhoid
article.articleSummary: Typhoid fever remains a high-burden public health problem in Indonesia, based on BPJS Kesehatan data from 2015–2023 covering about 8 million encounters among ~6.9 million individuals in all provinces. With 95.9% population coverage in 2023, the dataset offers a national view of typhoid-related healthcare utilization in primary care and hospitals. Peak annual prevalence reached 347 per 100,000 in primary care (2017) and 314 per 100,000 in hospitals (2016); by 2023, estimates were 143 per 100,000 in primary care and 167 per 100,000 in hospitals, still above the high-burden threshold of 100 per 100,000. Hospital admissions accounted for 47.6% of visits; cumulative hospital deaths reached 11,991, averaging 0.57 deaths per 100,000 per year. Diagnoses relied on physician ICD-10 coding (A01.0) rather than routine microbiological confirmation; Widal/rapid tests are commonly used, with culture confirmation rare. Burden skewed toward young children; subsidised low-income enrollees had higher hospitalization risk; pronounced subnational clustering observed.

triage.headline_ja: 9年間の保険データがインドネシアの根強い腸チフス負担を明らかに
triage.triage_reason: 2015-2023年の保険データに基づく既知の風土病（腸チフス）の疫学的分析であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態ではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は腸チフスが既にインドネシアで高負荷の風土病として存在していることを示す9年間の保険データ分析報告であり、急性アウトブレイクの報告ではない。研究結果として公衆衛生政策への示唆はあるが、緊急シグナルとしての性質はない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue hits Ekta Diwas parade contingent in Gujarat, 24 test positive
article.articleSummary: 24 dengue positives among 34 Gandhinagar-hosted personnel admitted for Rashtriya Ekta Diwas preparations in Gujarat over two days. At Gandhinagar Civil Hospital, 23 of 34 Thursday admissions tested positive; five more admitted Friday (one positive, four suspected) bringing total positives to 24. Patients, mostly 25–30 years old, are stable with no complications; about 10 have been discharged; several remain under observation. Infections involve personnel from Uttar Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Maharashtra, Kerala and Bihar, housed together in a Gandhinagar hostel while preparing for Ekta Diwas at Ekta Nagar on Oct 31. Authorities will investigate the infection source; the hospital notes no confirmed hostel-origin link yet. Gujarat had recently reviewed vector-borne disease status; over 1.35 lakh suspected dengue samples tested, with 2,099 positives in 2026 up to the review.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州のエクタ・ディワス行進隊でデング熱、24人が陽性
triage.triage_reason: インドで流行地域における通常のデング熱クラスターであり、重症例や死亡は報告されていないが、集団生活環境でのベクター媒介感染拡大の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドで流行性疾患であり、今回のクラスターは国家行事準備のための集団宿泊施設内で発生。感染源調査中だが、患者は安定しており重症化は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: गुजरात: 'एकता दिवस' परेड दल में डेंगू का प्रकोप, 24 की रिपोर्ट पॉजिटिव आई - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gujarat: Dengue outbreak in Unity Day parade contingent, 24-year-old tests positive - Punjab Kesari
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 2, 2026, in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, dengue has been confirmed in at least 24 National Unity Day parade personnel preparing for the event. About 34 personnel were admitted on Thursday, with 23 testing positive. By Friday evening, five more admissions included one positive and four suspected cases. Most affected are aged 25-30, presenting fever and body aches; none have severe illness. The workers came from Uttar Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Maharashtra, Kerala, and Bihar, and are housed in a single Gandhinagar hostel for Unity Nagar's Oct 31 parade preparations. The source of infection is not yet determined. State and district public health teams have been alerted; epidemiological assessments will be conducted by experts, while hospital staff focus on treatment. No information on exported cases is provided.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州：「統一記念日」パレード隊でデング熱発生、24人が陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: 単一宿舎に集団生活するパレード要員24人がデング熱陽性となったが、重症例はなく、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも低いため、フルRRAには至らないが続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 国家統一デーのパレード準備要員が単一の宿舎に集団生活しており、デング熱クラスターが発生。感染源は特定されておらず、重症例はない。インド各州（UP、Chhattisgarh、Maharashtra、Kerala、Bihar）から集まった要員であるため地域拡散の可能性があるが、現時点では国内の局所的事案と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: 2/10/2026- Lauro de Freitas capacita profissionais para fortalecer diagnóstico e tratamento de Hanseníase e Esporotricose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: October 2, 2026 - Lauro de Freitas trains professionals to strengthen diagnosis and treatment of Hansen's disease and Sporotrichosis.
article.articleSummary: On October 2, 2026, Lauro de Freitas’ Municipal Health Secretariat (SESA) hosted a briefing for health professionals at UNIME to strengthen diagnosis and treatment of Hansen's disease (leprosy) and Sporotrichosis. The session targeted physicians, nurses, and other network staff, emphasizing early detection, appropriate clinical management, and reinforced epidemiological surveillance to curb transmission in Lauro de Freitas, Brazil. Experts covered practical aspects of Hansen's disease — a chronic infectious condition affecting skin and peripheral nerves — and Sporotrichosis, a deep fungal infection often linked to contact with infected animals, stressing timely identification and correct treatment. Lucas Carvalho Meira, Director of Epidemiological Surveillance, underscored the program's strategic value for rapid response. Andrea Rebouças led the training, outlining referral workflows, while pharmacist Rosa Cruz noted aligning community pharmacy guidance with new guidelines to support treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年10月2日 - ラウロ・デ・フレイタス市、ハンセン病とスポロトリコーシスの診断・治療強化のため専門職研修を実施
triage.triage_reason: これは自治体による医療従事者向け研修プログラムの告知記事であり、感染拡大や異常事態を示す内容ではない。公衆衛生上の緊急性や社会的関心の高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は研修プログラムの告知であり、具体的な症例数・アウトブレイク情報は含まれていない。ハンセン病・スポロトリコーシスともにブラジルでは既知の風土病的疾患であり、通常の公衆衛生活動の一環と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de ebola: Congo registra 4 mil mortes e letalidade chega a 48%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic: Congo reports 4,000 deaths and the case fatality rate reaches 48%
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is at its deadliest since the disease was first identified in 1976. As of 2 October 2026, official figures show over 8,300 confirmed Ebola cases and more than 4,000 deaths, yielding a case fatality rate above 48%. The current outbreak began in Ituri province, in the northeast, and the virus is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, one of six recognized Ebola species. For Bundibugyo, there are no approved treatments or vaccines. Early symptoms documented include severe headache, sudden high fever, extreme fatigue, muscle and joint pains, and sore throat. The report notes that prior to 2026, Zaire ebolavirus had been the main cause of the most recent RDC outbreak, underscoring evolving viral dynamics in the country.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行：コンゴで死者4000人、致死率48%に達する
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱流行が1976年以来最悪の規模（8300例超、死者4000人超、致死率48%超）に達しており、承認された治療薬・ワクチンがないBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる発生であるため、重大なシグナルとして評価する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルスには承認された治療薬・ワクチンが存在しないため、通常のZaireエボラウイルス流行時よりも対応が困難である点に留意。フルリスク評価（RRA）への移行を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-uitbraak in Congo eist al meer dan 4.000 levens
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has already claimed more than 4,000 lives.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 deaths, with about 8,300 confirmed or suspected infections since the crisis began in the east on May 15. The fast escalation strains response efforts. In Ituri province, Bunia medical staff protested over unpaid salaries dating to August–September, halting care. Military actions have destroyed health infrastructure and displaced about 19,000 after soldiers in Kigonze accidentally burned a refugee camp housing a treatment center. UN officials warn the toll is devastating given already scarce funds and personnel, with at least 50 healthcare workers reported dead. To curb spread, authorities have deployed mobile laboratories, including one near a treatment center in Butembo, as Doctors Without Borders (MSF) describes the outbreak as unprecedented for the country.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、死者数が4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクで死者4,000人・感染者8,300人超と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、医療インフラ崩壊・軍事活動による避難民発生など国際的対応が必要な状況。
triage.notes: MSFが「前例のない」規模と表現。医療従事者の未払い賃金によるストライキ、軍事行動による治療センター焼失・避難民発生など、対応能力に重大な支障が生じている。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Ξεπέρασαν τις 4.000 οι νεκροί από την επιδημία Έμπολα - Κρίσιμη η διεθνής βοήθεια
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: The death toll from the Ebola epidemic has surpassed 4,000 — international aid is critical.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached about 8,300 cases with 4,018 deaths (case fatality ~48.4%), the worst on record. The epidemic began in Ituri province (northeast) and has spread to seven northern/eastern provinces, including North Kivu, where four of six cases died in areas held by the M23. Violence and mistrust hamper response: Ituri clashes displaced over 5,000 people and a treatment center was burned; a contractor identifying cases was killed at a North Kivu health facility. French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot will visit Bunia, Ituri, to show support; France has allocated 13.4 million euros (Jan–Jul), while the United States added 237 million euros for the response. Vaccines and therapies are under evaluation; Ervebo doses were given to frontline workers and are effective against the Zaire strain, as the Bundibugyo strain drives the current surge.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラ流行による死者が4,000人を超える — 国際支援が急務
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が8,300症例・4,018死亡（致死率約48.4%）と過去最悪規模に達し、複数州への拡大、暴力による対応阻害、国際支援の要請という複数のIHR・WPRO基準を満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 米国・フランスは資金援助国として言及されているのみで発生国ではないため除外。Bundibugyo株による新規サージである点、M23支配地域での治安悪化が対応を阻害している点が特筆される。

article.articleHeadline: Magas az ebolajárvány halálozási aránya a Kongói Demokratikus Köztársaságban
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak has a high mortality rate in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo is facing its deadliest Ebola outbreak, with 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths, and 2,162 recoveries (case fatality rate 48.4%) as of 2 October 2026. The outbreak began in Ituri in mid-May and has spread to seven northern and eastern provinces; in North Kivu, six cases have four deaths under control of the M23 (Kigali-backed) group. Violence and distrust hinder response, with clashes displacing more than 5,000 people and a transit center for Ebola patients burned in Ituri; a subcontractor involved in case-finding was killed in a health facility attack. French Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot visited Bunia to express support; France allocated €13.4 million (Jan–Jul) for Ebola efforts, and the United States added €237 million. Trials are evaluating vaccines and treatments for Bundibugyo ebolavirus; Ervebo has begun dosing frontline volunteers, though previously shown effective mainly against the Zaire strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行、致死率が高水準
triage.triage_reason: DRCで8,300例・4,018死亡（致死率48.4%）という大規模かつ致死率の高いエボラ流行が7州に拡大しており、武力紛争により対応が阻害され国際支援（仏・米）も行われていることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 武力紛争（M23等）により対応拠点が破壊され、医療従事者が襲撃されるなど、感染症対応そのものが治安悪化の影響を強く受けている点に留意。北キブ州の症例はM23支配地域下にあるがルワンダ国内での発生ではないためRwandaは対象外。

article.articleHeadline: تفشي فيروس إيبولا في شرق الكونغو وتأثيره على المناطق المتمردة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo and its impact on rebel-held areas.
article.articleSummary: Six new Ebola virus disease cases have been reported in rebel-held areas of eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, where the Congo River Alliance / March 23 Movement (M23) controls parts of North Kivu and South Kivu near Lubero, close to government fronts. A patient previously known to have active infection left an Ebola treatment center after 26 days. The rebels report two new cases in Kaina (North Kivu) and four in Alimbongo. Four cases were identified post-mortem among people who died; the remaining two are receiving treatment, with contact tracing underway. Authorities note the outbreak began May 15 and, per government data, has caused over 4,000 deaths among about 8,300 confirmed cases. Earlier, rebels claimed Ebola was absent in June; a case in early September in Kaina confirmed ongoing transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部でエボラ出血熱が発生、反政府勢力支配地域への影響
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部の反政府勢力支配地域でエボラ出血熱の新規症例が報告され、致死率が高く、紛争により接触者追跡や封じ込めが困難な状況であるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 反政府勢力(M23)支配地域での発生により、政府・WHOによる確認やコンタクトトレーシングが困難な状況。致死率約48%（8,300例中4,000例死亡）と高く、紛争地域での拡大懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: गुजरात 'एकता दिवस' परेड दल में डेंगू का प्रकोप, 24 की रिपोर्ट पॉजिटिव आई | Gujarat: Dengue hits ?Ekta Diwas? parade contingent; 24 test positive (Photo: IANS)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue outbreak in Gujarat's 'Unity Day' parade contingent; 24 tested positive
article.articleSummary: An outbreak of dengue has been confirmed among National Unity Day parade personnel arriving in Gandhinagar, Gujarat for preparations. Over the past two days, at Gandhinagar Civil Hospital, at least 24 staff tested positive for dengue, with fever and body pains common among others placed under surveillance. Hospital RM0 Vipul Pandya said about 34 personnel were admitted Thursday; 23 were dengue-positive. By Friday evening, five more admissions included one positive and four suspected cases; tests for the latter were pending. By Friday afternoon roughly 10 patients had been discharged, with the remainder in stable condition and no complications reported. Most patients are aged 25–30. The individuals came from Uttar Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Maharashtra, Kerala, and Bihar, and are housed in a Gandhinagar hostel for Unity Day preparations at Unity Nagar on October 31. The source of infection is not identified; state and district health teams will conduct epidemiological assessments.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州「統一記念日」パレード隊でデング熱が発生、24人が陽性
triage.triage_reason: 特定の集団（パレード参加者）における局地的なデング熱クラスターであり、重症例や死亡の報告はないが、感染源が未特定で疫学調査中のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 複数州（ウッタル・プラデーシュ、チャッティースガル、マハーラーシュトラ、ケーララ、ビハール）出身者が1か所に集まったことでクラスター化した可能性があり、デング熱自体は季節性・地域流行性疾患であるため新規性は低い。感染源調査の結果待ち。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : plus de 4 000 morts dans la pire flambée en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: more than 4,000 dead in the worst outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 4,000 deaths with more than 8,000 confirmed cases as of October 2, 2026, according to Congolese authorities. Declared mid-May with several weeks’ delay, this is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the country, described as the largest and deadliest on record. The response is hindered by insecurity in several affected areas, complicating containment efforts. The figures come from official data published on October 2, 2026; the article does not specify laboratory confirmation details, infection source, or clinical symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国で史上最悪の流行、死者4,000人超
triage.triage_reason: 死者4,000人超・8,000人以上の確定症例という大規模流行で、IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 史上最大規模（17回目）のエボラ流行とされ、治安不安により対応が困難。詳細な検査確定情報や臨床症状の記載はなし。

article.articleHeadline: وباء إيبولا يسجل أكثر من 4 آلاف وفاة في الكونغو...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak records more than 4,000 deaths in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed 4,018 people out of 8,300 confirmed cases, making it the deadliest Ebola event in the country’s history and the 17th outbreak. As of Oct 2, 2026, 2,162 recoveries are recorded. The northern and eastern regions are affected, with North Kivu Province reporting 6 confirmed infections in areas within the province. Field operations face significant obstacles due to security risks, armed attacks, and burned health centers hindering surveillance and response. International support includes the United States providing an additional $267 million and France approving €13.4 million. One Doctors Without Borders (MSF) staff member was evacuated to the Netherlands after a confirmed infection while on duty.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱の流行により死者4,000人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の過去最大級の流行が発生し、死亡者数が4,000人を超え、治安悪化により対応が困難化、国際支援も大規模に行われているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 米国・オランダ・フランスは国際支援や感染者の後送先として記載されているが、発生国はDRCのみ。治安悪化・医療施設焼失によりサーベイランスと対応が阻害されている点が特記事項。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : 24 décès à Mahagi, aucun nouveau cas depuis près de
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: 24 deaths in Mahagi, no new case for nearly
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Ituri's Mahagi territory reports 24 deaths among 50 confirmed Ebola cases since the outbreak declaration. As of October 2, 2026, no new cases have been recorded in Mahagi for nearly two months. Mahagi continues to receive patients from other outbreak zones, notably Mongwalu, identified as a major transmission hub. Some patients are transported by motorcycle via clandestine routes to evade checkpoints, complicating epidemiological surveillance. Other health zones under surveillance include Rimba, Logo, Aungba, Kambala, and Mahagi itself. The response faces logistical challenges, particularly fuel shortages for vehicles involved in the response, including an ambulance. Community sensitization activities persist to counter misinformation and local resistance. With support from the World Health Organization and partners, territorial authorities are scaling campaigns to promote preventive measures and sustain vigilance against further spread.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州エボラ出血熱：マハギで24人死亡、約2ヶ月間新規症例なし
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクで50症例・24死亡と公衆衛生への深刻な影響があり、越境・他地域への感染拡大リスク（検問回避の密輸ルート経由での患者移送）も確認されるためフルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 新規症例は約2ヶ月間報告されていないものの、他地域（モングワロ等）からの患者流入が継続し、燃料不足などロジスティクス上の課題、WHO支援下での対応継続が確認されるため引き続き注視が必要。アンゴラ（Lunda Norte）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia di Ebola, in Congo si contano almeno 4.000 morti e 8.000 casi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic, in Congo at least 4,000 deaths and 8,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has caused more than 4,000 deaths among over 8,000 confirmed cases. Latest official data show 4,018 deaths on 8,300 cases, with 2,162 recoveries and a case fatality rate of 48.4%. Identified mid-May, the outbreak began in Ituri and has spread to seven northern and eastern provinces, including North Kivu, where four deaths were reported among six cases in areas controlled by the M23 movement backed by Kigali. Violence and resource shortages have hampered the response; clashes in Ituri displaced over 5,000 people, a transit center was burned, and a case-finder was killed in North Kivu. France and the United States pledged funds to support aid and response (France 13.4 million euros Jan-Jul; US 237 million euros). Vaccines and therapies for Bundibugyo strain are under study, with Ervebo doses administered to frontline staff in a clinical trial.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行、コンゴで少なくとも4,000人死亡、8,000症例
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%の大規模エボラ流行がDRC複数州に拡大し、紛争により対応が阻害されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当し国際支援も行われている。
triage.notes: 米国・フランスなど発生地域に含まれる国は資金援助提供国であり発生国ではないため除外。ルワンダも同様に発生国ではなく除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebole v KDR podľahlo už viac ako 4-tisíc ľudí
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo has claimed more than 4,000 lives.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has claimed more than 4,000 lives as of 2 October 2026. Tallies show 8,300 infections, 4,018 deaths, and 2,162 recoveries, a case fatality of 48.4%. The 17th outbreak began in Ituri in the northeast and has spread to seven northern and eastern provinces, hampered by conflict and distrust. In Ituri, clashes displaced over 5,000 people and a transit center for Ebola patients was burned after soldiers entered the site. In North Kivu, an attack on a health facility killed a case-finder. M23 reports indicate six Ebola cases in North Kivu, four deaths. The outbreak is driven by a rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain first identified in 2007 in Uganda, with no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Vaccines and therapies are under study; Ervebo has begun dosing frontline workers and has shown efficacy against Zaire ebolavirus. US provided $267 million in September; France allocated €13.4 million to support the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱、死者4000人超
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%の大規模エボラ流行（感染8,300人、死亡4,018人）が7州に拡大し、紛争により対応が妨げられている重大な公衆衛生事態であり、国際支援も実施されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダ由来の稀なBundibugyo株による第17次流行で、ワクチン未承認。紛争による治療センター焼失・医療従事者殺害などアクセス制限要因あり。米国・フランスが資金支援。ウガンダ・米国・フランスは発生地域ではなく支援国または株の由来地として言及されているため対象国リストからは除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 8 224 cas confirmés et 3 982 décès au 2 octobre - Mali Actu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 8,224 confirmed cases and 3,982 deaths as of October 2 - Mali Actu
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports 8,224 confirmed Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases and 3,982 deaths as of October 2, 2026, per the Ministry of Communication and Media via Anadolu Agency as cited by Mali Actu. The outbreak spans seven provinces and 63 health zones. Key indicators: 851 patients in isolation or hospitalized; 2,121 recovered; case-fatality rate 48.4%; contact tracing 78.7%. These figures are provisional snapshots; the count surpassed 8,000 by late September. Ituri remains the epicenter with 6,155 cases and 2,834 deaths, while Nord-Kivu has 1,523 cases and 906 deaths. The response focuses on patient care, community prevention, and capacity strengthening of health teams, with a call to report symptoms via the toll-free line 151. No Mali-linked cases are reported in these Congolese tallies.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：10月2日時点で確認症例8,224件、死者3,982人 - Mali Actu
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%の大規模エボラアウトブレイクが7州63保健地区に拡大しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: Mali（対象国外）は記事中で『マリ関連の症例は報告されていない』と明記されており、実際の発生国はDRCのみ。Ituri州とNord-Kivu州が主要被災地域。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Nia-Nia : l'inauguration d'un centre de transit annoncée dans les prochains jours - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Nia-Nia: inauguration of a transit center announced in the coming days - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, Ebola in Nia-Nia (Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo) prompts plans for a transit center inauguration. Dr. Joseph Pemanakue, the medical chief of the Nia-Nia health zone, announced that a transit center under construction at PK47 on the Nia-Nia-PK51 axis will be inaugurated by the end of the week to streamline management of suspected Ebola cases along this corridor. The facility will receive and monitor suspected cases before referral to the Nia-Nia Treatment Center (CTE) upon confirmation. Samples collected there will be sent to the Nia-Nia laboratory for early testing and patient management. An ambulance will be stationed at PK47 to enable rapid transfer of any positive patient directly to the CTE, enhancing prompt care and isolation.

triage.headline_ja: ニア・ニアのエボラ出血熱:数日中にトランジットセンターの開設を発表 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州ニア・ニアでエボラ出血熱の疑い症例管理体制が構築されており、既存のアウトブレイク対応の一環とみられ、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクが高い疾病であるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ疑い症例の管理体制構築（トランジットセンター開設）に関するものであり、具体的な症例数・死亡者数・アウトブレイク規模は記載されていない。既存のエボラ流行への対応措置と推察されるが、現時点のアウトブレイク状況の詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Mandima : quatre points de contrôle activés pour renforcer la surveillance(Coordonnateur provincial du PNHF) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Mandima: four checkpoints activated to strengthen surveillance (Provincial Coordinator of the PNHF) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Four checkpoints equipped with supplies were activated in Mandima health zone, Ituri province, North-East Democratic Republic of Congo, as of 2 October 2026, in the response to the 17th Ebola virus disease outbreak. The handover, supported by the SGI Presidential Task Force and the International Organization for Migration, aims to strengthen surveillance along main transit routes through systematic traveler screening and alert identification to interrupt transmission chains. Dr. Théophile Ponde, provincial coordinator of the National Program for Border Hygiene (PNHF) in Ituri, emphasized that entry-point staff enhance epidemiological surveillance by engaging communities, easing dialogue with travellers and residents, reducing resistance, and improving acceptance of public health measures. The measures come as Mandima reports a surge in Ebola cases in recent days, underscoring the need for enhanced movement monitoring of travelers across key corridors.

triage.headline_ja: マンディマでのエボラ出血熱：監視強化のため4つの検問所を設置（PNHF州調整官）
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の第17次アウトブレイクがコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州マンディマで継続中であり、症例急増が報告されている。重篤な疾患でヒト-ヒト感染のリスクがあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCイトゥリ州マンディマでの第17次エボラアウトブレイクの監視強化策（検問所設置）について報じており、症例急増の記載あり。IOMや大統領タスクフォースが関与し国際的な支援体制が既に稼働中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak in DR Congo Surpasses 4,000 Deaths as Containment Efforts Struggle
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has 4,018 deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases, with 2,162 recoveries, as of 2 October 2026. Declared on 15 May 2026, it spans seven provinces and 63 health zones, with 45 reporting active transmission and a case fatality rate of 48.4%. It is the deadliest Ebola epidemic in DRC history and the second-deadliest globally after 2014–2016 West Africa. Africa CDC notes a local decline in reported cases in some areas, but warns this may reflect surveillance gaps; Médecins Sans Frontières cautions the true toll is higher due to incomplete detection. Containment is hindered by insecurity in eastern provinces (Ituri epicenter), community resistance, and mistrust; a transit centre near Bunia was burned, displacing thousands. No approved vaccine or specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo; experimental options are under evaluation. WHO warns the outbreak remains far from over and could exceed West Africa if response challenges persist, urging intensified international support for surveillance, engagement, and logistics.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、死者数4,000人を超え封じ込め対応が難航
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%・死者4,000人超のDRC史上最悪のエボラ流行であり、治安悪化や地域社会の不信による封じ込め困難、国際支援要請がなされているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: Angolaは発生地域に含まれるが記事本文では言及されておらず、国境を越えた拡大リスクとしての言及もないため verified_locations からは除外。ワクチン・治療法未承認であること、サーベイランスの不備により実態はさらに深刻な可能性がある点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يحصد أكثر من 4 آلاف قتيل في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola kills more than 4,000 people in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Over 4,000 people have died from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 8,300 infections and 2,162 recoveries reported. The outbreak, the seventh Ebola episode in the DRC, began in May in Ituri with the Bundibugyo strain and has spread to seven northern and eastern provinces. Efforts are hindered by resource shortages, armed groups, and public distrust; in North Kivu, six cases (including four deaths) were recorded in areas controlled by the M23. A UN incident saw soldiers burn a patient-transfer camp in Ituri near Bunia, prompting about 19,000 people to flee. France pledged 13.4 million euros and the United States 267 million dollars to combat Ebola, while MSF evacuated one staff member to the Netherlands after infection. WHO cited encouraging signs in mid-September, but Africa CDC cautioned the outbreak is not under control.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国で死者4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは死者4,000人超、感染者8,300人に達し、複数州に拡大、武装勢力による対応妨害や国際支援(仏・米の資金拠出、MSFスタッフの国外搬送)も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 米国・オランダ・フランスは資金拠出やMSFスタッフの搬送先として言及されているが、アウトブレイク発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。北キブ州ではM23支配地域での症例も報告されており、治安情勢が対応を複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola se extiende en RD Congo y deja ya 4.000 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak is spreading in the DR Congo and has already left 4,000 dead.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the country's worst yet, has 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths (2,162 recoveries; 48.4% case fatality). Detected mid-May, it began in Ituri and has spread to seven northern and eastern provinces amid conflict and severe resource shortages that hamper response. Violence has displaced over 5,000 people; a transit center for Ebola patients was burned in Ituri after soldiers entered a displacement camp; a contracted case-detection worker was killed at a health center in North Kivu. France has allocated €13.4 million to Ebola response (Jan–Jul); the United States announced €237 million to curb spread. Healthcare workers are at high risk in poor, remote areas. Vaccines and treatments are being studied for the Bundibugyo strain; Ervebo doses have been given to frontline staff as part of a clinical trial, though Ervebo was previously shown effective against the Zaire strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の感染拡大、死者数は既に4,000人に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%、8300症例・4000人超の死者を出すDRC史上最悪のエボラ流行で、紛争地域での対応困難と国際支援（米仏による巨額拠出）も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: 米国・フランスは資金拠出国であり発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外。DRC史上最悪規模の流行で、紛争による対応阻害、医療従事者殺害、ワクチン治験（Ervebo、Bundibugyo株）など複数の懸念要因あり。

article.articleHeadline: En République démocratique du Congo, l'épidémie d'Ebola dépasse les 4 000 morts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ebola outbreak has surpassed 4,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 deaths, reflecting a devastating toll from this flare-up. As of October 2, 2026, Congolese authorities report 8,300 cumulative cases, including 4,018 deaths and 2,162 recoveries, yielding a case fatality rate of 48.4%. The update confirms that this outbreak is the deadliest ever recorded in the DRC, signaling ongoing, high-fatality transmission across affected regions. The reported figures highlight the persistent burden on the health system as responders continue to track cases and provide care to those infected. The data presented correspond to the latest official tally released by authorities on the specified date.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行が死者4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%・死者4,000人超のDRC史上最悪のエボラ流行であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: DRC史上最悪規模のエボラ流行とされ、死者数・症例数ともに継続的に増加中。WHOや国際支援の状況については記事中に明記なし（不明）。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка Эболы в Демократической Республике Конго унесла жизни более 4 000 человек (официальные данные)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has claimed more than 4,000 lives (official data).
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak has 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths, with 2,162 recoveries (case fatality 48.4%). The mid-May outbreak originated in Ituri and has spread to seven northern and eastern provinces amid ongoing armed conflict that hampers medical response. In North Kivu, 6 cases and 4 deaths were reported in areas controlled by the M23 anti-government coalition. Violent clashes disrupted care; a transit center for Ebola patients was burned and a contractor aiding case detection was killed. France pledged €13.4 million for Jan–Jul Ebola response, and the United States announced an additional €237 million. Work is under way on vaccines and therapies for Bundibugyo ebolavirus (Bundibugyo strain), including first Ervebo doses given to frontline workers in clinical trials.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、死者4,000人超（公式発表）
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%の大規模エボラアウトブレイクが武力紛争下で7州に拡大し、国際支援も大規模に投入されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 米国・フランスからの資金援助、ワクチン（Ervebo）の臨床試験導入など国際的関与が顕著。武力紛争（M23）により医療対応が妨げられている点は管理困難性を示す重要な要素。米国・フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en la República Democrática del Congo roza los 4.000 muertos y supera los 8.200 casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo nears 4,000 deaths and surpasses 8,200 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains the deadliest in the country’s history, with 8,224 confirmed cases and 3,982 deaths as of 2026-10-02, per the INSP, a case fatality rate of 48.4%. In the last 24 hours, 53 new infections and 28 deaths were reported. About 851 patients are hospitalized or in isolation, while 2,121 have recovered. Contact tracing coverage stands at 78.7%. The epicenter is Ituri province, accounting for ~76% of total cases; seven provinces are affected: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, Tshopo, and Ubangi-Sud. Violence in the east hampers the response, with 63 of 167 health zones affected and ongoing displacement. DR Congo has the deepest Ebola experience globally; Kasai outbreak ended in December 2025. Projections suggest it could surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) of 28,616 cases and 11,325 deaths per WHO.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola dans la Tshopo : 10.000 doses de vaccin attendues (Chef de division) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Tshopo: 10,000 vaccine doses expected (Division Chief) - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Kisangani, in the North-East Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Tshopo province, is set to receive more than 10,000 Ebola virus disease (EVD) vaccine doses to sustain vaccination of frontline health workers and other first responders. On October 2, 2026, Dr. Bienvenu Ikomo, provincial health division chief, said the province previously received 5,500 doses and is currently facing a shortage, with frontline staff numbering over 8,000. Vaccination coverage in this category remains below 80%. The initial 5,500 doses were allocated to frontline workers at the campaign’s start due to direct exposure in health facilities and on the field. The vaccine in use is based on the Zaire (Zaïre) strain, while the outbreak strain identified is Bundibugyo, reflecting an effort to achieve cross-immunity amid limited doses. The additional supply will strengthen ongoing vaccination and protection of frontline personnel.

triage.headline_ja: タショパ州のエボラ出血熱：ワクチン1万回分の到着を期待（保健局長）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCタショパ州で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにおいて、最前線医療従事者向けワクチンの不足と追加供給計画が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）を満たす。
triage.notes: 既存のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクの継続報道。ワクチン（ザイール株ベース）の交差免疫による対応状況と供給不足が焦点。フルRRAでの経過確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Kisangani : appel à la déclaration des cas lancé aux structures sanitaires - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kisangani: Call for Reporting of Cases Directed at Health Facilities - ACP
article.articleSummary: In Kisangani, North-East Democratic Republic of Congo, health authorities are urged to report any suspected or confirmed Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases to public or private health facilities. University professor and microbiology expert Alain Okito emphasized that reporting is a responsibility to patients and the community and does not imply patients will flee. He reassured the public about the reality of Ebola and urged protective behaviors, including regular handwashing, avoiding unnecessary physical contact, reducing travel and gatherings, and limiting contacts in crowded venues such as bars and restaurants. As of October 1, 2026, the Tshopo province records a cumulative 46 confirmed EVD cases. The message calls for heightened surveillance and prompt case reporting to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニでのエボラ出血熱:医療機関への症例報告呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準上常に通知対象となる重篤な疾患であり、DRC・ツショポ州で46例の確定例が累積しているため、公衆衛生上重大な影響と国際的拡大のリスクが認められる。
triage.notes: ツショポ州キサンガニでのエボラ流行が継続中で、累積46例の確定症例が報告されている。症例報告の徹底と行動変容の呼びかけが行われており、感染拡大防止のための監視強化が求められている段階。

article.articleHeadline: Beni : dix patients guéris d'Ebola quittent les centres de traitement en une journée - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: Ten Ebola patients who recovered left treatment centers in a single day - ACP.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, ten patients recovered from Ebola and were discharged from two treatment centers in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, marking a record single-day recovery since the outbreak’s declaration. Dr. Jérémie Muhindo noted durations of 9 and 22 days in care and stressed that early detection and rapid treatment increase survival chances, urging families to trust health facilities. Ongoing new cases persist in Beni and Nord-Kivu amid lingering distrust and home-based care practices that risk further transmission. He rejected the view of treatment centers as “mouroirs,” and acknowledged infections among health workers. Community-focused sensitization—targeting youth leaders, civil groups, and motorbike associations—aims to establish community-based surveillance to quickly identify suspected cases and refer them for care, helping to end the eastern DRC outbreak after the region’s 2018-2020 experience.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ：エボラから回復した10人の患者が1日で治療センターを退院 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のDRCエボラアウトブレイクに関する報告で、医療従事者への感染や新規症例の継続が記載されており、公衆衛生上重大なリスクが継続しているため。
triage.notes: 既知のエボラアウトブレイク（北キブ州ベニ）に関する継続報告。新規症例や医療従事者感染、家庭内ケアによる感染拡大リスクが記載されており、既存のRRA対象イベントの続報と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: 4000 حالة وفاة جراء وباء إيبولا في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 4000 deaths due to the Ebola outbreak in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused more than 4,000 deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases, authorities report. The seventh and deadliest outbreak in the DRC started in Ituri and has expanded to seven provinces in the north and east. Of the 8,300 cases, 4,018 have died and 2,162 have recovered. Six cases, including four deaths, have been recorded in North Kivu in areas controlled by M23 rebels (backed by Rwanda). Response efforts are hampered by resource shortages, armed-group activity, and distrust among communities in some of the most unstable regions. The outbreak underscores persistent, complex public health challenges in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱流行により4000人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行(8300症例、4000人超死亡)が7州に拡大しており、致死率の高さ、武装勢力活動による対応困難、国際的拡大リスクからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの流行拡大を主題としている。ルワンダは地理的近接・M23支配地域への言及のみで、ルワンダ国内での発生は確認されていないため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 5 questions about Congo's Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo has caused 4,018 deaths among 8,300 cases since May 15, the fastest-growing outbreak in history. As of 2026-10-02, weekly cases have dipped to about 490 with 230 deaths in September, though Africa CDC cautions that insecurity and community resistance may explain the decline. The WHO warns the outbreak could surpass West Africa's 2014-2016 toll of about 11,000. Response challenges include unpaid wages triggering protests in Bunia, a burned displacement camp in Kigonze that forced about 19,000 to flee, and deep distrust. At least 50 health workers have died; an MSF worker infected was flown to the Netherlands and placed in Leiden's isolation unit. Mobile laboratories now provide results in six hours, and a village-centered education approach faces resistance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行に関する5つの疑問
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ東部で史上最速拡大とされるエボラ流行が継続し、死者4,018人・症例8,300件に達し、国際医療従事者の感染搬送も発生しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: オランダ（Leiden）は感染したMSFスタッフの搬送・隔離先であり発生地域ではないため除外。Angola・Africa(大陸)も記事主題の発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果民主共和國本輪伊波拉疫情造成逾4000人死亡
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo's current Ebola outbreak has killed more than 4,000 people.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-02, the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ebola outbreak has spread to seven provinces, with 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths (case fatality rate 48.4%), and over 2,100 recoveries. The outbreak was declared in May 2026 and is described by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus as the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record. Médecins Sans Frontières cautions that surveillance and case-finding gaps may mean the true number of cases is higher than official totals. Vaccination campaigns are underway, including in Ituri Province where Governor Mulomba received the Ebola vaccine. The report underscores ongoing transmission in the DRC and the need for sustained public health response to control this substantial outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、今回のエボラ出血熱流行で死者4,000人超
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する大規模エボラ流行（8,300症例、死者4,018人、致死率48.4%、7州に拡大）であり、史上2番目の規模とWHOが認識する重大な公衆衛生イベント。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が史上2番目の規模と言及、MSFはサーベイランス不足により実際の症例数がさらに多い可能性を指摘。ワクチン接種活動が進行中だが、致死率48.4%と非常に高く、国際的な支援継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: República Democrática del Congo: qué se sabe del brote de ébola que ya superó los 4.000 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: What Is Known About the Ebola Outbreak That Has Already Surpassed 4,000 Deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues, surpassing 4,000 deaths and over 8,300 confirmed cases as of Oct 2, 2026. Declared May 15, 2026, the outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant, for which there are no approved vaccines or specific therapies. Case fatality rate around 48% in hardest-hit areas. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected humans or animals, causing hemorrhagic fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and multiorgan failure. The epidemic is the most severe in the country’s history, amplified by armed violence, mass displacement, healthcare worker strikes, and local mistrust toward authorities. Epidemiological teams report tracing about 80.6% of direct contacts to prevent spread to major urban centers or cross-border regions. International collaboration and investment are essential to control the outbreak and rebuild public health capacity in conflict-affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:死者4,000人を超えたエボラ出血熱の流行について分かっていること
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約48%、4,000人超の死亡、ワクチン未承認のBundibugyo型エボラの大規模流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大イベント。
triage.notes: 国内史上最悪規模の流行とされ、武力紛争・住民移動・医療従事者ストライキ等により対応が複雑化。国境地域や都市部への拡大リスクが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Influenciadora é internada após infecção retornar com fortes dores e vômitos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influencer is hospitalized after an infection returns with severe pain and vomiting.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-02, Brazilian digital influencer Jéssica Ingrede from Acre was hospitalized in the capital after a previously contracted infection resurfaced. The illness originated during a trip to Cruzeiro do Sul, in interior Acre. The return of the infection caused severe vomiting, nausea, and intense pain. She initially sought care at an urgent care clinic, but symptoms worsened, requiring admission to a private hospital. At the hospital, she underwent an electrocardiogram and comprehensive testing; she endured extreme pain necessitating morphine. In Cruzeiro do Sul she reportedly had only malaise and no tests, but at the current facility many abnormal laboratory values were detected, prompting inpatient care. She remains under observation with some fluctuations in condition but reports improvement and emphasizes adhering to the prescribed treatment. The case highlights a reemergence of infection after an initial period of recovery.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンサーが感染症再発により入院、激しい痛みと嘔吐を訴える
triage.triage_reason: 単一の個人症例であり、病原体不明、公衆衛生上の広がりや異常性を示す根拠がなく、社会的関心も個人の有名人報道に限られる。
triage.notes: 疾患名が不明であり、個人の有名人に関するゴシップ的な報道。公衆衛生イベントとしての特徴（集団発生、病原体特定、感染経路の明示）が見られないため、対象国の公衆衛生事象としては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Famato reforça cuidados para prevenir a raiva e alerta para a importância da comunicação de suspeitas nos rebanhos " Notícia Exata - Notícias de Alta Floresta e Região!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Famato reinforces precautions to prevent rabies and alerts to the importance of reporting suspected cases in herds
article.articleSummary: Six rabies cases were confirmed in September in Mato Grosso: one equine and five bovines on farms in Dom Aquino and Rondonópolis. Mato Grosso reported 25 foci in 2024, 26 in 2025, and 18 foci through September 27, 2026. Famato emphasizes vaccination and reporting to Indea-MT for investigation by the Official Veterinary Service. Rabies is a fatal viral disease of the central nervous system, mainly transmitted to production animals by hematophagous bats. Neurologic signs include herd isolation, ataxia, stumbling, hind-limb paralysis, urinary/defecatory issues, and death after lateral recumbency with paddling. Early reporting allows lab confirmation by Indea’s own lab, in partnership with UFMT, at no cost to producers. Humans are at risk; seek care and inform Indea-MT after bat exposure. Vaccination: initial two-dose schedule 30 days apart for newcomers, then annual boosters; avoid handling suspect animals and refrain from capturing bats.

triage.headline_ja: ファマト、狂犬病予防のための注意喚起を強化し、家畜における疑い例の報告の重要性を訴える
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・マトグロッソ州における家畜（牛・馬）の狂犬病発生に関する定例の獣医学的注意喚起であり、人の感染例は確認されておらず、例年通りの発生数の範囲内であるため。
triage.notes: 記事は家畜（牛・馬）の狂犬病発生とコウモリ媒介による感染リスクについての農業団体（Famato）による予防啓発記事。人への感染報告はなく、例年並みの発生件数（2024年25件、2025年26件、2026年9月時点18件）であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: एकता परेड से पहले गुजरात में डेंगू का साया, 6 हजार जवानों में से 14 पॉजिटिव, अलर्ट मोड पर स्वास्थ्य विभाग
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue looms in Gujarat ahead of Unity Parade, 14 positive cases among 6,000 personnel, health department on alert.
article.articleSummary: Dengue confirmed in 14 of about 6,000 security personnel from states including Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Bihar, Odisha, Punjab, Kerala and Andhra Pradesh who arrived in Gandhinagar for rehearsals for the Unity Parade at the Statue of Unity in Gujarat, scheduled for Oct 31. The 14 positives were among personnel from BSF, ITBP and other reserve forces lodged in newly built Government quarters in Sector 28 and 29; several developed fever and were admitted to Gandhinagar Civil Hospital. Over 50 samples were collected; none is in critical condition; all are receiving treatment. The Gandhinagar health department has a three-phase response: Phase 1 - treat confirmed dengue cases; Phase 2 - fogging of about 1,000 quarters; Phase 3 - fogging within 500 meters of quarters, empty water-filled containers and treat with larvicides, and conduct local checks to prevent spread. No deaths reported.

triage.headline_ja: ユニティ・パレードを前にグジャラートでデング熱、6000人の隊員中14人が陽性、保健当局が警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はインドで季節的に発生する風土病であり、重症例・死亡者はなく規模も限定的だが、国家的行事（ユニティ・パレード）関連で複数州から集まった要員間での発生であり、今後の拡大を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: जंगल में 'राजकुमार' की रहस्यमय मौत! न शरीर पर चोट, न पेट में भोजन मिला...आखिर कौन सी बीमारी खूंखार जानवर को बीमार बना रही?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mysterious death of the 'Prince' in the jungle! No injuries on the body, no food found in the stomach... Which disease is making the ferocious animal ill?
article.articleSummary: Barwani, Madhya Pradesh: A two-year-old female tiger was found dead in Barwani Forest Division, near Rehgun village, about 200 metres into the jungle, around 6:35 pm. A postmortem led by Dr. Mahendra Baghel found no external injuries; the carcass had languished for about 48 hours. The abdomen contained neither food nor water, and lesions were noted in the stomach suggesting possible infection. Doctors cite dehydration and infection as potential drivers; septicemia remains a concern but the exact cause awaits laboratory confirmation on viscera samples. Poison was not indicated. This is the second tiger death in West Nimad within a short span; earlier, on Sept 11, an adult tiger in Chirai Forest range, Khargone district, died with hind-limb paralysis; dehydration and starvation suspected. Officials say food-water availability and health monitoring are under review; the body was cremated per protocol.

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Beni: 10 patients guéris d'Ebola sortent des CTE | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Beni: 10 Ebola survivors leave Ebola treatment centers | mediacongo.net.
article.articleSummary: Ten Ebola survivors left treatment centers in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, on 2 October 2026, as the Ebola outbreak remains active in North Kivu. Seven were discharged from an International Medical Corps Ebola Treatment Center, and three from MSF-Holland’s center; among them is a nurse who contracted the virus while caring for a patient. This development signals progress in the response, with ongoing care and contact tracing to curb transmission. A visit by women’s organizations to IMC’s CTE highlighted care protocols and protective measures to inform communities and reduce rumors about the disease and the treatment centers. The response emphasizes early screening and rapid referral of suspected cases to interrupt transmission chains and strengthen community trust in control measures.

article.articleHeadline: أكثر من 4 آلاف وفاة.. الكونغو الديمقراطية تواجه أسوأ تفشٍّ لإيبولا في تاريخها
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 4,000 deaths: the Democratic Republic of the Congo faces the worst Ebola outbreak in its history.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak—the deadliest in its history—has caused 4,018 deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases, with 2,162 recoveries (case fatality rate 48.4%). Detected in mid-May, it has spread across seven northern and eastern provinces, beginning in Ituri and reaching North Kivu. Violence and mistrust hinder response, driving displacement of thousands; a crossing center for Ebola patients was burned and a contractor monitoring cases was killed in separate attacks. France’s Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot planned to visit Bunia; Paris had previously allocated €13.4 million, while the US announced another €237 million. Doctors Without Borders evacuated a staffer after infection; the patient is a doctor deployed from the Netherlands. Vaccines and therapies are under study for Bundibugyo; frontline workers have begun Ervebo dosing in a trial, after efficacy against Zaire. WHO noted encouraging signs in mid-September, but Africa CDC says the outbreak is not under control.

article.articleHeadline: Leishmaniose é tema de palestra para profissionais da Saúde de Felisburgo e Rio do Prado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leishmaniasis is the topic of a lecture for health professionals from Felisburgo and Rio do Prado
article.articleSummary: Health professionals from Felisburgo and Rio do Prado in Brazil attended a lecture on leishmaniasis, held as a collaboration between the Felisburgo and Rio do Prado city halls and the Nascentes de Pureza Masonic Lodge. The session focused on recognizing the disease's main symptoms, preventive measures, and the importance of seeking medical care for suspected cases. The aim was to strengthen local capacity to identify possible infections and implement prevention strategies. Participants were reminded to monitor for signs warranting professional evaluation, such as non-healing wounds that persist. Leishmaniasis is an infectious disease caused by Leishmania parasites and transmitted by phlebotomine sandflies. Early detection and appropriate treatment depend on prompt medical consultation. The initiative underscores ongoing training of health teams and information dissemination to protect the population from leishmaniasis.

article.articleHeadline: Militia Violence Empties 19,000-Person Camp at Heart of Ebola Outbreak as Death Toll Rises
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province; the Kigonze displacement camp, which housed about 19,000 people, has been emptied after a military raid. As of this week, authorities report over 8,000 Ebola cases and more than 4,000 deaths (case-fatality ≈50%), with the western media and WHO noting the outbreak could become the deadliest in DRC history and potentially the worst on record globally. Transmission remains via contact with infected bodily fluids, not airborne. Ongoing violence and distrust hinder emergency response, with health workers facing mob attacks and mass displacement fueling further spread. The camp loss also undermines surveillance; meanwhile, Ituri hosts more than 1.1 million displaced people, including 373,000 in camps. Despite chaos, progress includes expanding mobile burial teams (114) and deploying 57 community burial teams in Mangala and Fataki, though a key Ebola transfer/treatment center at Kigonze burned down this week.

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو.. 4 آلاف وفاة و8 آلاف إصابة بإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo: 4,000 deaths and 8,000 infections from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has tallied 8,300 confirmed infections and 4,018 deaths, with 2,162 recoveries, as of 2 October 2026. The seventh, and deadliest, outbreak began in Ituri (northeast) and has spread to seven provinces, including North Kivu, where six cases (four deaths) were recorded. The response is hampered by armed clashes, resource shortages, and widespread insecurity. A treatment center in Ituri was burned after soldiers entered a displacement site, triggering evacuations; a health worker assisting case finding was killed at a North Kivu checkpoint. France has earmarked €13.4 million for Ebola control (Jan–Jul), while the United States released $267 million more. Doctors Without Borders evacuated one staff member to the Netherlands after Ebola confirmation; Dutch authorities confirmed the patient is a doctor deployed to DRC. WHO reported encouraging indicators in mid-September, but African Union health officials say the outbreak is not under control.

article.articleHeadline: Ecuador registra un aumento de casos de dengue ante la llegada de El Niño
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ecuador reports an increase in dengue cases ahead of El Niño's arrival.
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases rise in Ecuador ahead of El Niño. From Aug 31 to Sep 6, 2026, the Ministry of Public Health reports 34,058 dengue infections nationwide, an 18% increase from the same period in 2025, with an incidence of about 172 per 100,000 population. The highest burden is in Guayas province, with deaths in Naranjal, Balzar, Durán, and Salitre. In Guayaquil, by Sep 22, 2026, 459 dengue cases have been reported citywide, including 47 in September; August had 57 cases, a 17.5% decline. Dengue is categorized as without warning signs, with warning signs, and severe dengue; in Guayaquil most cases lack warning signs. Common symptoms include fever >38°C, headache, myalgias, and malaise. Warning signs include persistent vomiting, severe abdominal pain, and mucosal bleeding. Illness typically lasts 1–7 days (up to 10). Authorities warn against self-medication and NSAID misuse; prevention emphasizes reducing Aedes mosquito breeding.

article.articleSummary: Ebola fever in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed 4,018 people among about 8,300 laboratory-confirmed cases, yielding a case-fatality rate of 48.4%. Authorities emphasize ongoing surveillance and cross-border coordination as cases accumulate. Public health authorities are monitoring hospitalizations, viral load, and potential nosocomial transmission.

article.articleHeadline: Afrique : Mandat d'arrêt contre une ex-présidente du Parlement sud-africain, l'UA s'inquiète de la crise Éthiopie-Érythrée, Ebola tue encore en RDC... l'actualité chaude de ce 2 octobre - Cameroun24.net infos actus news
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa: Arrest warrant for a former Speaker of the South African Parliament, the AU is concerned about the Ethiopia-Eritrea crisis, Ebola continues to kill in the DRC... the top news on October 2 - Cameroun24.net news updates
article.articleSummary: Laboratory-confirmed Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo exceed 4,000 as of October 2, 2026, underscoring a continuing deadly outbreak with limited publicly detailed case totals. Concurrently, the African Union urged Ethiopia, Eritrea, and Egypt to exercise maximum restraint and pursue peaceful dialogue to avoid destabilizing the region amid the Ethiopia–Eritrea crisis. In northern Ethiopia, fighting across Tigré, Afar, and Amhara has displaced tens of thousands; 480 injuries, including civilians, were admitted to hospitals in Korem and Alamata. Humanitarian operations are severely hampered by ongoing conflict, with aid deliveries affected by drones and air strikes. Diplomatic tensions intensified: Ethiopia closed its embassy in Asmara and declared Eritrean diplomats persona non grata; Eritrea severed relations, and Egyptian diplomats were expelled from Addis Ababa, with reciprocal moves reported from Cairo.

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Las lecciones de África y el papel de la Iglesia para contener el virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Africa's Lessons and the Church's Role in Containing the Virus.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus has claimed over 4,000 lives since its May 2026 declaration. Ebola symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle pains, sore throat, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, and rashes; the World Health Organization notes a global case fatality around 50%, with outbreaks ranging 25–90%. Containment emphasizes rapid detection and isolation, laboratory testing, contact tracing, infection prevention, and protecting health workers, alongside swift, coordinated responses. Community trust and religious leadership are highlighted, with Caritas Bunia and Sister Angèle Gapio underscoring the church’s role in risk communication and promoting safe, dignified burials. While imported cases can occur, CDC notes they do not necessarily yield sustained transmission; past examples (Nigeria, Senegal, Mali) show containment with quick action. No vaccines or universal treatments exist for all Ebolavirus species, and risk depends on travel, surveillance, and outbreak magnitude.

article.articleHeadline: ΛΔ Κονγκό: Ξεπέρασαν τους 4.000 οι νεκροί από τον Έμπολα - Φόβοι για νέα διασπορά
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Death toll from Ebola surpasses 4,000 - Fears of a new outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 4,000 deaths as of 2026-10-02, amid ongoing transmission driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. The current wave is described as the worst and most devastating in the country’s history, and the second deadliest Ebola outbreak worldwide after the 2014-2016 West Africa crisis (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone with more than 28,600 cases and over 11,000 deaths). Although September reports flagged early signs of decline in Ituri province, the eastern region continues to experience rapid spread. A fatal case in North Ubangi province—an individual who traveled from the east to the northwest—demonstrates the virus’s geographic dispersion within the country. The situation remains critical, with public health systems struggling to curb transmission.

article.articleHeadline: Demokratyczna Republika Konga. Tragiczny bilans epidemii wirusa ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo. The tragic toll of the Ebola virus outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, was detected mid-May and has infected 8,300 people with 4,018 deaths and 2,162 recoveries (case fatality ~48.4%). Ituri province remains the epicenter, with signs of waning transmission in some areas but ongoing spread amid conflict and distrust in several provinces. New cases have appeared in territory controlled by Rwanda-backed AFC/M23 rebels—six infections there (four identified at autopsy, two under treatment). Since the outbreak began, about 2,000 patients have recovered. Response efforts are hampered by violence: a medical center in Ituri burned during clashes; a health worker was killed in an attack on a facility in North Kivu. Reuters notes this is the deadliest Ebola outbreak since the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic.

article.articleHeadline: Над 4000 жертви на ебола в ДР Конго при най-тежката епидемия досега
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 4,000 Ebola deaths in DR Congo during the deadliest outbreak to date.
article.articleSummary: More than 4,000 deaths and about 8,300 Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo strain) infections have been reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo, making it the deadliest outbreak to date. By 2 October 2026, 4,018 fatalities and 8,300 confirmed cases, with 2,162 recoveries and a case fatality rate of 48.4%, are documented. The outbreak began in Ituri and has spread to seven northern and eastern provinces. In North Kivu, four deaths occurred among six cases in areas controlled by the M23 group. Conflict and resource shortages hamper containment, with over 5,000 people displaced; a transit center for Ebola patients was burned, and a health worker employed by a contractor was killed at a North Kivu facility. Vaccines and therapies for Bundibugyo ebolavirus are under study, and initial Ervebo doses have been given to frontline workers as part of a clinical trial.

triage.headline_ja: DR コンゴで4000人超のエボラ死者、過去最悪の流行に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%、8,300症例・4,018死亡という大規模流行で、7州に拡大し紛争地域での対応困難も重なり、国際的拡大・渡航貿易制限リスクが高いためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 武装勢力（M23）による紛争地域での対応困難、医療従事者殺害、移送施設焼失など、治安悪化が流行制御を著しく阻害している点に注意。過去最悪規模の流行であり、ワクチン・治療薬の臨床試験も進行中。

article.articleHeadline: La epidemia de ébola en República Democrática del Congo supera los 4.000 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 4,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 deaths. Authorities report 8,300 cases and 4,018 fatalities, for a case-fatality rate of about 48.4%. The outbreak began in Ituri province in the northeast and is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no licensed vaccine or specific treatment exists. It has spread to six northern and eastern provinces where state control is fragile and armed groups operate. Early Bundibugyo infection can display seemingly mild symptoms, delaying detection. Several experimental treatments and vaccines are in trials against this strain. Historically, Zaire ebolavirus has caused most outbreaks in the DRC, but this episode centers on Bundibugyo in this region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、死者4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 死者4,000人・致死率48.4%と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、ワクチン未承認のブンディブギョ株で複数州に拡大、紛争地域で統制困難なためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス株による流行で、武装勢力が活動する統制困難な地域に拡大している点が特に懸念される。ワクチン・治療薬は未承認で臨床試験段階。

article.articleHeadline: أكثر من 4 آلاف وفاة جراء وباء إيبولا في الكونغو... - الوكيل الإخباري
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 4,000 deaths due to the Ebola epidemic in Congo...
article.articleSummary: Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 8,300 confirmed infections, with 4,018 deaths and 2,162 recoveries, making it the 17th outbreak and the deadliest in the country’s history. The flare-up began in Ituri (North East) and has spread to seven northern and eastern provinces. In North Kivu, 6 cases have been reported, including 4 deaths, in areas under armed-group control. Ongoing response efforts are hampered by resource shortages, armed conflict, and mistrust among communities in volatile areas. United Nations briefings note that intense clashes have disrupted operations in Ituri; a treatment center there was burned after soldiers entered a displacement site, triggering evacuations. Data reflect sustained transmission as of 2 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱流行による死者が4000人を超える…
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の大規模流行（感染8,300例、死者4,018人）が複数州に拡大し、武力紛争により対応が阻害されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 史上最悪規模の流行で、武力紛争により治療センターが焼失するなど対応が著しく困難化している。国連も状況を注視しており、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يواصل حصد المزيد من الأرواح في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola continues to claim more lives in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 October 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed 4,018 people among 8,300 confirmed cases, with 2,162 recoveries. The outbreak is the seventeenth recorded in the country and the deadliest in its history. It began in Ituri province in the northeast and has spread to seven provinces in the north and east. In North Kivu, six additional Ebola cases have been reported, including four deaths. The World Health Organization described mid-September indicators as encouraging, but the African Union health agency director-general warned that the outbreak is not yet under control. The figures underscore ongoing transmission and the challenge of containing the most lethal Ebola outbreak the country has faced.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国でさらに多くの死者を出し続ける
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最悪のエボラ流行が継続中で、死者4,018人・感染者8,300人に達し、複数州への拡大とヒト-ヒト感染継続が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 史上最悪規模のエボラ流行で、WHOは一部改善の兆候を指摘する一方、アフリカCDCは依然制御下にないと警告しており、継続的なモニタリングとフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果埃博拉死亡人数超过四千，治疗中心着火，工作人员罢工
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in Congo surpasses 4,000; treatment centers set on fire; workers go on strike.
article.articleSummary: By Oct 1, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 8,300 cases and 4,018 deaths, with over 2,000 recoveries, across seven provinces since it began on May 15. The epidemic is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in DRC history, and second only to the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (28,600 infections, at least 11,000 deaths). A displacement camp near Bunia in the Kigonze area that housed an Ebola transit center was torched by soldiers, forcing about 19,000 people to flee. Health workers have faced hardship, with at least 50 clinicians dying from infection and salaries often unpaid, prompting protests bearing signs such as 'no money, no data.' One MSF doctor infected with Ebola was airlifted to the Netherlands for care at Leiden University Medical Center. The United States has provided about $887 million in direct health and humanitarian aid, with an additional $267 million announced on Sept 23 for treatment centers, safe burial teams, PPE, surveillance, and contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ死者数が4000人を超える、治療センター焼失、職員ストライキ
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大・最悪のエボラ流行（8,300症例、死者4,018人）で、医療従事者感染死や国際支援・患者の国外搬送も発生しており、IHR基準に複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: オランダ（ライデン）や米国は感染拡大地ではなく、患者搬送・資金援助先として言及されているため対象国から除外。アンゴラも記事主題に含まれず除外。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en el Congo se cobra más de 4000 vidas en la peor epidemia de la historia del país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo has claimed more than 4,000 lives in the worst epidemic in the country’s history.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed 4,018 people and infected 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces, with more than 2,000 recoveries. The epidemic, the worst in DRC history, began in Ituri and is spreading rapidly in North Kivu, while South Ubangi Province declared an outbreak after a traveler from the east died. The Bundibugyo strain is less common and can present mild early symptoms, delaying detection; experimental vaccines and treatments are in trials. The outbreak trails the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic (over 28,600 cases, more than 11,000 deaths) but surpasses the 2018-2020 RDC outbreak in scale. Health workers face wage arrears and strikes, hindering response, while security incidents and displacement complicate control efforts. Mobile labs now deliver results in about six hours, expanding reach to places like Katwa and Bunia; WHO warns of rapid geographic expansion.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、死者4000人超に—同国史上最悪の流行に
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準のうち複数該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク）し、DRC史上最悪規模のエボラ流行で複数州に拡大、社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: Angolaは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事サマリーでは言及されておらず、対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。南ウバンギ州での渡航者発症例があり、さらなる国際拡大の可能性に注意。医療従事者のストライキや治安悪化が対応を阻害している点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola transit centre burned down amid insecurity in DR Congo - Peoples Gazette Nigeria
article.articleSummary: Ebola transit centre burned down at the Kigonze displacement site in Bunia, Ituri Province, DR Congo. The eight-bed facility, operated by the International Medical Corps and supported by more than 50 staff (many displaced), was set alight on Thursday, Sept 30, 2026. Senior Ebola Coordinator Julien Harneis warned the loss of a transit or treatment centre sets the response back, eroding capacity and investments and denying people urgently needed care. The Bunia site hosts nearly 19,000 displaced people amid rising insecurity since Sept 20, with armed violence, threats and intimidation forcing displacement and hampering humanitarian access. OCHA stressed that displacement sites must remain civilian and humanitarian, with any movement voluntary, safe and dignified. Authorities are assessing the incident and working to protect health facilities and ensure continued delivery of life-saving services; no Ebola case data are cited in the report.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴでエボラ出血熱の移送センターが治安悪化の中で焼失
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち「深刻な公衆衛生影響」と「異常・予想外」の2つに該当し、エボラ対応能力の喪失と治安悪化による人道アクセス制限が懸念されるためフルRRAへの移行が適切。
triage.notes: 記事にはエボラの症例数・感染状況データは記載されておらず、治安悪化による医療インフラ（移送センター）焼失とその対応能力低下に焦点がある。約19,000人の避難民が治安悪化の影響下にあり、人道支援アクセスの制約が継続的な感染拡大リスクを高める可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا 2026.. نُخبر دون أن نُهوِِّل
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola 2026... We report without sensationalizing.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) in 2026: as of Sept 28, 2026, 8,067 confirmed cases and 3,901 deaths, mainly in Ituri and North Kivu; outbreak confirmed May 14, 2026, with the WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern within three days. No licensed vaccine or specific antiviral; experimental trials ongoing (including in Oxford). More than 1,700 recoveries reported; the Uganda cluster in June was controlled within weeks. Morocco has no cases; risk deemed low. Transmission requires direct contact with blood or body fluids or contaminated objects; not airborne or vector-borne. Incubation 2–21 days; symptoms include high fever, fatigue, pain, headache, malaria-like. Preventive measures: avoid unnecessary travel to affected areas, regular handwashing, 21-day post-travel fever monitoring, seek care and call 141 SAM before emergency; testing restricted to accredited laboratories. Emphasis on vigilance, not panic, with public health guidance from authorities.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ2026年…煽らず事実を伝える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで8,067例・3,901死亡の大規模エボラ流行がWHOによりPHEIC宣言されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。

article.articleHeadline: Deaths From the Ebola Outbreak in Congo Exceed 4,000
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo's eastern outbreak, confirmed deaths exceed 4,000 among 8,300 cases, with more than 2,000 recoveries. North Kivu is the epicenter, described as spreading like wildfire by MSF, accounting for nearly 40% of new confirmed cases since September, up from 24% by end-August. This Ebola outbreak is Africa's second-largest since 2014–2016 West Africa. MSF operates in Ituri, North Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uélé. On Oct 1, MSF confirmed one staff member tested positive for Bundibugyo disease and evacuated to the Netherlands. Vaccination with the Ervebo vaccine, effective for a different Ebola strain, has been used but may be less protective for current variants. The WHO reports persistently high daily cases, with a high case-fatality ratio and challenges from conflict, limited access, and damaged infrastructure hindering surveillance and timely care. UN notes armed groups impede containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行による死者数が4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で死者4,000人超・症例8,300件に達する大規模エボラ流行であり、武装勢力による対応妨害や国境を越えたスタッフ感染例もあることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dżuma przypomniała o sobie w Rosji. Zaczęło się od młodej laborantki
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The plague has resurfaced in Russia. It began with a young lab technician.
article.articleSummary: Plague has resurfaced in Russia, starting with a 27-year-old institute employee who died from Yersinia pestis. Twelve of 189 people were placed under observation at a plague treatment facility as authorities trace contacts. Two exposure scenarios: contact with bacteria in a broken diagnostic test tube, or infection during travel to Buryatia border with Mongolia, where an outbreak was detected. Authorities, including Irkutsk Governor Igor Kobziew, convened an emergency commission. Plague has three forms—bubonic, septicemic, and pneumonic—with initial symptoms appearing 2–7 days after exposure: fever, chills, severe headache, muscle pain, and weakness; bubonic plague causes painful lymph node swelling. Prompt treatment requires potent antibiotics. Historically deadly, the disease killed millions in the medieval era. Last Russian case was in 2016 in Altai. Ongoing foci persist in Madagascar, DRC, Algeria, China, Vietnam, and Mongolia; Mongolia reported 137 foci in 2023 near the Russian border. Poland has been plague-free for over 300 years.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでペストが再燃。若い検査技師から始まった。
triage.triage_reason: ロシア（イルクーツク州・ブリヤート共和国）で死亡例を含むペスト（Yersinia pestis）症例が確認され、189人中12人が観察下に置かれ緊急委員会が招集されるなど、異常性・重症度・流行拡大の可能性が高い事案。
triage.notes: 本事案はロシア（Buryatia/Irkutsk）での発生であり、対象国リストに含まれない。記事中でMadagascar, DRC, Algeria, China, Vietnam, Mongoliaが既存のペスト常在地として言及されているが、これらはあくまで背景情報であり、今回の発生の主題ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola já matou mais de 4 mil pessoas na República Democrática do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has already killed more than 4,000 people in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola has caused more than 4,000 deaths and over 8,000 confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo, marking the worst outbreak in the country’s history. The Bundibugyo strain, transmitted through contact with bodily fluids and capable of causing hemorrhagic fever, currently has no vaccine or specific treatment. As of 2 October 2026, the outbreak is spreading at a record pace, with the United Nations reporting about one death every 30 minutes in the DRC. The crisis is aggravated by fragile local health systems and ongoing armed-group instability, hindering prevention and care. Declared on 15 May after weeks of circulation in northern and eastern regions, the outbreak ranks as the second-largest globally, surpassed only by the 2014–2016 West Africa Ebola epidemic affecting Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone.

article.articleHeadline: Amambai atualiza dados epidemiológicos sobre Dengue, Chikungunya e Zika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amambai updates epidemiological data on dengue, chikungunya, and Zika.
article.articleSummary: Amambai, Brazil: The municipal Health Department and Epidemiological Surveillance released an updated bulletin on Dengue, Chikungunya, and Zika for January 1 to October 2, 2026, based on SINAN data. Dengue recorded 1,197 notified cases, with 1,130 closed, 49 confirmed and 1,081 discarded; no dengue deaths reported in the period. Chikungunya tallied 1,196 notified cases, 1,118 closed, 230 confirmed and 888 discarded; no fatalities. Zika had 8 notified cases, 7 closed, 0 confirmed and 7 discarded; no deaths. The bulletin underscores ongoing arbovirus surveillance and informs planning of public health actions in Amambai. Data reflect the month-to-date snapshot and support continued monitoring of dengue, chikungunya, and Zika transmission in the municipality.

triage.notes: 地方自治体レベルの定期的な疫学速報であり、死亡例や重症例の急増は報告されていない。デング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱はブラジルで流行性があるが、本記事は通常の監視活動の一環。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: 10 regiones del país muestran aumento de casos sospechosos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: Ten regions across the country show an increase in suspected cases.
article.articleSummary: Paraguay reports low overall arbovirus circulation in 2026, with dengue total at 293 confirmed cases to date; no dengue cases in the last 21 days and no outbreaks or deaths. The General Directorate of Health Surveillance notes a rise in suspected dengue notifications in 10 departments during the last three weeks: Central, Asunción, Itapúa, Paraguarí, San Pedro, Alto Paraná, Presidente Hayes, Concepción, Boquerón, and Cordillera. Chikungunya remains limited, with 19 confirmed cases this year, including 3 imported from Bolivia. The weekly average of suspected dengue is 153. As El Niño brings heat and rain into the final quarter, preventive measures stress eliminating mosquito breeding sites, disposing of water-collecting containers, covering or storing items that hold water, keeping pools chlorinated, and daily water changes for animal troughs. Seek medical care for fever, body pains, or headaches and avoid self-medication to curb Aedes aegypti transmission.

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en la RDC deja ya más de 4.000 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC has already claimed more than 4,000 lives.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has caused 4,018 deaths from 8,300 confirmed cases as of October 2, 2026, with 2,162 recoveries and 842 patients hospitalized or in isolation. Seven of the 26 provinces have been affected, and the case fatality rate stands at 48.4%. The contact-tracing rate is 80.6%.
