article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Ebola deaths exceed 4,000... fires at treatment centers and health workers' strike.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports Ebola deaths surpassing 4,000 with about 8,300 confirmed cases in seven provinces since the outbreak was declared on May 15, 2026. The Bundibugyo virus has no approved vaccines or therapies, making it the fastest-spreading, largest Ebola outbreak in DRC history. The UN reports gains were jeopardized when armed forces burned a displacement camp near an Ebola patient transport center in Bunia’s Kigonje outskirts, displacing about 19,000 people. Health workers in Bunia protested unpaid wages, highlighting distrust and staffing strain; at least 50 health workers have been infected and died. An MSF doctor infected was evacuated to the Netherlands and treated at Leiden University Medical Center. The United States has provided about $887 million directly, with an additional $266.7 million announced at UNGA for treatment facilities, burial teams, PPE, surveillance, and contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴ:エボラ死者4,000人超…治療施設火災・医療従事者スト
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大規模・最速拡大のエボラ流行で死者4,000人超、国際支援・渡航制限リスクもあり、IHR基準複数該当のためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: オランダ・米国は国際支援・医療従事者避難先として記事に登場するが、発生地はDRCのみ。承認されたワクチン・治療薬が無いBundibugyoウイルスによる史上最大規模の流行であり、武装勢力による治療施設周辺の放火・医療従事者のスト等、対応能力に重大な懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: Pilibhit News: जलभराव से निचले इलाकों में बीमारियों का खतरा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pilibhit News: Risk of diseases in low-lying areas due to waterlogging.
article.articleSummary: Bisalpur, Pilibhit: Despite crores spent by the municipality to build large drains to curb chronic waterlogging, several city areas still hold floodwater. Water scarcely drains, leaving homes inundated in many colonies and main roads flooded, hindering movement. Even after the monsoon ends, water remains in lower-lying areas, including posh colonies and mohallas, forming stagnant pools. This elevates the risk of dengue and malaria as pathogens proliferate in stagnant water. Officials are attempting to fix drainage and mitigate health risks, but residents continue to face waterlogged streets and potential vector-borne disease outbreaks.

article.articleHeadline: Thousands flee Ebola-hit displacement camp in DR Congo UN
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province worsened as thousands fled the Kigonze displacement camp after clashes during a security operation; the camp, housing about 19,000, was largely abandoned and a key Ebola transit center run by International Medical Corps was destroyed by fire. Across eastern DR Congo, fighting has hampered response at least at Rhoe camp in Djugu, where over 3,000 people have fled since Sept 27, with at least four killed and seven injured. The outbreak, declared a public health emergency in May, has spread to seven of DR Congo's 26 provinces, with Ituri as the epicenter. As of Sept 29, authorities recorded 8,224 confirmed Ebola cases and 3,982 deaths ( CFR 48.4%). Africa CDC cautioned that declines in reported cases do not mean the outbreak is under control. The Bundibugyo Ebola strain currently lacks an approved vaccine or treatment, though candidates are studied per WHO.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ感染拡大の国内避難民キャンプから数千人が避難 - 国連報告
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行は公衆衛生緊急事態として宣言済みで、致死率48.4%、7州に拡大、紛争により対応が妨げられ国際支援が必要な状況であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株には承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく、紛争により対応が困難な状況が続いている。Africa CDCは症例報告数の減少を流行制御の兆候と誤認しないよう警告している。

article.articleHeadline: Επιδημία Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό: Πάνω από 4.000 νεκροί
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: More than 4,000 dead.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is at its deadliest yet, reporting 4,018 deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases and 2,162 recoveries (mortality 48.4%). Initiated in Ituri province in mid-May, the outbreak has spread to seven northern and eastern provinces, including North Kivu, where four deaths have occurred in six cases in M23-controlled zones. Violence and distrust hinder response; more than 5,000 people have been displaced in Ituri, and a patient-transit center was burned by soldiers. A health worker was killed in North Kivu. France allocated €13.4 million for Ebola relief (Jan–Jul), while the United States pledged €237 million. Vaccines and therapies are under study for Bundibugyo, with Ervebo doses administered to frontline staff in a clinical trial.

triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%の大規模エボラ流行がDRC複数州に拡大し、紛争地域での対応困難・国際支援の動員を伴う深刻な公衆衛生事案であるため、フルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Thousands flee Ebola-hit displacement camp in DR Congo - UN -- RT Africa
article.articleSummary: Thousands fled the Ebola-hit Kigonze displacement camp in Ituri Province, eastern DR Congo, leaving about 19,000 residents displaced after security forces entered to search for weapons and suspected armed-group members, with gunfire reported. An Ebola transit center at Kigonze was destroyed by fire, disrupting containment. Fighting has driven more than 3,000 people from the Rhoe camp in Djugu since September 27, with at least four killed and seven injured. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, was declared a health emergency in May and has spread to seven of DR Congo’s 26 provinces, with Ituri as the epicenter. As of September 29, 8,224 confirmed cases and 3,982 deaths (case fatality 48.4%) were recorded. Africa CDC warns against assuming a decline means control, citing disrupted surveillance; 45 of 63 health zones report ongoing transmission. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment; candidate vaccines and therapies are under study per WHO.

triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が7州に拡大し致死率48.4%、紛争により封じ込め体制が破壊され避難民が急増するなど、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 武力紛争により感染症対応施設（トランジットセンター）が破壊され、サーベイランス体制が崩壊している点は特筆すべきリスク要因。承認済みワクチン・治療薬がない点も深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en la República Democrática del Congo deja más de 4.000 fallecidos - teleSUR
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo leaves more than 4,000 dead - teleSUR
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths since it was declared May 15, with an overall case fatality rate of 48.4%. The epidemic is centered in Ituri and has spread to Tshopo, Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, North Kivu, South Kivu, and South Ubangi, affecting 63 health zones across seven provinces. Recoveries total 2,162; 842 patients are currently hospitalized or under strict isolation. This Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak is the second deadliest globally, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (about 11,000 deaths). Cross-border transmission occurred into Uganda (20 cases, 2 deaths) before the regional end. No specific treatment exists; two vaccines are in Phase 1 trials, while the Congolese government has begun mass vaccination with Ervebo, which showed positive signals in animal tests for this variant. Frontline workers in Bunia protest unpaid salaries, threatening contact tracing; Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids, causing fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and hemorrhagic symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、死者4,000人超に - teleSUR
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%の大規模エボラ流行で8,300例・4,018人死亡、7州63保健地域に拡大しウガンダへの越境感染も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たすためフルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Seasonal malaria chemoprevention introduction is associated with sustained reductions in childhood malaria burden in northern Ghana
article.articleSummary: Seasonal malaria chemoprevention (SMC) was introduced in Ghana’s Northern Region in June 2019, delivering monthly sulfadoxine-pyrimethamine plus amodiaquine to children aged 3–59 months during the June–September rainy season. Analyzing 10 years of monthly health facility data (2015–2024) and four rounds of national household surveys (2014–2022) with seasonal ARIMA and Bayesian structural time-series methods, post-SMC outcomes were lower than the counterfactual: malaria deaths (−80.3%), admissions (−23.0%), and incidence (−16.1%). At the individual level, post-SMC children had significantly lower odds of malaria infection (adjusted OR 0.595; 95% CI 0.470–0.751). Despite a decline in insecticide-treated net coverage, malaria burden continued to fall across data sources. The findings suggest an association between SMC implementation and reduced childhood malaria burden in this high-transmission Sahelian setting, underscoring the need to maintain high SMC coverage as part of integrated malaria control in northern Ghana.

article.articleHeadline: ഡെങ്കിപ്പനി പടരുന്നു; കരുതൽ വേണം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Smallpox is spreading; precautions are needed.
article.articleSummary: Chennai and several Tamil Nadu districts are grappling with a dengue fever surge. In September alone, Chennai city reported 1,219 dengue cases, part of 17,651 statewide Jan–Sept with 19 deaths. Chennai totals this year reach 3,759, up from 3,366 last year; Coimbatore, Tiruvallur, Chengalpattu, and Kanchipuram are also heavily affected. The Chennai Corporation Commissioner G.S. Sameeran said the outbreak is under control and there is no need to panic; 74 new cases were recorded in a single Wednesday. Primary symptoms include high fever with severe body pains, headaches, and fatigue, transmitted by day-biting mosquitoes. Authorities have intensified vector-control and urged cleanliness around homes and communities. October remains hot (temperatures 2–5°C above normal in many areas) with El Niño driving heat; an unfavorable Northeast monsoon could worsen water scarcity in Tamil Nadu.

article.articleHeadline: Guyana leads Amazon health cooperation talks on malaria elimination, Indigenous health - INews Guyana
article.articleSummary: Malaria elimination drives Amazon regional talks as Guyana, presiding over CESAM, convenes Amazon countries (Guyana, Bolivia, Suriname, Venezuela in person; Brazil virtually) to advance malaria control, Indigenous health, and surveillance. The meeting, since Sept 8, 2026, identified malaria, hepatitis B and C, Indigenous health, intercultural health, and surveillance as priorities. Suriname shared success eliminating local malaria transmission through community-based diagnosis and rapid response; ACTO proposed a technical workshop in Suriname to share practices. Bolivia highlighted Indigenous health access challenges and mercury contamination from gold mining. Brazil reaffirmed cooperation on Indigenous health; Venezuela urged culturally appropriate care and stronger joint surveillance for malaria, dengue, and onchocerciasis. PAHO pledged technical cooperation, linking elimination to culturally appropriate approaches. A health module for the Amazon Regional Observatory and national focal points for data exchange were discussed. Malaria remains a top priority; hepatitis cooperation to continue with multilateral financing.

article.articleHeadline: RT-Engels: Thousands flee Ebola-hit displacement camp in DR Congo UN
article.articleSummary: Thousands fled the Ebola-hit Kigonze displacement camp in Ituri Province, eastern DR Congo, after security forces conducted a search operation that sparked clashes and gunfire. The camp, which housed about 19,000 people, has been largely abandoned as residents fled during the operation. An Ebola transit center at Kigonze, run by International Medical Corps with over 50 staff to isolate and assess suspected cases before transfer to treatment, was destroyed by fire this week, undermining containment. Across eastern DR Congo, fighting has hampered response efforts: more than 3,000 people fled the Rhoe displacement camp in Djugu territory since clashes resumed on September 27, with at least four killed and seven injured. The Ebola outbreak has spread to seven of DR Congo’s 26 provinces, with Ituri remaining the epicenter; the outbreak was declared a public health emergency in May.

article.articleHeadline: Nova tecnologia: fêmea do Aedes aegypti vira aliada no combate à dengue em Gurupi com uso de estações disseminadoras
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New technology: Female Aedes aegypti becomes an ally in the fight against dengue in Gurupi with the use of disseminating stations.
article.articleSummary: Gurupi, Brazil, will deploy 150 Disseminating Larvicide Stations (EDLs) starting October 5, 2026, to bolster control of Aedes aegypti and the dengue, Zika, and chikungunya threats. The federally funded system, developed by Fiocruz in partnership with the Ministry of Health, uses pyriproxyfen larvicide. The device attracts female mosquitoes; when she lands on a treated fabric, she acquires the larvicide and then spreads it to other breeding sites as she seeks oviposition sites, inhibiting egg hatching and larval development. Installations will be placed at Strategic Points—gardens, tire shops, cemeteries, junkyards, and other locations with historical water accumulation—not in residential homes. Endemic disease agents will maintain stations, replacing the impregnated screens every 30 days. This approach complements ongoing Ovitrampa residential monitoring to disrupt reproduction and reduce transmission in Gurupi.

article.articleHeadline: Soldados incendian centro de tratamiento del ébola en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Soldiers set fire to the Ebola treatment center in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo worsened after soldiers burned a displacement camp housing a transit center for patients near Bunia, Ituri province, displacing about 19,000 people. Since the outbreak was declared on 15 May in eastern DRC, the province has recorded roughly 8,300 cases and 4,018 deaths. At least 50 health workers have died treating the outbreak. A Médecins Sans Frontières staff member contracted Ebola and was evacuated to the Leiden University Medical Center in the Netherlands for isolation. The attack, part of a security operation in Kigonze on the outskirts of Bunia, compounds an already strained response, with shortages of resources, personnel, and infrastructure. UN officials warn that losing a treatment center cripples capacity and access, underscoring the unprecedented human toll of the Congo’s largest Ebola outbreak to date.

article.articleHeadline: An Ebola treatment center was burned down as the death toll in Congo passes 4,000
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed 4,018 people and infected 8,300 since it was declared in eastern Congo on May 15, marking the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history. North Kivu now accounts for about 40% of new confirmed cases since late August. The epicenter shift to Ituri’s Bunia area includes a burned transit center in Kigonze, with about 19,000 displaced. Front-line workers report months of unpaid wages amid ongoing protests; at least 50 health workers have died. MSF reports an infected aid worker evacuated to the Netherlands and treated in isolation. Mobile labs in Butembo cut test results from 72 hours to six, aiding rapid deployment to Katwa. The WHO warns the outbreak could surpass West Africa’s 2014–2016 toll of about 11,000, amid insecurity, resistance, and distrust in government, with a village-centered containment approach continuing to face obstacles.

article.articleHeadline: Três Lagoas coleta mais de 12 mil ovos de Aedes aegypti em ovitramps
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Três Lagoas collects more than 12,000 Aedes aegypti eggs in ovitraps.
article.articleSummary: In Três Lagoas, Brazil, the Municipal Health Secretariat monitored 379 ovitraps during week 37 of 2026 and collected 12,487 eggs from Aedes aegypti, the vector for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Installation and monitoring were carried out by Endemias and Entomology teams; Entomology analyzes the eggs to determine the presence and distribution of Aedes aegypti within the municipality. The surveillance supports arbovirus vigilance and prevention, enabling health teams to identify areas with higher vector density and to target control actions, including prioritization of neighborhoods and resource allocation for vector control efforts and community interventions. The data support prioritizing areas with higher egg density for intensified interventions.

triage.triage_reason: 蚊媒介ベクターの定期モニタリング活動の報告であり、実際の感染症患者発生や異常な流行を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: ベクターサーベイランス（蚊の卵採集）に関する行政活動報告であり、患者発生情報ではないため対象国としての患者発生事例は含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Escolas de Couto de Magalhães de Minas recebem ação de prevenção à dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Schools in Couto de Magalhães de Minas receive a dengue prevention campaign.
article.articleSummary: Dengue prevention education carried out in Couto de Magalhães de Minas, Brazil, targeting students in the municipal school network. The City Hall organized the activity with Endemic Disease Control Agents and nurse Ana Karolina, aiming to curb the Aedes aegypti mosquito, vector of dengue and other arboviruses. Participants received practical guidance on breaking the mosquito’s life cycle, including eliminating standing water, keeping containers and reservoirs sealed, and inspecting locations prone to water accumulation. The campaign also encouraged students to relay the information to family members and other community members, extending prevention beyond the classroom. This initiative forms part of ongoing dengue control strategies by raising awareness and reducing breeding sites to lower transmission risk in the municipality.

triage.headline_ja: クト・デ・マガリャンイス・デ・ミナスの学校でデング熱予防キャンペーンが実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の学校向けデング予防啓発活動の報道であり、疾病発生や症例急増の情報はなく、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防教育活動のみを報じており、具体的な感染者数や流行状況の記載がないため対象国としても計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le diplomate français en visite officielle de deux jours à Kinshasa et Ituri - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the French diplomat on an official two-day visit to Kinshasa and Ituri - ACP.
article.articleSummary: French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot will undertake a two-day official visit to the Democratic Republic of Congo from October 2–4, 2026, to evaluate and discuss with Congolese authorities the Ebola virus disease outbreak. Kinshasa and Bunia in Ituri, the epicenter of the 17th Ebola outbreak, will be the focus of discussions. He will fly from Kinshasa to Bunia to meet authorities and response teams and to assess the on-ground situation amid a backdrop of security and humanitarian crises involving armed groups. Before these talks, there will be a segment on gender-based violence with Justice Minister Guillaume Ngefa. They will also discuss the investigation into the March death of French UNICEF aid worker Karine Buisset in Goma, believed killed in a drone strike. This is Barrot's second trip to the DRC; no audience is planned for this visit; a prior visit occurred in January 2025.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行下のコンゴ民主共和国：フランス外交官がキンシャサとイトゥリを公式訪問（2日間）
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラアウトブレイクに関する内容であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、既存シグナルとしてフルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事自体はフランス外交官の訪問を報じる内容で新規疫学情報は乏しいが、背景にある第17次エボラアウトブレイク（イトゥリ州が震源地）および治安・人道危機（武装勢力、国連職員の死亡事件）が国際的関心と支援の必要性を示している。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola ya provocó más de 4 mil muertes en República Democrática del Congo, que atraviesa la peor epidemia de su historia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak has already caused more than 4,000 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, which is experiencing the worst epidemic in its history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has killed more than 4,000 people and surpassed 8,000 confirmed cases as of 2026-10-02. Latest official figures report 4,018 deaths among 8,300 cases, with 2,162 recoveries, yielding a 48.4% case fatality rate. The outbreak began mid-May in Ituri (northeast) and has spread to seven northern and eastern provinces, including North Kivu, where four deaths occurred among six cases in areas held by the M23 group. Ongoing violence and resource shortages, along with local distrust of authorities, hamper containment. Displacements exceed 5,000; a transit center for Ebola patients was burned; a health center attack in North Kivu killed a contractor. International response includes US$267 million from the United States and €13.4 million from France to date; no indication of new French aid. Vaccination efforts include Ervebo doses given to frontline staff in a clinical trial.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで4,000人以上が死亡、同国史上最悪の流行に
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)による死者4,000人超・致死率48.4%の大規模流行が継続し、紛争地域への拡大と国際対応も報告されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 米国(US$267M)・フランス(€13.4M)からの国際支援あり。米国・フランスは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。武装勢力(M23)占領地域での感染拡大や医療従事者への攻撃など、封じ込めを困難にする要因が複数存在し、史上最悪規模の流行と報じられている。

article.articleHeadline: Six Ebola Cases Confirmed in M23‑Controlled Areas of Eastern DRC
article.articleSummary: Six Ebola cases have been confirmed in M23-administered areas of eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with four in Alimbongo and two in Kayna. Four cases were identified post-mortem after community deaths; the remaining two symptomatic patients were detected through surveillance and are now in care. Health authorities say all transmissions stem from a single chain that began with an imported case from Butembo, a government-controlled city. Response teams have intensified surveillance and contact tracing in Alimbongo and Kayna, urging residents to report suspected cases. The latest infections follow the 29 September discharge of the only known active Ebola patient in the rebel-held area, who spent 26 days in a treatment centre and was the first confirmed infection there since the territory was declared Ebola-free in late June after four earlier cases. This outbreak in eastern DRC, declared 15 May, has tallied more than 8,300 confirmed cases and over 4,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国東部のM23支配地域で6件のエボラ症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: 既存の大規模エボラアウトブレイク（8,300例超、死亡4,000人超）が紛争地域であるM23支配地域に拡大し、政府の保健対応が困難な状況であるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: M23支配地域での感染拡大により政府・国際機関のアクセスが制限される可能性があり、サーベイランスと対応能力に懸念。既存の大規模アウトブレイク（2026年5月15日宣言）の一部として継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil teve 547 casos da doença de Creutzfeldt-Jakob de 2005 a 2021
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil had 547 cases of Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease from 2005 to 2021.
article.articleSummary: Brazil recorded 547 confirmed Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease (CJD) cases from 2005–2021. Through August 2026, the Ministry of Health logged about 2,500 suspect CJD notifications nationwide. CJD has been a notifiable disease since 2005. Of 1,576 suspected cases through 2021, 547 (34.7%) were confirmed, 457 (29%) discarded, and 572 (36.3%) lacked final classification. For 2021–2026, no confirmed-case counts were provided. Among notifications up to 2021, 290 (18.4%) deaths were attributed to CJD; others died of different causes or data were missing. The majority of cases were aged 55–74 (60.2%), with a mean age of 66; 53.6% female. Among confirmed through 2021, São Paulo led with 202 cases, followed by Minas Gerais (57) and Paraná (44). Diagnostics combine symptoms, clinical progression, MRI, EEG, and CSF analysis, including RT-QuIC; definitive confirmation requires brain tissue post-mortem. No cure exists; care focuses on symptom management. Notably, pilot/influencer Lito Sousa died in São Paulo on Oct 1, 2026, 41 days after disclosure.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでは2005年から2021年までにクレッツフェルト・ヤコブ病(CJD)の症例が547件確認された
triage.triage_reason: CJDは散発性のまれなプリオン病であり、本記事は過去の統計データの報告であって新規の公衆衛生上の脅威や異常な集団発生を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内のCJD罹患統計（2005-2021年の累積データ）を報告する内容であり、散発性疾患の疫学レビューに相当する。感染症の急性アウトブレイクではなく、豚コレラ(Classical Swine Fever)への言及は本文中に見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Centro de tratamento de ebola no Congo é queimado por exército enquanto casos passam de 4 mil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola treatment center in Congo is burned by the army as cases exceed 4,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has caused 4,018 deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases, according to the latest Ministry of Health data released on Oct 1. Official declaration of the epidemic occurred on May 15, making it one of the fastest-moving outbreaks on record. Violence, resource shortages, and challenges in maintaining field teams are hampering the response. Earlier this week, soldiers burned a displacement camp that hosted a transit center for Ebola patients in Kigonze, on the outskirts of Bunia, reportedly during a weapons search. About 19,000 people were forced to flee the site. The incident underscores security and humanitarian hurdles amid ongoing surveillance, with Associated Press documenting medical teams and laboratories operating in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ治療センターが軍に焼かれる、感染者数は4000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部でのエボラ流行が8,300症例・4,018死亡に達し、急速な拡大と治安悪化により対応が困難化しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 軍による治療センター焼失・約19,000人の避難など人道・治安上の重大な障害が報告されており、致死率が高いことから優先的なリスク評価が必要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Salud reporta tres semanas sin nuevos casos de dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health reports three weeks without new dengue cases.
article.articleSummary: Paraguay reports three weeks without confirmed dengue cases, covering epidemiological weeks 36–38, with no outbreaks or deaths in that period. The national total diagnosed with dengue so far this year stands at 293. Health surveillance notes an average of 153 notifications of suspected dengue cases per week. Ten health regions—Central, Asunción, Itapúa, Paraguarí, San Pedro, Alto Paraná, Presidente Hayes, Concepción, Boquerón, and Cordillera—have seen increased notifications over the past three weeks. With ongoing circulation of the dengue vector, authorities urge persistent vector-control measures: discard water-collecting containers, keep water storage covered, clean gutters, refresh water in animal drinkers daily; keep pools chlorinated; use damp sand in flower vases; and remove standing water from plant saucers. Citizens with fever, headache, or body pains should seek healthcare and avoid self-medication.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、デング熱新規症例なしで3週間と報告
triage.triage_reason: パラグアイにおけるデング熱の新規症例が3週間なく、流行拡大の兆候もないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。なお対象国リストにパラグアイは含まれない。
triage.notes: 記事はパラグアイのデング熱状況を報告しており、対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand等）には該当しない。発生地域にPhilippinesが含まれるが、記事内容はパラグアイに限定されるため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de tuberculose aumentam em Imperatriz; município já registra 150 notificações em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis cases are increasing in Imperatriz; the municipality has already recorded 150 notifications in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Imperatriz, Maranhão, Brazil, recorded 150 tuberculosis notifications in 2026, with 103 cases among city residents. In 2024 there were 166 total cases (122 residents); 2025 saw 229 (162 residents). Officials attribute fluctuations to underreporting rather than a sharp surge. The Municipal Tuberculosis Program coordinator, Menildes Paixão, emphasizes early diagnosis to improve treatment and prevent lasting sequelae. Infectious disease specialist Aldicléya Luz notes that persistent symptoms should prompt evaluation; key signs include a cough lasting at least three weeks, fever, weight loss, coughing up blood, and night sweats. Data come from Semus (Municipal Health Secretariat). The article underscores ongoing TB activity and urges residents with symptoms to seek medical assessment to enable timely diagnosis and management.

triage.headline_ja: インペラトリスで結核症例が増加；同市は2026年にすでに150件の報告を記録
triage.triage_reason: 結核の通常の症例報告であり、むしろ前年より件数は減少傾向。異常性や国際的拡大リスクはなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列。地方自治体の通常の結核監視報告であり、過少報告が主因とされ急増ではないと記事内で明言されている。

article.articleHeadline: Centro de tratamiento del ébola fue incendiado mientras el número de muertos en el Congo supera los 4 mil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola treatment center was set on fire as the number of deaths in Congo surpasses 4,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has killed 4,018 people among 8,300 cases since the May 15 declaration, making it the fastest-growing outbreak in the country’s history. The epicenters are Ituri and North Kivu provinces, with North Kivu accounting for about 40% of new confirmed cases since late August. MSF calls the crisis like fighting a forest fire as multiple foci strain resources. Health workers in Bunia protest unpaid August–September salaries, hampering response. A displaced-camp at Kigonze was burned by soldiers seeking weapons, forcing 19,000 to flee. An MSF field worker contracted Ebola and was evacuated to the Netherlands. Mobile laboratories now deliver results in about six hours, extending access to remote areas such as Katwa. WHO warns of rapid spread; Africa CDC notes fluctuating case numbers. The 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak caused around 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ治療センターが放火される中、コンゴの死者数が4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がコンゴ東部で急速に拡大し死者4,000人超・医療従事者スト・治安悪化等で対応が阻害されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: MSFスタッフがエボラに感染しオランダへ退避した事例あり。オランダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。治安悪化（避難民キャンプ放火）や給与未払いによる医療従事者の抗議が対応を妨げており、史上最速の感染拡大とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Herbal Remedies Remain First Response to Childhood Malaria in Ghana's
article.articleSummary: Tamale Metropolis, northern Ghana, reports malaria as a persistent threat to children. A cross-sectional study of 265 female caregivers of children ≤12 found 37.3% used plant-based medicines as first-line treatment for suspected malaria. Despite broad access to artemisinin-based combination therapies via hospitals, clinics, and licensed sellers, herbal remedies remain common; fever and vomiting were the main triggers for suspecting malaria, and 77.6% would first seek hospital care, indicating parallel use of formal care and herbal practice. Frequently cited plants: Azadirachta indica (neem) 18.7%, Carica papaya 16.5%, Psidium guajava (guava) 14.3%, Senna occidentalis 10%, Mangifera indica (mango) 9.6%. The study highlights practice vs. efficacy concerns, potential delays in accurate diagnosis, and possible herb–drug interactions. Low-income caregivers had markedly higher odds of herbal first-line use (adjusted OR 9.449; 95% CI 1.185–75.354). Published 2026-10-02 in BMC Complementary Medicine and Therapies.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナ北部における小児マラリアへの初期対応としてのハーブ治療の継続
triage.triage_reason: マラリアの治療行動に関する横断研究であり、新規の公衆衛生上の緊急事態や異常な流行を示す内容ではないため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術研究（治療行動調査）であり、マラリア流行の急増や新規アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Jakarta Nomor Dua Kasus TBC, Benarkah Kepadatan Penyebabnya?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jakarta: No. 2 in TB Cases — Is Population Density the Cause?
article.articleSummary: TB (Mycobacterium tuberculosis) in Indonesia is analyzed through population-density–based rankings, with Bangka Belitung first and Jakarta (DKI) second in TB case counts when viewed by density, prompting questions about the indicators used. Deputy Health Minister Dante Saksono Harbuwono notes that density can elevate airborne transmission but is not a direct measure of incidence. Absolute case counts, cases per 100,000 people, prevalence, and cases per area each yield different epidemiologic pictures; mixing indicators risks misinterpretation. In Jakarta, high urban mobility, housing density, poor ventilation, socioeconomic disparities, and cross-district movement complicate TB control; density alone does not capture risk. The article calls for granular mapping by subdistrict, housing conditions, vulnerable groups, and testing/treatment coverage, and insists that case finding must be followed by complete treatment and ongoing patient support. Cross-regional comparisons require careful interpretation of surveillance and access to care.

triage.headline_ja: ジャカルタ、結核症例数で2位 — 人口密度が原因なのか？
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病である結核に関する統計指標の解説記事であり、急性の公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 結核はインドネシアにおける既知の慢性感染症であり、本記事は統計的指標（人口密度ベースの順位）の妥当性を論じる解説記事。突発的なアウトブレイクではないためDISMISS相当だが、結核自体は継続的曝露・流行しやすさの観点でWPRO基準1つに該当するためWATCH寄りの情報として留意。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ出血熱、死者4000人超 コンゴ 最悪規模で拡大
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola hemorrhagic fever: Death toll tops 4,000 as Congo faces the worst outbreak on record.
article.articleSummary: Ebola hemorrhagic fever in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed more than 4,000 people, with official tallies showing about 8,300 infections, 4,018 deaths and 2,162 recoveries (case fatality ~48%). The outbreak, officially confirmed in mid‑May in Ituri, has spread to seven northern and eastern provinces amid ongoing conflict and severe resource shortages hindering medical response. In North Kivu, the M23 group reported four deaths. In Ituri, militia clashes prompted mass displacement, with the UN reporting over 5,000 uprooted on Oct 1, and a patient transfer center burned last month. A contracted staffer responsible for infection detection was killed at a health facility in North Kivu. Health workers face high risk in under-resourced areas. France and the United States are aiding the response; multiple vaccines and treatments for the Bundibugyo strain are under development.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、死者4000人超 コンゴ 最悪規模で拡大
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約48%、死者4000人超、7州に拡大し紛争地域での医療対応が困難という深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 米国・フランスが対応支援中であり、紛争（M23、民兵衝突）による大規模避難・医療従事者殺害など人道危機と重なっている。対象国リストに米国・フランスは含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Center Burned as Congo Death Toll Tops 4,000 - NewsFire.GR | English Version
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province (Bunia) has 4,018 deaths among 8,300 cases since May 15, the fastest-growing Ebola epidemic on record as of 3 October 2026. Frontline health workers have struck over unpaid wages (August–September), hampering containment. A displacement camp near Kigonze was burned, displacing about 19,000. An MSF aid worker contracted Ebola and was evacuated to the Netherlands for treatment at Leiden University Medical Center. Mobile labs in Butembo now deliver results in six hours, down from 72 hours, expediting case detection. The WHO cautions the outbreak could exceed the 2014–2016 West Africa toll of about 11,000 deaths. Weekly trends vary: mid-July ~850 cases/470 deaths; September ~490/230. At least 50 health workers have died.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱死者数が4,000人を突破、治療センターが焼失
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部のエボラ流行は過去最速のペースで拡大し、死者4,000人超・症例8,300件に達し、国際的な人員移送（MSF職員のオランダ搬送）も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: オランダへの患者搬送は治療目的の国際移送であり、現地での二次感染拡大は報告されていない。アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及なしのため除外。WHOは本流行が2014-2016年西アフリカ流行（約11,000人死亡）を超える可能性を警告している。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola se extiende por la República Democrática del Congo: ya hay 4.018 muertos y 8.300 casos confirmados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading through the Democratic Republic of the Congo: there are already 4,018 deaths and 8,300 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by the Bundibugyo strain has reached 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths, marking the country’s worst outbreak on record. The epidemic has spread to seven provinces, including Ituri and North Kivu, with Ubangi-Sud declaring a seventh province after a traveler from the east died. More than 2,000 people have recovered. Conflict, poverty, and weak infrastructure hinder response, contributing to delayed care and protests by health workers over late salaries; at least 50 health workers have died. A displacement camp near Bunia was burned by soldiers, displacing about 19,000 people and raising transmission risk. UN and WHO mobile labs are shortening case confirmation from 72 hours to roughly 6 hours. The outbreak’s geographic reach continues to expand, with warnings it could surpass the West Africa 2014-2016 toll.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で拡大：死者4,018人、確認症例8,300人に
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行が7州に拡大し、死者数・症例数が過去最悪水準に達しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 武力紛争・避難民発生・保健従事者の死亡など、感染拡大と対応困難要因が複合的に存在。西アフリカ2014-2016年規模を上回る恐れが指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Xuất hiện 2 ca mắc sốt xuất huyết, Kỳ Xuân chủ động phòng chống
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two cases of dengue fever have been reported; Kỳ Xuân is actively preventing and controlling.
article.articleSummary: Two dengue fever cases were reported in Ky Xuan Commune, Ha Tinh Province, Vietnam. Patients: T.K.Ch., born 2024, from Hoa Binh hamlet, and P.C.V., born 2012, from Dong Son hamlet, identified Sept 28 and Oct 1 respectively. Both presented with high fever, headache, loss of appetite, and muscle pains; no travel history. Ky Xuan Health Station conducted rapid epidemiological investigation and expanded surveillance around affected households, with a 24/7 on-site public health team and daily reports to the district disease-control committee. Local authorities implemented urgent vector-control measures: environmental sanitation, removal of standing water, larval source reduction, drainage clearance, and mosquito insecticide spraying around homes with cases. Given hot, humid, rainy conditions conducive to mosquito breeding, residents were advised to sleep under bed nets, maintain hygiene, eliminate containers that hold water, and seek medical care promptly if dengue symptoms appear to prevent wider transmission.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱患者2名発生、キーシュアン地区が積極的な防疫対策を実施
triage.triage_reason: 地方の小規模なデング熱症例2件であり、地域で既に対策が実施されている通常の公衆衛生対応であるため、国際的拡大リスクや異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムの流行地域で季節性に発生する風土病であり、本件は地元保健機関による標準的な媒介蚊対策対応が既に行われている。症例数も少なく、フルRRAへの移行は不要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola supera los 4,000 muertos - Medios OBSON
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola surpasses 4,000 deaths - OBSON Media.
article.articleSummary: 4,018 Ebola deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, according to the latest health authorities, yielding a case fatality rate of 48.4%. About 2,162 patients have recovered, and 842 remain hospitalized or in isolation. Contact tracing covers 80.6% of contacts. The outbreak spans 63 health zones across seven provinces, led by Ituri in the east; other affected provinces include Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, North Kivu, South Kivu, and South Ubangi. It is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; no specific treatment exists yet. The World Health Organization is evaluating two vaccines for this variant, with early Phase 1 safety results, but deployment could take months. Congo began a vaccination campaign in late August using Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV), the only vaccine available at scale, originally developed for the Zaire ebolavirus. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever and hemorrhagic fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding. The current outbreak is the second-deadliest globally, after West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の死者数が4,000人を超える - OBSON Media
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続中で、致死率48.4%、7州63保健地域に拡大しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際拡大リスクが明確に該当する。
triage.notes: 本件はBundibugyoエボラウイルス種による既知の大規模アウトブレイクであり、既にWHO・国際機関の関与がある継続事案と推測される。続報での死亡率・拡大状況の変化を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: وفيات "إيبولا" في الكونغو تتجاوز 4 آلاف وتحذيرات من سرعة انتشاره
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola deaths in the Congo exceed 4,000, with warnings about its rapid spread.
article.articleSummary: As of early October 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 4,018 Ebola deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases, about half of all infections, in the fastest outbreak the country has seen. The outbreak was declared on May 15 and is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, for which no approved treatment or vaccine exists. Kinshasa reported the update, warning of rapid geographic spread into new health zones and placing mounting pressure on limited public health resources. The World Health Organization has warned of the virus's expanding reach, complicating containment as cases continue to rise within the country. This ongoing outbreak highlights the urgent need for enhanced resources, surveillance, and international support to curb transmission.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 4,000 and warnings about its rapid spread - Ardu Point
article.articleSummary: As of October 2, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 8,300 laboratory-confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths, about half of all infections, marking the fastest-spreading wave the country has seen. The surge began on May 15 and is linked to the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which no approved treatment or vaccine exists. Kinshasa and other health zones face mounting transmission with limited resources, hindering containment. The World Health Organization has warned of rapid geographic spread to new areas, increasing pressure on public health systems and complicating outbreak control efforts.

article.articleHeadline: El ébola ya dejó más de 4.000 muertos en el Congo y el brote se acerca al peor de África | InfoVeloz.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has already claimed more than 4,000 lives in the Congo, and the outbreak is approaching Africa's worst | InfoVeloz.com
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces and 4,018 deaths, with over 2,000 recoveries. It is the worst outbreak in the DRC’s history, though still below the 2014–2016 Guinea–Liberia–Sierra Leone crisis. Ituri province is the origin, with North Kivu reporting new cases and South Ubangi declaring a seventh provincial outbreak after a traveler from the east died. Early Bundibugyo symptoms can be mild, hindering detection; vaccines and treatments are in trials. Health resources are strained by conflict, poverty, and weak infrastructure. In Ituri, unpaid salaries sparked protests; an army camp for Ebola patients was burned near Bunia, displacing about 19,000 people. Mobile laboratories cut diagnostic time from about 72 hours to six hours, aiding containment. MSF reports at least 50 health workers have died. WHO warns of geographic expansion and resource strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱による死者が4,000人を超え、アフリカ史上最悪の流行に迫る
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が8,300症例・4,000人超の死者に達し、複数州に拡大、医療従事者死亡や治安不安も伴う重大な公衆衛生事態であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola en RDC franchit le cap des 4 000 morts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC crosses the 4,000-death threshold.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the DRC has surpassed 4,000 deaths among 8,300 cases (4,018 deaths, 2,162 recoveries) with a case fatality rate of 48.4%. The 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, the worst in its history, has spread from Ituri to seven northern and eastern provinces, including Nord-Kivu, where six cases (four deaths) have been reported in areas controlled by the M23 group. The response is hampered by armed clashes and community mistrust, with more than 5,000 displaced in Ituri. A transit center for patients was burned after security forces entered a displacement site; a case-detection worker was killed at a Nord-Kivu checkpoint. Vaccination of frontline workers with Ervebo has begun, with about 70,000 doses allocated in August; Ervebo targets the Zaïre lineage, while this outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo. France and the United States have provided support, and an MSF staff member has been evacuated to the Netherlands after testing positive.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、死者数が4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が拡大し死者4,000人超・致死率48.4%、紛争地域への拡大や対応妨害、国際支援(仏・米・MSF)が発生しておりIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 武力紛争(M23)による対応妨害、ワクチン株(Zaire/Ervebo)と流行株(Bundibugyo)の不一致、MSFスタッフの国外搬送事例あり。米国・オランダ・フランスは感染者搬送・支援国であり発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola Death Toll Surpasses 4,000 as Treatment Centre Is Burned
article.articleSummary: Congo's Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo has reached 4,018 deaths and 8,300 cases since the May 15 declaration, the fastest-growing outbreak in the country's history. In Ituri's Bunia, health workers protest unpaid wages, delaying response as August–September salaries remain unsettled. A UN official said an Ebola-affected displacement camp near Bunia was burned by soldiers during a weapons search, destroying a transit centre and displacing about 19,000 people. An MSF aid worker contracted Ebola and was evacuated to the Netherlands for treatment. More than 50 health workers have died. Mobile laboratories in Butembo can produce Ebola test results in about six hours, speeding confirmation. WHO warns the virus is spreading to new health zones; Africa CDC notes a September decline in weekly cases and deaths, though insecurity and access issues persist. Distrust and a village-focused response launched last month aim to bolster containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数が4,000人を超える、治療センターが焼失
triage.triage_reason: 既知のDRCエボラ流行が8,300症例・4,018死亡という大規模な拡大を続けており、保健従事者の死亡、新たな保健地区への拡大、治安問題による対応遅延など深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo người nguy cơ cao mắc các bệnh nhiễm trùng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning: High-Risk Individuals May Contract Infectious Diseases.
article.articleSummary: By 2030, Vietnam will have about 18 million people aged 60+, with roughly two-thirds having chronic conditions and over half with multiple diseases. About 95% of older adults will have at least one chronic disease, averaging 2–3 conditions—most commonly cardiovascular disease, diabetes, musculoskeletal disorders, or cognitive decline—leading to roughly a decade living with illness. This burden elevates healthcare costs and pressures facilities. Diabetes and chronic kidney disease can weaken immunity; diabetics face higher rates of respiratory infections and pneumonia, with a 38% higher risk of herpes zoster and greater risk of severe RSV in the elderly. CKD increases herpes zoster risk by ~29% and RSV risk/progression. At the Vietnamese Association of Urology–Nephrology conference (VUNA), experts urged vaccination as proactive prevention, echoing KDIGO 2024 CKD guidance and MoH’s 2026 decision endorsing vaccines (HBV, HPV, RSV, influenza, pneumococcus, shingles). Integrated care, combining treatment and prevention, is emphasized, with GSK Vietnam collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症リスクの高い人々への警告
triage.triage_reason: 個別の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、高齢者・慢性疾患患者における感染症リスクとワクチン接種推奨に関する一般的な医療啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Adenovirus and Mycoplasma Leave Distinct Biomarker Fingerprints in
article.articleSummary: From Hangzhou Children's Hospital, China, a retrospective cohort of 6,093 pediatric admissions with acute respiratory tract infections (0–18 years) from Jan 5, 2023 to Jun 17, 2025 used a 13-target pharyngeal-swab panel (collapsed into 11 pathogen groups) and evaluated associations with inflammatory biomarkers (CRP ≥20 mg/L; PCT ≥0.5 ng/mL) and hospital stay ≥7 days. Of participants, 2,076 were panel-negative, 3,343 had a single pathogen, and 674 had multiple detections. Adenovirus detection doubled the odds of elevated biomarkers (CRP OR 2.19, 95% CI 1.63–2.96; PCT OR 1.93, 95% CI 1.34–2.77). Mycoplasma pneumoniae linked to lower PCT elevation (OR 0.22, 95% CI 0.13–0.37) but strongly predicted longer hospitalization (OR 2.57 for ≥7 days; 2.50 in the 24h subset, 2.76 in the 48h subset). Co-detections increased odds of longer stay (OR 2.21, 95% CI 1.73–2.82). Limitations: retrospective design; cannot prove causality; potential confounders include treatment and illness severity. Published in BMC Infectious Diseases.

article.articleHeadline: Число погибших от Эболы в ДР Конго превысило 4 тысячи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola death toll in the DRC has exceeded 4,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-02, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 4,000 deaths. INSP reports about 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces, with 2,162 recoveries and a case-fatality rate of 48.4%. The figures may change after regional verification. The epidemic has spread to seven provinces, with warnings of potential cross-border transmission to neighboring countries. In response, Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor has tightened sanitary controls at its borders. Vladimir Nikiforov, professor and head of the Department of Infectious Diseases and Epidemiology at the N.I. Pirogov Russian National Medical University, told Zvezdanews that Ebola cannot reach Russia, describing it as a localized outbreak confined to the DRC.

article.articleHeadline: RespiraTB Ciptaan Mahasiswa UII Bisa Pantau Gejala TBC Secara Real-Time
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RespiraTB, a creation by UII students, can monitor TB symptoms in real time.
article.articleSummary: RespiraTB, a wearable platform developed by Universitas Islam Indonesia (UII) students in Yogyakarta, provides real-time, non-invasive screening for tuberculosis (TB) by continuously monitoring breathing characteristics. The accelerometer/IMU-based device tracks chest-wall movement and work of breathing; data are processed on ESP32 with filtering and a threshold-based respiratory risk score, then transmitted to a mobile app via Firebase. It is intended as an initial screening tool, not a substitute for clinical diagnosis. Lab testing shows respiratory-rate accuracy of 96.28% versus manual counts, with a maximum deviation of one breath per minute; MPU6050 accuracy 92.08% against Esophageal Pressure Catheter, and ESP32-to-app transmission success 100% with an average 2.2 seconds. The team—Afwan Aditya Saputra, Huda Nur Ihsan Muhammad Akbar, Isfana Fatimah Darman—developed under Ali Parkhan and showcased at The 12th UTU Awards 2026. Initial markets cover West, East, and Central Java; TAM about Rp1.035 trillion/year; first-year sales 1,380 units at Rp950,000.

article.articleHeadline: 台灣流感高峰 日本病例暴增 疾管署籲快打疫苗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Taiwan's influenza peak; Japan sees surge in cases; Taiwan CDC urges vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan's seasonal influenza activity remains volatile near a peak, with Japan and Korea also seeing rising cases. Taiwan's CDC urges rapid vaccination amid multiple holidays and travel. In Japan, nationwide surveillance shows 31,000 influenza cases in the week ending Sept 20, averaging 8.48 cases per facility and up 53% from the prior week, tenfold year-on-year. Detectable viruses are about 98% influenza A(H1N1), and people aged 70+ account for 47.5%. Of Japan's 47 prefectures, 44 report increases, with Okinawa the most affected, followed by Tokyo, Aichi, Kanagawa, and Chiba; the surge is linked to Silver Week, with nine consecutive weeks of rise. Across Asia and the US, influenza activity is also climbing (China, Hong Kong, Korea, Singapore, United States). Taiwan began its flu and COVID vaccination drive on Oct 1; first-day doses reached 266,000 (flu) and 100,000 (COVID), the highest in recent years. Lin Ming-cheng stresses dual vaccination reduces pneumonia and cardiovascular risk; high-risk groups should vaccinate.

triage.headline_ja: 台湾インフルエンザ流行ピーク、日本で症例急増、台湾疾病管制署がワクチン接種を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の例年起こりうる流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれにも明確に該当せず、対象国における特段の異常性も認められない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾・日本における季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の流行状況とワクチン接種促進。中国・香港・韓国・シンガポール・米国は『同様に増加傾向』として簡潔に言及されるのみで主題ではないため、対象国リストに含まれる中国も verified_locations から除外した。季節性インフルエンザの通常変動範囲内と判断。

article.articleHeadline: 2.675 Penderita TBC Ditemukan di Sulbar Sepanjang 2026, 269 Meninggal Dunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 2,675 TB patients were found in West Sulawesi throughout 2026; 269 died.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis cases in West Sulawesi, Indonesia, reached 2,675 detected in 2026, with 269 deaths during treatment. The West Sulawesi Health Office (DKPPKB) uses cohort-based evaluation for TB management, noting treatment lasts at least six months. In the 2025 treatment cohort (patients starting in 2024), 3,895 began therapy and 3,358 were cured; 236 defaulted and 231 died. For 2026 (treatment period 2025), 3,942 began treatment and 3,268 completed; 269 died and 173 defaulted. Case-finding has fluctuated in recent years: 2020 estimated 4,445 cases, 2,264 found and 2,067 treated; 2021 2,409 found and 2,239 treated; 2022 2,939 found and 2,781 treated; 2024 found 4,089 and 3,895 started treatment. The data highlight a sustained TB burden in the region, underscoring ongoing needs for case finding and treatment adherence.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年通年で西スラウェシ州にて2,675人の結核患者が確認、269人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の地域流行病であり、既存の保健システムによるルーティンのサーベイランス・治療プログラムの一環としての報告であるため、新規性や緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 結核は慢性的な風土病であり、本記事は地域保健当局による年次統計報告の性格が強い。新規アウトブレイクや異常事態を示す記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : la pire épidémie de l'histoire du pays franchit la barre des 4 000 morts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the worst epidemic in the country's history has crossed the 4,000-death mark
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola virus disease outbreak has become the country’s deadliest on record, now surpassing 4,000 deaths. The episode is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC’s history and, within a few months, has become the most lethal documented in this vast Central African nation. According to Congolese authorities, the death toll crossed the 4,000 threshold as of Friday, October 2, 2026. The update underscores the sustained severity of the outbreak in the DRC, with authorities providing current tallies on the evolving situation. The article highlights the scale of the epidemic in the DRC and marks a grim milestone in the country’s long history with Ebola, reflecting a public health emergency of significant magnitude.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：同国史上最悪の流行、死者数4,000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最悪規模のエボラ流行となり死者4,000人を超えており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAに進むべき事案。
triage.notes: DRC史上17回目かつ最も致死的なエボラ流行とされ、死者数が4,000人を超えたことが報告されている。国際的拡大や渡航制限の有無については記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ribuan Orang Melarikan Diri dari Kamp Pengungsi yang Terdampak Ebola di Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thousands of People Flee from an Ebola-Affected Refugee Camp in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Thousands fled from the Ebola-affected Kigonze refugee camp in Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, after a security operation forced many to abandon the site that previously housed about 19,000 people. Residents escaped as security forces entered to seize weapons and members of armed groups, with gunfire reported during the operation. The United Nations warned that the challenge of stopping Ebola transmission in the DRC is becoming harder. A transit center for Ebola at Kigonze was burned down this week, hampering outbreak containment. The facility, run by the International Medical Corps and supported by more than 50 staff, was used to isolate and screen suspected cases before patients were moved on for care. This update is based on UN statements dated 1 October 2026, with the report published on 3 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラの影響を受けた難民キャンプから数千人が避難
triage.triage_reason: エボラ流行地域での治安作戦により隔離・検疫施設が焼失し、数千人が避難する事態となり、感染拡大防止策が阻害されているため、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: エボラ対応のための隔離・検疫施設(Kigonze transit center)が焼失し、約19,000人が居住していたキャンプから住民が避難。感染者の追跡・隔離が困難となり、アウトブレイク制御に重大な支障が生じている。UNも感染拡大阻止の困難化を警告しており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Xác định các điểm nguy cơ, phòng chống sốt xuất huyết trong mùa mưa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Identify high-risk areas and dengue fever prevention during the rainy season.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is an acute viral infection transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes and is a growing concern in Da Nang City during the rainy season. Laboratory data for January–September 2026 show 39 of 56 tested samples positive (70%), all of dengue virus serotype 2 (D2), a strain linked to severe disease. To curb spread, the Da Nang City Center for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) and partners intensify surveillance, deploy field teams to wards with rising cases, and monitor mosquito density and larval habitats to identify risk points. Interventions include larval source reduction, larviciding, spraying at outbreak sites, and community sanitation. Public messaging spans media, social networks, internet platforms, SMS, and the 1022 hotline. Citizens are urged to check water containers 10–15 minutes daily, cover or discard standing water, participate in vector-control campaigns, consider dengue vaccination for those 4 years and older, and seek prompt medical care for fever.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季におけるデング熱予防のための高リスク地点の特定
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ダナン市でデング熱（重症化しやすい血清型D2）の陽性率上昇が報告されているが、既知の季節性感染症で通常の対策範囲内であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。
triage.notes: 地方CDCによる通常の季節対応であり、D2血清型による重症化リスクに言及あるが、現時点で大規模流行や国際的懸念を示す情報はない。続報を注視。

article.articleHeadline: ΛΔ Κονγκό: Ξεπέρασαν τους 4.000 οι νεκροί από την πιο φονική επιδημία Έμπολα στην ιστορία της χώρας
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: The death toll from the most deadly Ebola outbreak in the country's history has surpassed 4,000.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo, attributed to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has surpassed 4,000 deaths, making it the country’s deadliest Ebola outbreak and the second-worst globally after West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic. Despite sporadic signs of stabilization in parts of Ituri Province, transmission continues to spread in the eastern DRC and has reached a seventh province, South Ubangi, after the death of a traveler. As of October 2, 2026, confirmed cases are around 8,300 with more than 2,000 recoveries. Health authorities and the United Nations are intensifying efforts to contain the outbreak, but officials have not yet halted transmission.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴ:同国史上最も致死的なエボラ流行による死者が4000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ流行がDRコンゴ史上最悪となり、複数州へ拡大、国際的拡大リスクも高くIHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC国内（Ituri州、South Ubangi州等）の流行のみが言及されており、Angolaでの発生は確認できないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: What Is Mpox (Monkeypox)?
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) is a viral disease with two clades: Congo Basin (up to 10% mortality) and West African (about 1% mortality; the 2022 outbreak). There is no mpox-specific approved treatment; antivirals developed for smallpox may help, usually reserved for immunocompromised patients: cidofovir, brincidovir (Tembexa), and tecovirimat (Tpoxx). Incubation is 5–21 days; initial flu-like symptoms (fever, headache, muscle aches, lymphadenopathy, fatigue) precede a rash that begins on the face and spreads to the hands and feet. Transmission occurs through close contact with infected people or animals, including respiratory secretions, lesions, or contaminated materials; animal exposure includes bites, scratches, meat, or products. Pregnant individuals can pass the virus to a fetus. Diagnosis relies on PCR from lesion samples. Vaccines: JYNNEOS (two-dose, approved 2019; up to 85% effective; effective within four days of exposure) and ACAM2000 (single-dose). Mpox is typically self-limiting in 14–21 days, though severe disease and complications can occur, especially in children.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox（サル痘）とは何か？
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生イベントに関する報道ではなく、Mpoxの一般的な疾患解説記事であるため、トリアージ対象のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は疾患の一般的な医学解説（症状、治療法、ワクチン等）であり、具体的な発生国や患者数等の情報は記載されていない。発生地域として付与されているDRC、ナイジェリア、アンゴラも記事本文中で具体的な発生事例として言及されていないため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll in DRC passes 4,000, as health workers are fighting to get paid
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has killed 4,018 people and infected 8,300, according to Health Ministry figures released on Thursday. The authorities characterize this as the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history, with ongoing transmission across the DRC challenging containment. The situation is further strained by reports that health workers are fighting to receive pay, potentially affecting the response. These figures—4,018 deaths among 8,300 cases—represent the latest update from the Health Ministry as authorities continue efforts to control transmission in affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでエボラ出血熱の死者数が4,000人を超える、医療従事者は給与未払いで闘争中
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の死者数・感染者数が多く、過去最速の拡大とされ、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と制御の困難さが認められるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 医療従事者への給与未払いが対応能力に影響を与えている点が懸念材料。続報でのWHO通知の有無、感染拡大地域の詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola di Kongo sebabkan 4.018 orang meninggal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kongo causes 4,018 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused more than 4,000 deaths, with nearly 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces as of 2026-10-03. The outbreak records 8,300 cases and 4,018 fatalities, a case-fatality rate of 48.4%, with about 2,162 recoveries. Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya warns Ebola poses a threat to neighboring countries. The figures come from Actualite, citing the National Institute for Public Health in Congo (INSP). The report, relayed by Sputnik via ANTARA, notes ongoing transmission across seven provinces and highlights cross-border risk, though it provides no symptom detail or laboratory confirmation specifics.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱により4,018人死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで7州にわたり8,300症例・4,018人死亡（致死率48.4%）という大規模流行が継続しており、Africa CDCが近隣国への拡大リスクを警告していることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事は症状詳細や検査確認の具体情報を欠くが、致死率48.4%・7州にわたる継続的伝播・越境リスクの明示的警告があり、フルリスク評価に進むべき事案。

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ebola: le bilan dépasse le seuil des 4.000 morts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: Death toll surpasses 4,000.
article.articleSummary: As of October 2, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 4,018 deaths from 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces, with 2,162 recoveries and a case fatality rate of 48.4%, according to the latest Ministry of Health update. The report notes potential undercounting, warning that the true toll is likely higher due to gaps in surveillance and case detection highlighted by Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF). This outbreak is the largest and deadliest on record in the DRC and ranks as the second-largest Ebola outbreak worldwide, behind the West Africa epidemic of 2014–2016. The article provides only official counts; no details on clinical symptoms, infection sources, or exported/imported cases are given beyond the confirmed diagnoses.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国/エボラ出血熱：死者数が4,000人の大台を突破
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラアウトブレイクが継続中で、死者数4,000人超・致死率48.4%と深刻な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも否定できないためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: MSFはサーベイランスのギャップにより実際の症例数・死亡者数はさらに多い可能性を指摘。史上最大・最も致死的なDRC国内アウトブレイクであり、世界的にも2014-2016年の西アフリカ流行に次ぐ規模。

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ebola : recul de l'épidémie dans plusieurs zones de santé malgré un bilan dépassant 4.000 morts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: Outbreak wanes in several health zones despite a death toll exceeding 4,000.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) shows localized gains despite a death toll surpassing 4,000. Health authorities report 4,018 deaths among 8,300 laboratory-confirmed cases across seven provinces, with 2,162 recoveries and a case-fatality rate of 48.4%. Of 63 health zones affected since the start, 12 have recorded no new cases for 42 days, and eight others no new cases for 22–42 days, indicating regional improvements. Kinshasa health officials say zones are beginning to pre-empt transmission, though insecurity continues to hinder access and hampers case detection and interruption of transmission chains. MSF cautions that the true toll may be higher due to surveillance gaps. Declared in May last year, this outbreak is the largest and deadliest in the DRC and the second-largest globally after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: DRC/エボラ: 死者数が4,000人を超える中、複数の保健地区で流行が沈静化
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおける過去最大規模のエボラ流行（死者4,018人、CFR 48.4%）が継続中であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常な規模（史上2番目の規模）が確認されるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事本文・サマリーともにDRC国内の状況のみに言及しており、Angolaでの発生は確認されないため除外した。治安悪化によるアクセス制限とサーベイランスギャップ（MSF指摘）により実際の被害規模は過小評価されている可能性がある。
